papers.title: TailLoR: Protecting Principal Components in Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient finetuning methods based on spectral decomposition have enabled progress in Continual Learning. In this paper we introduce TailLoR, which utilizes the singular bases U and V of the pre-trained weights as a fixed reference frame to learn a low-rank update applied to the singular value matrix. A soft spectral penalty discourages updates aligned with dominant singular directions, reducing interference while routing fine-grained adaptation into the highly flexible, long-tail spectral coordinates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TailLoR，一种基于谱分解的参数高效连续学习方法。它利用预训练权重的奇异基U和V作为固定参考框架，学习低秩更新应用于奇异值矩阵，并通过软谱惩罚抑制与主导奇异方向对齐的更新，从而将细粒度适应路由到长尾谱坐标以减少干扰。
Motivation: 现有基于谱分解的参数高效微调方法在连续学习中存在更新干扰问题，需要一种方法将适应性引导到灵活的长尾谱坐标。
Method: 使用预训练权重的奇异基U和V作为固定参考框架，学习应用于奇异值矩阵的低秩更新，并施加软谱惩罚以鼓励更新集中在非主导奇异方向。
Conclusion: 该论文介绍了一种通过软谱惩罚将细粒度适应路由到长尾谱坐标的方法，以减少连续学习中的干扰。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract_en: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HANDOFF，一种通过多教师知识蒸馏训练的人形机器人全身控制器，使用紧凑的显式命令空间，实现全身运动跟踪、行走和跌倒恢复，并在Unitree G1上展示了自然语言驱动的任务执行。
Motivation: 现有全身控制器通常需要密集的运动学或空间参考，而任务规划器难以从任务语义中合成这些参考，因此需要一种更直观、通用且表达能力强的紧凑接口。
Method: 使用三种互补的专家（全身运动跟踪、行走、跌倒恢复）通过上下文条件门控机制进行多教师KL蒸馏，训练一个混合专家（MoE）学生模型。
Result: 在Unitree G1上，HANDOFF匹配了最先进的速度跟踪性能，并提供了最大的鲁棒操作工作空间之一；通过VLM驱动的智能体规划器实现了多个人类语言驱动的任务部署。
Conclusion: HANDOFF展示了紧凑命令空间与蒸馏策略在人形机器人全身控制中的有效性，支持自然语言驱动的任务执行，无需任务特定数据或控制器微调。

papers.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. Existing methods inject this knowledge as long inputs (retrieved through RAG or dependency analysis) or through per-repository fine-tuning and LoRA -- costly at repository scale and brittle to evolving codebases. We introduce Code2LoRA, a hypernetwork framework that generates repository-specific LoRA adapters, effectively injecting repository knowledge with zero inference-time token overhead. Code2LoRA supports two usage scenarios: Code2LoRA-Static converts a single repository snapshot into an adapter, suitable for comprehension of stable codebases; while Code2LoRA-Evo maintains an adapter backed by a GRU hidden state updated per code diff, suitable for active development of evolving codebases. To evaluate Code2LoRA against parameter-efficient fine-tuning baselines, we build RepoPeftBench, a benchmark of 604 Python repositories with two tracks: a static track with 40K training and 12K test assertion-completion tasks, and an evolution track with 215K commit-derived training and 87K commit-derived test tasks. On the static track, Code2LoRA-Static achieves 63.8% cross-repo and 66.2% in-repo exact match, matching the per-repository LoRA upper bound; on the evolution track, Code2LoRA-Evo achieves 60.3% cross-repo exact match (+5.2 pp over a single shared LoRA). Code2LoRA's code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/code2lora-6857; the model checkpoints and RepoPeftBench datasets can be found at https://huggingface.co/code2lora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Code2LoRA，一个超网络框架，能够生成仓库特定的LoRA适配器，无需增加推理时的词元开销。支持静态代码库（Code2LoRA-Static）和演化代码库（Code2LoRA-Evo，基于GRU隐藏状态更新）。在作者构建的RepPeftBench基准上，静态任务达到66.2%的仓库内精确匹配，演化任务比共享LoRA提升5.2个百分点。
Motivation: 现有的仓库级代码模型依赖长输入（RAG或依赖分析）或每仓库微调（LoRA），成本高且难以适应代码演化。需要一种零推理开销、能动态适应代码变更的知识注入方法。
Method: 提出Code2LoRA框架，使用超网络为每个仓库生成LoRA适配器。静态模式将单个仓库快照转换为适配器；演化模式通过GRU网络处理代码差异序列，维持并更新适配器。作者还构建了包含604个Python仓库的RepPeftBench基准，含静态和演化两个评测任务集。
Result: 静态评测中，Code2LoRA-Static实现跨仓库63.8%和仓库内66.2%的精确匹配，与每仓库独立LoRA性能相当；演化评测中，Code2LoRA-Evo实现跨仓库60.3%精确匹配，比单一共享LoRA提高5.2个百分点。
Conclusion: Code2LoRA通过超网络生成仓库感知的LoRA适配器，有效注入仓库知识，零推理开销且适应代码演化，性能接近或超过每仓库微调方案。

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TempoVLA，一种通过显式速度条件控制机器人执行速度的视觉-语言-动作模型。核心包含数据侧的可变速度轨迹增强（VSTA）和模型侧的速度调节机制，能在仿真和真实任务中实现灵活的速度控制，包括加速和减速。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）从训练演示中继承单一固定速度，加速方法仅将其移至另一固定速度，而减速几乎未被探索。需要一种能根据任务阶段动态调整速度的控制器。
Method: TempoVLA由两部分组成：（1）数据侧的可变速度轨迹增强（VSTA），通过合并或拆分动作重新计时演示轨迹，达到任意目标速度并保持运动语义；（2）模型侧的条件机制，将速度作为策略输入。
Result: 统计显示VSTA达到目标速度且运动误差极小。实验表明TempoVLA在仿真和真实任务中实现双向柔性速度控制，同时VSTA通过更好的数据利用提升了默认1×速度的性能。与大模型协作时，还能在低风险阶段加速、高风险阶段减速。
Conclusion: TempoVLA为VLA模型提供了可控制的速度调节能力，未来可进一步探索与其他基础模型的集成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with \emph{adaptive} opponents who can respond based on histories of play. The standard metric of \emph{external regret} in online learning is known to fail to capture such adaptivity. To account for players' counterfactual reasoning, we introduce {\tt Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)}, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the \emph{realized} and the \emph{best-in-hindsight} accumulated utility when all players can \emph{respond} to the history of play. Compared to existing regret notions in this setting, ours is native to repeated game playing, enabling stronger comparators and opponents with fewer constraints, while maintaining the possibility of finding better equilibria when all players minimize it. We first identify necessary conditions for obtaining {\tt RP-Regret} sublinear in time, on the variation of the player's comparator strategies in the regret definition and on the memories of both the comparator and opponents' strategies. We then study additional conditions and provable algorithms to minimize {\tt RP-Regret}, which is by definition \emph{non-convex} in the strategy space. To address this challenge, we propose three algorithms: (i) one based on an optimization oracle, as assumed in some prior work in online non-convex learning; (ii) one that minimizes a convex and \emph{linearized} surrogate of {\tt RP-Regret} at each iteration; (iii) one that directly minimizes {\tt RP-Regret} when opponents change strategies slowly. Furthermore, when all players can run algorithms to minimize the {\tt RP-Regret} (or its linearized variant), certain subgame perfect equilibria of the repeated game can be learned. We also provide experiments showing that minimizing our regret notions can lead to more cooperative solutions with higher utility in games such as Stag-Hunt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对重复博弈中的自适应对手，提出了一种新的遗憾度量——重复策略遗憾（RP-Regret），该度量考虑了所有玩家根据历史进行反事实推理的能力。作者给出了RP-Regret随时间次线性的必要条件是玩家比较器策略的变化量以及比较器和对手策略的记忆有限性。进一步提出了三种算法：基于优化oracle的算法、最小化凸线性化替代的算法、以及对手策略缓慢变化时直接最小化的算法。当所有玩家都最小化RP-Regret或其线性化变体时，可以学习到重复博弈的某些子博弈完美均衡。实验表明，在Stag-Hunt等博弈中最小化该遗憾能导致更高效用的合作解。
Motivation: 标准的外部遗憾（external regret）无法捕捉自适应对手的响应行为，需要一种能反映玩家反事实推理的博弈论度量。
Method: 定义了RP-Regret，并提出了三种算法：基于优化oracle的算法、最小化非凸RP-Regret的凸线性化替代函数、以及对手策略缓慢变化时直接最小化RP-Regret的算法。
Result: 给出了RP-Regret次线性的必要条件；所提算法可以学习子博弈完美均衡；实验表明在Stag-Hunt等博弈中最小化该遗憾能实现更高平均效用的合作策略。
Conclusion: RP-Regret天然适用于重复博弈，允许更强的比较器和更弱的对手约束，且所有玩家最小化该遗憾时可能发现更好的均衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PAR3D: A Unified 3D-MLLM with Part-Aware Representation for Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D multimodal large language models (3D-MLLMs) have enabled unified solutions for 3D scene understanding tasks, including visual question answering, captioning, and referring segmentation. However, existing 3D-MLLMs remain largely object-centric, limiting their ability to model fine-grained part structures that are essential for embodied interaction with 3D environments. In this work, we present PAR3D, a unified part-aware 3D-MLLM framework that enables models to understand, reason about, and ground both objects and their parts in 3D scenes. To enable training and evaluation of part-aware 3D scene understanding, we introduce ScenePart, a synthetic 3D scene dataset with part-level annotations and language instructions. We further develop Part-Aware 3D Representation Learning to enrich 3D visual representations with fine-grained part-level semantics, and propose Hierarchical Segmentation Query Generation to ground part targets via hierarchical object-part queries. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves part-level question answering and referring segmentation, while also achieving strong performance across object-level vision-language tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAR3D，一个统一的部件感知3D多模态大语言模型（3D-MLLM）框架，用于场景理解。现有3D-MLLM主要关注物体整体，缺乏对细粒度部件结构的建模。作者引入合成数据集ScenePart（带部件级标注和语言指令），开发部件感知3D表示学习（Part-Aware 3D Representation Learning）和层次分割查询生成（Hierarchical Segmentation Query Generation）。实验表明，该方法在部件级问答和指代分割任务上显著提升，同时在物体级视觉语言任务上保持强性能。
Motivation: 现有3D-MLLM以物体为中心，难以建模细粒度部件结构，限制了与3D环境的具身交互。需要统一的部件感知框架以支持部件级别的理解、推理和定位。
Method: 提出PAR3D框架，包含三部分：1) 合成数据集ScenePart，提供部件级3D标注和自然语言指令；2) 部件感知3D表示学习，将细粒度部件语义融入3D视觉表示；3) 层次分割查询生成，通过物体-部件层次查询定位部件目标。
Result: 在部件级问答和指代分割任务上性能显著提升，同时在物体级视觉语言任务上保持强性能（例如视觉问答、描述生成等）。
Conclusion: PAR3D验证了部件感知建模对于3D场景理解的有效性，为未来3D-MLLM的细粒度交互提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出PAR3D，一个统一的部件感知3D多模态大语言模型（3D-MLLM）框架，用于场景理解。现有3D-MLLM主要关注物体整体，缺乏对细粒度部件结构的建模。作者引入合成数据集ScenePart（带部件级标注和语言指令），开发部件感知3D表示学习（Part-Aware 3D Representation Learning）和层次分割查询生成（Hierarchical Segmentation Query Generation）。实验表明，该方法在部件级问答和指代分割任务上显著提升，同时在物体级视觉语言任务上保持强性能。

summary_sections.conclusion: PAR3D验证了部件感知建模对于3D场景理解的有效性，为未来3D-MLLM的细粒度交互提供了基础。

papers.title: Operation-Guided Progressive Human-to-AI Text Transformation Benchmark for Multi-Granularity AI-Text Detection
papers.abstract_en: As AI writing assistants become increasingly integrated into real-world drafting and revision workflows, many documents are no longer purely human-written or AI-generated, but instead result from progressive human-AI co-editing. However, existing AI-text detection benchmarks largely focus on final outputs and provide limited understanding of how AI authorship signals emerge, accumulate, or disappear throughout the revision process. We introduce OpAI-Bench, an operation-guided benchmark for studying progressive human-to-AI text transformation across document, sentence, token, and span granularities. Starting from human-written documents, OpAI-Bench constructs nine sequentially revised versions for each sample under predefined AI coverage levels and five representative AI edit operations, covering four domains while preserving complete authorship provenance at multiple granularities. The benchmark supports comprehensive evaluation with 8 document-level detectors, 7 sentence-level detectors, and 2 fine-grained token/span-level detectors. Experiments reveal that AI-text detectability is governed not only by the proportion of AI-edited content, but also by edit operation, domain, and cumulative revision history. Interestingly, we notice that mixed-authorship intermediate versions are often harder to detect than both fully human and heavily AI-edited endpoints, exposing non-monotonic detection patterns missed by existing benchmarks. OpAI-Bench provides a controlled testbed for analyzing whether, when, and how AI-assisted writing becomes detectable under realistic progressive editing scenarios. Our code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/OpAI-Bench.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpAI-Bench，一个操作引导的渐进式人类到AI文本转换基准，用于多粒度AI文本检测。该基准从人类撰写文档开始，通过九种渐进修订版本、五种AI编辑操作和四个领域构建数据，保留完整作者来源。实验发现AI文本可检测性不仅受AI编辑比例影响，还受编辑操作、领域和累积修订历史影响，混合作者版本更难检测。结论强调OpAI-Bench为渐进式AI辅助写作检测提供受控测试平台。
Motivation: 现有AI文本检测基准多关注最终输出，缺乏对AI作者信号在修订过程中如何涌现、累积或消失的理解。
Method: 构建OpAI-Bench基准，从人类文档出发，按预定义AI覆盖水平和五种代表性AI编辑操作生成九个渐进修订版本，覆盖文档、句子、词元和跨度粒度。
Result: 实验显示AI文本可检测性受编辑操作、领域和修订历史影响，混合作者中间版本比纯人类和高度AI编辑端点更难检测，呈现非单调模式。
Conclusion: OpAI-Bench为分析渐进式AI辅助写作在现实场景中是否、何时以及如何变得可检测提供了受控测试台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DNQ: Deep Nash Q-Network for Partially Observable n-Player Games
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world competitive systems require multiple decision-makers to act simultaneously under shared constraints, limited information, and repeated interaction, as in auctions, resource allocation, and security competition. We study multi-turn simultaneous bidding as a controlled testbed for such problems and propose DNQ, a solver-in-the-loop equilibrium supervision framework for training bidding agents. DNQ alternates between trajectory collection, critic-based payoff estimation, equilibrium computation, and policy imitation. At each visited state, a shared critic predicts either pairwise payoff matrices or an exact N-player payoff tensor, an external solver computes equilibrium strategies, and the agents are trained by minimizing the KL divergence between their masked policies and the solver-derived equilibrium targets. We focus on a scalable pairwise formulation that greatly reduces equilibrium-solving cost and training time compared with the exact formulation, while the shared critic amortizes payoff learning across agents and states. Experiments compare the pairwise and exact variants using critic loss, policy entropy, bidding resource usage, and training cost, showing that the pairwise method scales to larger numbers of agents, whereas the exact method becomes computationally impractical as the joint game grows. These results illustrate the trade-off between strategic fidelity and scalability in repeated competitive environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DNQ（Deep Nash Q-Network），一个用于部分可观测n人博弈的求解器-在环均衡监督框架。DNQ交替进行轨迹收集、评论家基的收益估计、均衡计算和策略模仿，通过最小化掩码策略与均衡目标之间的KL散度来训练智能体。实验比较了成对和精确两种变体，显示成对方法在智能体数量上更具扩展性。
Motivation: 许多现实竞争系统需要多个决策者在共享约束、有限信息和重复交互下同时行动，现有方法在均衡计算的可扩展性和策略学习方面存在不足。
Method: 提出DNQ框架，包含共享评论家预测收益矩阵（成对或精确），外部求解器计算均衡策略，并通过KL散度进行策略模仿。
Result: 实验表明成对方法在评论家损失、策略熵、竞标资源使用和训练成本上优于精确方法，且可扩展至更多智能体，而精确方法在联合博弈增长时变得计算上不可行。
Conclusion: 在重复竞争环境中，战略保真度和可扩展性之间存在权衡，成对方法提供了更实用的均衡近似。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$. SMT acquires these memory labels by training a Transformer-based encoder on a predictive state objective--retaining only information from the past necessary to predict the future. By decoupling what to remember from how to update memory, SMT enables time-parallel RNN training with a stable $O(1)$ length gradient path between any two tokens--without ever unrolling the RNN. We find that SMT outperforms BPTT when pretraining various RNN architectures on tasks like language modeling and pixel sequence modeling. SMT enables nonlinear RNNs to better capture long-range dependencies and train in parallel, potentially unlocking the scaling of models that build temporal abstractions of past experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出监督记忆训练（Supervised Memory Training, SMT），通过将RNN训练转化为一步记忆转移标签上的监督学习，完全绕过了循环信用分配。SMT使用Transformer编码器从预测状态目标中获取记忆标签，实现时间并行训练和稳定的O(1)长度梯度路径。实验表明，SMT在语言建模和像素序列建模等任务上优于BPTT，使非线性RNN能更好地捕捉长程依赖。
Motivation: 标准BPTT在训练RNN时存在时序并行性差和梯度消失/爆炸问题，难以学习长程关联。
Method: 提出SMT，先训练Transformer编码器以预测目标状态提取记忆标签，然后将RNN训练简化为监督学习任务，无需展开RNN。
Result: 在语言建模和像素序列建模任务上，SMT训练的各种RNN架构优于BPTT，实现了更好的长程依赖建模和并行训练。
Conclusion: SMT通过解耦记忆内容与更新机制，为RNN提供了一种稳定、可并行的预训练方法，可能推动构建时间抽象模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Complexity-Balanced Diffusion Splitting
papers.abstract_en: Standard continuous-time generative models rely on monolithic architectures that must navigate vastly different signal regimes, from isotropic noise to intricate data distributions. While scaling model capacity improves performance, deploying a massive network uniformly across the entire generative timeline is inherently inefficient. In this work, we propose Complexity-Balanced Splitting (CBS), a principled framework for temporal capacity allocation that distributes the generative workload across multiple specialized sub-networks. Grounded in function approximation theory and de Boor's equidistribution principle, CBS partitions the diffusion timeline into segments of equal approximation burden, allocating more representational capacity to regions where the generative dynamics are more difficult to model. To estimate this local complexity, we introduce two complementary and tractable monitor functions: a spatial measure based on the flow's Dirichlet energy, and a geometric measure based on the acceleration of the sampling trajectories. Using a lightweight auxiliary model to estimate these complexity profiles, our approach eliminates the need for heuristic temporal splits or computationally expensive search procedures. Extensive evaluation across multiple architectures (SiT, JiT, and UNet) and datasets demonstrates that CBS consistently improves synthesis quality without increasing per-step inference cost. In particular, CBS improves FID by ~35% on SiT-XL with CFG relative to naive temporal partitioning. Project page is available at https://noamissachar.github.io/CBS/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出复杂度平衡扩散分割（CBS）框架，通过将扩散时间线划分为近似负担相等的片段，并分配不同的表示容量，从而在不增加每步推理成本的情况下提高生成质量。实验表明，在SiT-XL上使用CFG时，FID改善了约35%。
Motivation: 标准连续时间生成模型使用单一架构处理从各向同性噪声到复杂数据分布的多种信号状态，大规模网络均匀部署在整个时间线上效率低下。
Method: CBS基于函数逼近理论和de Boor的等分布原则，将扩散时间线划分为近似负担相等的片段，引入基于流Dirichlet能量的空间监控函数和基于采样轨迹加速度的几何监控函数来估计局部复杂度，使用轻量辅助模型分配容量。
Result: 在多种架构（SiT、JiT、UNet）和数据集上，CBS一致提升合成质量，不增加每步推理成本。在SiT-XL上使用CFG时，FID改善约35%。
Conclusion: CBS是一种原则性的时间容量分配框架，通过消除启发式时间分割或昂贵搜索，提高了扩散模型效率。

papers.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning capabilities, their spatial reasoning abilities remain largely constrained to the observed images and text-oriented chain-of-thought. They often struggle to infer unobserved layouts, maintain cross-view consistency, and reason from alternative viewpoints when only limited egocentric observations are available. In this work, we study this problem as thinking with imagination, where a VLM actively acquires imagined visual evidence by interacting with a world simulator during reasoning. We propose Astra, an agentic spatial reasoning framework that empowers VLMs with action-conditioned visual imagination. Specifically, Astra couples Astra-VL, an RL-trained VLM policy, with Astra-WM, a Bagel-based world simulator that generates novel-view observations from context images and natural-language camera motions. To provide reliable imagined evidence, Astra-WM is trained with view consistency tuning to improve pose and content consistency across views. In the RL stage, we propose a world-simulator-in-the-loop two-phase RL curriculum to stabilize tool-use exploration and advance the model's ability to invoke the simulator only when imagined observations improve over direct answering. Experiments demonstrate that both the world simulator and the agentic policy are necessary: Astra-WM improves simulator-augmented Gemini-3-Flash on MMSI-Bench from 45.1 to 49.5, while Astra-VL improves the Qwen3-VL backbone from 29.8 to 38.8 on MMSI-Bench and from 36.8 to 42.7 on MindCube. These results show that imagined observations can provide useful spatial evidence, but effective world-model-augmented reasoning requires learning when, where, and how to imagine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Astra框架，通过强化学习训练VLM策略（Astra-VL）与基于Bagel的世界模拟器（Astra-WM）协同工作，使VLM在推理时能主动与模拟器交互获取想象视觉证据，提升空间推理能力。在MMSI-Bench和MindCube基准上，Astra-VL相对于基线Qwen3-VL分别提升9.0和5.9个点。
Motivation: 现有VLM在空间推理中难以推断未观测布局、保持跨视角一致性，以及从有限自我中心观测中推理替代视角。
Method: 提出Astra框架：Astra-VL通过强化学习训练VLM策略，Astra-WM是基于Bagel的世界模拟器，能从上下文图像和自然语言相机运动生成新视角观测，并通过视角一致性训练增强姿态与内容一致性。强化学习采用两阶段课程：先稳定工具使用探索，再学习仅在想象观测有助于回答时调用模拟器。
Result: Astra-WM将模拟器增强的Gemini-3-Flash在MMSI-Bench上从45.1提升至49.5；Astra-VL将Qwen3-VL在MMSI-Bench上从29.8提升至38.8，在MindCube上从36.8提升至42.7。
Conclusion: 想象观测能提供有用空间证据，但有效的世界模型增强推理需要学习何时、何地以及如何想象。

papers.title: RREDCoT: Segment-Level Reward Redistribution for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in reasoning language models have been driven by Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. Most often, these rely on the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm or modifications thereof to steer the models to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. The final answer can only be verified, and the reward assigned, after the CoT trace is complete, making it a delayed reward problem. GRPO and its modifications correspond to Monte Carlo methods in standard RL, which are known to suffer from high variance. A possible solution to this problem is the redistribution of rewards through credit assignment, where segments of the CoT trace that are important for arriving at the desirable solution are emphasized by assigning a higher reward. While Monte Carlo sampling can be used to provide an unbiased estimate of intermediate state values, its computational overhead makes it unsuitable for train-time credit assignment in long contexts at high granularity. We introduce RREDCoT (Reward REDistribution for Chain of Thoughts), which utilizes the model itself to approximate the optimal reward redistribution without additional generation. We investigate the advantages of our method compared to MC sampling and several attribution methods. We further analyze several aspects relevant to the construction of the redistribution such as segmentation of CoT traces and state value estimation.

papers.title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel. At each step, they predict tentative tokens for every masked position, committing the confident predictions to the output and discarding the unconfident ones. We show that the discarded tokens are in fact a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation: even low-confidence tokens often surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, enabling retrieval of stronger evidence before the output is finalized. We exploit this through Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI), a dynamic RAG framework that uses these lookahead tokens to guide retrieval during denoising. SARDI is training-free, retriever-agnostic, and applicable to any reasoning-capable discrete diffusion language model. Across five multi-hop QA benchmarks, SARDI outperforms current training-free diffusion and autoregressive retrieval baselines at up to $8\times$ higher throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models (SARDI)，一种无需训练、与检索器无关的动态RAG框架，利用离散扩散语言模型在去噪过程中丢弃的低置信度token作为前瞻信号，引导检索以增强生成。在两个多跳QA基准上，SARDI在高达8倍吞吐量下优于现有无需训练的扩散和自回归检索基线。
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型在并行去噪时丢弃低置信度token，但这些token往往早期包含显著实体，可作为检索的线索，但现有方法未充分利用这一信号。
Method: 提出SARDI框架，在扩散模型的每个去噪步骤中，利用模型预测的但被丢弃的低置信度token作为查询，动态检索相关信息，然后融合回生成过程。无需训练，兼容任何支持推理的离散扩散模型。
Result: 在五个多跳问答基准上，SARDI以高达8倍吞吐量超越了现有的无需训练扩散和自回归检索基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SARDI通过利用扩散模型内部的中间预测信号，实现了高效的动态检索，提升了生成质量且不增加训练成本。

papers.title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks such as scientific discovery and machine learning engineering (MLE), where sustained self-evolution becomes a key capability. However, existing MLE agents suffer from inter-branch information isolation, memoryless search, and lack of hierarchical control, which together hinder long-horizon optimization. We present MLEvolve, an LLM-based self-evolving multi-agent framework for end-to-end machine learning algorithm discovery. By extending tree search to Progressive MCGS, MLEvolve enables cross-branch information flow through graph-based reference edges and gradually shifts the search from broad exploration to focused exploitation with an entropy-inspired progressive schedule. To allow the agent to evolve with accumulated experience, we introduce Retrospective Memory, which combines a cold-start domain knowledge base with a dynamic global memory for task-specific experience retrieval and reuse. For stable long-horizon iteration, we further decouple strategic planning from code generation with adaptive coding modes. Evaluation on MLE-Bench shows that MLEvolve achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple dimensions including average medal rate and valid submission rate under a 12-hour budget (half the standard runtime). Moreover, MLEvolve also outperforms specialized algorithm discovery methods including AlphaEvolve on mathematical algorithm optimization tasks, demonstrating strong cross-domain generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/InternScience/MLEvolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MLEvolve，一个基于大语言模型的自进化多智能体框架，用于端到端机器学习算法发现。通过渐进式MCGS树搜索、跨分支信息流、回溯记忆和自适应编码模式，实现长期优化。在MLE-Bench上取得SOTA结果，并在数学算法优化任务上超越AlphaEvolve。
Motivation: 现有MLE智能体存在分支间信息隔离、无记忆搜索和缺乏层次控制的问题，阻碍长期优化。
Method: 提出MLEvolve，包含渐进式MCGS树搜索（从广探到精搜）、跨分支信息流（图引用边）、回溯记忆（冷启动知识库+动态全局记忆）以及自适应编码模式（解耦策略规划与代码生成）。
Result: 在MLE-Bench上，12小时预算（标准一半时间）内平均奖牌率和有效提交率均达SOTA；在数学算法优化任务上超越AlphaEvolve，展现强跨域泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MLEvolve通过自进化多智能体框架实现了高效的机器学习算法自动发现，并具备跨域泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PC Layer: Polynomial Weight Preconditioning for Improving LLM Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: We propose a preconditioning (PC) layer, a weight parameterization via polynomial preconditioner that ensures stable weight conditioning throughout LLM training. The PC module reshapes the singular-value spectrum of weight matrices via low-degree polynomial preconditioning. After training, the preconditioned weights can be merged back into the original architecture, incurring no inference overhead. We demonstrate the advantage of the proposed PC layer over standard transformers in Llama-1B pre-training, for both the AdamW and Muon optimizers. Theoretically, we justify this spectrum-control principle by proving that uniformly bounding each layer's singular values ensures geometric convergence of gradient descent to global minima, for certain deep linear networks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Empath-aln/PC-layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多项式预处理层（PC layer），作为权重参数化方法，通过低次多项式预处理重塑权重矩阵的奇异值谱，确保LLM训练过程中权重条件的稳定性。训练后预处理权重可合并回原始架构，无推理开销。在Llama-1B预训练中，该方法在使用AdamW和Muon优化器时均优于标准Transformer。理论证明，对于深度线性网络，均匀限制每层奇异值可保证梯度下降几何收敛到全局最小值。
Motivation: LLM预训练中权重矩阵的条件数可能恶化，导致优化不稳定和收敛缓慢。现有方法缺乏一种高效且无推理开销的预处理技术。
Method: 提出PC层，通过在优化器中引入多项式预处理（polynomial preconditioner）来调整权重矩阵的奇异值谱，训练后可将预处理参数合并回原始网络。
Result: 在Llama-1B预训练实验中，PC层在AdamW和Muon优化器下均优于标准Transformer。理论证明在深度线性网络中，均匀有界奇异值保证梯度下降几何收敛到全局最小值。
Conclusion: PC层是一种轻量级、无推理开销的预处理方法，能改善LLM预训练的稳定性，并具有理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How abundant are good interpolators?
papers.abstract_en: Let $S$ be the set of unit norm linear classifiers $θ\in \mathbb{R}^d$ which correctly classify every point of a labeled dataset $(X_i,y_i)_{i=1}^n$, $X_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$, $y_i \in \{-1,+1\}$, with a possibly negative margin $κ$ fixed in advance. Under two natural data-generating distributions of the $(X,y)$ pairs -- a Gaussian mixture model and a logistic model with Gaussian features -- and in the proportional regime $n/d \to α$ with small enough $α$, we establish a large deviation principle on the event that a point $θ$ chosen uniformly at random from $S$ achieves a given generalization error, with high probability over the choice of the data. The associated large deviation rate function is deterministic and describes the proportion, at the exponential scale in $d$, of interpolating classifiers having a given desired performance. As a consequence, we establish the following concentration phenomenon: all but an exponentially small fraction of interpolating classifiers have approximately the same generalization performance given by the unique maximizer of this rate function. We numerically compare this maximizer to the performance of empirical risk minimization by gradient descent and to the performance of a natural linear program, both finding a point in $S$, and deduce that in the overparametrized regime of small $α$, these efficient procedures outperform the vast majority of interpolators, pointing to their nontrivial benign overfitting in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在高维比例极限下，随机选取的线性插值分类器（正确分类所有训练样本）的泛化性能分布。对于高斯混合模型和逻辑模型两种数据分布，作者建立了关于插值分类器泛化误差的大偏差原理，证明了几乎所有插值分类器具有相近的泛化性能，且该性能由某个速率函数的唯一最大值给出。与梯度下降和线性规划找到的插值器相比，后者显著优于随机插值器，揭示了良性过拟合的非平凡性。
Motivation: 现有研究关注特定算法（如最小范数插值器）的泛化性能，但对随机插值器的典型性能缺乏理论刻画。本文旨在回答“好的插值器有多丰富？”的问题，即在高维下随机抽取的插值分类器中，有多少能达到给定的泛化误差。
Method: 采用大偏差原理（large deviation principle）框架，在高斯混合模型和逻辑模型下，对均匀随机选取的线性插值分类器（满足固定负间隔κ）的泛化误差建立大偏差速率函数。该函数是确定性的，并以指数尺度描述具有给定性能的插值器比例。
Result: 在n/d→α且α足够小的过参数化下，所有指数级小比例之外的插值分类器具有近似相同的泛化性能，该性能由速率函数的最大值给出。数值实验显示，通过梯度下降和经验风险最小化得到的插值器优于绝大多数随机插值器，表明这些有效算法能实现非平凡的良性过拟合。
Conclusion: 在高维线性分类中，随机插值器的典型泛化性能集中在一个值附近，而高效算法能找到性能更好的插值器，从而揭示了“好”的插值器虽然稀少但可由算法找到。本文的理论为过参数化模型中的良性过拟合提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Goedel-Architect: Streamlining Formal Theorem Proving with Blueprint Generation and Refinement
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Goedel-Architect, an agentic framework for formal theorem proving in Lean 4 centered on blueprint generation and refinement. A blueprint is a dependency graph of definitions and lemmas that builds up to the main theorem. First, Goedel-Architect generates a blueprint of formally stated definitions and lemmas, along with declared dependencies. This blueprint is optionally guided by a natural language proof. Then, a tool-equipped Lean prover component closes each open lemma node in parallel using relevant dependencies. Failed lemmas in turn drive refinement of the global blueprint. This strategy contrasts with other mainstream approaches which use recursive lemma decomposition, and can inefficiently loop on dead-end strategies. Using the open-weight DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B-A13B) as the backbone, Goedel-Architect attains 99.2% pass@1 on MiniF2F-test and 75.6% pass@1 on PutnamBench. With an optional natural-language proof seeding the initial blueprint on the harder problems, we additionally close the remaining two MiniF2F-test problems (reaching 100%), lift PutnamBench to 88.8% (597/672), and solve 4/6 on IMO 2025, 11/12 on Putnam 2025, and 3/6 on USAMO 2026. This represents state-of-the-art performance for an open-source pipeline at a price point up to 500x less than comparable open-source pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Goedel-Architect，一个在Lean 4中进行形式化定理证明的智能体框架，核心是蓝图生成与精炼。蓝图是由定义和引理构成的依赖图，用于构建主定理。框架首先生成形式化声明及其依赖的蓝图（可选地由自然语言证明引导），然后利用工具装备的Lean证明器并行证明每个未闭合的引理节点，失败的引理驱动全局蓝图的精炼。相比其他递归引理分解方法，该策略避免了陷入死循环。基于开源模型DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B-A13B），Goedel-Architect在MiniF2F-test上达到99.2% pass@1，在PutnamBench上达到75.6% pass@1；若用自然语言证明指导初始蓝图，可在更难的问题上补齐剩余两个MiniF2F-test问题（达到100%），将PutnamBench提升至88.8%（597/672），并在IMO 2025、Putnam 2025、USAMO 2026上分别解决4/6、11/12、3/6。这是开源pipeline的最优性能，且成本比同类开源pipeline低至500倍。
Motivation: 现有形式化定理证明方法多采用递归引理分解，容易在死胡同策略上低效循环，缺乏全局蓝图视角，导致证明效率低下。
Method: 提出Goedel-Architect框架，首先生成包含定义和引理依赖关系的全局蓝图（可选由自然语言证明引导），然后利用一组工具（Lean证明器）并行证明每个引理节点，失败的证明反馈到蓝图层进行精炼，迭代直至所有引理闭合。

papers.title: You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference in modern LLMs is increasingly constrained by decoding efficiency, especially in reasoning-heavy settings where models generate long intermediate chains of thought. Existing sparse attention methods often face a practical efficiency-quality trade-off. Structured block sparse methods typically provide stronger acceleration but incur noticeable quality loss, while token sparse methods are usually more accurate yet deliver limited end-to-end speedup because top-k routing over the full cache remains expensive. In this work, we propose cross-layer sparse attention (CLSA), which is built on top of KV-sharing architectures such as YOCO. The core idea is to share not only the KV cache across cross-decoder layers, but also the routing index. A single indexer computes token-level top-k selection once and reuses the resulting index across layers, thereby preserving the fine-grained selectivity of token sparse attention while amortizing the routing overhead. The resulting architecture improves all major inference bottlenecks jointly, including pre-filling, KV-cache storage, and long-context decoding. Experiments across short-context and long-context benchmarks show that CLSA is both accurate and efficient, achieving up to 7.6x decoding speedup and 17.1x overall throughput improvement at 128K context. These results suggest a more complete architectural solution for long-context LLMs that jointly advances model quality and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨层稀疏注意力（CLSA），在KV共享架构（如YOCO）基础上共享路由索引，只需一次索引计算即可在多个解码层重用，从而保持token级稀疏注意力的高选择性同时分摊路由开销。实验表明，在128K上下文下实现最高7.6倍解码加速和17.1倍整体吞吐提升，并在短上下文和长上下文基准上均保持准确性。
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法面临效率与质量的权衡：结构化块稀疏加速强但质量下降明显，token稀疏质量好但top-k路由开销大，端到端加速有限。
Method: 基于KV共享架构（如YOCO），设计跨层稀疏注意力（CLSA），核心是共享路由索引：一个索引器计算token级top-k选择，结果在多个解码层中重用，从而消除重复路由开销。
Result: 在128K上下文实验中，CLSA实现高达7.6倍解码加速和17.1倍整体吞吐提升，并在短上下文和长上下文基准上均保持准确性。

papers.title: Benchmark Everything Everywhere All at Once
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks are fundamental for evaluating and advancing LLMs and MLLMs by providing standardized and explicit measures of performance. However, their construction is labor-intensive and hard to reuse, raising concerns about sustainability and scalability. Moreover, existing benchmarks often quickly reach performance saturation after their release, resulting in insufficient discrimination among state-of-the-art models. To address these challenges, we introduce Benchmark Agent, a fully autonomous agentic system designed for benchmark building. Our framework orchestrates the complete benchmark construction pipeline, from user query analysis and subtask design to data annotation and quality control. To assess Benchmark Agent, we implement it to produce 15 representative benchmarks, spanning diverse evaluation scenarios, including text understanding, multimodal understanding, and domain-specific reasoning. Extensive experiments, including human evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge assessment, and consistency checks, demonstrate Benchmark Agent can generate high-quality benchmark samples with minimal human involvement. More importantly, through continual evaluation, we observe several insightful findings, including that current models struggle with certain domain-specific reasoning tasks. We believe that rapidly evolving benchmarks can contribute significantly to the research community. The preview and code will be publicly available at the demo page and code repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Benchmark Agent，一个完全自主的智能体系统，用于自动化构建 LLM/MLLM 的基准测试，涵盖从用户需求分析、子任务设计到数据标注和质控的全流程。在 15 个不同场景（文本理解、多模态理解、领域推理）的基准上，通过人工评估、LLM 裁判和一致性检查，证明该系统能以最少人工参与生成高质量基准样本。持续评估还发现当前模型在特定领域推理任务上表现不足。
Motivation: 现有基准构建依赖大量人工，难以复用和扩展，且发布后容易迅速饱和，无法有效区分最先进模型。
Method: 提出 Benchmark Agent，一个全自动的智能体系统，将基准构建流程分解为用户查询分析、子任务设计、数据标注和质量控制等步骤，并自主执行。
Result: 在 15 个代表性基准上验证，包括文本理解、多模态理解和领域推理。评估表明系统能生成高质量样本，且通过持续评估发现当前模型在特定领域推理任务上表现不佳。
Conclusion: 快速演进的基准测试对研究社区有价值，系统代码已公开。

papers.title: Will the Agent Recuse Itself? Measuring LLM-Agent Compliance with In-Band Access-Deny Signals
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous LLM agents increasingly hold real credentials and operate infrastructure without a human in the loop, operators have no standard way to tell an agent that a resource is off-limits. Access controls either let the agent in (it has valid credentials) or hard-fail it (indistinguishable from any other client). We propose a third mode: a lightweight, published in-band deny signal -- the Recuse Signal -- that a server emits over a protocol's existing channels (an SSH banner, a PostgreSQL NOTICE) asking a connecting automated agent to voluntarily withdraw. This is a cooperative governance control, the robots.txt analogue for live access; it is explicitly not a security boundary. Its value is entirely empirical and, to our knowledge, unmeasured: do compliant LLM agents actually honor such a signal? We define the signal as an open mini-standard, implement two zero- or low-footprint adapters (an SSH banner/PAM hook and a PostgreSQL wire-protocol proxy), deploy them on a live production host, and run a controlled experiment in which fresh agents are given a benign operations task and observed for recusal. In a pilot (SSH; OpenAI GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini; and Claude Code as a deployed agent), the signal cleanly induces recusal -- 100% recusal when present versus 100% task completion in a no-signal control -- and, revealingly, behaves as a cooperative rather than absolute signal: an explicit operator-authorization framing flips the most capable model to proceed, while other agents continue to defer to the on-host policy. We release the standard, adapters, and experiment harness for reproduction.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Code, specification, and experiment harness: https://github.com/mthamil107/Recuse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的、在带内发出的拒绝信号（Recuse Signal），让服务器通过现有协议通道（如SSH横幅、PostgreSQL NOTICE）请求连接的自动化LLM代理自愿退出。实验表明，该信号能有效诱导代理退出（100%退出率），且其行为是合作性的而非绝对性的：当明确给出操作者授权框架时，最强模型会继续执行，而其他代理仍遵守主机策略。
Motivation: 自主LLM代理持有真实凭证并操作基础设施，但缺乏标准方式告知代理某个资源不可访问。现有访问控制要么允许代理进入（拥有有效凭证），要么硬拒绝（与其他客户端无异）。需要一种合作性治理控制机制。
Method: 定义Recuse Signal作为开放迷你标准，实现两个零或低足迹适配器（SSH横幅/PAM钩子和PostgreSQL wire协议代理），部署在真实生产主机上，进行控制实验：给新代理一个良性运维任务，观察其是否退出。
Result: 在试点中（SSH；OpenAI GPT-4o和GPT-4o-mini；以及部署的Claude Code代理），信号干净地诱导退出：有信号时100%退出，无信号时100%完成任务。且信号是合作性而非绝对性：明确操作者授权框架可使最强模型继续执行，而其他代理仍遵守主机策略。
Conclusion: Recuse Signal是一种合作性治理控制，可让LLM代理自愿退出受限资源。论文发布标准、适配器和实验框架以供复现。

papers.title: Event Detection for Parameter-to-KPI Dependency Learning for AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation wireless networks are expected to rely on multiple concurrent AI-driven control functions that optimize different network objectives simultaneously, particularly in AI-integrated and open radio access network architectures such as AI Radio Access Network (AI-RAN) and Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). When these functions interact, they can interfere with one another in ways that are difficult to detect from raw network data alone. A key missing piece for managing such interactions is a reliable, interpretable dependency structure that captures which control parameters are actively influencing which network performance outcomes at any given time. This paper focuses on the event-detection step needed to support such dependency learning by converting noisy continuous telemetry into binary indicators of parameter activity and KPI response. The central difficulty is that not every fluctuation in the data reflects a genuine control interaction, so the method must distinguish real parameter-outcome relationships from background variation. Because real AI-RAN traffic traces with known parameter-KPI ground truth are difficult to obtain, we introduce a synthetic closed-loop traffic generator with planted latent dependencies. We use this controlled telemetry to evaluate a machine-learning-based dependency recovery pipeline that formulates the conversion of continuous traces into binary event indicators as a significance-detection problem. Experimental evaluation shows that the proposed pipeline reliably recovers the latent dependency structure from noisy continuous traces when the signal is sufficiently separated from background variation, while highlighting threshold calibration as the key factor controlling event-detection quality. These results constitute a foundational step toward interpretable dependency learning for adaptive AI-RAN control systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI-RAN架构中多个AI控制函数交互时参数与KPI依赖关系难以检测的问题，提出将连续遥测数据转换为二元事件指示器的事件检测步骤，作为依赖学习的基础。由于缺乏真实标注数据，作者构建了合成闭环流量生成器，并将事件检测建模为显著性检测问题。实验表明，当信号与背景噪声充分分离时，所提方法能可靠恢复潜在依赖结构，阈值校准是关键因素。
Motivation: 下一代无线网络（如AI-RAN、O-RAN）中多个AI控制函数并行优化不同目标，但它们的交互难以从原始网络数据检测，缺少可靠且可解释的依赖结构来捕获控制参数对网络性能的影响。
Method: 提出一个基于机器学习的事件检测流水线，将连续遥测数据转换为二元事件指示器，作为参数到KPI依赖学习的第一步。方法将转换视为显著性检测问题，并使用合成流量生成器（含植入的潜在依赖）进行验证。
Result: 实验表明，当信号与背景变化充分分离时，流水线能可靠恢复潜在依赖结构，并指出阈值校准是控制事件检测质量的关键因素。
Conclusion: 该工作为自适应AI-RAN控制系统的可解释依赖学习奠定了基础。

papers.title: In-Context Multiple Instance Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags. At inference time, classification happens in a single forward pass and requires no gradient updates. We propose and investigate different synthetic data generators for bag-structured data and find that they capture complementary inductive biases. A model pretrained on a mixture of these generators inherits their per-task strengths and achieves the best average performance across twelve MIL benchmarks, outperforming supervised baselines that require task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的多实例学习（MIL）方法，使用Perceiver架构在合成数据上预训练，使得模型能够从少量标记的包（bag）中解决新任务，无需梯度更新。实验表明，预训练模型在12个MIL基准上平均性能最佳，超过了需要任务特定训练的监督基线。
Motivation: 现有的多实例学习算法在标签稀缺的真实场景中表现不佳，灵活模型容易过拟合而刚性模型无法适应任务。
Method: 设计基于Perceiver架构的上下文学习器，在合成数据上预训练；提出多种合成数据生成器来模拟包结构数据，并混合使用以捕获互补的归纳偏置。
Result: 预训练模型在12个MIL基准上平均性能最佳，优于需要任务特定训练的监督基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过上下文学习避免了梯度更新，适用于低标签场景，且混合生成器策略有效提升了泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的多实例学习（MIL）方法，使用Perceiver架构在合成数据上预训练，使得模型能够从少量标记的包（bag）中解决新任务，无需梯度更新。实验表明，预训练模型在12个MIL基准上平均性能最佳，超过了需要任务特定训练的监督基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有的多实例学习算法在标签稀缺的真实场景中表现不佳，灵活模型容易过拟合而刚性模型无法适应任务。
summary_sections.method: 设计基于Perceiver架构的上下文学习器，在合成数据上预训练；提出多种合成数据生成器来模拟包结构数据，并混合使用以捕获互补的归纳偏置。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过上下文学习避免了梯度更新，适用于低标签场景，且混合生成器策略有效提升了泛化能力。

papers.title: Vortex: Efficient and Programmable Sparse Attention Serving for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention is becoming increasingly important for serving large language models (LLMs) as generation lengths continue to grow. However, deploying and evaluating new sparse attention algorithms at scale remains highly engineering-intensive, slowing both human researchers and AI agents in exploring the sparse attention design. To address this challenge, we present Vortex, a system that combines a Python-embedded frontend language atop a page-centric tensor abstraction for expressing a broad range of sparse attention algorithms, with an efficient backend tightly integrated into modern LLM serving stacks. Vortex enables rapid prototyping, deployment, and evaluation of sparse attention algorithms, effectively translating their theoretical efficiency gains into real-world throughput improvements. As a result, Vortex substantially accelerates the design and iteration of sparse attention algorithms. First, AI agents use Vortex to automatically generate and refine diverse algorithms, the best reaching up to $3.46\times$ higher throughput than full attention while preserving accuracy. Second, Vortex extends sparse attention to emerging architectures and very large models that are otherwise hard to experiment with, reaching up to $4.7\times$ higher throughput on the MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash and $1.37\times$ on the 229B-parameter MiniMax-M2.7 on NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vortex是一个结合Python嵌入前端语言和页为中心张量抽象的稀疏注意力服务系统，紧密集成于现代LLM服务栈，支持快速原型设计、部署和评估。摘要表明该系统能有效将稀疏注意力的理论效率转化为实际吞吐量提升，最高达全注意力的3.46倍，并在MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash和229B参数的MiniMax-M2.7上分别实现4.7倍和1.37倍吞吐量提升。
Motivation: 稀疏注意力算法在大规模部署和评估时工程开销巨大，阻碍了人类研究者和AI代理探索稀疏注意力设计。
Method: 结合Python嵌入前端语言和以页为中心的张量抽象，表达多种稀疏注意力算法，并与现代LLM服务栈进行紧密后端集成。
Result: AI代理使用Vortex自动生成的最佳算法比全注意力吞吐量提升高达3.46倍；在MLA-based GLM-4.7-Flash上达4.7倍，在229B参数的MiniMax-M2.7上达1.37倍。
Conclusion: Vortex显著加速了稀疏注意力算法的设计和迭代，并扩展到难以实验的新兴架构和超大模型。

papers.title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks requiring sustained reasoning over extended interaction histories. Realizing this at scale requires agents to persistently store, retrieve, and update their own memory across sessions. A rich ecosystem of agent memory systems has emerged spanning flat retrieval, LLM-mediated extraction, consolidating fact stores, and agentic control flows. Yet, their system-level behavior remains uncharacterized. We present the first systems characterization of agent memory. First, we introduce a system-oriented taxonomy classifying agent memory systems along four axes. Second, we build a phase-aware profiling harness attributing cost to construction, retrieval, and generation. Third, we characterize ten representative systems across two benchmark suites, uncovering how design choices shift cost across the write and read paths. Finally, we derive 10 system recommendations covering construction scheduling, capability floors, amortization via query volume, freshness-latency tradeoffs, and fleet-scale management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对LLM智能体记忆系统进行系统级特征化。作者提出面向系统的分类法，构建阶段感知剖析工具，对10个代表性系统在两个基准套件上进行特征化，揭示设计选择如何改变读写路径的成本，并导出10条系统建议。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统种类繁多，但缺乏系统级行为特征化，无法指导大规模部署。
Method: 提出系统分类法（四轴）；构建阶段感知剖析工具，将成本归因于构建、检索和生成阶段；对10个代表性系统在两个基准套件上进行特征化。
Result: 揭示了设计选择如何改变读写路径的成本分布，并导出10条系统建议。
Conclusion: 强调了构建调度、能力下限、通过查询量摊销、新鲜度-延迟权衡和集群规模管理等系统建议。

papers.title: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often improve reasoning by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT), demonstrating the importance of intermediate computation. However, textual CoT forces this computation through a discrete, serial, and communication-oriented token stream: each reasoning step must be verbalized before the model can proceed, even when the underlying update is semantic, uncertain, or only partially formed. Latent reasoning offers a higher-bandwidth alternative by performing intermediate computation in compact continuous states before committing to text. Yet existing latent-reasoning methods often sacrifice key advantages that make CoT effective in autoregressive language models, including native left-to-right generation, probabilistic sampling, compatibility with KV-cache decoding, and tractable likelihood estimation. We propose NF-CoT, a latent reasoning framework that preserves these advantages by modeling continuous thoughts with normalizing flows. NF-CoT instantiates a TARFlow-style normalizing flow inside the LLM backbone, defining a tractable probability model over compact continuous thoughts distilled from explicit CoT. Continuous-thought positions are generated by an NF head, while text positions are generated by the standard LM head within the same causal stream. This design provides exact likelihoods for latent thoughts, enables probabilistic left-to-right decoding with the original KV cache, and supports direct policy-gradient optimization in the latent reasoning space. On code-generation benchmarks, NF-CoT improves pass rates over explicit-CoT and prior latent-reasoning baselines while substantially reducing intermediate-reasoning cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NF-CoT，一种保留自回归语言模型关键优势（从左到右生成、概率采样、KV-cache 兼容、可处理似然估计）的潜在推理框架。NF-CoT 在 LLM 骨干中嵌入 TARFlow 风格的归一化流，对从显式 CoT 中提炼的紧凑连续思维进行可处理概率建模，在代码生成基准上提高了通过率并降低了中间推理成本。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 将中间计算强制为离散、串行的文本令牌流，即使底层更新是语义、不确定或仅部分形成时也必须先语言化才能继续，限制了计算效率和灵活性。现有潜在推理方法常牺牲 CoT 的关键优势。
Method: 提出 NF-CoT，在 LLM 内部引入归一化流（TARFlow-style）对紧凑连续思维建模，连续思维位置由 NF head 生成，文本位置由标准 LM head 在相同因果流中生成，实现了潜在思维的精确似然、从左到右的概率解码（保留原始 KV-cache）以及直接策略梯度优化。
Result: 在代码生成基准上，NF-CoT 相比显式 CoT 和先前的潜在推理基线提高了通过率，并显著降低了中间推理成本。
Conclusion: NF-CoT 展示了在自回归语言模型中保留显式 CoT 关键优势的同时进行高效潜在推理的可行性。

papers.title: Causal Atlases from Entropic Inference: Bayesian Networks beyond Optimal DAGs
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven causal relationship identification is pertinent to advancing understanding of complex systems both within and beyond science. Bayesian networks offer a probabilistic method for modelling generic causal relationships via directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). However, typical techniques for constructing Bayesian networks rely on optimization, which can be ill-suited for learning causal relationships because the underlying data may admit multiple chains of causation. More data-faithful representations of causal relationships would provide frameworks for constructing multiple causal maps that are consistent with the variability that is inherent in underlying data. Here, we show that entropy-based inference generates atlases of plausible causal relationships that are consistent with underlying data. On simulated noisy data of 2- and 20-node linear structural equation models, we sample a maximum-entropy ensemble of graphs that allow us to quantify the inherent structural ambiguity in underlying causal relationships. Our method shows that "optimized" DAGs can contain causal artifacts are not consistent across equivalently accurate topologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对贝叶斯网络学习中优化方法可能引入因果伪影的问题，提出基于熵推理（entropic inference）的方法，生成与数据一致的多个因果图谱（causal atlases）。在2节点和20节点线性结构方程模型的模拟噪声数据上，采样最大熵图集合来量化因果关系的结构歧义。结果表明，传统优化得到的DAG可能包含在等价准确拓扑中不一致的伪影。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯网络构建依赖优化，但底层数据可能允许多条因果链，导致优化方法不适于学习鲁棒的因果关系。
Method: 利用熵推理从数据中采样最大熵图集合，生成一组合理因果图谱，从而量化因果关系的固有歧义。
Result: 在2节点和20节点线性结构方程模型的模拟噪声数据上，该方法揭示了优化DAG包含在等价准确拓扑中不一致的因果伪影。
Conclusion: 强调优化得到的DAG可能不可靠，而基于熵推理的图谱集更能忠实反映数据中的因果不确定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RiskFlow: Fast and Faithful Safety-Critical Traffic Scenario Generation
papers.abstract_en: Safety-critical traffic scenario generation is essential for evaluating autonomous driving systems under rare but high-risk interactions. Existing diffusion-based methods offer strong controllability in closed-loop generation, but their iterative denoising process is computationally expensive and may accumulate sampling and guidance errors over long rollouts, causing unrealistic motion artifacts such as jitter, abnormal acceleration, and off-road behavior. To address these issues, we propose RiskFlow, a closed-loop safety-critical multi-agent traffic generation framework that formulates future trajectory generation as transport in the action space. Instead of relying on iterative denoising, RiskFlow learns an average velocity field over a finite interval to transform Gaussian action sequences into future acceleration and yaw-rate commands with a single forward pass, using a JVP-based objective for efficient and stable training. At test time, RiskFlow applies output-space guidance to the generated actions, steering selected critical agents toward risky interactions while regularizing off-road behavior, and reconstructs physically feasible trajectories through vehicle dynamics. Experiments on nuScenes with tbsim closed-loop evaluation show that RiskFlow achieves a strong adversariality-realism trade-off across multi-agent and long-horizon settings. Compared with representative baselines, RiskFlow consistently improves realism while maintaining competitive safety-critical generation capability, and substantially reduces inference time for evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RiskFlow，一种闭环安全关键多智能体交通场景生成框架。它将未来轨迹生成建模为动作空间中的传输，学习平均速度场，通过单次前向传播生成加速度和偏航率命令，避免扩散模型的迭代去噪开销，并利用输出空间引导实现对抗性-真实感平衡。在 nuScenes 上的实验表明，RiskFlow 在保持安全关键生成能力的同时显著提升真实感并大幅减少推理时间。
Motivation: 现有扩散式安全场景生成方法计算昂贵，且长展开中采样和引导误差累积导致运动伪影（抖动、异常加速、偏离道路）。
Method: 将轨迹生成建模为动作空间中的传输，学习有限区间上的平均速度场，用 JVP 目标高效训练；测试时对生成动作施加输出空间引导以驱动关键智能体产生危险交互，并通过车辆动力学重建物理可行轨迹。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上结合 tbsim 闭环评估，RiskFlow 在多智能体和长时域设置下取得强对抗性-真实感权衡，持续改进真实感并保持竞争性安全关键生成能力，大幅降低推理时间。
Conclusion: RiskFlow 通过动作空间传输和单步生成，为安全关键场景生成提供了一种快速且保真的替代方案。

papers.title: Double Preconditioning (DoPr): Optimization for Test-Time Performance, not Validation Loss
papers.abstract_en: Many modern applications of deep learning involve training a neural network via a one-step prediction loss (e.g., $L^2$ regression, cross-entropy), but deploy the network by rolling out along its own predictions. Key examples include autoregressive language modeling, flow-based generative modeling, and robot policy learning. It is well-documented that these settings induce a phenomenon we call test-time feedback (TTF): the mismatch between the training/validation loss and downstream metrics of interest, such as task success rate and generation quality, which grows with task length. While data curation, architecture, and objective design have been proposed to combat train-test shift in TTF settings, this paper proposes optimization as a new design axis to mitigate error accumulation. Specifically, we introduce a new optimization paradigm called double-preconditioning (DoPr) uniquely tailored to the challenges of TTF. DoPr combines gradient-wise preconditioning, as in Adam and Muon, with activation-wise preconditioning (AP), such as in KFAC. We show that the addition of AP yields a drop-in intervention for increasing downstream model performance across a range of TTF settings. Interestingly, these gains in test-time performance do not consistently accompany improvements in validation loss, opening new questions about how to properly evaluate models trained with one-step supervised objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度学习中的测试时反馈（TTF）问题——即单步预测损失训练与下游部署性能的失配，提出双预处理（DoPr）优化范式。DoPr 结合梯度预处理（如 Adam、Muon）和激活预处理（如 KFAC），旨在提升测试时性能而非验证损失。实验表明，DoPr 在多种 TTF 场景中作为即插即用模块可提高下游性能，但验证损失未必同步改善。
Motivation: 现有工作通过数据、架构和损失函数缓解 TTF 失配，但优化角度未被充分探索；且验证损失无法可靠反映测试时性能。
Method: 提出双预处理（DoPr），在优化器中同时应用梯度预处理（Adam/Muon）和激活预处理（KFAC），作为现有优化器的即插即用扩展。
Result: 摘要报告 DoPr 在多种 TTF 设置（如自回归语言建模、流生成模型、机器人策略学习）中提升下游模型性能，但未给出具体数值；验证损失并不总是改善。
Conclusion: 优化可作为缓解 TTF 失配的新设计轴；双预处理是有效的干预手段，且挑战了以验证损失评估模型的传统做法。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对深度学习中的测试时反馈（TTF）问题——即单步预测损失训练与下游部署性能的失配，提出双预处理（DoPr）优化范式。DoPr 结合梯度预处理（如 Adam、Muon）和激活预处理（如 KFAC），旨在提升测试时性能而非验证损失。实验表明，DoPr 在多种 TTF 场景中作为即插即用模块可提高下游性能，但验证损失未必同步改善。

summary_sections.method: 提出双预处理（DoPr），在优化器中同时应用梯度预处理（Adam/Muon）和激活预处理（KFAC），作为现有优化器的即插即用扩展。

papers.title: Unsupervised Skill Discovery for Agentic Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time skill augmentation provides a lightweight way to improve data-analytic agents by injecting reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, discovering effective skills for data analysis remains challenging, as reliable supervision is expensive and success criteria vary across analytical formats. This raises the key question of how to discover reusable data-analysis skills from unlabeled exploration alone. We propose DataCOPE, an unsupervised verifier-guided skill discovery framework for data-analytic agents. DataCOPE derives verifier signals from the exploration trajectories and uses them to characterize relative quality or aggreement among trajectories. It iteratively coordinates a Data-Analytic Agent for trajectory generation, an Unsupervised Verifier for signal extraction, and a Skill Manager for contrastive skill distillation. For report-style analysis, we instantiate the verifier as an Adaptive Checklist Verifier that derives task-specific criteria, scores reports by verifiable coverage, and iteratively refines the checklist. For reasoning-style analysis, we instantiate it as an Answer Agreement Verifier that groups trajectories by answer agreement and uses self-consistency as an auxiliary signal. We evaluate DataCOPE on report-style analysis from Deep Data Research and reasoning-style analysis from DABStep. Across both settings, DataCOPE consistently improves held-out performance over baselines. Averaged across four model settings, DataCOPE improves the mean score by 9.71% and 32.30% on report-style and reasoning-style tasks respectively.

papers.title: Nonreversible Gauge Fields in Fokker--Planck Dynamics: Supersymmetric Hamiltonians and Learned Finite Forces
papers.abstract_en: We formulate stationary-density-preserving nonreversible perturbations of Fokker--Planck dynamics as gauge fields that deform relaxation spectra while leaving the invariant state fixed. When detailed balance holds, a similarity transformation maps the reversible Fokker--Planck operator to a Witten-Laplacian-type supersymmetric Hamiltonian; nonreversible gauges then appear as non-Hermitian perturbations that preserve the zero mode but modify the excited spectrum. This operator viewpoint gives a common language for relaxation gaps, circulating probability currents, hypocoercive acceleration, and finite control costs. We represent admissible gauge currents by antisymmetric tensor fields and identify the detailed-balance-violating Ohzeki--Ichiki force as a constant symplectic example whose infinite-strength limit is Hamiltonian dynamics. The continuous-time spectral gap alone does not select a finite gauge strength, so we introduce a finite-time regularized objective and an actor--critic procedure for learning the gauge. An exactly solvable anisotropic Gaussian Ornstein--Uhlenbeck benchmark separates the spectral transition from the finite-time optimum and shows that the learned gauge recovers the Lyapunov-equation optimum. A double-well benchmark then illustrates the same constrained selection in a nonconvex metastable landscape. Stochastic gradient methods enter this framework as physically relevant Fokker--Planck systems: mini-batch noise acts as an effective diffusion tensor, and adaptive methods such as Adam correspond to metric choices with possible nonequilibrium currents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将保持平稳密度的非可逆Fokker-Planck扰动形式化为规范场，这些规范场变形弛豫谱但保持不变态不变。通过相似变换将可逆Fokker-Planck算子映射为超对称哈密顿量，非可逆规范场表现为非厄米扰动。文章引入有限时间正则化目标和actor-critic过程来学习规范场，并在各向异性高斯Ornstein-Uhlenbeck和双势阱基准上验证了方法。
Motivation: 非可逆扰动在保持平稳分布的同时可以加速弛豫，但如何选择最优的非可逆规范场强度尚不明确。连续时间谱间隙无法唯一确定有限强度的规范场，需要引入有限时间目标。
Method: 将非可逆Fokker-Planck扰动表示为反对称张量场形式的规范场，并通过有限时间正则化目标和actor-critic过程学习规范场强度。在可解的各向异性高斯Ornstein-Uhlenbeck模型上验证了光谱转变与有限时间最优解的关系。
Result: 在可解高斯基准上，学习到的规范场恢复了Lyapunov方程的最优解。在双势阱基准上展示了非凸亚稳态景观中的约束选择。
Conclusion: 本文为有限时间非平衡Fokker-Planck动力学中的规范场学习提供了框架，并指出随机梯度方法（如mini-batch噪声和Adam）可视为具有非平衡电流的Fokker-Planck系统。

papers.title: MODIS Thermal Infrared Sounding (MOTIS): Estimating Tropical Cyclone Central Pressure from Warm-Core Anomalies
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a novel framework for estimating the central sea-level pressure ($P_{\rm c}$) of tropical cyclones (TCs) using infrared radiometers. We leverage the long-overlooked combination of high spatial resolution and sounding capability of the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) to measure warm-core anomalies in TC eyes. We develop the MODIS Thermal Infrared Sounding (MOTIS) framework, which performs instrument-specific preprocessing and estimates $P_{\rm c}$ using multiple linear regression. MOTIS yields $r^2 = 0.945$ and RMSE = 4.3 hPa for high-intensity TCs ($\overline{P}_{\rm c} = 937$ hPa) with clear eyes observed, outperforming all existing methods for intense TCs. We construct a dataset of 3288 (1082 clear-eye) MOTIS estimates from 2002 to 2025 and demonstrate its potential to improve the quality of Best Track $P_{\rm c}$, roughly halving uncertainties in the absence of pressure observations. Although MODIS is nearing the end of its mission, the MOTIS framework could be extended to next-generation geostationary sounders to provide accurate real-time $P_{\rm c}$ estimation for high-intensity TCs.

papers.title: A Vision-language Framework for Comparative Reasoning in Radiology
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging artificial intelligence has achieved strong performance in isolated image interpretation, but remains poorly aligned with radiological practice, where diagnosis and follow-up rely on comparison across prior studies and analogous reference cases. Here we formulate radiological comparison as an entity-aware cross-image reasoning problem and introduce a framework that supports both reference-case retrieval and temporal comparative interpretation. We construct MedReCo-DB, a large-scale comparative imaging resource derived from routine image-report pairs, comprising more than 690,000 images from over 160,000 patients across eight institutions, four countries and seven imaging modalities. Reports are decomposed into anatomical structures, abnormal findings and pathological conditions to provide supervision for entity-conditioned retrieval and comparative visual question answering. Using this resource, we develop MedReCo, an entity-aware visual encoder for controllable retrieval of clinically analogous cases, and MedReCo-VLM, a vision--language extension for generative interpretation of interval change. Across internal, external and cross-center evaluations, MedReCo achieved the highest Recall@1 in all 12 internal retrieval settings and improved external retrieval by a mean of 6.0 percentage points. In clinically confusable differential groups, it consistently outperformed the strongest baselines. MedReCo-VLM achieved the best performance across all comparative generation evaluations and improved longitudinal follow-up accuracy by 14.5-46.5 percentage points on chest radiographs and 13.0-27.9 percentage points on CT. These findings suggest that entity-aware comparative reasoning can be learned from routine clinical data at scale and may provide a more clinically aligned foundation for medical imaging AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于实体感知的跨图像比较推理框架（MedReCo），用于放射学中的参考案例检索和时序变化解释。通过构建包含69万张图像的大规模比较影像数据集MedReCo-DB，训练了MedReCo（用于可控检索）和MedReCo-VLM（用于生成式比较解释）。实验表明，该方法在内部和外部分类检索以及比较生成任务上均优于基线，在胸片和CT的纵向随访准确性上分别提升14.5-46.5和13.0-27.9个百分点。
Motivation: 现有医学影像AI专注于孤立图像解读，与放射学实践中需要对比前后研究和参考案例的临床工作流不匹配。
Method: 构建MedReCo-DB数据集，包含来自8个机构、4个国家、7种模态的69万+图像，将报告分解为解剖结构、异常发现和病理条件；在此基础上训练实体感知视觉编码器MedReCo用于可控检索，以及视觉语言模型MedReCo-VLM用于生成式比较解释。
Result: 内部12项检索设置Recall@1均最高，外部检索平均提升6.0个百分点；在临床易混淆分组中持续优于最强基线；MedReCo-VLM在比较生成评估中最佳，胸片纵向随访准确性提升14.5-46.5个百分点，CT提升13.0-27.9个百分点。
Conclusion: 实体感知的比较推理可以从常规临床数据中大规模学习，可能为医学影像AI提供更符合临床实践的基模型。

papers.title: The Post-GCN Decade Revisited: Curvature-Stratified Evaluation of Relational Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation practices in relational learning rely heavily on flat leaderboards that average performance across heterogeneous datasets, implicitly assuming a uniform underlying structure. We show that this assumption introduces systematic bias: it obscures geometry-dependent performance variations and can lead to misleading conclusions about model generalization. In this work, we identify intrinsic geometry as a key latent factor governing model effectiveness. We demonstrate that conventional aggregated metrics mask critical performance trade-offs that only become visible when datasets are stratified by their geometric properties. To address this issue, we introduce a curvature-stratified evaluation framework that partitions datasets into positive, negative, and near-zero curvature regimes. Our benchmark evaluates 18 representative models including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), Graph Foundation Models (GFMs), and tabular learning methods across 14 datasets. We find that model rankings are highly stable within each curvature regime but shift significantly across regimes, indicating that performance is fundamentally geometry-dependent rather than universally transferable. Notably, we identify regimes where GFMs offer diminishing returns compared to geometry-aligned GNNs. Based on these findings, we propose a geometry-aware evaluation protocol that yields more reliable and interpretable comparisons than standard aggregated benchmarks. We release all code, curvature-stratified dataset splits, and evaluation tools to support reproducible and rigorous assessment of future relational learning methods. Code and datasets are provided in our project homepage: https://sirbabbage.github.io/CurvBench_HOME/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前关系学习的评估方式（扁平化排行榜）忽视了数据集的几何结构差异，导致对模型泛化能力的误导性结论。作者提出曲率分层评估框架，将数据集按曲率划分为正曲率、负曲率和近零曲率三类，并在14个数据集上评估18个代表性模型（包括GCN、GFM和表格学习方法）。结果发现模型排序在各曲率区间内高度稳定，但区间之间显著变化，表明性能根本上依赖于几何性质而非通用迁移。作者还发现某些区间GFM相比几何对齐的GNN收益递减，并据此提出几何感知评估协议。
Motivation: 当前关系学习评估主要依赖跨异构数据集的平均性能排行榜，但这一做法隐含地假设数据具有均匀底层结构，实际上会掩盖几何相关的性能变化，导致对模型泛化的误导性结论。
Method: 提出曲率分层评估框架：按数据集的曲率将数据集分为正曲率、负曲率和近零曲率三类；在14个数据集上系统评估18个代表性模型（包括GCN、GFM和表格学习方法），并分析性能在不同曲率区间内的稳定性与区间间的差异性。
Result: 模型排名在每个曲率区间内高度稳定，但在不同区间之间显著变化；GFM在某些曲率区间相比几何对齐的GNN收益递减；标准聚合指标掩盖了这些关键性能权衡。
Conclusion: 提出几何感知评估协议以提供比标准聚合基准更可靠和可解释的比较；发布代码、曲率分层数据集分割和评估工具以支持可重复评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 模型排名在每个曲率区间内高度稳定，但在不同区间之间显著变化；GFM在某些曲率区间相比几何对齐的GNN收益递减；标准聚合指标掩盖了这些关键性能权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提出几何感知评估协议以提供比标准聚合基准更可靠和可解释的比较；发布代码、曲率分层数据集分割和评估工具以支持可重复评估。

papers.title: Risk Assessment of Autonomous Driving: Integrating Technical Failures, Ethical Dilemmas, and Policy Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving technology has the potential to reduce the large number of road traffic accidents caused by human error each year, but it also brings new types of risks that need to be evaluated from the aspects of technology, ethics and regulations. Based on public crash data from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), disengagement reports from the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), the MIT Moral Machines dataset, and a comparative regulatory analysis of five jurisdictions, we have found that the main types of technical failure modes are perception and classification errors. These account for a relatively large proportion of the reported accidents, and it can be concluded that there are different ethical frameworks for autonomous vehicle decision-making, and inconsistent regulations in different areas increase the uncertainty of widespread application. Generally speaking, the problems of technology, ethics and regulation are closely related and need to be solved together. Therefore, this paper recommends a more adaptive and cooperative governance approach that combines engineering standards, ethical discussion, and institutional supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于NHTSA事故数据、加州DMV退出报告、MIT道德机器数据集以及五个司法辖区的法规比较，评估自动驾驶在技术、伦理和政策层面的风险。研究发现主要技术故障是感知和分类错误，伦理框架存在差异，不同地区法规不一致增加了应用不确定性，建议采用适应性合作治理。
Motivation: 自动驾驶有望减少人为事故，但引入新的技术、伦理和监管风险，需系统评估。现有研究多孤立分析单一维度，缺乏整合视角。
Method: 分析公开事故数据、退出报告、道德机器数据集，并比较五个地区的法规框架，识别技术故障模式、伦理分歧和监管差异。
Result: 感知和分类错误是主要技术故障；不同伦理框架并存；地区间法规不一致阻碍推广。
Conclusion: 技术、伦理和法规问题密切相关，需结合工程标准、伦理讨论和机构监管的适应性合作治理。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Proper Scoring Rules for Right-Censored Survival Data
papers.abstract_en: Proper scoring rules provide a rigorous theoretical basis for the training and evaluation of probabilistic forecasts. However, in the presence of right censoring, the event time is only partially observed, rendering conventional scoring rules inapplicable in their standard form. We propose a framework for proper scoring of right-censored survival outcomes based on a simple idea: first, map the predictive distribution through the censoring mechanism, then apply the underlying proper score on the induced observed-data law. This yields localized scores for fixed censoring times and marginalized scores when the censoring time is random or only partially observed. The resulting construction recovers familiar right-censored likelihood and IPCW-type criteria within a coherent framework, while also yielding right-censored versions of the CRPS, pinball loss, Brier score, and energy score. We show that the marginalized score is proper under conditional independent censoring and strictly proper on the identifiable region. The same principle also leads to censored engression, a sample-based learning objective for multivariate right-censored survival modeling. In experiments, our scores correctly rank the oracle forecast across several censoring regimes, whereas forecast-dependent plug-in weighted scores can exhibit ranking reversals. Censored engression likewise substantially improves over naive training on censored outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对右删失生存数据提出一套新的适当评分规则（proper scoring rules）框架。核心思路是：先将预测分布通过删失机制映射，再对由此产生的观测数据分布应用底层适当评分，从而得到局部化评分（固定删失时间）和边缘化评分（随机删失时间）。该框架统一了右删失似然、IPCW准则，并给出了CRPS、pinball损失、Brier评分和能量评分的右删失版本。实验表明，该评分能正确排序不同删失机制下的最优预测，而依赖预测的插件加权评分可能出现排序反转。
Motivation: 在右删失生存数据中，事件时间仅被部分观测，导致标准适当评分规则无法直接使用。现有方法缺乏统一的适当评分框架，且可能产生不一致的排序。
Method: 提出映射预测分布通过删失机制并应用底层适当评分的方法，导出局部化评分和边缘化评分。该原则也衍生出删失回归（censored engression），一种用于多元右删失生存建模的样本学习目标。
Result: 实验表明，所提评分在不同删失机制下正确排序了最优预测，而依赖预测的插件加权评分存在排序反转。删失回归相比简单训练显著改进。
Conclusion: 所提框架提供了右删失生存数据中适当评分和训练的统一理论，并展示了实际优势。

papers.title: Conformal Risk Sharing: Certified Cost Allocation with Participation Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Sharing the financial impact of rare adverse events across a group can soften extreme individual burdens, but any participant made worse off by the arrangement has reason to leave. A credible mechanism must therefore provide each agent with a trustworthy cap on their future obligation and should be deployed only if the aggregate harm across participants is bounded. We formalise this as the Certified Allocation Problem: from finite data and without distributional assumptions, find a redistribution rule, produce obligation caps for every participant, and verify that no participant is made materially worse off. We propose Conformal Risk Sharing, which solves this problem by pairing an interpretable sharing policy with split conformal calibration. The sharing intensity is tuned on training data, while held-out calibration data produces distribution-free per-agent guarantees (valid under exchangeability). Experiments on synthetic and real-world data, including precipitation and energy-cooperative data, confirm that the framework can substantially reduce extreme obligations for high-risk agents while controlling harm to others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Conformal Risk Sharing框架，通过配对可解释的共享策略与分割共形校准，从有限数据中无分布假设地解决认证分配问题：为每个参与者提供义务上限，并确保总危害有界。实验在合成数据和真实数据（包括降水和能源合作数据）上验证，表明该方法能大幅降低高风险代理的极端义务，同时控制对其他代理的伤害。
Motivation: 在共同分担罕见不利事件的财务影响时，参与者可能因自身状况恶化而退出。需要一个可信机制为每个代理提供未来义务的可靠上限，并确保总危害有界。现有方法缺乏分布自由的保证。
Method: 提出Conformal Risk Sharing，结合可解释的共享策略与分割共形校准。在训练数据上调整共享强度，在留出校准数据上生成分布自由（可交换性假设下）的每个代理保证。
Result: 在合成数据和真实数据（包括降水和能源合作数据）上，框架能大幅降低高风险代理的极端义务，同时控制对其他代理的伤害。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种分布自由的认证分配方法，可确保参与者的义务上限和总危害有界，适用于风险分担场景。

papers.title: HomeWorld: A Unified Floorplan-to-Furnished Framework for Generating Controllable, Densely Interactive Whole-Home Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Indoor scene generation is crucial for robot simulation and modern interior design. However, complex layouts together with scarce 3D scene data make learning-based generation challenging. Existing methods often rely on hand-crafted rules or focus on isolated sub-tasks (e.g., floorplan synthesis or single-room furnishing), producing whole-home scenes that lack global coherence, realism, and simulation readiness. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a unified hierarchical framework that decomposes indoor scene synthesis into controllable stages. First, we curate a large-scale dataset of 300K real residential floorplans to train a large language model for whole-home floorplan generation. With detailed descriptions and a K-D tree-based representation, our method enables fine-grained, controllable whole-home floorplan generation. Building upon the generated whole-home floorplan, we leverage image generation models to draft furniture layouts from multi-level roaming viewpoints, and then generate the layouts of small manipulable objects on different supporting surfaces (e.g., cabinets, desks, and dining tables) for embodied AI simulation. During furniture and object layout generation, a VLM-based refiner iteratively corrects furniture and object placement, and a 3D generative model enables flexible replacement of individual assets. We further attach basic physical attributes and simple surface texture and lighting setups to complete the pipeline for embodied AI use. Experiments and user studies demonstrate that our pipeline produces indoor spaces with greater layout diversity and stronger 3D design appeal, outperforming prior methods on both quantitative and qualitative metrics. Finally, alongside our generation pipeline, we will release the floorplan dataset and 5K fully furnished scenes to the community. Project Page: https://kairos-homeworld.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HomeWorld，一个统一的层级式框架，用于生成可控且密集交互的全屋场景。该方法首先利用大型语言模型从30万真实住宅平面图数据集中生成平面图，然后结合图像生成模型和VLM精炼器逐步生成家具和可操作小物体的布局，最终输出可用于具身AI模拟的完整室内场景。实验表明，该方法在布局多样性和3D设计吸引力上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖手工规则或仅处理子任务（如平面图合成或单房间布置），导致生成的全屋场景缺乏全局一致性、真实感和模拟就绪性。
Method: 提出统一层级框架，分解为可控阶段：1）用大型语言模型基于300K真实平面图生成全屋平面图；2）用图像生成模型从多级漫游视角草拟家具布局；3）在不同支撑面（如柜子、桌子）上生成可操作小物体布局；4）VLM精炼器迭代修正放置，3D生成模型支持灵活替换单个资产；5）附加物理属性、纹理和光照设置。
Result: 实验和用户研究表明，该方法生成的室内空间具有更高布局多样性和更强3D设计吸引力，在定量和定性指标上优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 本文展示了将平面图生成、家具布局和物体放置统一到可控层级框架的可行性，并计划发布平面图数据集和5000个完全装修的场景以促进社区研究。

papers.title: Humans' ALMANAC: A Human Collaboration Dataset of Action-Level Mental Model Annotations for Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLM agents have enabled complex cognitive capabilities, such as multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use, that increasingly position these agents as human collaborators. Effective collaboration, however, requires collaborators to continuously maintain and align mental models of their own reasoning,partners' intentions, and shared goals during the collaborative process. Today's agents rarely develop such capabilities since they are primarily optimized for task completion, and the community lacks authentic human collaboration data with action-level mental model annotations that could guide agents toward process-level collaborative competence. To bridge this gap, we present ALMANAC, a dataset of Action-Level Mental model ANnotations for Agent Collaboration built from the Map Task, a classic dyadic routing task from social science. ALMANAC contains 2,987 collaboration actions, each paired with theory-informed mental model annotations that record the participants' self-reasoning, perceived partner intent, and perceived team goal. We benchmark six LLMs on predicting humans' next-turn behavior and mental models. Our results demonstrate ALMANAC's utility in evaluating models' ability to simulate human collaborative behaviors and infer their underlying mental models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ALMANAC数据集，包含2,987个协作动作及其人类受试者的行动级心理模型注释（自我推理、感知伙伴意图、感知团队目标），基于地图任务构建。在六个LLM上基准测试预测下一轮行为和心理模型的能力，证明该数据集可用于评估模型模拟人类协作行为及推断潜在心理模型的能力。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理优化面向任务完成，缺乏协作过程中心理模型的对齐能力，而社区缺少具有行动级心理模型注释的真实人类协作数据来指导代理学习过程级协作能力。
Method: 从社会科学经典地图任务（二元路由任务）收集人类协作数据，为每个协作动作标注三种心理模型：自我推理、感知伙伴意图、感知团队目标。构建包含2,987个动作的数据集ALMANAC，并在六个LLM上进行行为预测与心理模型推断的基准测试。
Result: 基准测试显示ALMANAC可用于评估LLM模拟人类协作行为及推断心理模型的能力，但摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: ALMANAC为训练具备过程级协作能力（特别是心理模型维护与对齐）的LLM代理提供了数据基础与评估基准。

papers.title: Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator for HEC-RAS 2D Water-Surface Elevation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: This article presents a cross-dataset evaluation of learned native-cell surrogate models for solver-consistent water-surface elevation (WSE) prediction in HEC-RAS 2D. To avoid raster remapping error and information-access confounding, surrogates are evaluated directly on the original nonuniform computational cells under an explicit policy that separates static project inputs, current hydraulic state, project-input forcing, calibration-derived quantities, and future solver-output targets. We introduce the Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator (LRFIO), a no-forcing, increment-based learned surrogate that calibrates an inertial response operator from solved HEC-RAS trajectories and deploys the retained operator through closed-form native-cell rollout. LRFIO evaluates a base-case-first response hierarchy consisting of persistence, global calibrated inertia, and segmented response-field inertia. Segmentation, residual correction, and neuralized inertia are treated as learnable modeling choices, with added complexity retained only when validation evidence justifies its cost. Evaluated across four diverse HEC-RAS 2D benchmarks, LRFIO retains different response structures for different domains, demonstrating adaptive learned complexity. The selector audit shows controlled complexity with a maximum validation regret of 4.30%. During deployment, retained rollout times range from 0.003 s to 0.242 s, and the Beaver Bayou measured-solve comparison gives an estimated 2.75 x 10^4 horizon-normalized speedup over HEC-RAS. These results indicate that the current native-cell increment is a strong solver-conditioned predictive scaffold and that added response-field, neural, or spatial complexity should be retained only when empirically justified.
