papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator (LRFIO)，一种基于增量学习的代理模型，用于 HEC-RAS 2D 水表面高程预测。该模型直接在原始非均匀计算单元上运行，避免栅格重映射误差，并在四种基准上验证。结果显示 LRFIO 能自适应选择复杂度，最大验证遗憾 4.30%，部署时间 0.003-0.242 秒，实现高达 2.75×10^4 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有代理模型在非均匀网格上评估时存在栅格重映射误差和信息访问混淆问题，需要一种直接基于原始计算单元、分离不同输入类型的预测方法。
Method: 提出 LRFIO，一种无强迫项、增量学习的代理模型，从 HEC-RAS 求解轨迹中校准惯性响应算子，并通过闭式原生单元滚动部署。采用基情况优先响应层次，包括持久性、全局校准惯性和分段响应场惯性，将分段、残差校正和神经化惯性作为可学习建模选择。
Result: 在四个多样基准上，LRFIO 保留不同响应结构，验证最大遗憾 4.30%，部署时间 0.003-0.242 秒，Beaver Bayou 实测-求解对比显示 2.75×10^4 倍标准化速度提升。
Conclusion: 当前原生单元增量是强求解器条件预测支架，增加响应场、神经或空间复杂性仅当经验证有据时才应保留。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Estimation of the sub-Gaussian parameter
papers.abstract_en: The sub-Gaussian parameter (also called the variance proxy) of a mean-zero random variable $X$ is defined as $ξ^2_* = \sup_{λ\in \mathbb{R}} L(λ)$ where $L(λ) = \frac{2}{λ^2} \log \mathbb{E} e^{λX}$ is a weighted cumulant generating function. Despite the ubiquity of sub-Gaussian random variables, the estimation of $ξ^2_*$ has received little attention and is not yet well understood. In this work, we study a natural estimator of $ξ^2_*$ based on constrained maximization of the empirical analogue of $L$. We prove that the estimator is consistent bound the rates of convergence under assumptions on $L$: if $L$ has an maximizer, then our bound is $O_p(n^{-1/2 + \varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon > 0$; if the argmax of $L$ is also bounded, then the bound improves to $O_p(n^{-1/2})$. We show that our assumptions on $L$ are necessary by proving that the minimax risk over all sub-Gaussian distributions is $Ω(1)$; imposing increasingly strong assumptions on the tail growth of $L$ yields a continuum of classes whose minimax lower bound interpolates between $Ω(1/\log n)$ and $Ω(1)$. Root-n rate is possible if we restrict to a subclass of distributions where $L$ attains its supremum in a bounded region, in which case our estimator is minimax optimal. If the underlying distribution is not sub-Gaussian, we show that our estimator goes to infinity with a divergence rate controlled by the tail of the distribution. Finally, we apply our estimator in a Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment study to construct p-values for a large-scale permutation test, showing that it can serve as a reliable alternative to the peaks-over-threshold approach, particularly in regimes where the peaks-over-threshold method is of uncertain validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究定义均值零随机变量X的次高斯参数（方差代理）ξ^2_* = sup_{λ} L(λ)，其中L(λ)是加权累积生成函数。提出基于L的经验类似物约束最大化的自然估计量，证明其一致性并给出收敛速率：若L有最大化者，速率为O_p(n^{-1/2+ε})；若argmax有界，则改进至O_p(n^{-1/2})。同时推导极小极大下界，表明假设的必要性。最后将估计器应用于基因本体（GO）富集研究中的置换检验p值构造，展示其作为峰过阈值方法可靠替代的潜力。
Motivation: 次高斯随机变量虽普遍存在，但其方差代理ξ^2_*的估计尚未得到充分研究，理解不足。
Method: 提出基于加权累积生成函数L的empirical analogue约束最大化的估计器，推导其收敛速率，并分析极小极大风险。
Result: 估计量一致，收敛速率在L有最大化者时为O_p(n^{-1/2+ε})，若argmax有界则为O_p(n^{-1/2})。极小极大下界显示假设必要，且当分布非次高斯时估计器发散。应用于GO置换检验，表明其可作为峰过阈值方法的可靠替代。
Conclusion: 该估计器在次高斯参数估计中具有理论保证，并在实际应用中（如GO置换检验）提供有效替代方案，尤其当峰过阈值方法不确定时。

papers.title: Emergent Language as an Approach to Conscious AI
papers.abstract_en: The question of whether artificial systems can be conscious remains open, in part because existing approaches either evaluate systems against theory-derived checklists (discriminative) or engineer consciousness-inspired modules directly (architectural); both leave open whether observed structures are artifacts of human language priors. We propose a generative methodology: emergent language (EL) in multi-agent reinforcement learning, where agents start from minimal (no language, no concept of self, minimal exposure to human text) and develop communication under task pressure alone, ensuring causal attributability to task demands rather than inherited human language priors. We position our methodology by discussing how EL serves as a generative tool for studying consciousness-relevant structure, including the role of environment complexity and the interpretation of emergent communication. As a proof of concept, we instantiate this methodology in a minimal environment and show that agents develop self-referential communication, including an echo-mismatch detection circuit that is not predicted by task structure or architecture alone but emerges from a specific environmental affordance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成方法论：利用多智能体强化学习中的涌现语言（Emergent Language）研究意识相关结构。智能体从无语言、无自我概念、极少人类文本暴露的初始状态出发，仅凭任务压力发展交流，从而确保因果归因于任务需求而非人类语言先验。概念验证实验表明，在一个最小环境中，智能体自发形成了自我指涉交流，包括一个回声-不匹配检测电路，该结构并非由任务或架构直接预测，而是从环境可负担性中涌现。
Motivation: 现有意识AI研究要么依赖理论检查表进行判别，要么直接工程化意识模块，两者都可能混入人类语言先验，难以区分观察结构是否源于任务需求。本文提出生成方法论以解决该问题。
Method: 采用多智能体强化学习中的涌现语言框架，智能体从最小初始条件（无语言、无自我概念、极少人类文本）开始，仅通过任务驱动发展通信，确保可因果归因于任务需求。
Result: 概念验证显示，在最小环境中，智能体发展出自我指涉通信，包括一个回声-不匹配检测电路，该电路并非由任务结构或架构单独预测，而是从环境特定可负担性中涌现。
Conclusion: 本文定位涌现语言作为研究意识相关结构的生成工具，但还需要进一步探讨环境复杂性的作用以及对涌现通信的解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation, including lesion detection and report generation. However, their practical utility remains limited by insufficient sensitivity to subtle lesions, whose visual evidence is often sparse, low-contrast, and embedded within complex anatomical context. As local visual tokens are aggregated, these weak lesion cues can become underrepresented in global image representations, making them difficult for medical VLMs to recognize. Existing efforts to improve lesion sensitivity mainly rely on medical-domain vision-encoder pre-training, clinical-term-guided alignment, or trainable pathological representation enhancement. Although effective, these approaches usually require additional training or model-specific adaptation and may overfit to particular disease morphologies, limiting their applicability to frozen medical VLMs. To address these limitations, we propose EasyLens, a training-free plug-and-play subtle-lesion representation amplifier for medical VLMs. EasyLens first constructs EasyBank, a pathology-anatomy prototype space that provides lesion-related prototypes and anatomy-aware normal references for comparing suspicious patches against both pathological and normal anatomical patterns. To avoid blindly amplifying normal tissues, EasyTag selects lesion-relevant patches through counterfactual prototype reasoning. To counteract the dilution of subtle lesion cues in global image representations, EasyAmplifier strengthens the selected lesion-relevant patch representations through morphology-guided residual enhancement, thereby increasing their contribution to the global image embedding. Experiments on multiple medical image datasets and frozen medical VLM backbones show that EasyLens improves subtle-lesion detection and outperforms existing encoder-enhancement baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EasyLens是一个无需训练的即插即用模块，用于增强医学视觉语言模型（VLM）对细微病变的表征。它构建了病理-解剖原型空间（EasyBank），通过反事实原型推理选择病变相关块（EasyTag），并通过形态学引导残差增强（EasyAmplifier）放大其表示。在多个医学图像数据集和冻结的医学VLM骨干上，EasyLens改善了细微病变检测，优于现有编码器增强基线。
Motivation: 现有医学VLM对细微病变不敏感，而现有改进方法需额外训练或特定模型适配，不适用于冻结的VLM。
Method: EasyLens包含三个组件：EasyBank（病理-解剖原型空间，提供病变原型和解剖感知正常参考）、EasyTag（通过反事实原型推理选择病变相关块）和EasyAmplifier（形态学引导残差增强，放大病变块表示）。
Result: 在多个医学图像数据集和冻结的医学VLM骨干上，EasyLens改善了细微病变检测，并优于现有编码器增强基线。
Conclusion: EasyLens无需训练即可即插即用，通过增强细微病变表征提高了VLM对病变的敏感性，且不依赖特定疾病形态或模型适配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Infrastructure Inspection as Image Difference Classification: A Traffic Sign Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins (DTs) allow the digitalization of road infrastructure inspection, though this is hindered by limited annotated data. This work exploits the relational nature of continuous asset condition monitoring to reformulate image-based defect detection as image difference classification (IDC) to reduce data reliance. This was evaluated in a case study on low-resource traffic sign inspection with different IDC classifiers using a newly-curated, high quality dataset. Results indicate that the instruction-based classifier outperforms encoder-based ones and gains from comparison with reference images. This shows that IDC can be an effective task modeling for tackling data constraints in infrastructure inspection and DT asset condition updating.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将基础设施检查重新定义为图像差异分类（IDC），以减少对标注数据的依赖。以交通标志检测为案例，使用新数据集评估不同分类器，发现基于指令的分类器优于基于编码器的分类器，表明IDC可有效应对数据稀缺问题。
Motivation: 基础设施数字双胞胎（DT）检测受限于标注数据稀缺，需要一种数据高效的方法。
Method: 将缺陷检测转化为图像差异分类（IDC），比较当前图像与参考图像，使用指令型分类器。
Result: 基于指令的分类器在低资源交通标志检查中优于基于编码器的分类器，且从参考图像对比中获益。
Conclusion: IDC是应对基础设施检查数据约束的有效任务建模方法，可用于DT资产状态更新。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LatentWave: JEPA Pretraining for Wireless Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Wireless foundation models have emerged as a promising alternative to building separate models for each wireless task. However, existing approaches rely on masked input reconstruction, which can bias representations toward low-level signal details. In this paper, we propose LatentWave, a wireless foundation model pretrained using a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) on diverse wireless spectrograms and channel state information (CSI). By predicting masked regions in latent space, LatentWave learns representations that are more transferable out of the box across diverse downstream tasks. The proposed architecture employs per-channel patch embeddings with stochastic channel sampling during pretraining, allowing it to process variable antenna counts and improving usability across heterogeneous wireless configurations. We evaluate LatentWave on four downstream tasks: RF signal classification, 5G NR positioning, beam prediction, and LoS/NLoS classification, comparing against a masked-modeling baseline (WavesFM) pretrained on the same data. Additionally, we show that the masking geometry introduces a task-dependent inductive bias: frequency masking strongly favors channel-related tasks such as positioning and beam prediction, while region masking better preserves discriminability for signal classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LatentWave，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的无线基础模型，在无线频谱图和信道状态信息上预训练，通过潜在空间预测学习可迁移表示。在RF信号分类、5G NR定位、波束预测和LoS/NLoS分类四个下游任务上评估，并与掩码建模基线比较。发现掩码几何引入任务相关的归纳偏置：频率掩码有利于信道相关任务，区域掩码保留信号分类的可判别性。
Motivation: 现有无线基础模型依赖掩码输入重建，可能使表示偏向低级信号细节，影响跨任务迁移性。
Method: 采用JEPA在潜在空间预测掩码区域，使用每通道补丁嵌入和随机通道采样，以处理可变天线数，提高异构无线配置的可用性。
Result: 在四个下游任务上评估，与基于相同数据预训练的掩码建模基线（WavesFM）比较，并展示了掩码几何对任务性能的归纳偏置效应。
Conclusion: 潜在空间预测能学习更可迁移的表示，掩码几何需要根据具体任务选择以引入合适的归纳偏置。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 潜在空间预测能学习更可迁移的表示，掩码几何需要根据具体任务选择以引入合适的归纳偏置。

papers.title: Visual Commonsense Driven Knowledge Refinements for Scene Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Learning-driven Scene Graph Generation (SGG) models excel on frequent relation types but degrade sharply under annotation sparsity, failing to capture reliable visual commonsense knowledge. We propose a model-agnostic, semantically-guided knowledge refinement framework that systematically mines commonsense-grounded constraints from training data - capturing spatial, functional, and qualitative relational regularities - and uses general declarative commonsense reasoning to correct and refine ranked SGG predictions at inference time. The framework requires no manual rule authoring, no model retraining, and transfers across datasets and architectures. On three standard benchmarks, we obtain consistent improvements over strong baselines, demonstrating that structured visual commonsense reasoning over deep scene semantics is a practical and effective complement to purely learning-based scene graph generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对场景图生成（SGG）中稀疏标注导致模型对稀有关系类型性能退化的问题，提出一个模型无关的语义引导知识精炼框架。该框架从训练数据中自动挖掘常识约束（空间、功能、定性关系规律），并在推理时通过声明式常识推理对SGG预测进行纠正和排序。在三个标准基准上，该方法一致地提升了强基线的性能，表明结构化视觉常识推理是纯学习方法的有效补充。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的SGG模型在频繁关系类型上表现良好，但在标注稀疏的情况下性能急剧下降，无法捕获可靠的视觉常识知识。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的、语义引导的知识精炼框架，系统地从训练数据中挖掘常识约束（空间、功能、定性关系规律），并使用通用声明式常识推理在推理时对排序后的SGG预测进行纠正和精炼。无需手动编写规则或重新训练模型，且可跨数据集和架构迁移。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，基于深度场景语义的结构化视觉常识推理是纯学习场景图生成的一种实用且有效的补充方案。

papers.title: Optimally taming biases in black-box models for efficient semiparametric estimation
papers.abstract_en: Modern semiparametric estimation often relies on flexible black-box machine learning methods to estimate nuisance functions, raising a fundamental question: how do nuisance estimation errors propagate into inference for low-dimensional target parameters? The dominant paradigm, exemplified by double machine learning (DML), yields error bounds in which nuisance estimation errors enter multiplicatively. While widely adopted, it remains unclear whether this multiplicative-rate dependence is optimal for black-box models. In this paper, we start by revisiting the partial linear model $Y = μ_0(X)+T\cdotβ_0+\varepsilon$ under a structure-agnostic setting, where the nuisance function $μ_0$ is estimated using a generic machine learning model, with approximation error $δ^a_μ$ and stochastic error $δ_μ^s$. We show that the standard DML rate is not optimal in the regime where the auxiliary function $\mathbb{E}[T|X=x]$ cannot be consistently estimated. We propose a new estimator for $β_0$ that achieves a sharper rate of $n^{-1/2}+δ^a_μ+(δ_μ^s)^2$ and establish a matching lower bound demonstrating its optimality. Our results reveal a new principle: the first-order stochastic error of nuisance estimation can be eliminated without imposing any additional assumptions. This also leads to a revised tuning strategy favoring under-smoothing, where $δ^a_μ\asymp(δ_μ^s)^2$, rather than the classical bias-variance trade-off $δ^a_μ\asymp δ_μ^s$. Under mild additional conditions, the estimator is asymptotically normal with minimal asymptotic variance. The proposed method extends to a broad class of semi-parametric linear functional estimation problems, including average treatment effect estimation. Our results imply that popular orthogonal score methods in semiparametric estimation with black-box nuisance learners can be substantially improved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究半参数估计中黑箱机器学习模型用于估计 nuisance 函数时的误差传播问题。通过分析部分线性模型，指出标准双机器学习（DML）的乘法速率并非最优，尤其在 nuisance 函数无法一致估计时。提出新估计器，达到速率 n^{-1/2}+δ^a_μ+(δ_μ^s)^2，并证明其最优性。新方法消除了 nuisance 一阶随机误差，推荐欠平滑策略（δ^a_μ≍(δ_μ^s)^2）而非经典偏差-方差平衡。结论扩展至平均处理效应等半参数线性泛函估计。
Motivation: 当前半参数估计通双机器学习（DML）使 nuisance 估计误差乘法性进入目标参数误差界，但该乘法速率在结构无关的黑箱模型中是否为最优尚不清楚，尤其当 nuisance 函数无法一致估计时。
Method: 考虑部分线性模型 Y=μ_0(X)+T·β_0+ε，在结构无关设定下，假设 nuisance 函数 μ_0 的估计具有逼近误差 δ^a_μ 和随机误差 δ_μ^s。提出新估计器，通过优化偏差-方差权衡，达到比标准 DML 更快的速率，并导出了匹配的下界。
Result: 新估计器达到 n^{-1/2}+δ^a_μ+(δ_μ^s)^2 速率，优于标准 DML 的速率。建议采用欠平滑策略使 δ^a_μ≍(δ_μ^s)^2，而非经典平衡。在温和条件下，估计量渐近正态且渐近方差达到最小。
Conclusion: 本文指出，在使用黑箱机器学习进行 nuisance 学习的半参数估计中，流行的正交得分方法（如 DML）可以显著改进，新方法消除了 nuisance 一阶随机误差，且不增加额外假设。

papers.title: End-to-End Subgraph Detection with GraphDETR
papers.abstract_en: Subgraph detection seeks to identify whether and where instances of query patterns occur within a larger graph. This problem is fundamental across scientific domains and is closely related to subgraph isomorphism, which is NP-complete, limiting combinatorial approaches to small patterns or moderately sized graphs. We introduce GraphDETR, a deep learning framework that formulates subgraph detection as a set prediction problem, analogous to DETR in object detection. GraphDETR encodes the target graph with a graph neural network, and employs a fixed set of learnable query vectors, decoded via a transformer decoder, to predict all pattern occurrences jointly in a single forward pass. This is enabled by training the model end-to-end with bipartite matching. Unlike traditional combinatorial methods that only solve exact structural matching, GraphDETR naturally extends to approximate matching, enabling detection beyond exact pattern correspondence. Empirically, we show that GraphDETR can detect diverse patterns, such as molecular structures, cycles, cliques, and fuzzy patterns of up to 50 nodes, in target graphs with up to 1000 nodes. We further evaluate on molecular functional group detection over the ChEMBL dataset, where GraphDETR predicts the complete set of functional groups per molecule, achieving a strong performance of $\text{AP}_{100} = 91.2$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraphDETR，将子图检测视为集合预测问题，类似目标检测中的DETR。模型使用图神经网络编码目标图，通过Transformer解码器联合预测所有模式出现，并采用端到端训练。该方法支持近似匹配，在多达1000节点的图上检测50节点内的模式（如分子结构、循环、团等），在ChEMBL数据集上预测分子功能团达到AP100=91.2。
Motivation: 子图检测与子图同构相关，是NP完全问题，传统组合方法仅适用于小模式或中等规模图，限制其应用。
Method: GraphDETR框架：图神经网络编码目标图，固定一组可学习查询向量，经Transformer解码器解码，通过二分匹配进行端到端训练，预测所有模式出现。
Result: 可检测多达50节点的模式（分子结构、循环、团等）在高达1000节点的目标图上；在ChEMBL数据集上，预测分子功能团达到AP100=91.2。
Conclusion: 该框架自然扩展到近似匹配，超越了传统方法的精确匹配限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GMBFormer: An NDVI-Guided Global Memory Bank Transformer for Urban Green-Space Extraction from Ultra-High-Resolution Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Urban green-space extraction from ultra-high-resolution (UHR) imagery is commonly performed patch by patch, which limits semantic reuse among spatially separated but visually similar vegetation patterns. Directly injecting the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) into red-green-blue (RGB) backbones can also blur the roles of visual appearance learning and physical vegetation confidence. We propose GMBFormer, a SegFormer-based framework that replaces adjacency-driven feature propagation with selective, similarity-driven prototype retrieval. Only RGB channels enter the backbone and decoder, while NDVI is decoupled as a physics-informed gate that admits high-confidence vegetation descriptors into a compact global memory bank through momentum updates. During training and inference, the current patch queries stored prototypes through memory-mediated cross-attention, and the retrieved response is integrated with bounded overhead. Experiments use a self-constructed Chengdu UHR dataset with 7,700 labeled 512 x 512 patches and two reduced-label settings derived from the public International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (ISPRS) Potsdam dataset. Under the same training and evaluation protocol, GMBFormer obtains mean intersection over union (mIoU)/mean Dice (mDice) scores of 89.25%/94.31%, 92.17%/95.92%, and 83.72%/90.86%, respectively, improving the controlled SegFormer-B4 baseline in each setting. Ablation studies indicate that decoupled NDVI admission, memory retrieval, capacity, and momentum jointly shape the final performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GMBFormer，一种基于SegFormer的框架，用于从超高分辨率影像中提取城市绿地。方法将NDVI作为物理引导门控，通过全局记忆库进行选择性原型检索，替代局部特征传播。在自建成都数据集和ISPRS Potsdam数据集上，相比基线SegFormer-B4获得mIoU/mDice提升。
Motivation: 现有方法按块处理超高分辨率影像，限制了空间分离但视觉相似植被模式之间的语义复用；直接将NDVI注入RGB骨干网络会模糊视觉外观学习与物理植被置信度之间的角色。
Method: 仅RGB通道进入骨干网络和解码器，NDVI解耦为物理引导门控，允许高置信度植被描述符通过动量更新进入紧凑全局记忆库。训练和推理时，当前块通过记忆介导的交叉注意力查询存储的原型，并集成检索响应。
Result: 在自建成都UHR数据集（7700个512×512块）和ISPRS Potsdam数据集两个标签减少设置下，GMBFormer分别获得mIoU/mDice: 89.25%/94.31%、92.17%/95.92%和83.72%/90.86%，均优于受控的SegFormer-B4基线。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明，解耦的NDVI准入、记忆检索、容量和动量共同决定最终性能。

papers.title: Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-Video diffusion models leverage input images to generate visually stunning content, yet frequently produce motion that violates physical laws. We reveal a surprising finding: a 2-step generation often exhibits better physical consistency than a 50-step output from the same model. Through spectral analysis, we trace this to phase erosion during denoising; the phase degrades significantly (dropping by $\approx 18\%$ from step 2 to step 50), whereas the magnitude remains relatively stable. Building on this insight, we propose PhaseLock, a training-free framework that preserves the valid motion priors from few-step inference throughout the denoising trajectory. Rather than relying on full-step inference for physical consistency, PhaseLock extracts a motion prior from just 2 steps and enforces it onto high-fidelity generation via Latent Delta Guidance. Our approach effectively mitigates phase degradation, improving physical consistency by an average of 6.2 points across diverse models while largely maintaining visual fidelity, with negligible overhead ($1.06\times$ time, $1.02\times$ memory) and reduced reliance on expensive external guidance methods ($\sim5\times$ time).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现图像到视频扩散模型在两步生成时往往比五十步输出具有更好的物理一致性，通过频谱分析将原因归结为去噪过程中的相位侵蚀。提出PhaseLock，一种无需训练的方法，从两步推理中提取运动先验，并通过潜变量增量指导将其施加到高保真生成上。该方法有效缓解相位退化，将物理一致性平均提升6.2分，同时保持视觉逼真度，开销可忽略，并减少对外部指导的依赖。
Motivation: 现有图像到视频扩散模型常生成违反物理规律的运动，而增加推理步数反而可能恶化物理一致性，现有方法依赖昂贵的外部指导。
Method: 提出PhaseLock框架，通过两步推理提取运动先验（相位信息），并在整个去噪轨迹中利用潜变量增量指导锁定该先验，防止后续步骤的相位侵蚀。
Result: 该方法在多种模型上平均提升物理一致性6.2个点，视觉质量基本不变，时间开销仅1.06倍，内存1.02倍，同时将外部指导的时间成本降低约5倍。
Conclusion: 从两步推理中锁定运动先验是一种轻量且有效的策略，可大幅提升物理一致性，有望减少对昂贵外部物理模型的依赖。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: An Infectious Disease Spread Simulation Based on Large Language Model Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Modelling individual decision-making during infectious disease outbreaks is crucial for understanding behavioural dynamics and informing effective public health interventions. Prior work has shown that large language models can simulate realistic human behaviour by generating agent decisions based on demographic prompts and situational context. We build on this foundation with a spatially grounded, agent-based simulation framework that integrates LLM-generated decisions about self-reported influenza-like illness into a census-based synthetic population of agents. Location is treated as a central feature: agents are assigned to spatial units within cities, capturing the spatial distributions of different demographic groups using real-world census data and enabling geographically diverse behavioural modelling. We implement and compare three decision scenarios, independent reasoning, household influence, and message framing, and simulate self-reporting outcomes in San Francisco and Atlanta. Results reveal that income and education are the dominant drivers of reporting rate variation, with smaller but consistent effects from geography, LLM model choice, and message framing. Our framework generates synthetic data that captures both social and geographic heterogeneity, supporting spatial epidemiological modelling and bias-aware behavioural analysis.

papers.title: Comparison of Deep Learning Frameworks For Rice Disease Mapping From UAV Multispectral Imaging
papers.abstract_en: In this study, UAV multispectral imagery is used to segment the severity of bacterial leaf blight (BLB) in rice using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformer-based models. The evaluated architectures include U-Net with a ResNet- 101 encoder, U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 and EfficientNetB7, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer, all trained under a common pipeline with three input configurations (multispectral only, multispectral+NDVI, and multispectral+NDRE). Experiments are conducted using the publicly available BLB dataset with performance reported using mean IoU (mIoU), mean F1 (mF1), mean accuracy (mAcc), precision, and recall. U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3 achieved the highest performance, with an mIoU of 97.62%. SegFormer obtained lower segmentation accuracy but comparable inference speed. Overall, the results indicate that lightweight CNN backbones remain more reliable for operational BLB monitoring while integration of vegetation indices provides small and consistent improvements. The study also highlights the value of standardised UAV datasets to compare disease mapping methods and encourages the use of CNN architectures for field implementation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用无人机多光谱影像，评估了基于CNN和Transformer的深度学习模型在水稻白叶枯病严重程度分割上的性能。实验采用公开数据集，比较了U-Net、U-Net++、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer等架构，并测试了三种输入组合（仅多光谱、多光谱+NDVI、多光谱+NDRE）。结果表明，U-Net++搭配EfficientNet-B3取得了最高的平均IoU（97.62%），而SegFormer分割精度较低但推理速度相当。轻量级CNN骨干在操作性病害监测中更为可靠，植被指数的加入带来微小但一致的改进。
Motivation: 水稻细菌性白叶枯病（BLB）的精确分割对于病害监测至关重要，但缺乏对多种深度学习框架在无人机多光谱影像下性能的系统比较。
Method: 采用U-Net（ResNet-101编码器）、U-Net++（EfficientNet-B3和EfficientNet-B7）、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer等模型，在统一训练流程下，使用仅多光谱、多光谱+NDVI、多光谱+NDRE三种输入配置进行训练和评估。
Result: U-Net++ with EfficientNet-B3取得最佳性能，mIoU达97.62%；SegFormer精度较低但推理速度相当；轻量CNN骨干整体更可靠。
Conclusion: 该研究强调了标准化无人机数据集对方法比较的价值，并建议在实际田间部署中优先考虑CNN架构。

papers.title: F3-Tokenizer: Taming Audio Autoencoder Latents for Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Continuous audio autoencoders reconstruct waveforms well but often produce latents with weak structure for understanding, while self-supervised audio encoders capture semantics but are not directly decodable. This mismatch complicates a single audio tokenizer that must support both understanding and generation. We adapt continuous autoencoder latents to this setting with two components: a noise-regularized autoencoder bottleneck and a latent-side representation encoder. The bottleneck uses channel normalization and stochastic perturbation instead of KL-based variational training, yielding scale-controlled continuous latents for reconstruction and autoregressive generation. The representation encoder is trained on frozen autoencoder latents with RQ-MTP and frozen-LLM supervision. The resulting tokenizer provides high-dimensional representations for understanding while preserving normalized continuous latents as generation targets
papers.comment: Technical report; early work; 9 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出F3-Tokenizer，针对连续音频自编码器潜变量结构弱、自监督编码器不可解码的矛盾，设计噪声正则化瓶颈和潜变量表示编码器，使单一tokenizer同时支持音频理解与生成。
Motivation: 现有连续音频自编码器重构波形好但潜变量缺乏语义结构，而自监督音频编码器捕捉语义却不可解码，导致难以用一个tokenizer兼顾理解与生成。
Method: 提出两个组件：噪声正则化自编码器瓶颈（采用通道归一化和随机扰动替代KL变分训练）和潜变量侧表示编码器（在冻结的自编码器潜变量上使用RQ-MTP和冻结LLM监督训练）。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但描述该方法产生的高维表示可用于理解，同时保持归一化连续潜变量作为生成目标。
Conclusion: 该工作表明通过设计合适的瓶颈和表示编码器，可调和连续自编码器潜变量在理解与生成任务中的矛盾。

papers.title: Where Should Knowledge Enter? A Layered Framework for Knowledge Infusion in Multimodal Iterative Generative Mo
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal generative models produce fluent outputs but remain unreliable when generation must respect structured, domain-specific, or safety-critical knowledge. Existing methods incorporate knowledge through mechanisms such as prompt augmentation, guidance, latent editing, or fine-tuning, yet they are typically categorized by technique rather than by the component of the generative process they modify. We argue that knowledge infusion in iterative generative models is fundamentally anintervention-layer problem. Since thegenerative process unfolds as a trajectory of internal states, knowledge can act on four structurally distinct components of this process: the input/output boundary, the transition function, the intermediate state, and the model parameters. This maps to four intervention layers: surface, trajectory, latent, and parametric infusion. We instantiate the framework in diffusion models, map representative methods to all four layers, and derive design principles for multi-layer composition. In a controlled safety-alignment experiment using a multimodal knowledge graph with two diffusion backbones, we implement three of the four layers cumulatively, surface (input-side and output-side) and trajectory--latent (mid-generation). We show empirically that each additional layer addresses failure classes that prior layers cannot reach, reducing knowledge-violating outputs by 70.97% compared to vanilla generation and empirically confirming the framework's complementarity prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个分层知识注入框架，将多模态迭代生成模型中的知识干预分为表面层、轨迹层、潜在层和参数层。在扩散模型的安全对齐实验中，累积应用三层干预（表面、轨迹-潜在）相比原始生成减少70.97%的知识违规输出，验证了各层互补的预测。
Motivation: 现有知识注入方法按技术分类，缺乏对生成过程不同组件的系统理解，导致难以组合多种干预手段以覆盖所有失败模式。
Method: 定义生成过程的四个干预层：表面层（输入/输出边界）、轨迹层（转移函数）、潜在层（中间状态）和参数层（模型参数），并在扩散模型中实例化，进行累积式多层级知识注入。
Result: 在安全对齐实验中，表面+轨迹-潜在三层累积减少70.97%的知识违规输出，且各层独立处理其他层无法覆盖的失败类别。
Conclusion: 框架证明知识注入应视为干预层问题，多层组合可互补覆盖更广失败模式。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Maximising the Set-Piece Return: Optimising Football Corner Tactics with Graph Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is increasingly employed for the evaluation of football tactics. However, existing approaches focus on characterising historical actions or analyst-specified counterfactual scenarios. In this work, we seek to go beyond the imitation of historically observed patterns towards discovering new generalisable player configurations and strategies. To tackle this, we focus on optimising corner kick routines, and formulate a decision-making problem in which a central policy makes adjustments to attacking player positions and velocities to maximise first contact shot probability. Unlike classic optimisation that solves for isolated setups, we contribute a reinforcement learning architecture operating on graph-structured data that yields a general policy for adjusting arbitrary starting player positions. Evaluated on over 3,000 Premier League corners, our approach strongly outperforms baseline optimisation techniques under matched inference budgets. Our results suggest that graph reinforcement learning can shift set-piece analysis from historical evaluation and imitation towards reward-driven tactical discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对足球角球战术优化问题，提出一种基于图强化学习的决策框架。该方法将角球执行建模为强化学习问题，通过调整进攻球员位置和速度最大化第一接触射门概率，并在3000多个英超角球数据上验证了其优于传统优化方法。
Motivation: 现有足球战术分析方法多局限于历史动作评价或分析师指定的反事实场景，缺乏发现新策略的能力。本文旨在超越模仿，实现奖励驱动的战术发现。
Method: 将角球优化表示为强化学习问题，采用基于图结构数据的策略网络，能够针对任意初始球员位置调整其位置和速度，以最大化第一接触射门概率。
Result: 在3000多个英超角球数据集上，该方法在同等推理预算下显著优于传统基线优化技术。
Conclusion: 图强化学习可将定位球分析从历史评估和模仿转向奖励驱动的战术发现，为足球战术优化提供新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Function-Space Priors for Bayesian Neural ODEs with Application to Vessel Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Vessel trajectory prediction from Automatic Identification System (AIS) data is essential for maritime situational awareness, yet it remains challenging due to irregular sampling, missing reports, and complex dynamics. Beyond accurate point forecasts, maritime applications also demand well-calibrated uncertainty estimates for reliable decision-making. Bayesian Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) offer a principled framework for continuous-time trajectory modeling with uncertainty quantification by placing a prior over the neural vector field parameters. However, the commonly used isotropic Gaussian weight prior fails to encode informative structural properties of vessel dynamics, such as smoothness and locality. Existing function-space Bayesian neural network methods address this limitation for static mappings, but do not transfer directly to Neural ODEs, where the primary quantity of interest is the trajectory rather than the vector field itself. In principle, one could place a Gaussian process (GP) prior directly over ODE solutions, but this requires propagating distributions through a nonlinear ODE solver, which is analytically intractable. To address this challenge, we adopt a practical approach that imposes a GP-kernel-based prior directly on the vector field evaluated at a finite set of measurement points. Specifically, we augment the standard weight-space variational objective with a kernel-based regularizer that penalizes deviations of the vector field from the structure implied by a GP prior. To handle long and irregular AIS trajectories, we further combine this function-space regularization with probabilistic multiple shooting, which decouples inference across temporal segments while maintaining global consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动识别系统（AIS）数据中的船舶轨迹预测问题，提出一种在函数空间上施加高斯过程（GP）核先验的贝叶斯神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）方法。通过将基于GP核的正则化项引入标准权重空间变分目标，并结合概率多次射击（probabilistic multiple shooting）处理长且不规则轨迹，该方法在保持全局一致性的同时实现不确定性量化。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯神经常微分方程通常使用各向同性高斯权重先验，无法编码船舶动力学的光滑性和局部性等结构信息；而直接对ODE解施加GP先验在分析上不可行。
Method: 提出一种实用方法：在有限测量点上对向量场施加基于GP核的先验，通过核正则化项增强变分目标；并采用概率多次射击将推理分解到时间片段以处理长序列。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但强调该方法能够提供校准良好的不确定性估计，适用于不规则采样和缺失报告的船舶轨迹预测。
Conclusion: 函数空间先验与概率多次射击的结合为贝叶斯神经常微分方程在复杂动力学建模中提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Performance Evaluation of GraphCast for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting over Brazil
papers.abstract_en: The paradigm of global weather forecasting is rapidly shifting with the emergence of Machine Learning Weather Prediction models (MLWP). While these data-driven architectures demonstrate remarkable global skill, regional benchmarks in the Global South remain scarce, leaving their efficacy in complex, highly convective environments largely unverified. This study evaluates the performance of GraphCast operational against the deterministic ECMWF IFS HRES as baseline across four distinct Brazilian climatic sub-regions. Utilizing a scalable, cloud-native pipeline and the WeatherBench-X framework for benchmarking weather models, we assess selected tropospheric variables ($T_{850}$, $Q_{850}$, $Z_{500}$) over four selected seasonal windows, employing the operational IFS analysis as the ground truth to calculate the statistical metrics for both models. Results reveal a regime-dependent skill profile. During the austral winter, GraphCast underperforms in the medium range (lead days 2-7) for $Z_{500}$ when resolving fast-propagating baroclinic systems over southern Brazil, but regains an advantage in the extended range, where its inherent smoothing of chaotic small-scale variability becomes beneficial under deterministic skill metrics. Conversely, during the austral summer wet season, GraphCast accurately captures large-scale moisture transport while intrinsically dampening the high-frequency convective variability that degrades deterministic NWP temperature forecasts. These findings establish a baseline for Brazil and define the specific physical boundaries that will guide future ``tropicalization'' efforts, aiming to optimize these foundational AI models for regional resilience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了机器学习天气预测模型GraphCast在巴西四个气候亚区域的中期预报性能，以ECMWF IFS HRES为基线，对比850hPa温度、850hPa比湿和500hPa位势高度变量。结果表明GraphCast在冬季中短期表现较差，但在延伸期因平滑混沌小尺度变异而占优；夏季能准确捕捉大尺度水汽输送，但抑制了高频对流变率。
Motivation: 全球天气预报正转向机器学习模型，但全球南方地区的区域基准稀缺，模型在复杂对流环境中的有效性未经验证。
Method: 利用可扩展的云原生管道和WeatherBench-X框架，以IFS分析为真值，计算统计指标，对四个季节窗口的选定对流层变量进行对比评估。
Result: 冬季中短期（2-7天）GraphCast对500hPa位势高度预报不如IFS，但延伸期占优；夏季定性地捕捉大尺度水汽输送，但平滑了高频对流变率。
Conclusion: 研究为巴西建立了基线，并定义了未来'热带化'优化的物理边界。

papers.title: Attack Detection using Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of attack detection in cyber-physical systems without any knowledge of the plant model or its structure. A remotely located plant transmits sensor measurements to an operator over a network that is assumed to be under attack. We consider two classes of attacks: model-free replay attacks and model-based stealthy attacks. For the latter, we derive closed-form expressions for the optimal stealthy attack policy against a $χ^2$ detector, for both linear and nonlinear systems. We then propose a model-structure-free detector based on TimesFM, a time-series foundation model developed by Google Research, which serves as a surrogate residual generator operating in a zero-shot fashion. We show empirically that the TimesFM-based detector achieves a comparable or superior attack detection performance. The efficacy of the proposed approach is demonstrated numerically on the IEEE 14-bus power system. We also demonstrate that TimesFM predictions can serve as a substitute for corrupted measurements, a practical mitigation technique when classical redundancy assumptions fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络物理系统中无模型知识的攻击检测问题，提出基于TimesFM时间序列基础模型的零样本检测器。论文推导了针对χ²检测器的最优隐秘攻击策略（包括线性和非线性系统），并实验表明TimesFM检测器在IEEE 14-bus电力系统上实现相当或更优的检测性能，同时可替代被破坏的测量值用于缓解攻击。
Motivation: 现有攻击检测方法通常依赖精确的物理模型或冗余假设，但实际中模型可能未知或不可用。
Method: 利用Google Research的TimesFM时间序列基础模型作为零样本残差生成器，替代传统基于模型的残差生成器；同时推导了针对χ²检测器的最优隐秘攻击策略的闭式表达式。
Result: 在IEEE 14-bus电力系统上，基于TimesFM的检测器与经典方法（如基于模型的检测器）相比，实现了相当或更优的攻击检测性能。
Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型可在无模型结构知识的情况下有效用于攻击检测，并可作为测量值缺失时的替代方案。

papers.title: Boosting Brain-to-Image Decoding with TRIBE v2 Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Brain decoding is limited by the availability of labeled neural data, and remains challenging in low-data regimes. To address this issue, we investigate whether and when brain decoding can be boosted by augmenting small fMRI datasets with synthetic data generated by a pretrained model of fMRI responses to stimuli. We use TRIBE v2, a large encoding model pretrained on more than 1000 hours of fMRI responses to video, audio and language. For each dataset, we evaluate systematic grids that show how the performance of image decoders varies with the amount of synthetic data used for training. Our results, based on two datasets (the 7T fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset and 3T fMRI BOLD5000), show up to 68% improvement in Top-10 image-retrieval accuracy compared to decoders trained only on real data. Importantly, the proportion of augmented data required to reach a given image decoding performance needs to be adjusted depending on the data source. Surprisingly, image decoders trained exclusively on synthetic fMRI can perform above chance in some settings, suggesting that TRIBE v2 can support zero-shot brain-to-image decoding. Together, these results show how large-scale models of the fMRI responses to sight, sound and language may provide a foundation to improve the data efficiency for image decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过合成fMRI数据增强脑解码性能。使用TRIBE v2编码模型（基于1000小时fMRI响应预训练）生成合成数据，在Natural Scenes Dataset和BOLD5000数据集上，Top-10图像检索准确率提升最高达68%。结果表明，合成数据比例需根据数据源调整，纯合成数据也能实现零样本脑到图像解码。
Motivation: 标记神经数据稀缺限制了脑解码研究，尤其在低数据场景下性能不佳。
Method: 利用预训练的TRIBE v2编码模型生成合成fMRI数据，对真实小样本数据集进行数据增强，系统评估不同合成数据量对图像解码器性能的影响。
Result: 在7T fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset和3T fMRI BOLD5000上，Top-10图像检索准确率提升最高达68%；纯合成数据训练的解码器在某些设置下仍高于随机水平。
Conclusion: 大规模fMRI响应模型（如TRIBE v2）可有效提高图像解码的数据效率，但合成数据比例需根据数据源调整。

papers.title: Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic inference over spatially embedded variables requires beliefs that respect $SE(3)$ symmetry, yet existing equivariant networks produce only scalars and vectors -- not the rank-2 precision tensors needed for anisotropic uncertainty, and single-component messages collapse multi-modal energy landscapes to physically meaningless averages. We introduce Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation (ENBP), a factor-graph framework whose messages are equivariant Gaussian mixture models with sufficient statistics that transform exactly under $SE(3)$. Rank-2 precision matrices are synthesised via equivariant outer products, ingested through differentiable spectral decomposition, and kept tractable by a greedy KL-based mixture reduction that provably commutes with $SE(3)$. On GEOM-QM9 and GEOM-Drugs, ENBP achieves 98.9% conformational coverage at 0.090 $\mathring{A}$ error with sub-second latency -- over $100\times$ faster than diffusion baselines at higher accuracy. On multi-body robotic inference, vanilla loopy BP diverges at 15+ agents while ENBP converges with near-zero collision rates and machine-precision equivariance error (${\sim}10^{-7}$ vs.\ $10^{-1}$ for augmented baselines).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出等变神经置信传播（ENBP），一种因子图框架，其消息为等变高斯混合模型，在SE(3)变换下精确变换。通过等变外积合成秩2精度矩阵，利用可微谱分解处理，并通过贪婪KL混合约简保持可计算性。在GEOM-QM9和GEOM-Drugs上，ENBP达到98.9%构象覆盖率和0.090Å误差，亚秒级延迟，比扩散基线快100倍以上且精度更高。在多体机器人推理中，普通loopy BP在15个以上智能体时发散，而ENBP收敛，碰撞率接近零，等变误差达机器精度（~10^{-7}，而增强基线为10^{-1}）。
Motivation: 空间嵌入变量的概率推理需要尊重SE(3)对称性的信念，但现有等变网络仅输出标量和向量，无法生成各向异性不确定性所需的秩2精度张量，且单分量消息会将多峰能量景观坍缩为物理无意义的平均值。
Method: 提出等变神经置信传播（ENBP），一种因子图框架，其消息为等变高斯混合模型，其充分统计量在SE(3)下精确变换。通过等变外积合成秩2精度矩阵，经可微谱分解处理，并通过贪婪KL散度为基础的混合约简保持可计算性，该约简与SE(3)可交换。
Result: 在GEOM-QM9和GEOM-Drugs上，ENBP达到98.9%构象覆盖率，均方根误差0.090Å，延迟亚秒级，比扩散基线快100倍以上且精度更高。在多体机器人推理中，超过15个智能体时普通loopy BP发散，而ENBP收敛，碰撞率接近零，等变误差为~10^{-7}（增强基线为10^{-1}）。
Conclusion: ENBP通过等变高斯混合消息和可微谱分解，实现了高精度、极快的概率推理，尤其在多体系统中展现出比传统loopy BP更稳定的收敛性和更高的等变精度。

papers.title: Symmetric Divergence and Normalized Similarity: A Unified Topological Framework for Representation Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) offers a principled, intrinsic lens for comparing neural representations. However, existing paired topological divergences (e.g., RTD) are limited by heuristic asymmetry and, more critically, unbounded scores that depend on sample size, hindering reliable cross-scenario benchmarking. To address these challenges, we develop a unified topological toolkit serving two complementary needs: fine-grained structural diagnosis and robust, standardized evaluation. First, we complete the RTD framework by introducing Symmetric Representation Topology Divergence (SRTD) and its efficient variant SRTD-lite. Beyond resolving the theoretical asymmetry of prior variants, SRTD consolidates diagnostic information into a single, comprehensive cross-barcode signature. This allows for precise localization of structural discrepancies and serves as an effective optimization objective without the overhead of dual directional computations. Second, to enable reliable benchmarking across heterogeneous settings, we propose Normalized Topological Similarity (NTS). By measuring the rank correlation of hierarchical merge orders, NTS yields a scale-invariant metric bounded between -1 and 1, effectively overcoming the scale and sample-dependence of unnormalized divergences. Experiments across synthetic and real-world deep learning settings demonstrate that our toolkit captures functional shifts in CNNs missed by geometric measures and robustly maps LLM genealogy even under distance saturation, offering a rigorous, topology-aware perspective that complements measures like CKA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经表示比较中现有拓扑散度的不对称性和无界问题，提出对称表示拓扑散度（SRTD）及其高效变体SRTD-lite，以及归一化拓扑相似度（NTS）。SRTD解决了理论不对称性，提供单一综合交叉条码签名；NTS通过秩相关给出有界[-1,1]的尺度不变度量。实验证明该方法在CNN功能变化检测和LLM系谱映射上优于几何度量。
Motivation: 现有成对拓扑散度（如RTD）存在启发式不对称性以及得分无界且依赖样本量的问题，阻碍了跨场景可靠基准测试。
Method: 提出对称表示拓扑散度（SRTD）及高效变体SRTD-lite，完成RTD框架的对称化；提出归一化拓扑相似度（NTS），通过层次合并顺序的秩相关给出有界尺度不变度量。
Result: 在合成和真实深度学习设置中，该工具包捕捉到了几何度量（如CKA）遗漏的CNN功能变化，并在距离饱和下稳健映射LLM系谱。
Conclusion: 提供了一个严格的拓扑感知分析视角，补充了现有几何度量，适用于表示分析。

papers.title: StoryVideoQA: Scaling Deep Video Understanding with a Large-Scale, Multi-Genre and Auto-Generated Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Video question answering (VideoQA) aims to answer questions about given videos. While existing approaches excel on factoid VideoQA, they struggle with deep video understanding (DVU), which requires the comprehension of complex storylines. This challenge arises from the inherent long-range video content, multi-faceted question types, and instance-level story elements, all of which constrain the scale and diversity of manually constructed DVU datasets. These difficulties constrain the scale and diversity of manually-constructed DVU dataset. To address these, we previously introduced StoryMind to automatically construct DVU datasets with balanced fine-grained topics. Though it can generate high-quality question-answer pairs (QAs) for TV series, it suffers significant performance degradation when handling longer and more complex movies. In this paper, we further design StoryMindv2, an enhanced multi-agent collaboration framework to generate high-quality DVU datasets for both TV series and movies. By integrating a novel supervisor-guided generation mechanism and a refined multi-reviewer voting strategy, the framework is utilized to construct StoryVideoQA, the largest DVU dataset to date, featuring over 363K QAs on 393.2 hours diverse story videos including TV series (avg. 1,635 seconds) and movies (avg. 7,878 seconds). Comprehensive evaluations of 20 state-of-the-art VideoQA methods on this large-scale benchmark reveal that they cannot fully maintain long-range character associations or construct a coherent understanding of complex storylines. To bridge this gap, we propose PlotTree, a novel video understanding agent, re-organizing long-range video content into a hierarchical plot structure, enabling efficient storyline reasoning on StoryVideoQA. Project page: https://github.com/nercms-mmap/StoryVideoQA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度视频理解（DVU）中现有数据集规模不足、多体裁覆盖有限的问题，提出StoryMindv2多智能体协作框架，自动构建了StoryVideoQA数据集——包含393.2小时影视视频（电视连续剧平均时长1635秒，电影平均时长7878秒）上的363K问答对。评估20种SOTA视频问答方法后发现它们难以维持长程角色关联和连贯情节理解，为此进一步提出PlotTree视频理解智能体，通过层次化情节结构实现高效推理。
Motivation: 现有Factoid VideoQA方法在深度视频理解任务上表现不佳，因为手动构建的DVU数据集受限于长视频、多问题类型和实例级故事元素，难以扩展规模和多样性。
Method: 提出StoryMindv2框架，包含监督生成机制和多审阅者投票策略，自动为电视连续剧和电影生成高质量问答对；另提出PlotTree智能体，将长视频内容重组织为层次化情节结构以支持情节推理。
Result: StoryVideoQA是迄今最大的DVU数据集（363K QA对，393.2小时视频），20种SOTA方法评估显示均无法充分保持长程角色关联和连贯情节理解。

papers.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) deployments for long-horizon tasks face a fundamental constraint: context windows are finite while productive work sessions are not. When history exceeds the Maximum Effective Context Window (MECW), critical structured information - architectural decisions, task transitions, file histories - is silently discarded. Existing mitigations treat history as flat text, destroying the relational structure that makes sessions resumable. We present TokenMizer, an open-source proxy system that models LLM session history as a typed knowledge graph. The schema defines 14 node types and 7 edge types. A hybrid extraction pipeline populates the graph incrementally, while a three-tier checkpoint system serializes it into compact resume blocks. An 8-layer compression pipeline reduces context overhead, and a semantic cache reduces repeated-query latency. Evaluated on a controlled benchmark of 21 sessions spanning 5 domains, TokenMizer demonstrates significant token economy. It produces resume blocks averaging 78 tokens (range: 42-124) - 2x smaller than evaluated baselines (159-170 tokens) - while achieving higher decision recall (+9-17 percentage points). Crucially, baselines only preserve that a technology was mentioned; TokenMizer preserves the rationale. Across all sessions, TokenMizer achieves mean task recall 51.0%, decision recall 46.6%, and file recall 58.7%. Variance reflects domain heterogeneity: explicit imperative phrasing (software engineering) scores higher than implicit reasoning (research). Ablation studies show fuzzy label matching is the dominant improvement factor (+33 pp task recall). The heuristic compression achieves 47.3% token reduction with zero external dependencies. TokenMizer provides a queryable alternative to text-retention baselines at half the token cost.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 10 figures. Code and benchmark available at https://github.com/Shweta-Mishra-ai/tokenmizer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长时程LLM任务中上下文窗口有限导致结构化信息丢失的问题，提出TokenMizer开源代理系统，将会话历史建模为类型化知识图谱（14种节点类型、7种边类型），通过混合提取管道增量构建图谱，三阶段检查点系统序列化为紧凑恢复块，并结合8层压缩管道和语义缓存。在21个会话（5个领域）的基准上，恢复块平均78 token（比基线小2倍），决策召回率提高9-17个百分点，同时保留决策逻辑而非仅提及技术。
Motivation: LLM上下文窗口有限，长时程任务中历史信息超过有效窗口时，关键结构化信息（如架构决策、任务转换、文件历史）被丢弃。现有方法将历史视为纯文本，破坏了可恢复会话的关系结构。
Method: 设计类型化知识图谱schema（14种节点、7种边），混合提取管道增量填充，三阶段检查点系统生成紧凑恢复块，8层压缩管道减少上下文开销，语义缓存降低重复查询延迟。
Result: 在21个会话基准上，恢复块平均78 token（范围42-124），比基线（159-170 token）小2倍，决策召回率提高9-17个百分点。平均任务召回率51.0%，决策召回率46.6%，文件召回率58.7%。模糊标签匹配是主要改进因素（+33 pp任务召回率）。启发式压缩实现47.3% token减少且无外部依赖。
Conclusion: TokenMizer以一半的token成本提供了可查询的替代方案，保留了决策逻辑而非仅技术提及，但领域异质性导致性能方差：明确命令式措辞（软件工程）得分高于隐式推理（研究）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bridging Domain Expertise and Generalization for Performance Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Performance estimation under distribution shift aims to predict how a model behaves on an unlabeled test set whose distribution differs from the training data, a scenario that requires reliable indicators that can faithfully reflect model behavior without ground-truth labels. Existing approaches rely solely on the outputs of the given model whose biases are amplified once the distribution shifts, weakening the correlation with the true performance. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Fused Reference Alignment Prediction (FRAP), which leverages the complementary strengths of an external foundation model and the base model to construct a more reliable surrogate of the ground-truth labels. FRAP aligns the prediction distribution of the foundation model with that of the base model by applying temperature-scaled calibration that minimizes their divergence. The aligned predictions are fused through confidence-based weighting into a refined reference distribution that integrates robustness from the foundation model and domain-specific expertise from the base model, and performance estimation is obtained by measuring how closely the base model predictions agree with this reference. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and architectures show that FRAP provides consistent and substantial improvements over representative performance-estimation methods under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布偏移下的性能估计问题，提出FRAP方法，利用外部基础模型（foundation model）与当前模型（base model）的互补优势，通过温度缩放校准对齐预测分布，再基于置信度加权融合生成参考分布，最终通过测量当前模型与该参考分布的一致性来估计性能。实验表明FRAP在多个数据集和架构上持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有分布偏移下性能估计方法仅依赖当前模型输出，其偏差在分布偏移时被放大，导致与真实性能的相关性减弱。
Method: 提出Fused Reference Alignment Prediction (FRAP)，首先用温度缩放校准使基础模型的预测分布与当前模型对齐，然后基于置信度加权融合两者预测，得到集成鲁棒性与领域专业性的参考分布，最后通过测量当前模型与参考分布的一致性来估计性能。
Result: 在多个数据集和架构上的实验显示，FRAP在分布偏移场景下持续且显著优于代表性性能估计方法。
Conclusion: FRAP通过引入外部基础模型并融合对齐，构建了更可靠的性能估计指标，有效应对分布偏移。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantifying the Privacy of Counterfactuals by Leveraging Membership Inference Attacks Against Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactuals are typically used in high-stakes decision areas to explain a machine learning model by showing how changes to the user profiles result in the desired outcome. However, explaining the model's decisions through counterfactuals can also be exploited by an adversary to conduct privacy attacks against the model or its training data. Drawing on the analogy that counterfactuals provide realistic substitutes for real training data, similar to synthetic data, we demonstrate in this paper how it is possible to successfully perform privacy attacks on counterfactuals by drawing on the attacks developed against synthetic data. More precisely, we investigate the effectiveness of the membership inference attacks designed for synthetic data on various types of counterfactuals. Additionally, while existing membership inference attacks against counterfactuals usually require to be able to query the model, we show how it is possible to perform successful membership inference attacks using only a set of counterfactuals, with no access to the model from which they are generated. Our results demonstrate that model developers should be more cautious when releasing counterfactuals to various users, as it can lead to a privacy breach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证反事实解释（counterfactuals）与合成数据类似，可被用于隐私攻击。作者借鉴针对合成数据的成员推断攻击，成功对多种反事实执行攻击，且无需访问原始模型。结果表明发布反事实可能造成隐私泄露。
Motivation: 反事实解释用于解释模型决策，但可能被对手利用进行隐私攻击。此前攻击通常需要查询模型，本文探索仅凭反事实本身是否能实现成员推断。
Method: 将反事实视为合成数据的替代品，直接应用已有的针对合成数据的成员推断攻击方法，评估其在多种反事实上的有效性。攻击仅需一组反事实，无需模型访问。
Result: 成功对多种反事实执行成员推断攻击，证明仅凭反事实即可泄露训练数据成员信息。
Conclusion: 模型开发者在发布反事实时应更加谨慎，以避免隐私泄露。

papers.title: Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for mechanistic interpretability in large language models, yet their formulation assigns each latent feature a single decoder direction, implicitly assuming features to be one-dimensional. We show that this assumption mismatches with the multi-dimensional structure of model features, provably inducing feature splitting through two distinct mechanisms. Geometrically, reconstructing a feature of intrinsic dimension $d_i \ge 2$ to error $\varepsilon$ with single-direction decoders forces a number of atoms that is exponential in $d_i$. From an end-to-end optimization perspective, this splitting is not merely possible but actively preferred. We prove that there exists a continuous path from the true $d_i$-dimensional basis to a strictly lower risk of the $\ell_1$-regularized SAE objective, whose descent directions drive any trained dictionary into that exponential regime. A single coherent feature is therefore fragmented across many near-collinear latents, producing spurious multiplicity and obscuring the intrinsic geometry. Motivated by this, we introduce Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which replace single-vector decoders with learned decoder subspaces, enforce block sparsity via Top-$s$ group gating, and adapt each group's effective rank with a nuclear-norm regularizer. We then show that once the block size satisfies $r \ge d_i$, a single group not only can represent the entire feature slice but is the global minimizer of the SASA objective. This consolidation yields a sample complexity polynomial in $d_i$ rather than exponential -- a decisive advantage given that every training activation costs an LLM forward pass. Empirically, on GPT-2 and Mistral-7B, SASA reduces feature splitting and absorption, improves monosemanticity and interpretability, and matches or exceeds standard SAEs while training on roughly half the token budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明稀疏自编码器(SAE)将隐特征假设为一维会导致特征分裂，并引入子空间感知稀疏自编码器(SASA)，用学习到的解码器子空间替代单一向量解码器，通过Top-s组门控和核范数正则化实现块稀疏性。在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上的实验表明，SASA减少了特征分裂和吸收，提高了单义性和可解释性，且训练所需的token预算约为标准SAE的一半。
Motivation: 现有SAE假设每个隐特征对应单一解码方向，忽略了特征的多维结构，导致特征分裂和伪多重性，妨碍了内在几何结构的揭示。
Method: 提出SASA，采用可学习的解码器子空间（每组子空间为矩阵），通过Top-s组门控实现块稀疏，并利用核范数正则化自适应调整每个组的有效秩。
Result: 在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上，SASA减少了特征分裂和吸收，改善了单义性和可解释性，性能匹配或超过标准SAE，但训练token预算减半。
Conclusion: SASA通过子空间解码器保留了特征的多维结构，以多项式样本复杂度替代指数级，显著提升效率。

papers.title: Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values
papers.abstract_en: Asymptotic e-values are emerging as a powerful alternative to asymptotic p-values, particularly in post-hoc inference and multiple testing, where significance levels may be data-dependent. Existing asymptotic e-values, however, suffer from the ``missing factor,'' a scaling inefficiency resulting in overly conservative inference. Drawing on the framework of near-optimal concentration inequalities developed by Bentkus in the 2000s, we introduce Bentkus-type asymptotic e-values and prove that they successfully eliminate the missing factor. We also demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that Bentkus-type e-values consistently deliver sharper inference than existing alternatives, leading to tighter post-hoc confidence intervals and higher rejection rates in multiple testing procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有渐近e值存在的“缺失因子”导致推断过于保守的问题，借鉴Bentkus在2000年代提出的近优浓度不等式框架，引入Bentkus型渐近e值，并证明其能成功消除缺失因子。理论与实证均表明，Bentkus型e值比现有方法产生更紧的事后置信区间和更高的多重检验拒绝率。
Motivation: 渐近e值作为渐近p值的替代在事后推断和多重检验中有潜力，但现有方法存在“缺失因子”导致的尺度低效，使推断过于保守。
Method: 利用Bentkus近优浓度不等式构造Bentkus型渐近e值，证明其消除缺失因子。
Result: 理论证明和实证均显示Bentkus型e值比现有替代方法产生更紧的事后置信区间和更高的多重检验拒绝率。
Conclusion: Bentkus型渐近e值能有效消除缺失因子，提供更尖锐的统计推断。

papers.title: Efficient Mean Curvature Computation on High-Dimensional Data Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Estimating local mean curvature at each point of a high-dimensional dataset is a key ingredient of geometry-aware machine learning algorithms, such as the Mean Curvature Boundary Points (MCBP) method. The naive implementation of this computation, based on a local shape operator approximated from k-nearest neighbor patches, involves an explicit construction of a matrix $H$ whose trace form yields an $O(m^4)$ cost per point, rendering the approach intractable for datasets with more than a few dozen features. This paper introduces two complementary contributions that together reduce this cost by several orders of magnitude. The first contribution is an exact algebraic identity. This identity, derived from the orthogonality of the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix and the cyclicity of the trace operator, eliminates $H$ entirely and reduces the per-point cost to $O(m^2)$ after the eigendecomposition. The second contribution addresses the remaining $O(m^3)$ bottleneck of the full eigendecomposition. Since the local covariance matrix has rank at most $k-1 \ll m$, we replace it with a truncated SVD of the $k \times m$ centered data matrix, an $O(k^2 m)$ operation, and derive an analytical approximation for the contribution of the null-space eigenvectors based on the expected value of their outer product under the Haar measure. The resulting estimator has total cost $O(k^2 m + k m p^2)$, where $p = k-1$. Experiments on real-world datasets confirm speedups of 50 to 300 times relative to the original implementation, with negligible loss when the fast estimator is used to replace the original version. By providing a scalable and data-driven estimate of local curvature, the proposed method establishes curvature as a practical geometric feature for a broad range of machine learning tasks, from classical to modern deep learning pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维数据流形上局部平均曲率计算开销过大的问题，提出两项互补贡献：一是利用协方差矩阵特征向量正交性和迹算子的循环性质，推导出精确代数恒等式，将每点计算复杂度从O(m^4)降至O(m^2)；二是通过截断SVD替代完整特征分解，并利用Haar测度下零空间特征向量外积的期望值进行解析近似，进一步将总复杂度降至O(k^2 m + k m p^2)。实验表明在真实数据集上相比原始实现加速50-300倍，且准确度损失可忽略。
Motivation: 在几何感知机器学习算法（如平均曲率边界点MCBP）中，需要高维数据集每点的局部平均曲率，但朴素实现基于k近邻贴片构建形状算子矩阵H，导致每点O(m^4)的计算开销，使得维度超过几十的特征数据集变得不可行。
Method: 提出两个贡献：1) 利用协方差矩阵特征向量正交性和迹算子循环性，导出精确代数恒等式，完全消除H矩阵，将每点代价降为O(m^2)（特征分解后）；2) 针对满特征分解的O(m^3)瓶颈，用k×m中心化数据矩阵的截断SVD替换，并基于Haar测度下零空间特征向量外积的期望值导出解析近似，总代价O(k^2 m + k m p^2)（p=k-1）。
Result: 在真实数据集上，相比原始实现获得50-300倍的加速，且使用快速估计器替代原始版本时准确度损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了可扩展且数据驱动的局部曲率估计，使曲率成为从经典到现代深度学习等广泛机器学习任务中实用的几何特征。

papers.title: PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: In healthcare, multimodal time series tasks often operate on incomplete observations in practice, for example when ECG segments are lost because electrodes detach or an entire respiratory channel is unavailable during overnight monitoring. Such missingness typically appears in two structurally distinct patterns: within-modality missing, where values are absent within an otherwise observed modality, and modality-level missing, where an entire modality is unavailable. Existing methods typically represent unobserved data implicitly through masks or missing embeddings, without learning instance-specific missing information, and most are designed for only one missingness pattern. A natural approach is to explicitly estimate the missing data; however, existing imputation methods treat missingness uniformly despite their different structural priors, and the imputation process is often isolated from downstream tasks, preventing downstream tasks from guiding imputation toward more informative representations. To address these limitations, we present PAMF, a multimodal time-series framework that explicitly handles different missingness patterns while coupling imputation with downstream prediction through prior-aware flow matching and weight sharing. Specifically, the method initializes the flow-matching source state with type-specific priors to distinguish two missing types. It further connects imputation and classification through architecturally matched encoders with weight sharing, transferring task-relevant representations into the imputation process. Experiments on multiple multimodal healthcare time-series benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves the strongest overall downstream performance across diverse datasets and missing settings compared with existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAMF框架，针对医疗健康多模态时间序列数据中两种缺失模式（模态内缺失和模态级缺失），通过先验感知的流匹配（flow matching）显式估计缺失数据，并将插补与下游分类任务通过权重共享编码器耦合。实验表明，PAMF在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法通常通过掩码或缺失嵌入隐式处理缺失数据，无法学习实例特定的缺失信息，且仅针对单一缺失模式设计；同时插补过程与下游任务隔离，无法利用任务信号指导插补。
Method: 提出PAMF，包含类型特定先验初始化流匹配源状态以区分两种缺失模式，并通过架构匹配的编码器与权重共享连接插补和分类，使任务相关表征融入插补过程。
Result: 在多个多模态医疗时间序列基准上，PAMF在不同缺失设置下均取得最优下游性能。
Conclusion: PAMF通过显式建模不同缺失模式并耦合插补与预测，有效提升不完整多模态时间序列数据的下游任务表现。

papers.title: DragOn: A Benchmark and Dataset for Drag-Based GUI Interactions
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents - vision-based models that control desktops, web browsers, and mobile devices through graphical user interfaces - promise to automate a wide range of digital tasks. While million-scale datasets have enabled substantial progress on click-grounding, drag grounding (e.g. drag-and-drop, swipe, highlight) data remains an order of magnitude smaller and current models fall short on complex drag-based interactions. We introduce DragOn, a drag grounding benchmark and training dataset covering four domains: text highlighting, cell selection, element resizing and slider manipulation. The dataset comprises 286K training screenshots and 3.5M training tasks, plus a 2000-example held-out evaluation suite. We evaluate proprietary (GPT, Claude) and open-weight (Qwen, Kimi, Holo) models, as well as a Qwen VLM fine-tuned on our training data. Results suggest that our dataset could improve performance of state-of-the-art models on downstream computer-use tasks.
papers.journal_ref: Published as a workshop paper at SCALE - 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DragOn，一个拖拽接地（drag grounding）基准和训练数据集，涵盖文本高亮、单元格选择、元素调整大小和滑块操作四个领域。数据集包含 286K 训练截图和 3.5M 训练任务，以及 2000 个评估示例。评估了 GPT、Claude、Qwen、Kimi、Holo 等模型，微调后的 Qwen VLM 在下游计算机使用任务上有所提升。
Motivation: 现有 GUI 代理在点击接地（click-grounding）上取得显著进步，但拖拽接地（如拖放、滑动、高亮）数据规模小一个数量级，当前模型在复杂拖拽交互上表现不佳。
Method: 构建大规模拖拽接地基准数据集 DragOn，包含四个领域的合成训练任务和真实截图，并基于 Qwen VLM 进行微调。
Result: 数据集可提升最先进模型在下游计算机使用任务上的性能。
Conclusion: DragOn 为拖拽接地提供了更丰富的训练和评估资源，有望推动 GUI 代理在复杂交互上的进步。

papers.title: Learning What to Forget: Improving LLM Unlearning via Learned Token-Level Importance
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model while preserving its general capabilities. For autoregressive language models, not all tokens in a forget sample are equally relevant to forgetting. Existing approaches either ignore this heterogeneity or rely on auxiliary models, heuristics, or external annotations to estimate each token's relevance for forgetting. We instead characterize it through the interaction with the retain objective: a token is forget-specific to the extent that minimizing the forget loss on that token does not conflict with retain optimality. We formalize this perspective as a joint optimization problem over the model parameters and the token weights and show that, under a natural separation condition, the resulting objective recovers the oracle forget-specific token support. Motivated by this formulation, we introduce Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning (ATWU), a lightweight framework that jointly learns token forget-specificity and model parameters during unlearning using a simple linear scorer over the hidden states, without external token level supervision. Across TOFU and RWKU, ATWU achieves state of the art forget-retain trade-offs, outperforming sample-level methods, probability-based token weighting heuristics, and auxiliary-model-based approaches. Moreover, the learned scores align substantially better with ground truth forget-specific spans, indicating that ATWU identifies semantically meaningful token level forgetting signals. Overall, our results suggest that retain conflict provides an effective criterion for identifying what language models should forget, enabling unsupervised learning of token level forget-specificity directly from model representations with minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归语言模型中的机器遗忘问题，提出一种无需外部标注即可学习每个token遗忘重要性的框架ATWU。该方法通过联合优化模型参数与token权重，基于遗忘损失与保持最优性之间的冲突程度定义token的遗忘特异性。在TOFU和RWKU基准上，ATWU实现了最佳的遗忘-保持权衡，且学到的分数与真实遗忘区间高度一致。
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法要么忽略token级别的异质性，要么依赖辅助模型或启发式规则估计每个token对遗忘的重要性，缺乏一种无监督且高效的token级遗忘重要性学习机制。
Method: 提出交替token加权遗忘（ATWU），通过联合优化目标同时学习token遗忘特异性和模型参数；利用隐藏状态上的线性打分器（linear scorer）预测每个token的权重，无需外部token级监督。
Result: 在TOFU和RWKU基准上，ATWU在遗忘-保持权衡上达到最优，优于样本级方法、基于概率的token加权启发式方法以及基于辅助模型的方法。学到的分数与真实遗忘区间的对齐度显著更好。
Conclusion: 保留冲突（retain conflict）是识别语言模型应遗忘内容的有效准则，能从模型表征中无监督学习token级遗忘信号，且计算开销极小。

papers.title: Quantum enhanced rare event discovery and sampling
papers.abstract_en: Financial crashes, cascading failures in infrastructure, and critical errors in AI systems are frequently triggered by events that occur with extremely small probability. Efficiently discovering and sampling events with probability below a threshold is therefore of critical interest. Yet this task is highly non-trivial using existing classical or quantum methods. Being rare, such events require an immense sampling overhead to collect sufficient data samples. Moreover, because the rare events are not known in advance, they cannot be flagged for amplification using standard techniques. Here, we introduce a quantum algorithm for rare-event discovery and sampling without first learning which events are rare. The algorithm achieves the optimal quantum scaling with the rarity threshold. We further demonstrate that this can achieve a quadratic speedup for heavy-tailed systems whose tail has nonvanishing total mass, and translates into a robust polynomial speedup for stationary stochastic processes, with the exponent determined by its entropy-rate structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子算法，用于发现和采样概率低于给定阈值的稀有事件，无需预先知道哪些事件是稀有的。该算法达到稀有性阈值的最优量子标度，并在重尾系统上实现二次加速，在平稳随机过程上实现多项式加速，其指数由熵率结构决定。
Motivation: 金融崩溃、基础设施级联故障和AI系统关键错误常由极小概率事件触发，但现有经典和量子方法在发现和采样这些未知稀有事件时效率极低，需要巨大采样开销。
Method: 提出一种量子算法，通过量子振幅放大和估计技术，在不预先学习稀有事件的情况下直接发现并采样，实现了与稀有性阈值最优的量子标度。
Result: 该算法在重尾系统（尾部非零总质量）上实现了二次加速，在平稳随机过程上获得了鲁棒的多项式加速，加速指数由过程的熵率结构决定。
Conclusion: 该工作为稀有事件发现和采样提供了一种具有最优量子标度的通用框架，并在理论上证明了其加速优势，但摘要未提及具体实验或实际应用验证。

papers.title: LLM Self-Recognition: Steering and Retrieving Activation Signatures
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in interpretability suggest that large language models (LLMs) implicitly encode signals in their generated text that enable self-recognition of their outputs. We demonstrate that this capability is reliable, even in low-entropy scenarios, and that it can be amplified through targeted intervention. By steering the internal residual stream during generation with a random sparse vector, we create a detectable fingerprint that enables attribution of a given text to a specific LLM. This signal is recoverable from the activations of an LLM used as a detector, achieving over 98% accuracy across multiple detection settings while preserving the quality of generated text. As AI-generated content proliferates, this approach offers a practical alternative to traditional detectors by leveraging the model's natural representation structure for attribution rather than embedding a signal externally. Our contributions include: (i) establishing reliable self-recognition capabilities in LLMs, (ii) a simple steering mechanism enabling multi-LLM identification with no quality degradation, (iii) demonstrating that activation spaces contain exploitable structure for encoding signals without semantic interference.
papers.comment: To appear in Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在生成文本中隐式编码信号以实现自我识别，并提出通过随机稀疏向量干预残差流来创建可检测的指纹，在保持生成质量的同时实现超过98%的归因准确率。
Motivation: 随着AI生成内容的激增，需要一种可靠且实用的文本归因方法，而现有外部检测器存在局限。
Method: 通过向LLM的残差流注入随机稀疏向量进行干预，在生成文本中留下可恢复的激活签名，并利用检测器LLM的激活空间进行信号恢复。
Result: 在多种检测设置下实现了超过98%的归因准确率，且不降低生成文本质量。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了LLM激活空间内在的可利用结构，为多LLM身份识别提供了无需外部嵌入的实用方案。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作展示了LLM激活空间内在的可利用结构，为多LLM身份识别提供了无需外部嵌入的实用方案。

papers.title: DAS-PINNs for high-dimensional partial differential equations: extending deep adaptive sampling to spacetime domains
papers.abstract_en: Time-dependent high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) with spatially localised and dynamically evolving solutions pose a fundamental challenge for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), as uniform collocation sampling becomes increasingly ineffective in high-dimensional spatiotemporal domains. In this work, a deep adaptive sampling framework for PINNs is extended to the time-dependent setting by treating space and time as a unified domain without any explicit time marching. A normalising flow neural network model effectively learns the distribution induced by the PDE residual and generates new collocation points concentrated in regions where the solution is most difficult to learn. Unlike conventional adaptive strategies that require explicit time stepping or moving meshes, high-residual regions are automatically identified and tracked across both space and time, driven purely by the PDE residual distribution. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is assessed on a range of benchmark problems, from sharp and moving features in two spatial dimensions to localised structures in up to eight spatial dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAS-PINNs框架，将深度自适应采样扩展到时空域，用于求解时间依赖的高维偏微分方程。该方法将时空视为统一域，使用归一化流学习PDE残差的分布，自动生成集中于高残差区域的配置点，无需显式时间步进或移动网格。在二维至八维的基准问题上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 传统PINN在时空域中均匀采样效率低，尤其当解具有局部动态特征时，难以捕捉高维时空中的关键区域。
Method: 将时空视为统一域，通过归一化流神经网络学习由PDE残差诱导的分布，生成新的配点，自动聚焦于难以学习的区域。
Result: 在二维至八维的基准问题上，该方法能有效识别并追踪时空中的高残差区域，处理尖锐移动特征和局部结构。
Conclusion: 该自适应框架无需显式时间推进即可处理时间依赖的高维PDE，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Wall Shear Stress Reconstruction from Concentration: Differentiable Physics and Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Wall shear stress (WSS) governs near-wall transport dynamics and is a key hemodynamic indicator in cardiovascular flows, yet remains difficult to infer accurately due to the need for precise computation of near-wall velocity gradients. Passive scalar fields, such as concentration or temperature, are advected by the same underlying velocity field and have the potential to uncover hidden flow physics metrics such as WSS. In this work, we demonstrate such reconstruction from spatially limited passive scalar observations using two fundamentally different inverse frameworks: a differentiable physics framework based on discrete adjoint, PDE-constrained optimization, which enforces the governing equations as hard constraints, and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), which treat them as soft constraints. Benchmark problems include a 2D canonical backward-facing step (2D-BFS) and a 3D patient-specific stenotic coronary artery. For the 2D-BFS case, evaluated under three measurement scenarios (near-wall, far-field, and combined), PINN achieves high accuracy when near-wall data are available but fails when restricted to far-field measurements, whereas the differentiable physics approach recovers accurate WSS across all scenarios. In the 3D patient-specific case, the differentiable physics framework outperforms PINNs, yielding accurate WSS reconstruction. These results establish that measurement location and inverse formulation jointly determine reconstruction fidelity in scalar-based near-wall flow inference. The proposed framework opens a path toward estimation of near-wall hemodynamics from scalar transport data, with broader applicability to fluid flow problems where passive scalars can be observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从被动标量浓度观测中重建壁面剪切应力（WSS），提出了两种逆问题框架：基于离散伴随的PDE约束优化（硬约束）和物理信息神经网络（PINNs，软约束）。在二维后向台阶和三维患者特异性狭窄冠状动脉基准测试中，可微物理框架在所有测量场景下均能准确重建WSS，而PINN仅在近壁数据可用时有效。结果表明测量位置和逆问题公式共同决定重建保真度，为从标量输运数据推断近壁血流动力学提供了新途径。
Motivation: 壁面剪切应力是心血管流中的关键血流动力学指标，但精确计算近壁速度梯度困难。被动标量场由同一速度场输运，有望揭示隐藏的流动指标，但目前从有限标量观测中重建WSS的方法尚不充分。
Method: 采用两种逆框架：可微物理框架，通过离散伴随和PDE约束优化强制执行控制方程作为硬约束；物理信息神经网络（PINNs），将控制方程作为软约束。在2D后向台阶和3D患者特异性冠状动脉上进行测试。
Result: 在2D后向台阶案例中，PINN在近壁数据下高精度，但远场数据时失败；可微物理框架在所有测量场景（近壁、远场、组合）下均准确重建WSS。在3D患者特异性案例中，可微物理框架优于PINN，获得精确的WSS重建。
Conclusion: 测量位置和逆问题公式共同决定基于标量的近壁流推断的重建保真度。该框架为从被动标量观测数据估计近壁血流动力学开辟了道路，并可推广到其他流体问题。

papers.title: AIS-Based Vessel Trajectory Prediction Using Memory-Augmented Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vessel trajectory prediction is essential for safe and efficient maritime operations, enabling collision avoidance and supporting route optimization. Although memory-augmented neural networks have recently shown strong performance in pedestrian and road-vehicle trajectory prediction by selectively retrieving relevant information from an external memory, their potential for vessel trajectory prediction remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical investigation of memory-based trajectory prediction using Automatic Identification System (AIS) data. Experiments on data from the Gulf of Mexico and the New York Bight demonstrate consistent and substantial performance gains over a range of deep learning baselines that do not incorporate an external memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证研究基于记忆增强神经网络（memory-augmented neural networks）的船舶轨迹预测方法，利用AIS数据在墨西哥湾和纽约湾数据集上取得优于多种深度学习基线的结果。
Motivation: 记忆增强神经网络在行人及车辆轨迹预测中表现优异，但在船舶轨迹预测领域的潜力尚未被充分探索。
Method: 采用外部记忆模块（external memory）选择性检索相关信息的记忆增强神经网络，基于AIS数据进行船舶轨迹预测。
Result: 在墨西哥湾和纽约湾数据集上的实验显示，该方法相对于多种不含外部记忆的深度学习基线，取得了持续且显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 记忆增强机制能有效提升船舶轨迹预测精度，为海事安全与路径优化提供支持。

papers.title: RhymeFlow: Training-Free Acceleration for Video Generation with Asynchronous Denoising Flow Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models based on Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved remarkable performance in video synthesis, yet they suffer from high inference latency and computational costs due to the quadratic complexity of 3D attention. Existing acceleration methods primarily reduce computational complexity within each individual denoising steps through techniques such as sparse attention and KV-caching. However, they rigidly adhere to the inherent constraint of the standard diffusion pipeline: every frame in the target video sequence must be subjected to a complete, dense denoising process across all diffusion timesteps. We observe that due to the corresponding contents and motions among adjacent frames, when keyframes with critical semantic transitions are anchored, the intermediate states of others often follow more predictable trajectories, which indicates that such uniform, dense denoising process is inherently redundant for natural video data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{RhymeFlow}, a training-free framework that decouples the denoising trajectories of different frames. Specifically, we first identify a sparse set of pivotal key frames that dominate the latent semantic evolution. Then, only these keyframes undergo dense, step-by-step denoising to ensure structural integrity, while non-keyframes progressively skip denoising steps to minimize computational cost. Since skipped intermediate states of non-keyframes break the temporal coherence in keyframe denoising steps, leading to visual degradation, we further introduce a latent trajectory projection module, which enables keyframes to interact with a complete and temporally consistent sequence representation. Extensive experiments on current DiT-based video generation models demonstrate our method outperforms existing baselines with higher inference speed and better visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RhymeFlow，一种无需训练的视频生成加速框架，通过异步去噪流调度，仅对关键帧进行密集去噪，非关键帧逐步跳过，并引入潜轨迹投影模块保持时间连贯性，在 DiT 视频生成模型上实现更高推理速度和更好视觉质量。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 视频生成模型因 3D 注意力的二次复杂度导致高延迟和计算成本，现有加速方法僵化地遵循标准扩散管道，对所有帧进行完整密集去噪，而帧间内容冗余使得该过程不必要。
Method: 识别稀疏的关键帧进行逐步密集去噪，非关键帧逐步跳过去噪步骤，并通过潜轨迹投影模块让关键帧与完整、时间一致的序列表示交互。
Result: 实验表明，在现有 DiT 视频生成模型上，RhymeFlow 相比基线方法具有更高的推理速度和更好的视觉质量。
Conclusion: 该方法无需训练，通过非均匀去噪调度显著加速视频生成，并保持时间连贯性。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction
papers.abstract_en: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensional discrete spaces, we introduce a Jacobian-free mechanism that directly corrects the clean prediction logits, facilitating stable and effective guidance. Our method accommodates both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions. Extensive experiments across DNA, protein sequence, and molecular generation tasks demonstrate that GILC achieves state-of-the-art performance without additional training, frequently outperforming fine-tuning approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度信息对数校正（GILC）框架，作为一种即插即用方法，无需重新训练即可实现离散扩散模型的可控生成。GILC通过将预训练去噪网络用作变分代理来估计引导信号，并引入无雅可比机制直接校正干净预测logits，避免了高维离散空间中的梯度不稳定问题。在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上，GILC无需额外训练即达到最先进性能，常优于微调方法。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型的可控生成方法计算开销高或需要重新训练，缺乏高效的即插即用引导方案。
Method: 提出Gradient-Informed Logit Correction（GILC），利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理估计引导信号，通过无雅可比机制直接校正干净预测logits，支持可微和不可微奖励函数。
Result: 在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上，GILC实现最先进性能，无需额外训练，常优于需要微调的方法。
Conclusion: GILC为离散扩散模型提供了一种高效、即插即用的引导框架，避免了重新训练和梯度不稳定问题，在多种生物序列和分子生成领域具有广泛适用性。

papers.title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) serving is critical for consistent user experiences, yet the linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant pressure on GPU memory and bandwidth. Non-uniform KV compression effectively preserves more information by considering the individual importance of each KV cache. However, such KV cache heterogeneity introduces various systemic challenges - including memory fragmentation, scheduling complexities, and diminished kernel utilization - which collectively lead to significant inefficiencies in existing LLM serving systems. To overcome these challenges, we present Tangram, a novel serving system designed to make Non-uniform KV caches practical. Tangram addresses systemic inefficiencies through three core techniques: (1) Deterministic Budget Allocation assigns a static memory footprint to each head based on its intrinsic pattern, entirely eliminating dynamic scheduling overhead and prefill stalls; (2) Head Group Page clusters attention heads with similar retention demands and manages them with independent, vectorized page tables, thereby maximizing physical memory reclamation; and (3) Ahead-of-Time (AOT) Load Balancing leverages static budget profiles to ensure uniform GPU utilization without runtime overhead. Experimental results show that Tangram improves throughput by up to 2.6x compared to existing baselines, while fully preserving model accuracy. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tangram 是一个针对多轮大语言模型（LLM）服务的系统，通过非均匀键值缓存（KV cache）压缩来提高效率。它采用确定性预算分配、头组页面和前向负载均衡三种技术，解决了非均匀KV缓存带来的内存碎片、调度复杂性和内核利用率下降问题，最终在保持模型精度的情况下将吞吐量提升至2.6倍。
Motivation: 多轮LLM服务中KV缓存的线性增长对GPU内存和带宽造成巨大压力，现有的非均匀压缩虽能保留更多信息，但引入内存碎片、调度复杂性和内核利用率降低等系统性问题，导致效率低下。
Method: 提出三点核心设计：确定性预算分配为每个注意力头分配固定内存开销，消除动态调度开销；头组页面将相似保留需求的头分组管理，最大化物理内存回收；前向负载均衡利用静态预算配置确保GPU负载均匀，减少运行时开销。
Result: 相比现有基准，Tangram 将吞吐量提升最高2.6倍，且完全保持模型精度。开源实现已发布于 https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM。
Conclusion: Tangram 证明了非均匀KV缓存在实际部署中的可行性，通过系统级设计克服了异质性带来的低效，为高效LLM服务提供了新方向。
