summary_sections.motivation: 多轮LLM服务中KV缓存的线性增长对GPU内存和带宽造成巨大压力，现有的非均匀压缩虽能保留更多信息，但引入内存碎片、调度复杂性和内核利用率降低等系统性问题，导致效率低下。
summary_sections.method: 提出三点核心设计：确定性预算分配为每个注意力头分配固定内存开销，消除动态调度开销；头组页面将相似保留需求的头分组管理，最大化物理内存回收；前向负载均衡利用静态预算配置确保GPU负载均匀，减少运行时开销。
summary_sections.result: 相比现有基准，Tangram 将吞吐量提升最高2.6倍，且完全保持模型精度。开源实现已发布于 https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM。
summary_sections.conclusion: Tangram 证明了非均匀KV缓存在实际部署中的可行性，通过系统级设计克服了异质性带来的低效，为高效LLM服务提供了新方向。

papers.title: Multi-ResNets for Subspace Preconditioning in Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose MResOpt, a staged residual neural network architecture for constrained optimization problems. Our architecture fits within predict-complete-correct pipelines and decomposes constraint satisfaction by priority through intermediate re-completion and stage-aware losses. The framework enables domain-informed ordered constraint satisfaction which allows the network to utilize ordinal structure when present. Under an idealized infinite-width regime, we show that our design behaves as sequential Gaussian Process regression. On synthetic QP, QCQP, and SOCP benchmarks, the staged architecture improves high-priority constraint satisfaction across convex and non-convex settings. On line-flow-constrained AC optimal power flow, we introduce a physics-motivated constraint ordering and show that MResOpt supports a learned division of labor that keeps iterates on the equality manifold, achieving substantially lower high-priority violation than reprojected baselines while remaining computationally efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MResOpt，一种分阶段残差神经网络架构，用于约束优化中的子空间预条件。该架构在预测-补全-校正流水线中，通过中间重补全和阶段感知损失按优先级分解约束满足。理论分析表明在无限宽区域行为类似于序贯高斯过程回归。在合成凸/非凸优化问题和AC最优潮流上，MResOpt显著降低高优先级约束违反，同时保持计算效率。
Motivation: 现有约束优化方法难以高效处理多优先级约束，特别是在非凸和高维场景下。摘要指出需要一种能够利用序贯结构并进行分阶段约束满足的预条件方法。
Method: 提出MResOpt，一种分阶段残差网络，在predict-complete-correct框架内，通过中间重补全和阶段感知损失实现优先级排序的约束满足。理论分析证明其在无限宽区域等价于序贯高斯过程回归。
Result: 在合成QP、QCQP、SOCP基准上，MResOpt提高高优先级约束满足；在AC最优潮流中，采用物理动机的约束排序，实现学习分工，保持迭代在等式流形上，相比再投影基线显著降低高优先级违反，且计算效率高。
Conclusion: MResOpt提供了一种有效的子空间预条件方法，能够利用约束的序贯结构，适用于多种约束优化问题。作者强调其计算效率和优先级约束满足能力。

papers.title: Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events
papers.abstract_en: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity $u(z)$, whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential $h(z)$, obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, $u$ and $h$ remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enhanced sampling methods. Flux Matching is validated through the generation of current velocity trajectories and rate constant calculations on molecular systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flux Matching 框架，从反应轨迹数据中学习电流速度 $u(z)$ 和标量势 $h(z)$，用于揭示稀有事件的反应路径和反应坐标。该方法无需动力学或稳态分布知识，适用于投影到非马尔可夫集体变量，并可通过自适应界面改进增强采样。在分子系统上验证了电流速度轨迹生成和速率常数计算。
Motivation: 路径采样方法生成反应轨迹集合，但从中提取机制性洞察仍然困难。现有方法如基于 committor 的方法在投影到非马尔可夫集体变量时可能不适用。
Method: 通过加权亥姆霍兹-霍奇分解从反应电流中学习电流速度 $u(z)$ 和标量势 $h(z)$，两者最小化反应路径系综上的二次泛函，类似于生成建模中的流匹配损失。
Result: 在分子系统上成功生成了电流速度轨迹并计算了速率常数，验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: Flux Matching 提供了一种无需动力学先验的机制发现和自适应采样框架，适用于复杂系统中的稀有事件。

papers.title: Towards One-to-Many Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Grounding (TG) aims to localize video segments corresponding to a textual query. Prior research predominantly focuses on single-segment retrieval. Real-world scenarios, however, often require localizing multiple disjoint segments for a single query -- a setting we term One-to-Many Temporal Grounding (OMTG). Previous state-of-the-art MLLMs, optimized for one-to-one settings, struggle in this context, often yielding near-zero scores due to a lack of event cardinality perception. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic solution with three key contributions. First, we establish the first comprehensive OMTG benchmark, introducing Count Accuracy (C-Acc) and Effective Temporal F1 (EtF1) as evaluation metrics. Second, we curate a high-quality OMTG dataset comprising 56k samples through a sophisticated construction pipeline. Third, we develop novel temporal and caption reward functions specifically designed for OMTG. In particular, the caption reward leverages Chain-of-Thought reasoning over dense video captions to explicitly guide policy optimization toward both preciseness and completeness. Extensive experiments show our model achieves a new state-of-the-art EtF1 of 43.65\% on OMTG Bench, outperforming Gemini 2.5 Pro and Seed-1.8 by 15.85\% and 15.61\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一对多时间定位（One-to-Many Temporal Grounding, OMTG）任务，旨在根据文本查询定位视频中多个不连续的片段。现有方法在此任务上表现不佳，原因是缺乏事件基数感知。作者构建了首个OMTG基准和包含56k样本的高质量数据集，并设计了针对OMTG的时序和字幕奖励函数，其中字幕奖励利用密集字幕的链式推理引导策略优化。实验表明，所提模型在OMTG Bench上达到43.65%的EtF1，超越Gemini 2.5 Pro和Seed-1.8分别15.85%和15.61%。
Motivation: 现有时间定位研究大多针对单片段检索，而现实场景中同一查询常需定位多个不连续片段，现有模型缺乏事件基数感知能力，导致性能极低。
Method: 建立OMTG基准和评估指标（Count Accuracy, Effective Temporal F1），构建含56k样本的OMTG数据集，提出针对OMTG的时序和字幕奖励函数，利用密集字幕的链式推理进行策略优化。
Result: 模型在OMTG Bench上取得43.65%的EtF1，相比Gemini 2.5 Pro和Seed-1.8分别提升15.85%和15.61%。
Conclusion: 本文提出的OMTG任务、基准、指标和奖励函数有效解决了多片段时间定位问题，并在实验中达到了领先性能。

papers.title: PAC-Bayesian Adversarially Robust Generalization for Message Passing Graph Neural Networks: A Sensitivity Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Whilst the vulnerability of graph neural networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks poses a critical threat to graph representation learning, the understanding of the robust generalization behavior remains a fundamental challenge in the adversarial setting. Recently, PAC-Bayesian margin-based generalization analysis substantially advances this line of research by providing a flexible and data-dependent analytical framework. However, existing robust analyses often rely on isotropic Gaussian posteriors and control weight perturbations in the full parameter space, which limits the ability to capture heterogeneous parameter sensitivity yet hinges on hidden-width-dependent complexity terms, resulting in not-tight-enough generalization bounds. In this paper, we extend a recently proposed sensitivity-aware PAC-Bayesian framework from deep neural networks to message passing GNNs (MPGNNs) and derive a tighter robust generalization bound in the adversarial setting. Specifically, we first quantify how sensitive the perturbations across different parameter blocks are to the network outputs by deriving the output Jacobians with respect to the weight parameters. Exploiting the fact that these Jacobian matrices have rank at most $K$ in $K$-class graph classification, we then construct Jacobian-aligned sensitivity matrices and use anisotropic Gaussian posteriors with optimized covariances to upper bound the KL divergence in a tight way. Notably, by refining the spectral-norm dependence on the learned weights and reducing the leading dimension factor from hidden-width-dependent terms to the number of classes $K$, our analysis yields much tighter robust generalization guarantees for MPGNNs, thereby guiding their designs to enhance adversarial robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对消息传递图神经网络（MPGNN）在对抗攻击下的鲁棒泛化问题，将最近提出的敏感感知PAC-Bayesian框架从深度神经网络扩展到MPGNN，推导出更紧的对抗鲁棒泛化界。通过利用输出雅可比矩阵的秩不超过类别数K这一事实，构造雅可比对齐的敏感矩阵，并使用各向异性高斯后验分布来紧化KL散度，从而得到更紧的泛化界。
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒泛化分析通常依赖于各向同性高斯后验和全参数空间的权重扰动控制，无法捕捉参数异质敏感性，且包含依赖于隐藏宽度的复杂度项，导致泛化界不够紧。
Method: 扩展敏感感知PAC-Bayesian框架至MPGNN，通过推导输出对权重参数的雅可比矩阵，利用其在K类图分类中秩至多为K的性质，构造雅可比对齐的敏感矩阵，并使用各向异性高斯后验优化协方差以紧化KL散度。
Result: 通过将谱范数依赖从隐藏宽度项降低到类别数K，得到更紧的对抗鲁棒泛化界，为MPGNN设计提供对抗鲁棒性指导。
Conclusion: 该分析为MPGNN提供了更紧的鲁棒泛化保证，有助于指导模型设计以增强对抗鲁棒性。

papers.title: Synthetic Data Generation and Vision-based Wrinkle and Keypoint Detection for Bimanual Cloth Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation of textiles remains challenging because continuous deformation and self-occlusions hinder the robust visual perception required to estimate the cloth's state. To address the lack of annotated real-world data, we developed a Blender-based synthetic pipeline exporting auto-annotated keypoints, and combined manually labeled renders with real-world data to train a wrinkle detector. We present a perception framework integrating a CNN for permutation-invariant keypoint detection and a YOLOv8-OpenCV pipeline to extract grasping points from structural wrinkles. A proposed bimanual algorithm uses this system to stretch fully folded garments via wrinkles, transitioning to keypoint-based ironing once corners emerge. The keypoint model achieves a Mean Position Error (MPE) of 1.7615 pixels. The perception system transfers to physical fabrics without fine-tuning, outperforming baselines that fail in high-occlusion states or yield false positives on severe folds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对布料机器人操作中的视觉感知难题，提出基于Blender的合成数据生成管道，自动标注关键点，并结合人工标注渲染图和真实数据训练褶皱检测器。提出的感知框架包括用于置换不变关键点检测的CNN和用于从结构褶皱中提取抓取点的YOLOv8-OpenCV管道。双臂算法利用该系统通过褶皱拉伸完全折叠的衣物，并在角点出现后转为基于关键点的熨烫。关键点模型的平均位置误差为1.7615像素。感知系统可直接迁移到真实布料，无需微调，优于在高遮挡状态或严重褶皱上产生假阳性的基线方法。
Motivation: 布料操作中连续变形和自遮挡阻碍了鲁棒的视觉感知，且缺乏标注的真实世界数据。
Method: 提出基于Blender的合成数据生成管道，自动标注关键点；结合手动标注的渲染图和真实数据训练褶皱检测器；构建包含CNN置换不变关键点检测和YOLOv8-OpenCV褶皱抓取点提取的感知框架；设计双臂算法，先通过褶皱拉伸折叠衣物，再转为关键点熨烫。
Result: 关键点模型的平均位置误差为1.7615像素；感知系统无需微调即可迁移到真实布料，在高遮挡和严重褶皱场景下优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 该合成数据生成和感知框架有效应对布料操作中的视觉挑战，且可迁移到真实场景。

papers.title: Discrete Causal Representations from Heterogeneous Domains: A Bayesian Approach with Social Survey Applications
papers.abstract_en: Causal representation learning aims to infer the high-level latent causal concepts that give rise to observed low-level measurements. This is particularly relevant for heterogeneous data from different environments or domains since distribution shifts often arise through sparse, localized changes in some of the underlying causal mechanisms, while other parts of the generative process remain unchanged. Whereas identifiability of causal representations has been studied extensively, practical uncertainty-aware methods and real-world use cases remain less explored. In this work, we propose a Bayesian approach to learning causal representations from multi-environment data, focusing on the case of discrete causal concepts and unknown multi-node soft interventions. To this end, we translate causal assumptions and interpretability desiderata into suitable priors and parametric choices within a hierarchical model. We then devise an inference scheme based on sequential Monte Carlo sampling to approximate the resulting multimodal posterior. We showcase our approach through case studies on social survey data, where latent causal concepts correspond to cultural values or political opinions, measurements to survey responses, and environments to different countries or states. Our model infers meaningful high-level concepts and plausible causal relations among them, demonstrating its utility for learning causal representations of complex real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多环境数据中的离散因果表示学习问题，提出一种贝叶斯方法，将因果假设转化为层级模型中的先验，并使用序贯蒙特卡洛采样近似后验。在社会调查数据（文化价值观、政治观点）上，模型能推断出有意义的潜概念及其因果关系。
Motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法缺乏不确定性量化，且多环境数据下的离散因果概念及未知软干预场景尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出层级贝叶斯模型，将因果可解释性要求融入先验设计，并采用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样推断多模态后验分布。
Result: 在社会调查案例中，模型成功推断出与地区差异相关的潜概念（如文化价值观）及其因果结构。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯方法能够为因果表示学习提供不确定性估计，并适用于真实世界异构数据的分析。

papers.title: LLMs Can Leak Training Data But Do They Want To? A Propensity-Aware Evaluation of Memorization in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can reproduce training data, but existing memorization evaluations mostly measure whether models can be forced to do so, rather than whether they do so under ordinary use. We introduce PropMe, a propensity-aware framework for memorization evaluation that contrasts prefix-based capability attacks with non-adversarial evaluations. We propose a metric transformation that, applied to existing functions, allows to create propensity metrics. We further introduce SimpleTrace, a lightweight tracing pipeline built on infini-gram that deterministically attributes model generations to large-scale training corpora and computes verbatim, near-verbatim, and propensity-transformed memorization metrics. Evaluating two fully-open models: Comma and DFM Decoder on two datasets: Common Pile and Dynaword in two languages, we find a consistent gap between capability and propensity: prefix attacks elicit substantially stronger memorization signals than generic or dataset-specific prompts, while propensity scores remain low overall. Thus, the models can reveal training data when directly elicited, but rarely do so in more common non-adversarial settings. We also find that DFM Decoder, which is continually pre-trained from Comma, exhibits reduced memorization and memorization propensity for Common Pile, confirming that memorization capability can decrease when later training emphasizes partially different data. Our results suggest, and we encourage, that memorization audits should report both worst-case extractability and ordinary leakage propensity in order to have a more comprehensive view of this phenomenon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PropMe框架，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在非对抗性使用下的训练数据记忆倾向。通过对比前缀攻击与非对抗性评估，发现模型在对抗性提示下能泄露训练数据，但普通提示下记忆倾向很低。在两个开源模型和两个数据集上的实验验证了这一差距。
Motivation: 现有记忆评估大多测量模型在强制攻击下能否泄露数据，而非普通使用下的实际泄露行为，缺乏对倾向性（propensity）的度量。
Method: 提出PropMe框架，包含基于前缀的能力攻击与普通提示的非对抗评估；提出度量转换方法将现有指标转化为倾向性度量；开发SimpleTrace管道，基于infini-gram归因生成文本并计算逐字、近逐字及倾向性转换的记忆度量。
Result: 在两个模型（Comma和DFM Decoder）和两个数据集（Common Pile和Dynaword）上，前缀攻击显著增强记忆信号，而倾向性分数整体较低；DFM Decoder（从Comma持续预训练）在Common Pile上表现出更低的记忆倾向。
Conclusion: 建议记忆审计应同时报告最坏情况可提取性和普通泄露倾向性，以获得更全面的视角。

papers.title: TRACE: A Temporal Conditional Estimation for Multimodal Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TS-FMs) aim to learn generalizable temporal representations that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. In real-world multimodal settings, time series are frequently affected by temporal misalignment and partial modality missingness, where different modalities are observed at heterogeneous time scales or are partially absent. Existing approaches typically rely on naive imputation or masking strategies, which fail to account for cross-modal dependencies and often lead to misaligned or degraded representations. We propose TRACE, a conditional estimation paradigm for multimodal time series foundation model pipelines under missingness and irregular sampling, allowing incomplete target modalities to be systematically inferred from available auxiliary modalities. We evaluate TRACE on diverse multimodal benchmarks spanning healthcare and affective computing, including the MIMIC-IV clinical dataset and the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI benchmarks for multimodal sentiment analysis. Across a range of downstream prediction tasks and missing-modality settings, TRACE consistently outperforms prior multimodal fusion approaches, demonstrating improved robustness to severe modality missingness and more reliable cross-modal representations.
papers.comment: 5 figures and 5 tables in the main paper, plus appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE，一种用于多模态时间序列基础模型的条件估计范式，解决时间错位和模态缺失问题。在医疗和情感计算基准上，TRACE在缺失模态下优于现有融合方法。
Motivation: 现有方法对多模态时间序列的缺失和采样不规则处理简单，忽略跨模态依赖，导致表示退化。
Method: TRACE通过条件估计，在缺失和不规则采样下，从可用辅助模态系统推断不完整目标模态。
Result: 在MIMIC-IV临床数据集和CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI情感分析基准上，TRACE在多种下游预测和缺失模态设置中持续优于先前方法。
Conclusion: TRACE提升了多模态时间序列对严重缺失模态的鲁棒性，但仅在医疗和情感计算领域验证。

papers.title: ToolChoiceConfusion: Causal Minimal Tool Filtering for Reliable LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on external tools, but larger tool menus can reduce reliability and efficiency by increasing wrong-tool calls, premature actions, and token cost. Existing tool-selection methods often optimize semantic relevance, exposing tools whose names or descriptions match the user request. We argue that relevance is insufficient: a tool may be related to the task while still being unnecessary or premature at the current step. We propose Causal Minimal Tool Filtering (CMTF), a training-free method that selects tools by causal sufficiency. CMTF uses lightweight precondition-effect contracts to expose only the minimal next-step tool frontier needed to advance from the current state toward the user goal. Across multi-step tool-use tasks, we compare CMTF with all-tools exposure, keyword retrieval, state-aware filtering, and causal-path ablations, measuring task success, wrong-tool calls, premature actions, tool exposure, and token cost. In the main benchmark with 102 tasks, 100 tools, four LLM backends, and 2448 task-method-model runs, CMTF matches the strongest causal baseline in aggregate success while reducing visible tools from 100 to one per step and reducing token usage by about 90% relative to all-tools exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出因果最小工具过滤（Causal Minimal Tool Filtering, CMTF），一种无需训练的工具选择方法。通过轻量级前置条件-效果合约，仅暴露当前步骤所需的最小工具集，减少错误工具调用和token消耗。在包含102个任务、100个工具的多步工具使用基准测试中，CMTF保持了与最强因果基线相当的成功率，同时将每步可见工具从100个降至1个，token使用减少约90%。
Motivation: 现有工具选择方法多依赖语义相关性，导致工具菜单过大时可靠性下降，增加错误工具调用、过早行动和token成本。
Method: 提出Causal Minimal Tool Filtering (CMTF)，利用轻量级前置条件-效果合约，根据因果充分性选择仅推进任务所需的最小下一步工具集。
Result: 在102个任务、100个工具、4个LLM后端的2448次运行中，CMTF成功率达到最强因果基线水平，同时将每步可见工具数从100降至1，token使用减少约90%。
Conclusion: CMTF是一种无需训练的工具过滤方法，能在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著提高工具选择和推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geodesic Flow Matching on a Riemannian Degradation Manifold for Blind Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Blind image restoration requires recovering clean images from observations corrupted by unknown and potentially mixed degradations. While recent deterministic flow-based methods model restoration as transport processes that map degraded images to clean ones, they typically rely on Euclidean interpolation, implicitly assuming linear degradation geometry. In this paper, we explicitly model degradations as points on a low-dimensional Riemannian manifold and formulate restoration as geodesic transport on the joint image-manifold space. Using a geodesic flow matching objective, we learn intrinsic transport dynamics that respect the curvature of degradation space. This framework generalizes linear flow matching, provides a principled treatment of mixed degradations as geodesic compositions, and yields a clean theoretical interpretation for generalization beyond observed degradations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于黎曼流形的测地线流匹配方法用于盲图像恢复，将退化建模为低维黎曼流形上的点，并学习测地线传输动力学，以处理未知和混合退化。该方法推广了线性流匹配，并在理论上能够泛化到未见退化。
Motivation: 现有基于确定性流的图像恢复方法通常假设线性退化几何，无法有效处理混合退化或泛化到未见退化。
Method: 将退化显式建模为低维黎曼流形上的点，在联合图像-流形空间上定义测地线流匹配目标，学习尊重退化空间曲率的内在传输动力学。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法推广了线性流匹配，为混合退化提供测地线组合，并具有泛化到未见退化的理论解释。
Conclusion: 该框架为盲图像恢复提供了更原则性的退化建模方式，有望提升复杂退化场景下的恢复性能。

papers.title: Adapting Diffusion Language Models for Lossless Pixel-Level Image Transmission
papers.abstract_en: Lossless pixel-level image transmission is a fundamental regime beyond semantic communications, because exact recovery requires both accurate symbol probability modeling and reliable delivery over noisy channels. This paper proposes DDM-SSCC, a discrete-diffusion-model-based separate source-channel coding framework for lossless image transmission. Different from raster-order autoregressive coding, the proposed source codec adapts a diffusion language model to pixel-token restoration and performs synchronized reverse arithmetic coding under bidirectional attention, allowing multiple masked tokens to be coded within one reverse denoising step. This progressive restoration process also yields a more favorable source representation for noisy transmission, since newly restored tokens can serve as bidirectional context in subsequent denoising steps. To bridge the gap between generation-oriented masked denoising and lossless arithmetic coding, we further introduce a Halton-guided denoising order, a mask-ratio-aware cosine schedule, and a lightweight temperature calibration module. These designs respectively improve spatial coverage, adapt the denoising pace to context reliability, and calibrate the probability tables used by arithmetic coding. Experiments on CIFAR10, DIV2K-LR-X4, and Kodak over additive white Gaussian noise and Rayleigh fading channels show that DDM-SSCC achieves better exact-recovery performance than representative lossless and semantic communication baselines, while ablation studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed denoising order, schedule, and calibration modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDM-SSCC，一种基于离散扩散模型的独立源信道编码框架，用于无损像素级图像传输。该框架将扩散语言模型适配为像素令牌恢复，并在双向注意力下实现同步反向算术编码，通过 Halton 引导的去噪顺序、掩码比例感知余弦调度和轻量温度校准模块，提升了无损传输性能。实验在 CIFAR10、DIV2K-LR-X4 和 Kodak 数据集上，针对加性高斯白噪声和瑞利衰落信道，相比现有无损和语义通信基线取得了更好的精确恢复性能。
Motivation: 无损像素级图像传输需要精确的符号概率建模和可靠的信道传输，现有基于光栅顺序的自回归编码方法效率有限，且语义通信不能保证像素级无损恢复。
Method: 提出 DDM-SSCC，包括：扩散语言模型作为源编解码器，在反向去噪步骤中对多个掩码令牌进行同步算术编码；引入 Halton 引导去噪顺序以改善空间覆盖；掩码比例感知余弦调度以适应上下文可靠性；轻量温度校准模块以校准算术编码的概率表。
Result: 在 CIFAR10、DIV2K-LR-X4 和 Kodak 数据集上，针对 AWGN 和 Rayleigh 衰落信道，DDM-SSCC 在精确恢复性能上优于代表性无损和语义通信基线，消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 所提出的基于扩散模型的源信道编码框架能够实现无损像素级图像传输，并优于现有方法，但论文未讨论计算复杂度或扩展到其他模态的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Your GFlowNet Secretly Learns an Optimal Transport Plan
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a framework for sampling structured objects via stochastic trajectories in a directed graph. In this work, we establish a theoretical connection between non-acyclic GFlowNets and optimal transport (OT). We show that fixing the initial flow distribution in a minimum-flow GFlowNet reduces its objective to a Kantorovich OT problem with graph-induced shortest path costs. At the optimum, the learned GFlowNet policy therefore encodes an optimal transport plan from the source distribution to the target distribution: we show that sampling trajectories from the minimum-flow GFlowNet recovers the corresponding optimal coupling. Our formulation enables applying the GFlowNet learning framework to OT problems on large graphs via edge flows and neural parameterization. Experiments confirm agreement with exact OT solvers and demonstrate that GFlowNets can learn high-quality transport plans.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: DAST: A VLM-LLM Framework for Cross-Interface Anomaly Detection in O-RAN
papers.abstract_en: O-RAN enables a disaggregated baseband stack with programmable functions that communicate over standardized open interfaces. The same openness that enables multi-vendor composition also expands the attack surface across logically decoupled tiers that make up the compute continuum. Among these threats, Denial-of-Service and performance-degradation attacks, which account for the majority of catalogued O-RAN threats, are particularly difficult to detect. Traditional Time-Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD) methods fail in this new regime where labelled baselines are scarce, threats evolve faster than detectors can be retrained, and the high-dimensional multivariate telemetry overwhelms monolithic inference models. To address these challenges, we present DAST, a zero-shot multi-agent framework for cross-interface anomaly detection in O-RAN that chains a three-stage VLM $\rightarrow$ LLM $\rightarrow$ VLM pipeline. DAST converts multivariate KPI streams into visual representations, scores textual per-interface descriptions against O-RAN domain knowledge, and verifies suspects on high-resolution heatmaps to output the problematic interfaces, the anomalous time intervals, an indicative O-RAN WG11-aligned operational impact rating and the decision rationale. We evaluate DAST on real network traces collected from an O-RAN testbed under representative performance degradation scenarios, achieving 0.910 F1-Score and 0.843 Accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art TSAD baselines.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAST框架，一种零样本多智能体方法，用于O-RAN中跨接口的异常检测。DAST将多变量KPI流转换为视觉表示，通过VLM→LLM→VLM三阶段流水线进行文本描述评分和高分辨率热图验证，输出问题接口、异常时间区间和操作影响评级。在真实O-RAN测试台数据上，DAST在性能退化场景下达到0.910 F1和0.843准确率，优于传统时间序列异常检测基线。
Motivation: O-RAN的开放接口扩大了攻击面，其中拒绝服务和性能退化攻击难以检测。传统时间序列异常检测方法在标签稀缺、威胁演化快和高维遥测数据下表现不佳。
Method: 提出DAST，一个零样本多智能体框架，由VLM→LLM→VLM三阶段组成：首先将多变量KPI流转换为视觉表示；其次使用LLM对每个接口的文本描述与O-RAN领域知识进行评分；最后通过高分辨率热图验证嫌疑区域，输出问题接口、异常时间区间和符合O-RAN WG11标准的操作影响评级及决策理由。
Result: 在真实O-RAN测试台上的性能退化场景下，DAST取得了0.910 F1分数和0.843准确率，优于现有最先进的时间序列异常检测基线。

papers.title: OneReason Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation models in the OneRec family have been widely deployed in many real-world services, such as short-video, live-streaming, advertising, and e-commerce. However, these generative models can only benefit from the scaling advantage, while their reasoning ability is hard to activate, since we cannot construct meaningful Chain-of-Thought (CoT) sequences consisting of itemic tokens only. Inspired by the success of the reasoning-style ``think before answer'' paradigm in the LLM field, we conduct preliminary studies (i.e., OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec) to explore reasoning capability in generative recommendation. Nevertheless, we notice an unexpected phenomenon: the thinking mode does not show advantages over the non-thinking mode. Drawing insights from recent findings on CoT robustness in multi-modal language models, we argue that effective reasoning in recommendation rests on two factors: perception, the ability to ground itemic tokens in their underlying language semantics, and cognition, the ability to reorganize a user's behavior sequence into coherent latent interest points. We therefore propose OneReason, which includes: (1) strong itemic token perception in pre-training, (2) a three-level cognition-enhanced CoT format for recommendation tasks in SFT, and (3) a specialize-then-unify training recipe in RL to enhance the thinking ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OneReason，一种面向生成式推荐的推理增强框架。通过强 token 感知预训练、三层次认知增强 CoT 和专化再统一的 RL 训练，尝试激活推荐模型的推理能力。初步实验发现直接思考模式并无优势，因此引入感知和认知两个关键因素。
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐模型虽能受益于规模扩展，但难以激活推理能力，因为无法构造有意义的 item token 链式推理序列。
Method: 提出 OneReason 框架：1) 预训练阶段增强 item token 的语言感知；2) SFT 阶段使用三层次认知增强 CoT 格式；3) RL 阶段采用专化再统一训练策略。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明所提方法优于非思考模式基线。
Conclusion: 有效推理需同时具备感知（将 item token 映射到语言语义）和认知（将行为序列重组为潜在兴趣点）能力，OneReason 通过三组件设计激活推荐模型的推理。

papers.title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
papers.abstract_en: As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Several important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems largely rely on a monolithic KV cache abstraction, where the KV cache is treated as a homogeneous sequence of token-level memory blocks and managed with similar policies across attention heads and serving scenarios. We observe that KV cache utility is highly structured across KV heads: different heads exhibit different functional roles, attention distances, and runtime importance. Therefore, a full KV cache is not always necessary for every head, token range, or serving scenario. We present RedKnot, a head-aware KV cache management system for LLM serving. RedKnot breaks the conventional monolithic KV cache abstraction by decomposing the KV cache along KV heads, whose importance and effective attention ranges vary significantly across serving scenarios. This head-level decomposition turns the KV cache from a monolithic tensor abstraction into a structured memory object, enabling RedKnot to uniformly support position-independent KV reuse, prefix KV compression, hot/cold KV separation, and distributed KV placement while preserving output fidelity and improving resource efficiency, without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning. RedKnot establishes a new foundation for AI infrastructure by transforming the KV cache from a monolithic, passive runtime artifact into a dynamic, model-aware runtime substrate for scalable LLM serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型服务中KV缓存成为主要瓶颈的问题，提出RedKnot系统。该系统通过按注意力头分解KV缓存，打破传统单一缓存抽象，支持位置无关的KV重用、前缀压缩、热/冷分离和分布式放置，无需模型重新训练。摘要表明该方法在保持输出保真度的同时提高了资源效率。
Motivation: 现有LLM服务系统将KV缓存视为同质化的token级内存块，忽略了不同注意力头在功能角色、注意力距离和运行时重要性上的差异，导致缓存利用率低下，限制了GPU内存容量和服务并发度。
Method: RedKnot将KV缓存按KV头部进行分解，将单一的张量抽象转变为结构化的内存对象，根据头部重要性及有效注意力范围制定差异化管理策略，统一支持多种缓存优化技术。
Result: 摘要报告RedKnot在保持输出保真度的同时提高了资源效率，并支持位置无关KV重用、前缀KV压缩、热/冷KV分离和分布式KV放置，且无需模型重新训练或微调。
Conclusion: RedKnot通过将KV缓存从被动的运行时工件转变为动态的、模型感知的运行时基础，为可扩展的LLM服务建立了新的AI基础设施基础。

papers.title: RadiusFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling on CPUs and GPUs via Spherical Voxel Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Point clouds are a primary sensory representation for robotic perception, underpinning LiDAR-based autonomous driving, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and navigation. Within these pipelines, Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) is the most well-known downsampling operator, as its uniform coverage preserves the geometric structure on which downstream perception relies. However, the large time complexity of classical FPS scales poorly with the million-point-per-second rates of modern 3D sensors, making it a dominant latency bottleneck that conflicts with the real-time and limited onboard compute budgets of robotic systems. Therefore, we propose RadiusFPS, an FPS acceleration framework based on spherical voxel pruning that preserves the standard FPS update rule under the same initialization and tie-breaking policy. By indexing the point cloud with spherical voxels, RadiusFPS derives a conservative geometric bound that prunes redundant distance computations in each iteration, complemented by a coordinate-wise point-skip test that removes residual updates. We further introduce RadiusFPS-G, a warp-level GPU implementation that fuses voxel selection, pruning, and distance update into memory-coalesced kernels, eliminating costly global-memory round-trips. On indoor (S3DIS, ScanNet) and outdoor LiDAR (SemanticKITTI) benchmarks, RadiusFPS-G attains up to 2.5x speedup over GPU-based FPS and matches or exceeds QuickFPS among the evaluated methods while using roughly half its GPU memory, with comparable segmentation accuracy. When coupled with the learning-based FastPoint sampler, the resulting pipeline achieves the fastest End-to-End inference among all evaluated configurations. These properties make high-quality FPS-style sampling practical for latency- and memory-constrained robotic vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadiusFPS，一种基于球体体素剪枝的 Farthest Point Sampling（FPS）加速框架，在保持标准 FPS 更新规则的同时，通过保守几何边界剪枝冗余距离计算，并引入坐标级点跳检测减少残余更新。在 GPU 上实现了融合体素选择、剪枝和距离更新的 warp 级实现 RadiusFPS-G，在室内和室外 LiDAR 基准测试中，相比 GPU 基线的 FPS 实现了最高 2.5 倍加速，且内存使用约为 QuickFPS 的一半，分割精度相当。当与学习型 FastPoint 采样器结合时，实现了评估配置中最快的端到端推理。
Motivation: 经典 FPS 的计算复杂度随点云规模线性增长，难以满足现代 3D 传感器每秒百万点的高速率和机器人系统的实时、低计算预算需求，成为延迟瓶颈。
Method: 提出 RadiusFPS 框架，利用球体体素索引点云，推导保守几何边界剪枝每次迭代中的冗余距离计算，并辅以坐标级点跳检测去除残余更新；进一步提出 RadiusFPS-G，一种 warp 级 GPU 实现，将体素选择、剪枝和距离更新融合到内存合并的内核中，避免昂贵的全局内存往返。
Result: 在 S3DIS、ScanNet 和 SemanticKITTI 基准上，RadiusFPS-G 比 GPU 基线的 FPS 加速最高 2.5 倍，内存使用约为 QuickFPS 的一半，分割精度与基线相当；与 FastPoint 采样器结合时实现最快的端到端推理。
Conclusion: RadiusFPS 使高质量的 FPS 风格采样在延迟和内存受限的机器人视觉中变得实用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Closing the Loop on Latent Reasoning via Test-Time Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent work moves intermediate reasoning from natural-language traces into latent or cache-level representations to reduce token overhead and avoid a discrete communication bottleneck. However, this shift also removes a key advantage of textual reasoning: intermediate states are no longer inspectable, making it difficult to determine whether a latent state still preserves the constraints of the original query. As a result, latent reasoning typically operates in an open loop, where a latent state is produced and consumed without an input-anchored fidelity check. We propose ReLAT (Reconstruction-Guided Latent Reasoning At Test Time), a self-supervised test-time training method that closes this loop using the query itself as the reference. Our key observation is that if a latent state faithfully represents a query, the query should be recoverable from it; if the query cannot be recovered, the latent state has lost task-relevant information. ReLAT operationalizes this principle by constructing a differentiable Question -> Latent Thought -> Question cycle and optimizing query reconstruction loss through the latent thought before answer generation. This anchors opaque latent computation to the problem specification it is supposed to represent. Across mathematical reasoning, knowledge QA, and code generation benchmarks on the Qwen family, ReLAT consistently improves over single-model inference, text-based collaboration, open-loop latent collaboration, and alternative test-time training objectives. On Qwen3-8B, ReLAT raises AIME 2024 accuracy from 56.7% to 73.3%, a 16.6-point gain over the strongest open-loop latent baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLAT，一种自监督测试时训练方法，通过重构查询来闭环潜在推理过程。该方法利用查询作为参考，确保潜在状态保留任务相关信息的可恢复性，从而克服开放循环潜在推理的不可检查性。实验表明，在数学推理、知识问答和代码生成基准上，ReLAT 优于单模型推理、文本协作和开放循环潜在协作等基线，例如在 Qwen3-8B 上将 AIME 2024 准确率从 56.7% 提升至 73.3%。
Motivation: 现有潜在推理方法将中间推理从文本转移到潜在或缓存层级，减少了 token 开销并避免了离散通信瓶颈，但丧失了文本推理的关键优势——中间状态可检查，导致难以判断潜在状态是否保留原始查询约束，从而形成开放循环。
Method: ReLAT 通过构建可微的“问题→潜在思考→问题”循环，在答案生成之前优化查询重构损失，从而将不透明的潜在计算锚定到问题规范。
Result: 在数学推理、知识问答和代码生成基准上，ReLAT 一致优于单模型推理、文本协作、开放循环潜在协作及其他测试时训练目标。在 Qwen3-8B 上，AIME 2024 准确率从 56.7% 提升至 73.3%，相比最强开放循环潜在基线提升 16.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过自监督重构损失闭环潜在推理，可以确保潜在状态忠实于原始查询，显著提升推理性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GRAMformer: Any-Order Modality Interactions via Volumetric Multimodal Cross-Attention
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based multimodal models rely on attention mechanisms to integrate information across heterogeneous modalities. Despite their success, existing multimodal attention formulations compute their scores through collections of pairwise dot-product interactions or by concatenating all the modalities into the keys, even when multiple modalities should be jointly involved. As a consequence, current approaches either incur quadratic complexity in the number of modalities or fail to explicitly model interactions that depend on the joint configuration of multiple representations. In this work, we introduce the Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA), a novel cross-attention mechanism in which attention scores are defined as a function of the joint geometry of a query and multiple modality-specific keys. VMA computes the volume spanned by query and key vectors across multiple modalities, capturing joint multimodal dependencies beyond pairwise similarity, enabling native modeling of any-order modality interactions. We integrate VMA into our novel multimodal transformer architecture, named GRAMformer, explicitly designed to integrate any number of modalities. We evaluate the proposed model on multimodal learning tasks, demonstrating improved effectiveness and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Volumetric Multimodal cross-Attention (VMA)，一种新的交叉注意力机制，通过计算查询和多个模态键向量的体积来建模任意阶的模态交互，并集成到 GRAMformer 架构中，以高效处理任意数量模态的多模态学习任务。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 多模态注意力机制要么在模态数量上呈二次复杂度，要么无法显式建模多个模态的联合配置依赖，缺乏对任意阶交互的原生支持。
Method: 提出 VMA，将注意力分数定义为查询和多个模态键向量在联合几何空间中的体积，从而捕获超越成对相似性的多模态依赖，并设计 GRAMformer 架构集成任意数量模态。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在多个多模态学习任务上提升了效果和效率。
Conclusion: VMA 能够原生建模任意阶模态交互，为多模态 Transformer 提供了更灵活且高效的注意力机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MPCoT: Reward-Guided Multi-Path Latent Reasoning for Test-Time Scalable Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remain brittle in long-horizon and high-uncertainty control, where one-pass action decoding provides limited inference-time deliberation. Explicit chain-of-thought can increase reasoning depth, but introduces token latency and an indirect text-to-action interface. We propose MPCoT, a reward-guided multi-path latent reasoning framework that initializes $M$ hypotheses, refines them for K weight-tied steps, and softly aggregates them before action decoding. A training-only path-preference objective evaluates candidate action branches with expert-action consistency, world-model/VLM-based progress, and success feedback to align the latent path scorer with downstream execution quality. MPCoT preserves the original 8-step action interface, generates zero reasoning tokens, and exposes configurable inference controls (K,M). Under matched protocols on LIBERO and CALVIN, MPCoT improves long-horizon performance, with ablations confirming depth-width effects, confidence-weighted aggregation, and reward-guided path supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MPCoT，一种奖励引导的多路径潜在推理框架，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。该框架初始化M个假设，经过K步权重共享的细化后软聚合，再解码动作。通过训练阶段的路径偏好目标（包括专家动作一致性、世界模型/VLM进展和成功反馈）来对齐潜在路径评分器与下游执行质量。MPCoT保持原始8步动作接口，不生成推理token，并提供可配置的推理控制（K,M）。在LIBERO和CALVIN基准上，MPCoT提升了长时域任务性能，消融实验验证了深度-宽度效应、置信加权聚合和奖励引导路径监督的有效性。
Motivation: 现有VLA策略在长时域和高不确定性控制中表现脆弱，单次动作解码缺乏推理时 deliberation，而显式思维链会增加token延迟和间接的文本-动作接口。
Method: 提出MPCoT框架：初始化M个潜变量假设，经K步权重共享的细化迭代，通过软聚合生成最终潜变量，再解码为动作。训练时使用路径偏好目标（基于专家动作一致性、世界模型/VLM进展和成功反馈）训练路径评分器。
Result: 在LIBERO和CALVIN基准上，MPCoT提升了长时域任务性能。消融实验表明深度-宽度效应、置信加权聚合和奖励引导路径监督的有效性。
Conclusion: MPCoT提供了一种无需推理token、可配置推理深度的VLA策略改进方法，适用于长时域控制任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking Open-Source Layout Detection Models for Data Snapshot Extraction from Institutional Documents
papers.abstract_en: Institutional documents contain substantial amounts of operational and analytical information embedded within figures and tables. Current approaches for extracting visual content from documents are largely built around generic document layout analysis, where figures and tables are treated as uniformly relevant document objects rather than semantically meaningful analytical artifacts. In this work, we introduce a benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for \textit{data snapshot extraction}, the task of identifying and localizing semantically meaningful visual artifacts within institutional documents. The benchmark spans humanitarian reports, World Bank policy research working papers, and project appraisal documents, and includes annotations for figures and tables that contain reusable analytical information. Using this dataset, we benchmarked multiple open-source layout detection models and evaluated both detection performance and spatial extraction quality. Our results show that current models struggle to generalize to operational institutional documents despite strong performance on conventional academic benchmarks. Common failure modes include confusion between analytical and non-analytical content, fragmentation of composite analytical artifacts, and incomplete extraction of contextual information required for interpretation. These findings highlight a persistent gap between generic document layout analysis and operationally useful data snapshot extraction. We release the source PDFs, annotation dataset, metadata, and source code to support future research in operational document intelligence. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4data/data-snapshot and the source code is available at https://github.com/worldbank/ai4data/tree/main/experimental/data-snapshot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个用于机构文档中数据快照提取的基准数据集和评估框架，并评估了多个开源布局检测模型。结果显示，现有模型在操作型机构文档上泛化能力不足，存在混淆分析内容与非分析内容等问题。
Motivation: 当前方法将图表视为均匀相关的文档对象，而非具有语义含义的分析制品，导致无法有效提取机构文档中可复用的分析信息。
Method: 构建了包含人道主义报告、世界银行政策研究论文和项目评估文档的基准数据集，对图表进行语义标注，并评估多个开源布局检测模型的检测性能和空间提取质量。
Result: 现有模型在操作型机构文档上表现不佳，常见失败模式包括分析与非分析内容混淆、复合分析制品碎片化以及上下文信息提取不完整。
Conclusion: 通用文档布局分析与操作有效的数据快照提取之间仍存在差距，该工作为未来研究提供了数据集和代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TOKI: A Bitemporal Operator Algebra for Contradiction Resolution in LLM-Agent Persistent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory for an LLM agent is a write-heavy substrate: every belief update is a versioned write, and a new claim may contradict a stored one. Production systems use four resolution heuristics (last-writer-wins, evidence-weighted merge, await-confirmation, per-rule policy), yet none declares the isolation level it assumes or the write-time anomalies it admits. We show that contradiction resolution is write-time concurrency control and make the missing contract explicit. TOKI types the four heuristics as one family of bitemporal operators over a dual-row schema, each with an isolation precondition and a provenance annotation that preserves the losing fact in an audit row. Four soundness theorems close the contract across isolation, schema, and provenance, lift the guarantees to operator pipelines, and extend the fold operators to n-ary conflict sets. A tightness companion proves that, within the relational schedule model, keyed logging of the adjudicating judge is necessary for replay consistency, which every audited baseline omits. A verdict matrix over eight systems localizes the gap: every baseline that keeps a language-model judge on the write path admits at least one of three write-time anomalies (replay inconsistency, belief-drift skew, audit erasure); a content-addressed engine-layer comparator avoids them only by removing the judge, and TOKI alone excludes all three while keeping it. On its one natural-workload slice the audit-row defence moves LoCoMo by 0.86, and ablating the typed memory layer removes 0.49 accuracy on 1,444 answerable LoCoMo questions; the cross-system comparison stays underpowered and claims no superiority. The contribution is the contract: a write-time correctness specification, proved sound across isolation, schema, and provenance, pinning the guarantee every production heuristic assumes but no deployed system makes explicit.
papers.comment: 43 pages including full appendices (proofs, protocols, and reproducibility ledger). Code, data, and reproducibility artifact: https://github.com/ZenAlexa/toki-bitemporal-memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TOKI，一种用于LLM智能体持久内存中矛盾解决的位时算子代数。将四种矛盾解决启发式方法统一为位时算子家族，每个算子具有隔离前提和溯源注释，通过四个健全性定理给出隔离、模式和溯源之间的契约。在LoCoMo数据集上，审计行防御提升0.86准确率，移除类型化内存层降低0.49准确率。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体持久内存系统使用四种矛盾解决启发式方法，但均未声明其假定的隔离级别或允许的写入时间异常。矛盾解决本质上是写入时间的并发控制，但缺乏显式的正确性契约。
Method: 提出TOKI，一个位时算子代数，将四种启发式方法类型化为位时算子家族，每个算子带有隔离前提和溯源注释（保留失败事实的审计行）。通过四个健全性定理证明隔离、模式和溯源之间的契约，并扩展到算子流水线和n元冲突集。紧密性定理证明在关系调度模型内，关键记录裁决法官对于重放一致性是必要的。
Result: 在LoCoMo数据集的自然工作负载切片上，审计行防御带来0.86的准确率提升；移除类型化内存层后，在1444个可回答问题上准确率下降0.49。跨系统对比未宣称优越性。TOKI是唯一排除三种写入时间异常（重放不一致、信念漂移偏斜、审计擦除）同时保留语言模型法官的系统。
Conclusion: 贡献在于提供了一个写入时间的正确性规范契约，在隔离、模式和溯源方面证明其合理性，明确了每个生产启发式方法假定但未显式声明的保证。论文强调这是一个契约而非系统性能声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling
papers.abstract_en: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, contributed to PAI 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统计场框架，将大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本视为一维自旋链，通过改变softmax温度T观察磁化率尖峰、序参量突变以及低T下语义方向塌缩等临界现象。在Qwen3系列（0.6B-32B）和多种提示类别上验证了结果，现象类似连续相变，但自回归生成的非平衡性质需进一步研究。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏从统计物理临界现象角度定量分析LLM输出集体结构的框架，本文旨在通过温度缩放探索生成文本的统计结构及其与解码策略的联系。
Method: 将token embeddings视为连续自旋变量，定义连接两点关联函数的磁化率和系综平均嵌入场序参量，通过改变softmax温度T观察临界行为，并利用最近邻（TwoNN）方法估计本征维度进行独立验证。
Result: 在特征温度Tc附近观察到磁化率呈现幂律标度尖峰、序参量快速变化，且低于Tc时嵌入场塌缩到单一语义方向；TwoNN本征维度在Tc附近达到最小值。现象在Qwen3（0.6B-32B）模型和多种提示类别上稳健。
Conclusion: 现象与连续相变高度相似，但自回归生成的非平衡本质需更多研究；该框架为探测LLM输出统计结构提供了定量工具，并暗示解码策略与临界现象之间的关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tracing the Oracle: Improving Diffusion Timestep Scheduling for 3D CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion models demonstrate impressive potential in solving highly ill-posed 3D computed tomography (CT) inverse problems, while the inference process suffers from significant computational overhead. Furthermore, existing uniform timestep schedules fail to capture the non-uniform evolution of the reverse conditional diffusion stochastic differential equation, thereby introducing substantial truncation errors. To overcome this limitation, we propose Tracing the Oracle (TrO), a plug-and-play framework for improved timestep scheduling. Specifically, we treat densely sampled numerical integration trajectories on a few samples as the reference oracle. The optimized schedule is extracted by leveraging dynamic programming to globally minimize the cumulative error between the few-step approximation and the oracle. This mechanism precisely allocates the limited sampling steps to critical evolution stages that are highly susceptible to truncation errors. Our extensive experiments on the AAPM dataset across multiple 3D CT reconstruction tasks demonstrate that, when combined with the state-of-the-art 3D CT reconstruction method DDS, our optimized timesteps significantly improve reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency compared to existing heuristic schedules, especially under a strict budget of no more than 10 sampling steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tracing the Oracle (TrO) 框架，用于改进扩散模型在3D CT重建中的时间步调度。通过动态规划最小化少量采样步与密集参考轨迹之间的累积误差，从而优化调度。在 AAPM 数据集上，结合 SOTA 方法 DDS，在不超过10步采样时显著提升重建保真度和计算效率。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型用于3D CT重建时，均匀时间步调度导致截断误差大，且推理计算开销高。
Method: 提出 TrO，将密集采样的数值积分轨迹作为参考，利用动态规划全局最小化几步近似与参考之间的累积误差，从而优化时间步调度。
Result: 在 AAPM 数据集上，结合 SOTA 方法 DDS，优化后的时间步在不超过10步采样时显著提高了重建保真度和计算效率。
Conclusion: TrO 是一种即插即用框架，可改善扩散模型在3D CT重建中的采样效率，尤其适用于采样步数受限的场景。

papers.title: Design a Reliable LLM-Integrated Interface for Mortality Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Mortality forecasting plays an important role in actuarial and policy decision-making, but its implementation remains technically complex and inaccessible to non-expert users. This project proposes a reliable large language model (LLM)-integrated interface that improves usability while maintaining statistical power. The LLM is designed as a constrained orchestration layer that translates natural-language inputs into structured configurations for a deterministic forecasting pipeline. A three-phase methodology is employed to ensure accuracy, usability, and transparency. First, a baseline pipeline is implemented using the CoMoMo package, reproducing established mortality forecasting results. Second, the pipeline is extended to generate multi-step forecasts using rolling-origin evaluation and mean squared error (MSE). Third, a prototype interface uses a local LLM to handle users' forecasting requests in plain language. The system demonstrates that LLMs can enhance accessibility without compromising reproducibility, transparency, or actuarial validity in high-stakes analytical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的可信接口，用于死亡率预测。系统通过约束编排层将自然语言输入转换为确定性预测管道的结构化配置，采用CoMoMo包实现基线，并扩展为多步滚动原点预测。原型界面使用本地LLM处理用户请求，旨在提升非专家用户的可访问性，同时保持统计透明性和精算有效性。
Motivation: 死亡率预测在精算和政策决策中重要，但技术复杂且对非专家用户不友好。
Method: 三阶段方法：1) 使用CoMoMo包复现基线预测结果；2) 扩展为多步滚动原点预测并计算均方误差（MSE）；3) 基于本地LLM构建原型界面，处理自然语言请求。
Result: 系统证明LLM可以在不牺牲可重复性、透明性或精算有效性的前提下，提升高风险分析工作流的可访问性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LLM集成可以有效改善死亡率预测的可用性，同时保持统计和精算标准。

papers.title: Anchor PCA
papers.abstract_en: Principal component analysis (PCA) is one of the most widely used unsupervised dimension reduction techniques. We study PCA for data from multiple related domains. Since principal components generally differ across domains, one way to obtain a shared low-rank embedding is to perform PCA on the pooled data. However, this approach can focus on spurious directions that exhibit high variation in only a few domains. To find a robust embedding that still explains most variance in unseen but similar domains, we propose instead to focus on shared directions of variation. To this end, we introduce Anchor PCA which trades off overall explained variance with agreement between the shared and domain-specific low-rank embeddings. Anchor PCA amounts to PCA on a modified target matrix and thus can be solved efficiently. Moreover, we show that Anchor PCA recovers a maximal invariant subspace and admits a minimax reconstruction interpretation under bounded domain-specific covariance inflations. On simulated and real-world gas sensor data with temporal drift, we demonstrate, respectively, that Anchor PCA recovers the maximally invariant subspace and yields embeddings that explain more variance on unseen domains than the pooling baseline and a worst-case alternative. Taken together, these findings establish Anchor PCA as a promising approach to robust unsupervised dimension reduction from multi-domain data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anchor PCA，一种针对多领域数据的鲁棒无监督降维方法，通过权衡全局解释方差与领域间低维嵌入的一致性来捕捉共享变化方向，并在模拟和真实气体传感器数据上验证了其对新领域的泛化能力。
Motivation: 标准PCA在合并多领域数据时可能关注仅在少数领域出现的高方差方向，导致对未见领域的泛化能力差。因此需要一种能聚焦于共享变化方向的鲁棒降维方法。
Method: Anchor PCA 通过优化一个修改后的目标矩阵来实现，该矩阵在总体解释方差与共享和领域特定低维嵌入之间进行权衡，从而恢复最大不变子空间，并且可以高效求解。
Result: 在模拟数据和具有时间漂移的真实气体传感器数据上，Anchor PCA 相比合并基线和最坏情况替代方法，在未见领域上解释了更多方差，并恢复了最大不变子空间。
Conclusion: Anchor PCA 为多领域数据提供了一种鲁棒的无监督降维方法，具有最小最大重建解释，适用于存在领域漂移的场景。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: SAM-Flow: Source-Anchored Masked Flow for Training-Free Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Training-free image editing has recently attracted increasing attention due to its ability to modify real images using powerful pre-trained diffusion and flow-matching models without additional training. However, existing inversion-based and differential-flow-based methods usually perform global latent transport, which inevitably propagates editing effects to non-target regions and leads to background leakage. To address this problem, we propose SAM-Flow, a source-anchored masked flow framework for localized training-free image editing. Instead of updating the whole latent representation, SAM-Flow first uses a scout image and token-grounded attention maps to localize the editable semantic regions. It then applies differential velocity updates only within these regions, while anchoring the remaining areas to the source-image latent trajectory. To further improve spatial stability and boundary naturalness, we introduce a time-varying source-anchored projection mechanism with dynamic soft masks, transition regions, and temporal mask accumulation. The proposed method is plug-and-play and can be integrated with mainstream flow-matching backbones such as Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX without any fine-tuning. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that SAM-Flow achieves accurate semantic editing while significantly improving background preservation, providing a simple and general localized editing paradigm for training-free image editing. Code is available at: https://github.com/chwbob/Sam-Flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAM-Flow，一种基于源锚定掩码流的免训练图像编辑框架。该方法通过侦察图像和令牌注意图定位可编辑语义区域，仅在该区域应用差分速度更新，其余部分锚定到源图像潜空间轨迹，并引入时变源锚定投影机制提升边界自然度。无需微调即可集成到 Stable Diffusion 3 和 FLUX 等主流流匹配模型，实验表明在保持背景方面显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有免训练图像编辑方法通常进行全局潜变量传输，导致编辑效果扩散到非目标区域，造成背景泄漏。
Method: 先利用侦察图像和基于令牌的注意图定位可编辑语义区域，然后仅在该区域内进行差分速度更新，其余区域锚定到源图像的潜变量轨迹；引入时变源锚定投影机制，包括动态软掩码、过渡区域和时序掩码累积。
Result: 定性和定量实验表明，SAM-Flow 实现了精确的语义编辑，同时显著改善了背景保留效果，且无需微调即可与主流流匹配主干（如 Stable Diffusion 3 和 FLUX）集成。
Conclusion: 提供了一种简单且通用的免训练局部编辑范式，能够有效解决背景泄漏问题，并具有良好的兼容性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Drag reduction or reward hacking? Recurrent multi-agent reinforcement learning that earns its reward
papers.abstract_en: A reinforcement-learning agent maximises its reward, which can diverge from the outcome its designer intended. In physical control the reward rarely closes that gap, and drag reduction in wall turbulence makes it concrete. A mass-conservation projection couples agents' outputs and erases the per-agent credit the policy gradient needs; a memoryless policy cannot resolve the slow near-wall cycle it acts on; and a pressure-gradient reward pays for nominal drag reduction by pumping power through the wall. Two degenerate controllers achieve large drag reductions while total dissipation rises, so the reported figure can mask a more wasteful flow. We trace each fault to its cause and fix it: a differentiable projection that restores credit, a recurrent policy with a widened sensing stencil, and a reward scored on the true wall power. The corrected controller acts on the flow within a closed energy budget, earning a conservative $17\%$ under honest accounting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习在壁湍流减阻中的奖励黑客（reward hacking）问题。作者指出，质量守恒投影抹除了每个智能体的信用分配，无记忆策略无法处理慢近壁循环，压力梯度奖励可通过壁面泵功率换取名义减阻，导致两个退化控制器实现大减阻但总耗散上升。他们提出了三个修复：可微质量守恒投影恢复信用、循环策略（recurrent policy）配合宽感知模板、以及基于真实壁面功率的奖励。修正后的控制器在封闭能量预算内诚实计算下实现17%的减阻。
Motivation: 强化学习奖励与设计意图可能偏离，在物理控制中尤其严重，壁湍流减阻领域的现有奖励设计容易奖励虚假减阻而实际浪费能量。
Method: 提出三个修正：可微质量守恒投影恢复每个智能体的策略梯度信用；循环策略结合更宽的传感模板以解决慢近壁循环；将奖励从压力梯度改为基于壁面真实功率，从而闭合能量预算。
Result: 修正后的控制器在封闭能量预算下实现保守的17%减阻，避免了虚假减阻带来的更高总耗散。
Conclusion: 强调了在物理控制中奖励设计必须与真实物理量（如壁面功率）对齐，并通过能量预算闭环防止奖励黑客，确保减阻指标的诚实性。

papers.title: Bridging the Semantic-Collaborative Gap: An Asymmetric Graph Architecture for Cold-Start Item Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative filtering and graph-based recommendation models are highly effective because they leverage observed user interactions, but this dependence creates a fundamental cold-start challenge when newly added content has no interaction history. In Tubi's production retrieval system, this challenge is further constrained by the serving interface: new content must be assigned a standalone embedding immediately, and the model must also produce device embeddings suitable for approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval. We address this setting by formulating cold-start recommendation as an inductive graph-completion problem on a temporal bipartite device-content graph. We propose Shallow-RHS, an asymmetric link-prediction architecture in which the left-hand side (LHS) device tower leverages temporally valid watch-history message passing to capture collaborative signals, while the right-hand side (RHS) content tower is intentionally shallow with respect to the graph and encodes content solely from intrinsic features. The RHS tower does not use ID-based embeddings, content-side subgraphs, neighbor aggregation, or interaction-derived representations, forcing the content encoder to map intrinsic features into a collaborative-filtering-aware embedding space. After training, the learned content encoder generates embeddings for both warm and newly ingested content, enabling implicit graph completion through retrieval of warm surrogate neighbors. We further extend the same representation-completion principle to device cold-start by constructing cohort-based embeddings from demographic features. Large-scale online experiments demonstrate consistent relative improvements in content cold-start engagement, promotion speed, impression acquisition, and device cold-start engagement.

papers.title: Symb-xMIL: Symbolic Explanations for Multiple Instance Learning in Digital Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Explanations of multiple instance learning (MIL) models are widely used for validation and discovery in digital histopathology. Existing methods primarily rely on heatmaps that highlight influential regions but do not explain how evidence from different tissue regions is combined to produce a prediction. This limits interpretability, especially when decisions depend on interactions between tissue features. We introduce Symbolic explainable MIL (Symb-xMIL), a post-hoc explanation framework that quantifies how a MIL model's behavior aligns with human-readable decision rules, expressed as logical relationships (e.g., AND, OR, NOT) between input features. These alignment scores reveal semantic patterns underlying the model's predictions. We evaluate Symb-xMIL on synthetic and real-world histopathology datasets. On synthetic MIL data, Symb-xMIL reliably recovers ground-truth logical rules. In a clinical tumor detection task, the best-aligned rules uncover heterogeneous decision patterns and expose hidden model errors. On an HPV-prediction task on TCGA-HNSCC, a cohort of head and neck cancer, our framework refines patient survival stratification beyond HPV status with potential clinical relevance. Overall, Symb-xMIL extends MIL explainability beyond visual attribution toward structured, rule-based reasoning, enabling more transparent and semantically grounded interpretation of model predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Symb-xMIL，一种用于多实例学习 (MIL) 模型的后验解释框架，量化模型行为与可读决策规则（如 AND、OR、NOT）的对齐程度。在合成数据上能恢复真实逻辑规则，在临床肿瘤检测中发现异质决策模式并暴露隐藏错误，在头颈癌HPV预测任务中优化了生存分层。
Motivation: 现有MIL解释方法主要依赖热力图突出重要区域，但无法解释模型如何组合不同组织区域证据，限制了可解释性。
Method: 提出符号化可解释MIL (Symb-xMIL)，通过逻辑关系（AND、OR、NOT）量化模型行为与人类可读规则的对齐分数，揭示预测背后的语义模式。
Result: 在合成MIL数据上可靠恢复真实逻辑规则；在临床肿瘤检测中发现异质决策模式并暴露隐藏错误；在TCGA-HNSCC的HPV预测任务中，优化了患者生存分层（超越HPV状态）。
Conclusion: Symb-xMIL将MIL可解释性从视觉归因扩展到结构化、基于规则的推理，实现更透明和语义化的模型预测解释。

papers.title: From Reward-Hack Activations to Agentic Risk States: Context-Calibrated Mechanistic Monitoring in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents act through repeated cycles of observation, reasoning, and action selection, making safety monitoring depend on both internal model state and environment context. We study reward-hacking monitors in ReAct-style agents acting in Gameable ALFWorld and WebShop. Agents are instrumented with activation-based reward-hack scores, token-level entropy, and decision-context features. We find that adapters fine-tuned on \textit{School-of-Reward-Hacks} dataset can transfer reward-hack tendencies into agentic action selection, especially when the environment exposes proxy-reward affordances. However, mitigating such behavior cannot rely on activation dynamics alone. High reward-hack activation identifies a latent policy state, but does not necessarily imply an immediate exploit action. Across next-step prediction tasks, entropy and context-calibrated internal features improve risk estimation over reward-hack activation alone. Activation-direction steering further reduces proxy-exploit behavior in selected mixed-adapter regimes. Overall, our results support context-calibrated internal monitoring for agents: reward-hack activation identifies a latent policy state, while entropy and decision context help determine when that state becomes risky action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型代理（ReAct风格）中的奖励黑客（reward-hacking）监控问题。通过在Gameable ALFWorld和WebShop环境中，基于激活的奖励黑客分数、token级熵和决策上下文特征，发现微调后的适配器可以转移奖励黑客倾向到动作选择中，但仅依赖激活动态不足以缓解。熵和上下文校准的内部特征比单独奖励黑客激活能更好地估计风险，激活方向操控可减少代理滥用行为。总体支持上下文校准的内部监控。
Motivation: 现有关注语言模型代理安全监控的研究往往仅依赖内部模型状态，忽视了环境上下文的作用。论文旨在揭示奖励黑客行为在代理动作选择中的表现，并提出结合上下文特征的监控方法。
Method: 在ReAct风格的代理中，使用激活级别的奖励黑客分数、token级熵和决策上下文特征进行监控。通过School-of-Reward-Hacks数据集微调适配器，评估奖励黑客倾向的转移，并测试激活方向操控（activation-direction steering）对代理行为的影响。
Result: 微调适配器可将奖励黑客倾向转移到动作选择，尤其在代理奖励存在时。熵和上下文校准特征比单独奖励黑客激活提高了风险估计。激活方向操控在某些混合适配器设置中减少了代理滥用行为。
Conclusion: 上下文校准的内部监控比单独激活监控更有效：奖励黑客激活标识潜在策略状态，而熵和决策上下文帮助确定何时该状态变为风险动作。

papers.title: CLEAR: Cognition and Latent Evaluation for Adaptive Routing in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving models often struggle to balance multi-modal maneuver generation with real-time inference constraints. While diffusion models successfully capture diverse driving behaviors, their iterative denoising process incurs unacceptable latency for safety-critical deployment. To address this, we propose CLEAR (Cognition and Latent Evaluation for Adaptive Routing), a framework that combines ultra-fast generative planning with deep semantic reasoning. CLEAR employs Drive-JEPA as the visual encoder and replaces the multi-step denoising chain with a single-step conditional drift in a VAE latent space, introducing a conditioning coefficient to balance diversity and expert precision. Meanwhile, we fully fine-tune Qwen~3.5~0.8B on driving QA pairs to extract scene-aware hidden states. These states guide both an Adaptive Scheduler, which selects the conditioning coefficient $α$ and sample count $N$ from a discrete set of predefined schemes, and a cross-attention scorer that selects the optimal trajectory from candidates. On the NAVSIM v1 benchmark, CLEAR achieves a state-of-the-art PDMS of 93.7. Our results demonstrate that high-fidelity, multi-modal planning can be executed efficiently without dense geometric annotations or iterative sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLEAR 框架，用于端到端自动驾驶中的自适应路由规划。该框架使用 Drive-JEPA 作为视觉编码器，在 VAE 隐空间中通过单步条件漂移替代扩散模型的多步去噪，并引入调节系数平衡多样性与专家精度。同时微调 Qwen 3.5 0.8B 模型提取场景感知隐状态，用于自适应调度器和交叉注意力评分器选择最优轨迹。在 NAVSIM v1 基准上达到 93.7 PDMS 的 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶模型在平衡多模态轨迹生成与实时推理约束方面存在困难，扩散模型的迭代去噪过程在安全关键部署中延迟不可接受。
Method: 提出 CLEAR 框架：采用 Drive-JEPA 视觉编码器，用 VAE 隐空间中的单步条件漂移替代多步去噪，引入调节系数 α 和采样数 N 的可选方案，通过微调 Qwen 3.5 0.8B 获取场景感知隐状态，指导自适应调度器和交叉注意力评分器。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 基准上达到 state-of-the-art 的 PDMS 93.7。表明无需密集几何标注或迭代采样即可高效执行高保真多模态规划。
Conclusion: CLEAR 证明通过结合超快生成规划与深度语义推理，可以在不牺牲多模态多样性的情况下实现低延迟规划。

papers.title: TAM: Torque Adaptation Module for Robust Motion Transfer in Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: A policy tuned for one robot often behaves differently on another, whether due to the sim-to-real gap, unknown payloads, or the differing dynamics of two instances of the same robot. In contact-rich, dynamic manipulation, even small motion discrepancies can result in failure to track reference motion, since they disrupt the timing and modes of contact. Common remedies, such as domain randomization or system identification, either produce overly conservative task policies or require data that must be recollected for each robot or payload. We introduce the Torque Adaptation Module (TAM), a learned module that adapts the torque commands sent to the robot to match the behavior of an ideal robot. TAM operates between the low-level controller that tracks the policy's actions and the robot's torque interface. It includes a history encoder that embeds proprioceptive history into a latent state and a torque adaptor that computes residual torque corrections. Because TAM depends only on proprioceptive history and not on policy observations, or the action space, the same TAM weights can be reused to adapt policies with different action spaces (joint targets, end-effector targets, or direct torques). The policies themselves do not need to be trained with domain randomization of robot parameters. Instead, we offload the need for domain randomization to TAM by training it entirely in randomized simulation, using multi-robot pretraining followed by a robot-specific fine-tuning step that still requires no real-robot data. We evaluate TAM zero-shot on a real Franka Panda robot across dynamic manipulation tasks that include a vision-based box pushing policy (from RL), a flip policy (from BC), and an MPC ball-on-plate balancing. Our experiments show that TAM improves zero-shot real-robot execution compared to online system identification and RMA baselines and enables robust dynamic manipulation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出扭矩适应模块（TAM），通过学习残差扭矩校正来使机器人模拟器中的策略适应真实机器人，减少由于差异导致的运动跟踪失败。TAM仅依赖本体感受历史，可跨不同动作空间的策略复用。在真实Franka Panda机器人上零样本评估，提升动态操作鲁棒性。
Motivation: 策略在不同机器人或负载间迁移时因动力学差异导致接触丰富的动态操纵失败，现有域随机化产生保守策略，系统辨识需要重新收集数据。
Method: 提出TAM，包含历史编码器（将本体感受历史编码为隐状态）和扭矩适应器（计算残差扭矩校正）。TAM在随机化仿真中训练，采用多机器人预训练加机器人微调，无需真实数据。
Result: 零样本迁移到真实Franka Panda机器人，在基于RL的推箱子、基于BC的翻转、MPC球平衡等任务上，相比在线系统辨识和RMA基线提升执行性能，实现鲁棒动态操纵。
Conclusion: TAM通过解耦策略与机器人动力学适应，使得不同动作空间的策略可共享同一适应模块，无需对策略进行域随机化训练。

papers.title: DisasterBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for UAV-Based Disaster Response in Complex Environments
papers.abstract_en: When a disaster unfolds, responders must answer not only what is happening, but also why it is happening, what will happen next, and what to do now, often from noisy low-altitude UAV views and under tight on-site compute constraints. However, most existing multimodal benchmarks emphasize perception (e.g., recognition/description), cover limited disaster types, and provide insufficient support for the multi-stage reasoning required in practical emergency response. We introduce DisasterBench, a multi-stage multimodal reasoning benchmark for UAV-Based disaster response in complex environments. DisasterBench spans 14 disaster-related scene types and 9 response-critical tasks across pre-, during-, and post-disaster stages, with fine-grained disaster-task mappings that explicitly test causal attribution, propagation prediction, damage analysis, and decision-oriented reasoning. To enable reasoning on the edge, we further propose DisasterVL, a lightweight multimodal model optimized with a three-stage pipeline combining domain instruction tuning, chain-of-thought-guided multimodal alignment, and reinforcement learning-based policy optimization. Experiments across 21 popular MLLMs show that our 2B-parameter DisasterVL outperforms all evaluated open-source models and substantially narrows the gap to state-of-the-art closed-source models, achieving GPT-4o-comparable reasoning accuracy with superior efficiency. The project page is available at https://github.com/TanmouTT/DisasterBench.

Method: 构建多阶段多模态推理基准 DisasterBench，包含14种灾害类型和9项任务（覆盖灾前、灾中、灾后），并设计轻量级模型 DisasterVL，采用领域指令微调、思维链引导的多模态对齐和强化学习策略优化三阶段流水线。
Result: 在21个流行多模态大模型对比中，2B参数的 DisasterVL 超越所有开源模型，推理精度与 GPT-4o 相当，且效率更高。
Conclusion: DisasterBench 为灾害响应多阶段推理提供了标准化测试，DisasterVL 证明了小模型通过优化可在边端设备上达到接近顶级闭源模型的性能。

papers.title: Towards the Readability of LLM-Generated Codes through Multitask Representation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Correctness and readability are key measures of code quality, respectively ensuring functional fidelity and ease of comprehension. While most existing research focuses on improving the correctness of large language models~(LLMs) generated codes, readability remains under-addressed. Enhancing readability through targeted control is challenging due to its subjective nature. In this article, we employ representation engineering~(RepE) as the targeted control method given its characteristics of low data dependency and low computational cost. Prior work on RepE has primarily focused on the targeted control for a single task, but improving the code readability requires the control across multiple tasks. Accordingly we proposes the multitask RepE framework and theoretically discuss the impact of the multitask steering method on the tradeoff between the code readability and correctness. We further provide comprehensive experiments in support. All the relevant implementations are open-source and available upon request.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型生成代码的可读性不足问题，提出多任务表示工程（multitask RepE）框架，通过低数据依赖和低计算成本的控制方法，在多个任务上同时优化代码可读性与正确性。理论分析讨论了多任务引导对二者权衡的影响，并提供了实验支持。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注代码正确性，而可读性因主观性强而难以通过目标任务控制。
Method: 采用表示工程（RepE）作为目标控制方法，并扩展为多任务框架，通过低数据依赖和低计算成本的方式同时优化多个任务上的代码可读性。
Result: 通过实验支持了理论分析，展示了多任务引导在代码可读性与正确性之间的权衡效果。
Conclusion: 多任务表示工程能有效提升代码可读性，同时需权衡与正确性的关系。

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Configuration Repair for Computer Networks
papers.abstract_en: Misconfigurations in computer networks remain a major source of critical Internet outages. Research is turning to Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate the complex, error-prone task of network configuration. However, even state-of-the-art models fail to resolve misconfigurations in large-scale, complex scenarios and often introduce new errors. In this work, we benchmark open- and closed-source LLMs augmented with formal network verification and context retrieval tools. We demonstrate that agentic architectures outperform base LLMs in repair efficacy (by 12% on average) and safety (by 17% on average), enabled by the ability to dynamically manage context and iteratively validate configuration repairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对配备形式化网络验证和上下文检索工具的开源及闭源LLM进行了基准测试，评估其在计算机网络配置修复中的表现。摘要指出，基于智能体（agentic）的架构在修复效果（平均提升12%）和安全性（平均提升17%）上均优于基础LLM，原因在于其能动态管理上下文并迭代验证配置修复。
Motivation: 网络错误配置是导致关键互联网故障的主要原因，现有LLM在复杂大规模场景中修复失败且常引入新错误。
Method: 将LLM与形式化网络验证和上下文检索工具结合，构建智能体架构，通过动态上下文管理和迭代验证来修复配置错误。
Result: 智能体架构在修复效果上平均提升12%，在安全性上平均提升17%，优于基础LLM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调智能体架构通过动态上下文管理和迭代验证能够有效提升网络配置修复的性能和安全性。

papers.title: Unsupervised Pattern Analysis in Japanese Veterinary Toxicology: A Regulatory-Compliant Framework for Cross-Species Risk Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Veterinary pharmacovigilance systems are essential for monitoring adverse drug events (ADEs), yet existing approaches often fail to capture region-specific toxicity patterns shaped by local biological and regulatory contexts. In Japan, these challenges are amplified by species-specific metabolic differences and reporting practices defined by the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries (MAFF). Most prior work relies on prediction-oriented models, limiting mechanistic interpretability. This study proposes a regulatory-integrated unsupervised framework for pattern discovery using the National Veterinary Assay Laboratory (NVAL) database. ADEs are encoded into organ system-aligned representations and adjusted for species-specific reporting biases, enabling cross-species comparison. Similarity-based clustering and dimensionality reduction are applied to identify latent toxicity structures. Analysis of 4,120 high-confidence ADE reports (9,080 drug-ADE combinations) identified three significant species clusters (p < 0.01), including hepatic-dominant patterns in companion animals (0.42 $\pm$ 0.06), renal toxicity in ruminants (0.39 $\pm$ 0.07), and dermatological sensitivity in sheep (0.35 $\pm$ 0.07). Drug-level clustering achieved 83% alignment with pharmacological classes, while cosine similarity outperformed alternative metrics (silhouette score: 0.48; cluster precision: 87%). Regulatory validation showed strong agreement with established classifications. These findings demonstrate that regulation-aligned unsupervised analysis can uncover biologically meaningful, region-specific toxicity patterns, providing an interpretable and scalable framework for veterinary drug safety assessment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个监管整合的无监督框架，利用日本国家兽医实验室（NVAL）数据库对兽医不良药物事件（ADE）进行模式发现。通过将ADE编码为器官系统对齐表示并调整物种特异性报告偏差，采用相似性聚类和降维识别潜在毒性结构。分析4120份高置信度报告，识别出三个显著物种聚类（p<0.01），包括伴侣动物的肝主导模式、反刍动物的肾毒性和绵羊的皮肤敏感性，药物级聚类与药理类别对齐率达83%。
Motivation: 现有兽医药物警戒系统未能捕捉地区特异性毒性模式，尤其在日本，物种代谢差异和监管实践（MAFF）加剧了挑战，且多数方法依赖预测模型，缺乏机制可解释性。
Method: 提出监管整合的无监督框架：将ADE编码为器官系统对齐表示，调整物种特异性报告偏差，应用相似性聚类（余弦相似度表现最佳）和降维技术。
Result: 识别出三个显著物种聚类：伴侣动物肝毒性（0.42±0.06）、反刍动物肾毒性（0.39±0.07）、绵羊皮肤敏感性（0.35±0.07）。药物级聚类与药理类别对齐率达83%，余弦相似度获得最佳轮廓系数（0.48）和聚类精度（87%）。
Conclusion: 无监督分析结合监管对齐可揭示生物学意义且地区特异性的毒性模式，为兽医药物安全评估提供可解释和可扩展的框架。

papers.title: Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Event Data
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time event data, in which entities emit instantaneous events over time, arises naturally across many domains such as neuroscience, seismology, and social networks. Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a natural tool to uncover interpretable structure in such data, but it has so far only been applied after binning or smoothing the entity-level counting measures. This preprocessing step comes with the risk of erasing entity-level heterogeneities and fine-grained temporal features. In this paper, we introduce EventNMF, a continuous-time non-negative factorization model that operates directly on event times: each entity's events are modeled as a Poisson process whose intensity factorizes through a non-negative B-spline basis, and a simple estimation procedure recovers interpretable temporal templates shared across entities. The resulting method is mathematically principled, easy to implement, and computationally efficient. We further show that standard binned-count approaches arise as the special case of degree-zero splines, explore bias-variance tradeoffs and compare against existing methods on a synthetic latent factor model, and demonstrate the effectiveness of EventNMF on several real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EventNMF，一种直接对连续时间事件数据进行非负矩阵分解的模型。它使用非负 B 样条基函数对实体的事件强度进行泊松过程建模，无需事先分箱或平滑处理，从而保留实体异质性和细粒度时间特征。实验表明，该方法在合成数据和多个真实世界应用中有效。
Motivation: 现有 NMF 在事件数据上应用前必须进行分箱或平滑，这可能丢失实体级异质性和精细时间特征。
Method: EventNMF 将每个实体的事件建模为泊松过程，其强度通过非负 B 样条基函数分解，并通过简单估计过程恢复可解释的共享时间模板。
Result: 在合成潜在因子模型上进行了偏-方差权衡分析，并与现有方法比较，同时在多个真实世界应用中展示了有效性。
Conclusion: EventNMF 在数学上严谨、易于实现且计算高效。标准分箱方法可看作是零次样条的特例。

papers.title: Dense Contexts Are Hard Contexts: Lexical Density Limits Effective Context in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Input length and the position of relevant information are widely cited as the primary causes of degraded LLM long-context performance. Here, we study lexical density -- the rate at which a context introduces distinct information -- as a third, largely overlooked factor that systematically reduces the effective context window of LLMs. We quantify the impact of lexical density on open-weight LLMs (9B-685B) using three "find-the-needle" style benchmarks with identical length (~12k tokens) and controlled needle position, but increasing density of information. We observe a sharp performance collapse in higher-density benchmarks: models that are near-perfect in sparse contexts drop below 60% retrieval score on denser ones. To rule out task-type confounds, we vary and control the density within each benchmark while keeping all other properties unchanged. Reducing density generally restores performance, especially in the high-density regimes where degradation appears. These results show that effective context capacity is a function of lexical density, with direct implications for real-world LLM systems operating on compact, information-rich inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究词汇密度（lexical density，即上下文引入不同信息的速率）作为影响大语言模型（LLM）长上下文性能的第三个关键因素。通过三个“找针”式基准测试（约12k token长度，控制针位置）发现：词汇密度越高，模型检索性能急剧下降，从稀疏上下文的近乎完美降至低于60%。改变密度而保持其他不变，降低密度可恢复性能。表明有效上下文容量取决于词汇密度。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注输入长度和关键信息位置对LLM长上下文性能的影响，但词汇密度作为系统性降低有效上下文窗口的因素被忽视。
Method: 使用三个“找针”式基准测试，固定长度（约12k token）和针位置，但改变信息密度。通过比较不同密度下的检索准确率（如稀疏 vs 密集），并控制基准内密度变化以排除任务类型混淆。
Result: 高密度基准中模型性能急剧下降：稀疏上下文中近乎完美，而密集上下文中检索分数低于60%。降低密度通常能恢复性能，尤其在退化明显的高密度区域。
Conclusion: 有效上下文容量是词汇密度的函数，对处理紧凑、信息丰富输入的LLM系统有直接影响。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Learning to replenish: A hybrid deep reinforcement learning for dynamic inventory management in the pharmaceutical supply chains
papers.abstract_en: Pharmaceutical supply chains (PSCs) struggle with inventory management (IM) due to unpredictable demand patterns and variable lead times associated with restocking. This complexity is further compounded by the finite shelf lives of pharmaceutical products, which necessitate a delicate balance between adequate stock and minimal waste. These intertwined factors create a complex optimization problem that requires sophisticated inventory strategies to ensure both product availability and PSC efficiency. This study aims to develop an optimal inventory replenishment policy for pharmaceutical products that can handle the stochasticity arising from uncertain demand and variable PSC conditions. The objective is to maximize the profitability of the PSC while maintaining a high patient service level. We formulate the problem as a Markov decision process and propose a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approach, specifically, a hybrid asynchronous advantage actor critic distributed proximal policy optimization (A3C DPPO)algorithm. The A3C DPPO algorithm is tailored to handle the continuous action space inherent in IM. The numerical results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm adaptively updates the inventory replenishment strategy under dynamic scenarios, resulting in lower inventory costs compared to various benchmarks. We also conduct numerical validation using real-world pharmaceutical inventory data to confirm the practical feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

papers.title: SC-MFJ: A Simple Haptic Quality Metric for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Standard segmentation metrics such as Dice and Hausdorff distance measure geometric overlap but say nothing about whether a segmented surface is suitable for haptic rendering in surgical simulation. We propose SC-MFJ (Surface-Constrained Mean Force Jerk), a simple, inexpensive metric that samples a segmented organ surface with many short virtual stylus walks and measures how jerky the resulting contact forces are. The metric is computed from existing segmentation outputs and uses roughly one minute of CPU time per case. We evaluate three pancreas CT segmentation approaches-binary nnU-Net output, Gaussian-smoothed output, and learned signed distance function (SDF) regression-across 80 cases in five-fold cross-validation. SC-MFJ reveals a 147x gap in haptic quality between the raw binary baseline and simple Gaussian post-processing, a difference entirely invisible to Dice and HD95. It also shows that learned SDF regression, despite requiring full model retraining, produces more variable haptic quality than Gaussian smoothing, with a case-level standard deviation of 168 N/s2 compared with 22 N/s2 for Gaussian. A second evaluation on the LiTS liver dataset (131 cases) confirms the generality of these findings: the binary-to-Gaussian gap widens to 189x, and Gaussian smoothing again produces consistently low force jerk across all folds. Our results suggest that for haptic simulation applications, a one-line post-processing step may be sufficient, and that a cheap metric like SC-MFJ can flag problems that geometric metrics miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对医学图像分割中标准几何指标（如Dice和Hausdorff距离）无法反映触觉渲染质量的问题，提出SC-MFJ（Surface-Constrained Mean Force Jerk）度量，通过虚拟触笔采样表面并测量接触力抖动来评估分割表面的触觉适用性。在胰腺CT和肝脏CT数据集上，SC-MFJ揭示原始二进制nnU-Net输出与简单高斯后处理之间的触觉质量差距达147-189倍，而几何指标完全无法察觉。
Motivation: 标准分割指标（Dice、Hausdorff）仅衡量几何重叠，无法判断分割表面是否适合触觉渲染（如手术模拟中的力反馈），导致触觉质量差异被忽视。
Method: 提出SC-MFJ（Surface-Constrained Mean Force Jerk），通过沿分割表面行走多条虚拟触笔路径，计算接触力的平均抖动（jerk）值作为触觉质量的量化指标，每例约需1分钟CPU时间。
Result: 在80例胰腺CT上，SC-MFJ显示二进制基线到高斯后处理的触觉质量差距达147倍（Dice和HD95无变化）；学习SDF回归虽需重训练，但触觉质量变异更大（标准差168 vs 高斯22 N/s²）。在131例肝脏CT上差距扩大至189倍，高斯平滑始终产生低力抖动。
Conclusion: 对于触觉仿真应用，简单后处理（如高斯平滑）可能已足够；SC-MFJ作为一种廉价度量，能检测几何指标遗漏的触觉问题。
