papers.title: Improving Answer Extraction in Context-based Question Answering Systems Using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Question answering (QA) systems have achieved notable progress with the advent of large language models (LLMs). However, they still face challenges in accurately extracting and generating precise answers from given contexts, particularly when dealing with complex or ambiguous queries. Existing approaches often struggle with contextual understanding, answer consistency, and generalization across diverse domains. In this work, we propose a question answering system based on large language models, where the input consists of a textual context and a corresponding question, and the output is a concise and accurate answer. The motivation behind this research lies in addressing the limitations of current QA systems, particularly their tendency to produce irrelevant or imprecise responses despite having access to the correct context. Our methodology involves fine-tuning a pre-trained LLM on a benchmark QA dataset to improve its contextual comprehension and answer extraction capabilities. Specifically, we utilize the Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD1.1), which provides high-quality context-question-answer triplets for supervised training and evaluation. Experimental results show that the fine-tuned Roberta-base model achieves the highest performance, attaining a ROUGE-L score of 86.84%, a BLEU score of 28.24%, and a BERTScore of 95.38%. These results indicate strong accuracy and answer relevance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed approach for context-based question answering tasks. Furthermore, the findings confirm that targeted fine-tuning substantially improves the reliability and precision of QA systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于上下文的问答系统中答案提取不准确的问题，提出使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行微调的方法。采用SQuAD1.1数据集对RoBERTa-base模型进行微调，实验结果显示ROUGE-L分数达86.84%，BLEU分数为28.24%，BERTScore为95.38%，表明该方法能提升答案提取的准确性和相关性。
Motivation: 现有QA系统在复杂或模糊查询下常产生不相关或不精确的答案，尽管提供了正确的上下文，需要改进答案提取的精确性和一致性。
Method: 微调预训练的LLM（RoBERTa-base）在SQuAD1.1基准数据集上，通过监督学习增强模型对上下文的语义理解和答案抽取能力。
Result: 微调后的RoBERTa-base模型在SQuAD1.1上达到ROUGE-L 86.84%、BLEU 28.24%和BERTScore 95.38%，显示出高准确性和答案相关性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调针对性的微调显著提升了基于上下文的问答系统的可靠性和精度，验证了该方法的有效性。

papers.title: A Machine Learning-Based Framework for Discovering Huntington's Disease Stages: Integrating Graph Representation Learning and clustering to Uncover Progression Dynamics in Longitudinal Enroll-HD Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive brain disorder that gradually affects movement, cognitive function, and behavior. Identifying the stage of the disease accurately and consistently is important for understanding its course, grouping patients, personalized care, and discovering treatment. Existing clinical staging frameworks rely primarily on predefined clinical measurement thresholds and clinical expert decisions, yet these discrete cut-offs may obscure meaningful intra-stage variability and remain vulnerable to inter-rater differences, especially in motor and functional assessments. To address these limitations, we developed an unsupervised machine learning framework based on dynamic graph representation learning to capture temporal relationships within and across patients from longitudinal clinical measurements. Using the learned representations, we applied K-means++ clustering to identify well-separated groups. We then iteratively increased the number of clusters (k), using stability analysis to assess robustness and reveal additional meaningful clusters beyond the initial optimal solution. We applied the framework to 302 individuals from the Enroll-HD cohort (1,477 visits, 44 clinical variables per visit; 80% manifest participants), enabling data-driven discovery of HD stages reflecting natural clinical progression. Despite the limited cohort size, the proposed framework achieved robust clustering performance using a four-dimensional latent space, identifying four meaningful and statistically distinct disease stages through clustering stability analysis. Each stage corresponded to well-defined clinical measurement boundaries, with minimal overlap compared to previously established clinical staging methods.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 10th International Conference on Medical and Health Informatics (ICMHI 2026), Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对亨廷顿舞蹈症（HD）的分期问题，提出一种基于动态图表示学习的无监督框架。该框架利用K-means++聚类和稳定性分析，从纵向临床测量中识别出四个统计上显著的疾病阶段。在Enroll-HD数据集（302名患者，1477次访问）上的实验表明，这些阶段与临床测量边界对应良好，且重叠小于传统分期方法。
Motivation: 现有HD临床分期依赖预定义的测量阈值和专家判断，离散截断可能掩盖阶段内变异，且易受评估者间差异影响。
Method: 提出无监督框架：先通过动态图表示学习捕获患者内及患者间的时序关系，然后对学习到的表征应用K-means++聚类，并利用稳定性分析迭代增加簇数以发现稳健且有意义的疾病阶段。
Result: 在302名Enroll-HD参与者（80%症状明显）的四维潜在空间中，该方法通过聚类稳定性分析识别出四个统计上不同的疾病阶段，各阶段对应清晰的临床测量边界。
Conclusion: 该数据驱动方法能揭示反映自然临床进展的HD阶段，但需更大队列验证其泛化性。

papers.title: ActiveMimic: Egocentric Video Pretraining with Active Perception
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human video offers a scalable alternative to robot data for pretraining, yet models pretrained on such video consistently underperform those pretrained on robot data. We attribute this gap to a missing signal, the active perception behavior in egocentric videos, where humans continuously reposition their viewpoint during manipulation, inducing camera motion that standard pipelines treat as noise. To address this, we present ActiveMimic, a pretraining framework that recovers synchronized camera and wrist trajectories from a single body-worn RGB camera, models camera motion as a viewpoint action, and jointly learns active perception and manipulation from in-the-wild egocentric human video before adapting to a target robot. Empirically, real-world experiments across tasks with diverse active perception demands show that ActiveMimic consistently surpasses baselines pretrained on human video and matches state-of-the-art models pretrained on robot data. Further analysis provides evidence that active perception capability originates from egocentric human video pretraining rather than robot-specific fine-tuning, confirming active perception as the key to unlocking egocentric human video for robot pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ActiveMimic，一种从第一人称人类视频中预训练机器人操作模型的框架。现有方法在人类视频上预训练的效果不如在机器人数据上预训练，本文认为原因是人类视频中缺失主动感知信号（即相机运动）。ActiveMimic通过恢复相机和手腕轨迹，将相机运动建模为视角动作，联合学习主动感知与操作，在真实世界实验中达到了与机器人数据预训练相当的性能。
Motivation: 人类第一人称视频作为机器人预训练数据来源具有可扩展性，但预训练模型性能显著低于使用机器人数据训练的模型。本文认为差距源于人类视频中主动感知行为的缺失——标准预处理将相机运动视为噪声，而该信号对于操作学习至关重要。
Method: 提出ActiveMimic框架，从单个身体佩戴的RGB相机中恢复同步的相机和手腕轨迹，将相机运动建模为视角动作，联合学习主动感知与操作，然后适应目标机器人。
Result: 在多种需要主动感知的真实世界任务中，ActiveMimic持续超越基于人类视频预训练的基线，并匹配基于机器人数据预训练的最先进模型。分析表明主动感知能力源自人类视频预训练而非机器人微调。
Conclusion: 本文证实主动感知是解锁第一人称人类视频用于机器人预训练的关键信号，使人类视频成为机器人数据的可行替代。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks Already Tell the Answer: Directional Bias-Guided Test-time Defense for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as CLIP, have shown strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, posing serious risks in real-world applications. Test-time defenses for VLMs have recently emerged as a promising and efficient approach to defend against adversarial attacks without requiring costly large-scale retraining. In this work, we uncover a surprising phenomenon: under diverse input transformations, adversarial images in CLIP's feature space consistently shift along a dominant direction, in contrast to the dispersed patterns of clean images. We hypothesize that this dominant shift, termed the Defense Direction, opposes the adversarial shift, pointing features back toward their correct class centers. Building on this insight, we propose Directional Bias-guided Defense (DBD), a test-time framework that estimates the Defense Direction and employs a DB-score-based two-stream reconstruction strategy to recover robust representations. Experiments on 15 datasets demonstrate that DBD not only achieves SOTA adversarial robustness while preserving clean accuracy, but also reveals the counterintuitive result that adversarial accuracy can even surpass clean accuracy. This demonstrates that adversarial perturbations inherently encode directional priors about the true decision boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示对抗图像在CLIP特征空间中沿主导方向移动，提出方向偏置引导的测试时防御框架DBD，通过估计防御方向并采用基于DB分数的双流重构策略恢复鲁棒表示。在15个数据集上达到SOTA对抗鲁棒性，且保持干净准确率，甚至出现对抗准确率超过干净准确率的反直觉现象。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在零样本泛化中对对抗扰动高度脆弱，现有测试时防御为高效方案但尚未充分挖掘对抗扰动的内在结构。
Method: 提出DBD框架：首先估计主导的防御方向（Defense Direction），然后利用DB-score指导双流重构（two-stream reconstruction），将对抗特征向正确类中心回拉。
Result: 在15个数据集上，DBD达到SOTA对抗鲁棒性并保留干净准确率；对抗准确率甚至可超越干净准确率，表明对抗扰动编码了决策边界的先验信息。
Conclusion: 对抗扰动本身带有方向性先验，利用这一偏置可设计更高效的测试时防御，且无需大规模重训练。

papers.title: Diffusion Models Observe Only Gradients: A Geometric Perspective on Score Matching Errors
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models are typically trained by minimizing the $L^2$ score matching error, and standard theoretical analyses rely on this quantity to bound the sampling discrepancy between the learned and target distributions. We show the $L^2$ score error is not the right intrinsic measure of marginal distributional quality: a learned diffusion model can incur arbitrarily large $L^2$ score error while perfectly matching the target distribution. By decomposing score errors into a gradient and a solenoidal component (a Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition), we identify the geometric reason behind this: only the gradient component enters the marginal Fokker-Planck dynamics, while the solenoidal component is structurally invisible. We make this precise in three results. First, building on the corrected geometry, we prove an impossibility result: no monotone function of the $L^2$ score error can uniformly lower bound any divergence between the learned and target distributions. Second, we derive an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler divergence that depends only on the observable gradient component of the error, tightening the standard Girsanov bound and identifying its looseness as the cost of operating on path-space rather than marginal-space dynamics. Third, we give a tractable estimator of the gradient component via a dual Sobolev identity, which is shown to empirically correlate substantially better with sample quality than the full $L^2$ error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何视角分析扩散模型的得分匹配误差，发现L2得分误差不是衡量边缘分布质量的正确指标：学习到的扩散模型可能具有任意大的L2得分误差却完美匹配目标分布。通过Helmholtz-Hodge分解将得分误差分解为梯度分量和螺线管分量，指出只有梯度分量影响边缘Fokker-Planck动力学，而螺线管分量在结构上不可见。进一步证明了三个结果：不存在单调函数能通过L2得分误差一致下界任何分布散度；推导了仅依赖可观测梯度分量的KL散度上界，改进了标准Girsanov界；给出了梯度分量的可估计算子，其与样本质量的相关性显著优于全L2误差。
Motivation: 标准扩散模型训练基于最小化L2得分匹配误差，但其与采样质量的理论联系不紧密，需要更本质的误差度量。
Method: 采用Helmholtz-Hodge分解将得分误差分解为梯度项和螺线管项，并基于此分析边缘分布动力学；通过双Sobolev恒等式给出梯度分量的可估计算子。
Result: 证明了L2得分误差不能一致下界任何分布散度（不可行性结果）；推导了仅依赖梯度分量的KL散度上界，比标准Girsanov界更紧；所提梯度分量估计量与样本质量的相关性显著高于全L2误差。
Conclusion: 得分匹配误差中的螺线管分量对边缘分布质量无影响，因此理论界和训练目标应关注梯度分量而非全L2误差。

papers.title: Learning to Route LLMs from Implicit Cost-Performance Preferences via Meta-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) present a trade-off between performance and cost, where more powerful models incur greater expense. LLM routing aims to mitigate expenses while maintaining performance by sending queries to the most suitable model. However, existing methods cannot perform well for different user cost-performance preferences. To address this gap, we introduce a novel perceptive LLM routing paradigm for personalized and user-centric cost-performance optimization, which efficiently learns users' implicit preferences through little interaction. To handle the challenge of heterogeneous user needs, we formulate preference profiles as a set of distinct tasks in contextual bandit and propose MetaRouter, a meta-learning framework designed for preference-aware LLM routing. Experimental results show that MetaRouter outperforms strong baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. Furthermore, it exhibits high efficiency in learning user preferences, robustness to changes in the routable LLMs, and scalability to multi-model routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaRouter，一种基于元学习的 LLM 路由框架，通过少量交互隐式学习用户对性能与成本的个性化偏好，并在上下文赌博机 (contextual bandit) 中将偏好建模为不同任务。实验表明 MetaRouter 在分布内和分布外任务上均优于强基线，且对可路由 LLM 的变化具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由方法无法适配不同用户对成本-性能的个性化偏好，导致无法在性能和费用之间取得最优平衡。
Method: 将用户偏好配置为上下文赌博机中的一组不同任务，采用元学习框架 MetaRouter 学习隐式偏好，通过少量交互快速适应新用户。
Result: 摘要报告 MetaRouter 在分布内和分布外任务上均优于强基线，学习效率高，对可路由 LLM 变化鲁棒，且支持多模型路由。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MetaRouter 实现了用户中心的自适应优化，能够高效学习个性化成本-性能偏好，并具有较好的鲁棒性和可扩展性。

papers.title: RQUL-UIE: Revitalizing Quality-Unstable Labels for Underwater Image Enhancement via In-Dataset Self-Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE) is essential for mitigating degradations caused by water medium. Although learning-based methods have advanced significantly, most rely on paired datasets with unstable label quality, which bottlenecks model performance. This paper proposes a diffusion-based, in-dataset self-supervised learning strategy designed to exploit the quality distribution of training labels. Specifically, we evaluate label quality via semantic perception embeddings from a pre-trained diffusion model in a training-free manner. These quality scores are subsequently quantized into noise-level indices, guiding a multi-step denoising process for level-wise supervision. This mechanism prevents low-quality labels from degrading the model while maximizing their utility during training. Furthermore, a Fourier-based refinement network is incorporated to explicitly reconstruct high-frequency components. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms SOTA approaches in restoration quality. The code and pre-trained model will be available once accepted in link.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的自监督学习策略，用于处理水下图像增强（Underwater Image Enhancement, UIE）中标签质量不稳定的问题。通过预训练扩散模型评估标签质量并量化噪声等级，实现多步去噪监督，同时引入傅里叶细化网络恢复高频成分。实验表明该方法在恢复质量上优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有学习方法依赖成对数据集，但标签质量不稳定，限制了模型性能。
Method: 提出基于扩散模型的样本内自监督策略：利用预训练扩散模型的语义感知嵌入评估标签质量，将质量分数量化为噪声级别索引，指导多步去噪过程；并引入傅里叶细化网络显式重建高频成分。
Result: 摘要报告在多个水下图像增强基准上，该方法在恢复质量上一致优于现有技术。
Conclusion: 该方法通过有效利用质量不稳定的标签，避免了低质量标签的负面影响，同时最大化其效用，并改善了高频成分的重建。

papers.title: Learning to model pediatric asthma exacerbation from multiple risk factors: a case study in coastal Virginia
papers.abstract_en: Childhood asthma is a common illness exacerbated by air pollution as well as meteorological and neighborhood-level socioeconomic factors. Modeling asthma exacerbation (AE) in large spatiotemporal datasets requires disentangling impacts from multiple contributors. In this case study, we compared three techniques that balance predictive power with interpretability to predict AE in Hampton Roads, a coastal Virginia region comprising 7 cities and over 1.5 million people. After collating ambient air pollution measurements, weather data, and measures of neighborhood opportunity, we modeled zip code-level acute AE visits to a regional children's hospital and affiliated providers from 2018-2023. Generalized linear models (GLM) provided a baseline while neural networks (NN) served as a maximally predictive target. To bridge between statistical models and deep learning, we developed a framework based on sparse dictionary learning to identify and interpret parsimonious nonlinear interacting equations. After comparing each model's predictive performance, we estimated relative risks for AE due to input exposure variables and found consensus across frameworks. Our work links statistical and interpretable machine learning models to highlight possible synergistic interactions influencing AE, and may enable future studies to guide public health interventions in coastal Virginia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用稀疏字典学习框架，结合广义线性模型和神经网络，预测弗吉尼亚沿海地区儿童哮喘急性发作。摘要显示该方法在区域医院数据上比纯统计或深度学习模型更平衡预测性能与可解释性，并识别出多风险因素的协同作用。
Motivation: 儿童哮喘加剧受空气污染、气象和社区社会经济多因素影响，现有模型难以同时兼顾预测精度与可解释性，尤其在大尺度时空数据中。
Method: 对比广义线性模型、神经网络以及基于稀疏字典学习的框架，后者能够发现简洁的非线性交互方程，在保持可解释性的同时提升预测性能。
Result: 在弗吉尼亚汉普顿路地区7个城市2018-2023年数据上，稀疏字典学习模型在预测哮喘急性发作方面接近神经网络的精度，同时提供了可解释的风险因子相对风险估计。
Conclusion: 该工作将统计模型与可解释机器学习结合，指出了影响哮喘发作的协同因素，可为沿海地区公共卫生干预提供指导。

papers.title: Effective Dimensionality as an Operator Invariant for Physics-Preserving Constraint Adaptation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks inherently suffer from task interference because they rely on a shared parameter space to satisfy both governing differential equations and boundary conditions. We analyze this structural conflict using the Fisher Information Matrix to quantify the effective degrees of freedom ($d_{eff}$) in a physics-constrained model. Unlike the classical $d_{eff}$ which measures how many parameter directions are informed by data against a statistical prior, our $d_{eff}$ measures the dimension of the parameter directions unconstrained by the differential operator. For operators with finite-dimensional kernel, we show that $d_{eff}$ converges to the kernel dimension exactly, independent of network width, depth, or activation function, recasting it from a fit diagnostic into a structural invariant of the underlying continuous operator. For operators with infinite-dimensional kernel, $d_{eff}$ instead measures the network's finite-dimensional representational bandwidth for that kernel rather than recovering an integer invariant. Importantly, $d_{eff}$ also serves as an a priori structural diagnostic. Driving $d_{eff}$ of a well-posed problem to zero certifies that the physics and boundary constraints have absorbed the network's free directions. Building on this characterization, we introduce subspace projection strategies for boundary adaptation. Rather than retraining from scratch, we project parameter updates into the null space of the pre-trained physics operator so that new boundary conditions are satisfied without disturbing the learned physics. Gradient-based fine-tuning can match or exceed this but needs more wall-clock time and tuning, whereas subspace projection delivers near-equivalent quality in seconds to minutes. We validate on linear and nonlinear operators, demonstrating accurate adaptation to initial and boundary shifts and unencountered constraint types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Fisher信息矩阵量化物理约束神经网络中的有效自由度，证明对于有限维核的微分算子，有效自由度收敛到核维数，成为算子的结构不变量。基于此，提出子空间投影策略以适应边界条件，无需从头训练。
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络因共享参数空间而遭受任务干扰，需要分析物理约束与边界条件之间的结构性冲突。
Method: 通过Fisher信息矩阵定义新的有效自由度度量，分析其在有限/无限维核算子下的行为，并基于此提出子空间投影策略，将参数更新投影到预训练物理算子的零空间。
Result: 对于有限维核算子，有效自由度精确收敛到核维数，与网络宽度、深度或激活函数无关；子空间投影能在秒到分钟内达到与梯度微调相当的质量。
Conclusion: 有效自由度可作为先验结构诊断，子空间投影提供高效的边界适应方法，在多种线性和非线性算子上验证。

papers.title: ProSarc: Prosody-Aware Sarcasm Recognition Framework via Temporal Prosodic Incongruity
papers.abstract_en: We present ProSarc, an audio-only framework that detects sarcasm by modelling temporal prosodic incongruity, that is, the mismatch between local prosodic dynamics and the utterance-level emotional baseline. Dual encoding paths, a Global Emotion Encoder and a Temporal Prosody Encoder (BiLSTM + multi-head attention), feed a Prosodic Incongruity Analyzer that produces a scalar incongruity score for classification. Monte Carlo dropout provides uncertainty estimates, and an attention-based mechanism localises sarcastic onset without frame-level labels. ProSarc outperforms prior audio-only methods on MUStARD++ (F1=75.3) and generalises to spontaneous (PodSarc, F1=62.9) and cross-lingual speech (MuSaG, F1=65.6). Ten-run validation confirms the contribution of incongruity modelling (Wilcoxon p=0.002, Cohen's d=1.51). Human evaluation shows that model uncertainty tracks perceptual ambiguity and predicted onsets align with human-annotated temporal windows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProSarc 是一个仅基于音频的讽刺检测框架，通过建模时间韵律不协调（即局部韵律动态与语段情感基线之间的不匹配）来识别讽刺。它使用全局情感编码器和时间韵律编码器（BiLSTM+多头注意力）的双编码路径，通过韵律不协调分析器产生标量不协调分数进行分类。在 MUStARD++ 上达到 F1=75.3，在自发言语和跨语言语音上也有泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有讽刺检测主要依赖文本或多模态信号，音频方法常忽略韵律随时间的不协调性。本文旨在通过建模局部与全局韵律的差异来提升纯音频讽刺识别的准确性。
Method: 提出双编码路径结构：全局情感编码器提取语段级情感基线，时间韵律编码器（BiLSTM+多头注意力）捕捉局部韵律动态。Prosodic Incongruity Analyzer 计算两者差异并输出标量不协调分数用于分类。同时使用 Monte Carlo dropout 提供不确定性估计，注意力机制定位讽刺起始点。
Result: MUStARD++ 上 F1=75.3，PodSarc 上 F1=62.9，MuSaG 上 F1=65.6。十次验证确认不协调建模的贡献（Wilcoxon p=0.002, Cohen's d=1.51）。人类评估显示模型不确定性与感知模糊性相关，预测的 onset 与人工标注时间窗口对齐。

papers.title: On the training of physics-informed neural operators for solving parametric partial differential equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural operators (PINOs) aim to learn solution operators for partial differential equations by using the governing physics as supervision, rather than relying solely on paired input-output simulation data. By incorporating physical constraints into the training objective, PINOs combine the cross-instance generalization of neural operators with the data efficiency of physics-informed learning. Despite this promise, how to train PINOs efficiently and robustly remains less well-understood than the training of either data-driven neural operators or physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To bridge this gap, we examine key components of the PINO training pipeline, including architecture design, optimizer choice, loss balancing, and collocation-point sampling strategy. We study three representative operator backbones, Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), and Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), across five diverse parametric PDE systems. Our results show that CViT provides consistently strong and stable performance across the considered benchmarks. Beyond architecture, we find that several optimization pathologies previously identified in PINN training naturally arise in PINOs, including gradient conflicts and causal violation. We also find that mitigation algorithms developed for PINNs remain effective in the PINO setting. We further compare physics-informed and data-driven training under different data regimes, revealing that a carefully designed physics-informed training pipeline can match, and in some cases, outperform purely data-driven neural operators. Taken together, these findings provide a systematic empirical understanding of the optimization challenges in PINO training and inform a practical pipeline for efficient and robust physics-informed operator learning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/NanxiiChen/PI-CViT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了物理信息神经算子（PINO）的训练，包括架构设计、优化器选择、损失平衡和配置点采样策略。实验比较了 DeepONet、FNO 和 CViT 三种骨干网络在五个参数化偏微分方程系统上的表现，发现 CViT 性能稳健，且 PINN 训练中已知的病理现象（如梯度冲突和因果违反）在 PINO 中同样出现，而原有缓解方法仍然有效。研究还表明，精心设计的物理信息训练管道可以匹配甚至超越纯数据驱动的神经算子。
Motivation: 尽管物理信息神经算子（PINO）兼具神经算子的跨实例泛化能力和物理信息学习的数据效率，但其高效、鲁棒的训练方法尚未被充分理解。
Method: 系统考察了 PINO 训练流程中的关键组件，包括架构（DeepONet、FNO、CViT）、优化器、损失平衡以及配置点采样策略，并在五个参数化 PDE 系统上进行实验。
Result: CViT 在基准上表现一致稳健；PINN 训练中的梯度冲突和因果违反等病理现象也在 PINO 中出现，且 PINN 的缓解算法仍有效；物理信息训练在适当设计下可以匹配或超越纯数据驱动方法。
Conclusion: 本文提供了 PINO 训练中优化挑战的系统经验理解，并给出了一个高效、鲁棒的物理信息算子学习的实用训练流程。

papers.title: Where does Absolute Position come from in decoder-only Transformers?
papers.abstract_en: RoPE-trained transformers distinguish absolute position in their attention patterns, even though RoPE encodes only relative offsets in the inner product. We trace this leakage to two architectural components, The causal mask is responsible for the first: its per-query softmax denominator depends on the absolute query position by construction. The residual stream supplies the second. Under causal attention the activation at position $0$ attends only to itself and runs as a closed dynamical system from the embedding of the token at that position; downstream attention reads this trajectory through sink-reading heads. Both components appear in all three architectures we study, in architecturally specific balance: NTK scaling suppresses the residual-stream component, sliding-window attention allows it to accumulate with depth, and standard RoPE sits between. Replacing the \texttt{BOS} embedding before the forward pass removes $40\%$ of the residual-stream component at early queries. Attention sinks are token-anchored stabilizers that pass forward a deterministic fingerprint of the token at position $0$, constant across inputs when that token is the auto-prepended \texttt{BOS} and varying with it otherwise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究RoPE训练的decoder-only Transformer为何能在注意力模式中区分绝对位置，尽管RoPE仅编码相对偏移。发现因果掩码和残差流是导致绝对位置泄漏的两个架构组件。因果掩码的softmax分母依赖于绝对查询位置，而残差流中位置0的激活只关注自身，形成闭合动力系统，下游通过sink-reading头读取。三种架构（NTK缩放、滑动窗口注意力、标准RoPE）中这两个组件以不同方式平衡。
Motivation: 尽管RoPE只编码相对位置，但实验发现RoPE训练的Transformer能区分绝对位置，这一矛盾尚未被解释。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，识别因果掩码和残差流作为绝对位置泄漏的来源，并比较不同架构（NTK缩放、滑动窗口注意力、标准RoPE）下的相对贡献。
Result: 因果掩码的softmax分母天然依赖绝对查询位置；位置0的残差流形成闭合动力系统，下游通过sink-reading头获取位置信息。替换BOS嵌入可减少40%的残差流成分。
Conclusion: 绝对位置信息来源于两个通用架构组件，且在不同架构中平衡不同。注意力sink是token锚定的稳定器，传递位置0的确定性指纹。

papers.title: ITP-STDP: An Intrinsic-Timing Power-of-Two Learning Engine for On-Chip SNN Training
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have the potential to emerge as the third generation of neural networks and have attracted increasing attention across a wide range of applications. However, the large number of synaptic connections in SNNs leads to intensive weight-update computation by on-chip learning algorithms during training, resulting in substantial hardware resource utilization and energy consumption. Among existing SNN learning algorithms, spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) is one of the most extensively studied and widely adopted, serving as a fundamental learning component in SNNs. To address the hardware and energy overheads associated with SNN training, this paper presents intrinsic-timing power-of-two STDP (ITP-STDP) and its corresponding prototype learning engine hardware architecture. The proposed design is evaluated through a dedicated mean-field synaptic drift model for dynamical analysis and further validated across SNN networks of different scales and datasets. It is further implemented on both ASIC and FPGA platforms and compared with state-of-the-art approaches, including the original STDP and more complex STDP variants. The results demonstrate superior energy efficiency, higher operating speed, and substantially lower hardware resource utilization, as the proposed design eliminates most of the computational overhead of STDP through both algorithmic and hardware-level optimizations. On the FPGA platform, the proposed design improves energy efficiency by 4.5$\times$ to 219.8$\times$ over the compared designs. On the ASIC platform, the proposed design achieves a 4.8$\times$ to 22.01$\times$ speedup while consuming only 1.2% to 3.3% of the area required by prior works.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向片上SNN训练的Intrinsic-Timing Power-of-Two STDP（ITP-STDP）学习算法及其硬件架构。通过均值场突触漂移模型进行动力学分析，并在不同规模SNN网络和数据集上验证。在FPGA和ASIC平台上，与现有STDP方法相比，能效提升4.5倍至219.8倍，ASIC速度提升4.8倍至22.01倍，面积仅为先前工作的1.2%至3.3%。
Motivation: SNN训练中大量突触连接的权重更新计算导致高硬件资源消耗和能耗，需要更高效的片上学习算法。
Method: 提出ITP-STDP算法，利用2的幂次权重量化简化计算，并设计对应的原型学习引擎硬件架构，消除大部分STDP计算开销。
Result: 在FPGA上能效提升4.5×至219.8×；在ASIC上速度提升4.8×至22.01×，面积仅为先前工作的1.2%至3.3%。
Conclusion: ITP-STDP通过算法与硬件协同优化，显著提升SNN训练的能效和速度，适用于资源受限的片上学习场景。

papers.title: Adaptive Tokenisation Via Temporal Redundancy Masking And Latent Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive video tokenisation seeks to dynamically allocate token budgets based on the underlying visual complexity of a sequence. Current continuous-regime approaches achieve this via iterative binarised searches or trained neural regressors, while discrete methods often require a full-rate decoder pass to estimate information content. We demonstrate that such computational overheads are not strictly necessary. We show that the latent space of a frozen continuous video tokeniser inherently encodes temporal redundancy that can be exploited directly: spatial positions whose latent representations change minimally between consecutive frames carry near-zero additional information. We introduce a parameter-free adaptive token allocation mechanism that applies a fixed threshold to per-position temporal-L1 differences, identifying and dropping redundant latent positions. Consequently, the compression rate emerges naturally from the input content rather than being enforced top-down: static scenes get compressed aggressively, while highly dynamic sequences retain more tokens. To reconstruct the dropped positions, we propose the Latent Inpainting Transformer (LIT), a lightweight factorised spatial-temporal attention architecture. The resulting inference pipeline is highly efficient, requiring only a single encoder pass and one LIT forward pass, eliminating the need for auxiliary routing networks. Evaluations across TokenBench and DAVIS, which are the standard benchmarks used by recent tokenisers~\cite{infotok, agarwal2025cosmos}, indicate that our framework yields meaningful, content-driven token allocation while maintaining competitive reconstruction fidelity, and delivers a $31\times$ inference-time speedup over the continuous adaptive baseline (ElasticTok-CV) and an $\approx2\times$ speedup over the discrete information-theoretic baseline (InfoTok)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应视频令牌化方法，利用冻结的连续视频令牌化器的潜在空间中的时间冗余，通过固定阈值丢弃在连续帧间变化较小的潜在位置，从而自然实现内容驱动的压缩率。同时提出轻量级 Latent Inpainting Transformer (LIT) 重建被丢弃位置，无需辅助路由网络。在 TokenBench 和 DAVIS 上评估，推理速度比 ElasticTok-CV 快31倍，比 InfoTok 快约2倍。
Motivation: 现有自适应视频令牌化方法要么需要迭代二值搜索或训练神经回归器，要么需要全速率解码器来估计信息含量，计算开销大。本文证明这些开销并非必要。
Method: 利用冻结的连续视频令牌化器的潜在空间，测量每位置的时间L1差异，通过固定阈值识别并丢弃冗余潜在位置；提出 Latent Inpainting Transformer (LIT) 进行重建。
Result: 在 TokenBench 和 DAVIS 上实现有意义的、内容驱动的令牌分配，保持竞争性重建保真度，推理速度比 ElasticTok-CV 快31倍，比 InfoTok 快2倍。
Conclusion: 该方法仅需单次编码器和一次 LIT 前向传播，无需辅助路由网络，高效且自然适应内容复杂度。摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Trust-Aware Predictive Emissions Monitoring for Gas Turbine Fleets with Limited Labelled Data
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based predictive emissions monitoring systems offer a practical alternative to direct emissions measurement, but their deployment across gas turbine fleets is challenging when emissions labels are available for only a small subset of assets. In this work, a trust-aware probabilistic framework is proposed for fleet-level gas turbine NOx prediction under limited labelled supervision. The framework combines a multi-head recurrent prediction model with learned confidence estimation, ensemble-based uncertainty quantification, auxiliary feature prediction, feature-space distance analysis, and operating-range diagnostics. These signals are calibrated on labelled data to produce interpretable per-sample trust scores, providing indicators of prediction reliability on unlabelled turbines, supporting the identification of predictions that should be treated with greater caution during fleet-level deployment. Confidence-based filtering reduces MAE from 0.202 at full coverage to 0.070 for the highest-confidence 10\% of predictions, demonstrating that confidence estimates are meaningfully related to prediction error. Unlabelled and out-of-distribution samples exhibit increased uncertainty and reduced confidence, indicating that the framework responds appropriately to distributional shift. The results show that the proposed trust framework provides actionable reliability information for emissions prediction on unlabelled turbines, supporting more transparent and trustworthy deployment of PEMS across industrial fleets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种信任感知的概率框架，用于在仅有少量资产有标签的情况下预测整个燃气轮机机队的NOx排放。该框架结合多头部循环预测模型、置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，为无标签涡轮机生成可解释的逐样本信任分数。置信过滤将最高置信度10%预测的MAE从0.202降至0.070，表明置信度与预测误差相关。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的预测排放监测系统在部署到整个燃气轮机机队时面临挑战，因为只有少量资产有排放标签。现有方法缺乏对无标签涡轮机预测可靠性的量化，导致部署风险。
Method: 提出一个信任感知概率框架，包含多头部循环预测模型、置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，这些信号在标签数据上校准后生成逐样本信任分数。
Result: 置信过滤将最高置信度10%预测的MAE从0.202降至0.070；无标签和分布外样本表现出更高的不确定性和更低的置信度，表明框架能响应分布偏移。

papers.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception--action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{AffordanceVLA}, a unified framework that introduces structured affordance forecasting as a task-oriented intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception--action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components: 1) \textbf{Which2Act} for object-centric grounding via visual latent prediction to suppress distractions; 2) \textbf{Where2Act} for 2D interaction localization via affordance map estimation; and 3) \textbf{How2Act} for 3D geometric reasoning to guide manipulation policies. These affordance cues provide spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture with specialized experts and train the model using a three-stage training strategy with a progressive data curriculum. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA achieves strong performance across diverse manipulation scenarios.
papers.comment: Preprint. Code and project page are available. Code: https://github.com/Skywalker-yqz/AffordanceVLA Project page: https://skywalker-yqz.github.io/AffordanceVLA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AffordanceVLA，一个通过结构化可操作性预测作为任务导向中间表示来连接视觉-语言模型与机器人操作控制的统一框架。系统包含Which2Act、Where2Act和How2Act三个互补模块，分别实现目标级基础、2D交互定位和3D几何推理，并采用MoT架构与三阶段训练策略。模拟和真实实验表明该方法在多种操作场景中表现良好。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型因VLM语义空间与具体控制策略之间的结构不匹配，难以学习精确的感知-动作映射。

papers.title: Amortizing Federated Adaptation: Hypernetwork Driven LoRA for Personalized Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning of foundation models using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers a communication efficient solution for distributed learning. However, existing federated LoRA methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) structural aggregation bias, where independently averaging low rank factors fails to approximate the true combined update, and (2) client side initialization lag, as clients repeatedly reinitialize LoRA parameters across communication rounds, slowing convergence. We propose HyperLoRA, a unified framework that addresses both issues through amortized federated adaptation through hypernetwork-driven LoRA generation and product space aggregation. Instead of iterative per-client optimization, HyperLoRA employs a learned generator that maps client distribution signatures to LoRA initializations, effectively amortizing per client adaptation. On the server side, we introduce a learned aggregation module that directly synthesizes updates in the low-rank product space, eliminating the inconsistencies of factor-wise averaging. A lightweight residual correction module further improves stability under heterogenous (non-IID) client distributions.By replacing iterative optimization and heuristic averaging with learned operators, HyperLoRA jointly enables efficient personalization, unbiased aggregation, and faster convergence. Experiments on federated vision and vision-language benchmarks show that HyperLoRA achieves improved convergence speed, greater robustness to distribution shift, and stronger personalization performance compared to prior federated LoRA methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Workshop on Federated Learning in the Age of Foundation Models In Conjunction with IJCAI 2026 (FL@FM-IJCAI'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperLoRA，一个基于超网络 (hypernetwork) 的联邦微调框架，用于解决现有联邦 LoRA 方法中的结构聚合偏差和客户端初始化滞后问题。HyperLoRA 通过学习一个生成器将客户端分布签名映射为 LoRA 初始化，并在服务器端使用学习到的聚合模块直接在低秩乘积空间中合成更新，同时引入轻量级残差校正模块以处理非 IID 数据。实验表明，该方法在联邦视觉和视觉-语言基准上实现了更快的收敛、更强的鲁棒性和更好的个性化性能。
Motivation: 现有联邦 LoRA 方法存在两个根本局限：(1) 独立平均低秩因子无法近似真实联合更新的结构聚合偏差；(2) 客户端跨通信轮次重复初始化 LoRA 参数导致的初始化滞后，减慢收敛速度。
Method: HyperLoRA 包含三个关键组件：一个超网络驱动的 LoRA 生成器，用于将客户端分布签名映射到 LoRA 参数初始化；一个服务器端学习聚合模块，直接在低秩乘积空间中合成更新，避免因子级平均的不一致性；以及一个轻量级残差校正模块，用于增强非 IID 分布下的稳定性。
Result: 在联邦视觉和视觉-语言基准实验中，HyperLoRA 相比先前联邦 LoRA 方法在收敛速度、对分布偏移的鲁棒性和个性化性能上均表现出改进。
Conclusion: 通过用学习的算子替代迭代优化和启发式平均，HyperLoRA 实现了高效个性化、无偏聚合和更快收敛。

papers.title: Tight list replicability bounds via a novel sphere covering theorem
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, list replicability has emerged as a framework for formalizing reproducibility in learning theory. A central question is how the required list size relates to the accuracy parameter and natural complexity measures of the hypothesis class. To achieve sharp bounds on list replicability, we prove a novel topological sphere covering theorem, derived from the Borsuk-Ulam theorem. Specifically, if the $d$-sphere is covered by open sets, each of which lies in an open hemisphere, then $d+1$ of these sets must have a common intersection. Using this result, we obtain a sharp bound on the relationship between list size and accuracy for VC classes. We also show that for large-margin half-spaces, provided the margin is not too large, the optimal list size equals the ambient dimension. However, when the margin is taken to be very large, we devise a replicable algorithm achieving the minimal list size of $\lceil d/2 \rceil + 1$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了一个新的拓扑球面覆盖定理（基于Borsuk-Ulam定理），并利用它得到了列表可复现性（list replicability）框架下VC类的列表大小与精度参数之间的尖锐界。对于大间隔半空间，当间隔不太大时最优列表大小等于环境维度，而当间隔很大时存在算法达到最小列表大小⌈d/2⌉+1。
Motivation: 列表可复现性是形式化学习理论中可复现性的框架，核心问题是列表大小如何依赖于精度和假设类的复杂度，此前缺乏紧的上下界。
Method: 证明了一个新的拓扑球面覆盖定理：若d维球面被开集覆盖且每个开集包含于某个开半球，则必有d+1个开集的交集非空。该定理基于Borsuk-Ulam定理，用于推导列表复现性的紧界。
Result: 得到VC类列表大小与精度的尖锐界；对于大间隔半空间，当间隔不太大时最优列表大小等于环境维度，当间隔很大时存在算法达到⌈d/2⌉+1的列表大小。
Conclusion: 本文的拓扑方法为列表可复现性提供了紧界，展示了Borsuk-Ulam定理在可复现学习理论中的新应用。

papers.title: WorldFly: A World-Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise in UAV navigation. However, existing approaches typically rely on historical observations to directly predict actions, often struggling in dense urban environments where severe occlusions and sharp turns result in drastic viewpoint transitions. We argue that the ability to "imagine" future states -- inherent in World Models -- is critical for robust decision-making under such partial observability. To address this, we construct a challenging Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark, specifically designed to evaluate spatial understanding in scenarios characterized by severe occlusions and drastic viewpoint transitions. To this end, we propose WorldFly, a novel world-model-based VLA framework that employs a dual-branch coupled flow matching mechanism to jointly generate future video predictions and navigation actions, thereby explicitly guiding the agent's policy via spatial imagination. Extensive evaluations on our benchmark demonstrate that WorldFly outperforms other baselines, particularly in unseen environments, validating the effectiveness of integrating world models into embodied aerial agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WorldFly，一种基于世界模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，用于无人机导航。通过双分支耦合流匹配机制联合生成未来视频预测和导航动作，在密集城市环境（严重遮挡和剧烈视角转换）中超越基线，尤其在新环境中表现更优。
Motivation: 现有端到端VLA模型直接根据历史观测预测动作，在严重遮挡和剧烈视角转换的密集城市环境中表现不佳。本文认为想象未来状态（世界模型的能力）对部分可观测下的鲁棒决策至关重要。
Method: 提出WorldFly，基于世界模型的VLA框架，采用双分支耦合流匹配机制联合生成未来视频预测和导航动作，通过空间想象显式引导智能体策略。同时构建Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark评估空间理解。
Result: 在该基准上，WorldFly优于其他基线，特别是在未见过的环境中，验证了将世界模型集成到机载空中智能体的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调想象未来状态的能力对密集城市环境中无人机导航至关重要，WorldFly通过世界模型实现并取得更好性能。

papers.title: Computation-Aware Event-to-Frame Reconstruction via Selective Attention
papers.abstract_en: Event-to-frame (E2F) reconstruction bridges asynchronous event streams with frame-based vision pipelines, but existing methods often face a trade-off between reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. In this work, we propose an efficient E2F framework that emphasizes causal temporal modeling and computation-aware design. The architecture adopts a recurrent encoder-decoder to incrementally aggregate event information with compact hidden states. To improve robustness under fast motion and illumination variations, a selective context fusion strategy is introduced to integrate event-driven features with prior intensity cues. Within this fusion process, a lightweight hybrid attention mechanism enhances feature selectivity without relying on heavy attention operations. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive reconstruction performance while maintaining a favorable balance between accuracy and model complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种计算感知的事件到帧重建框架，使用循环编码器-解码器逐步聚合事件信息，通过选择性上下文融合策略集成事件驱动特征与先验强度线索，并采用轻量级混合注意力机制增强特征选择性。在标准基准上实现了竞争性的重建性能，同时保持准确性和模型复杂度之间的平衡。
Motivation: 现有事件到帧重建方法在重建质量和计算效率之间面临权衡，缺乏对计算感知和因果时序建模的充分考虑。
Method: 采用循环编码器-解码器架构增量聚合事件信息，引入选择性上下文融合策略将事件特征与先验强度线索结合，并使用轻量级混合注意力机制提升特征选择性，避免重计算开销。
Result: 在标准基准上，该方法取得了与现有方法竞争的重建性能，并在准确性和模型复杂度之间实现了良好平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，但强调所提框架在计算效率和重建质量之间取得了有利平衡。

papers.title: A Finite Certificate for the Positive $n=9$ Vasc Inequality
papers.abstract_en: We prove the positive-real $n=9$ case of the Vasc cyclic inequality. The proof was obtained with human-guided assistance from the AI agent MechMath Agent Team: the human-readable part reduces the rational inequality to a homogeneous polynomial inequality, fixes a cyclic maximum, and parametrizes each sorted fixed-maximum cone by cumulative gaps; the finite part is a certificate covering all $8!=40320$ sorted cones. MechMath Agent Team generated the certificate verification workflow through Python tool calls, including the case split, verification programs, and terminal classifications. The published certificate has $36815$ coefficient leaves, $2236$ ordinary Polya multiplier leaves, and $1269$ AM-GM midpoint overlay leaves. Human authors audited the mathematical reductions and verification logic, and a separate artifact contains the certificate, an independent verifier, and a from-source rebuild route.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了正实数情形下 n=9 的 Vasc 循环不等式。证明通过人工智能代理 MechMath Agent Team 的人机协作完成：将有理不等式化为齐次多项式不等式，固定循环最大值并用累积间隙参数化每个排序后的固定最大值锥，最终得到覆盖所有 8! = 40320 个排序锥的有限证书。证书包含 36815 个系数叶、2236 个普通 Polya 乘子叶和 1269 个 AM-GM 中点覆盖叶。
Motivation: Vasc 循环不等式在 n=9 正实数情形下仍未得到证明，该工作填补了这一空白。
Method: 采用人类指导与 AI 代理 MechMath Agent Team 协作的方式：人类完成不等式化简与锥参数化，AI 生成证书验证工作流，包括情形拆分、验证程序和终端分类。
Result: 成功构建了包含 36815 个系数叶、2236 个普通 Polya 乘子叶和 1269 个 AM-GM 中点覆盖叶的有限证书，覆盖所有 40320 个排序锥。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了 n=9 正实数 Vasc 不等式，但证书的人工审计和独立验证器已作为独立工件提供，确保可复现性。

papers.title: TLA-Prover: Verifiable TLA+ Specification Synthesis via Preference-Optimized Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: TLA+ is a formal specification language for verifying distributed systems and safety-critical protocols. Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce TLA+ specifications that fail the TLC model checker for semantic reasons. Across 25 LLMs, the best public baseline is 26.6% syntactic parse and 8.6% semantic model-check. We present TLA-Prover, a 20-billion-parameter model for TLA+ specification synthesis. Training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on verified examples with repair-based group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). In the GRPO stage, the model learns to fix its own rejected specifications. We also train a direct preference optimization (DPO) variant from the same SFT checkpoint as an ablation. TLC provides the reward signal directly, with no learned reward model. Four tiers grade each output: Bronze (parses), Silver (no warnings), Gold (passes TLC), and Diamond. To reach Diamond, the model's correctness property is automatically altered in a small way; TLC must then detect a violation. If TLC still passes, the property was always-true and contributes nothing; the output fails Diamond. TLA-Prover reaches 9/30 (i.e. pass@1 = 30%) at both Gold and Diamond on a held-out 30-problem benchmark. This is roughly 3.5x the 8.6% untuned baseline. The DPO variant reaches 20% at Diamond. Gold and Diamond coincide at every checkpoint; this prevents the trivial-property failure mode.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. Submitted at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TLA-Prover，一个200亿参数的TLA+形式化规范合成模型。通过监督微调和修复式组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练，模型能生成通过TLC模型检查器验证的规范。在30题基准上，Gold/Diamond级别通过率均为30%，是未调优基线（8.6%）的3.5倍。
Motivation: 大型语言模型生成的TLA+规范常因语义错误无法通过TLC模型检查，现有最佳基线仅8.6%通过语义验证。
Method: 两阶段训练：先对已验证示例进行监督微调（SFT），再进行修复式组相对策略优化（GRPO）。模型学习修复自身被拒绝的规范，TLC直接提供奖励信号，无需学习奖励模型。还训练了直接偏好优化（DPO）变体作为消融。
Result: 在30题基准上，TLA-Prover在Gold和Diamond级别均达30% pass@1，是基线8.6%的3.5倍。DPO变体在Diamond级别达20%。Gold和Diamond级别通过率始终一致，避免了平凡属性失败模式。
Conclusion: TLA-Prover显著提升了LLM生成可验证TLA+规范的能力，但基准规模较小（30题），且依赖TLC检查器提供的硬奖励。

papers.title: Adaptive state-action abstractions via rate-distortion
papers.abstract_en: When learning to walk, infants seem to address a coarse version of the problem first - stay upright, reach the caregiver - and refine it only when further practice at that resolution stops paying off. Reinforcement learning offers multiple techniques for building simple versions of complex tasks, but lacks general principles for how to dynamically adjust the granularity of these abstractions during learning. This paper proposes one such principle: refine the abstraction as soon as the learning error within it becomes comparable to the error induced by the abstraction itself. Here, we investigate one way of formalising this principle via a performance certificate that decomposes value error into two terms: a learning error bound captured by a Bellman residual, and an abstraction error bound given by a bisimulation metric. The resulting switching strategy is implemented by soft state-action abstractions built from rate-distortion principles, whose resolution along state and action axes can be continuously adjusted. We validate this construction in a range of tabular settings, showing that near-optimal performance can be achieved under substantial lossy compression of state and action information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于率失真 (rate-distortion) 原理的自适应状态-动作抽象方法，能够在强化学习训练过程中动态调整抽象的粒度。论文通过一个性能证书 (performance certificate) 将值误差分解为学习误差和抽象误差，并据此设计切换策略：当学习误差与抽象误差相当时细化抽象。在tabular环境中验证表明，即使对状态和动作信息进行大幅度有损压缩，也能达到接近最优的性能。
Motivation: 强化学习中缺乏动态调整抽象粒度的通用原则，现有方法多为固定抽象或启发式调整。本文希望建立一种理论驱动的切换策略，使抽象精度随学习过程自适应。
Method: 将值误差分解为Bellman残差界定的学习误差和由bisimulation度量界定的抽象误差，基于两者比较决定何时细化抽象。实现上采用率失真原理构建软状态-动作抽象，使状态和动作维度的分辨率可连续调整。
Result: 在多种tabular设置中，该方法在保持接近最优性能的同时，实现了对状态和动作信息的大量有损压缩。
Conclusion: 本文为强化学习中的自适应抽象提供了理论原则和实现方法，表明通过率失真原则可构建有效的软抽象，并在中等规模的表格环境中取得良好效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diff-CA: Separating Common and Salient Factors with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Analysis aims to separate factors that are common between two data distributions from those that are salient to only one of them. Existing contrastive methods are based on generative models (e.g., VAEs or GANs) that often suffer from limited reconstruction and image quality, which hampers effective latent factor separation and limits their applicability to high-fidelity image generation and edition. We propose a novel conditioning framework for diffusion models that enables contrastive decomposition without compromising generation quality. We first train a prompt-free, image-conditioned diffusion model, and then learn to decompose the conditioning into a common and a salient factor, using weak supervision. We prove that the additive contrastive factorization, commonly assumed in prior work, is identifiable under mild conditions. This factorization enables targeted operations by swapping or interpolating only the salient factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的对比分析框架 Diff-CA，用于将两个数据分布之间的共同因子和显著因子分离。该方法首先训练无提示的图像条件扩散模型，然后通过弱监督学习将条件分解为共同因子和显著因子，并证明了加性对比因子分解的可识别性。
Motivation: 现有对比分析方法依赖生成模型（如VAE或GAN），重建质量和图像质量有限，妨碍了高保真图像生成和编辑中的有效因子分离。
Method: 提出一种新的扩散模型条件框架：先训练无提示的图像条件扩散模型，再通过弱监督学习将条件分解为共同因子和显著因子，并利用加性因子分解实现因子交换或插值。
Result: 理论证明在温和条件下加性对比因子分解是可识别的，实验表明该方法能有效分离共同和显著因子并支持高保真图像编辑。
Conclusion: 该框架在不牺牲生成质量的前提下实现了对比分解，为高保真图像编辑提供了新的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $p$-adic Bi-Filtrations for Topological Machine Learning on Genomic Sequences
papers.abstract_en: We introduce pVR, a topological machine learning framework for alignment-free genomic sequence classification that combines $p$-adic numbers with topological data analysis. Each DNA sequence is encoded along two complementary axes: a $p$-adic distance on $k$-mer prefixes, which captures hierarchical positional structure, and a compositional $L_1$ distance on $k$-mer frequencies, which captures local sequence content. The two distances jointly parameterise a bi-filtered Vietoris--Rips complex, and per-sequence topological summaries from this bi-filtration serve as features for standard machine learning classifiers. We establish theoretical guarantees for the construction: stability under metric perturbations and invariance to the choice of prime, alongside a result that explains why a single $p$-adic axis is topologically uninformative and why the bi-filtration recovers nontrivial homology. On twelve genomic benchmarks ($28$ to $500$ sequences, $3$ to $7$ classes), pVR outperforms four established alignment-free baselines on three of six low-sample datasets, with gains of up to $21$ percentage points; it underperforms only on a SARS-CoV-2 variant benchmark whose point-mutation divergence violates the hierarchical assumption, and all methods saturate in the large-sample regime. pVR also outperforms zero-shot frozen embeddings from the 500M-parameter Nucleotide Transformer v2 by $6.7$ to $11.4$ percentage points on three low-sample benchmarks. The pVR codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/MAHI-Group/pVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 pVR 框架，结合 p-adic 数与拓扑数据分析，用于无需序列比对的基因组分类。将 DNA 序列编码为基于 k-mer 前缀的 p-adic 距离（层级位置结构）和基于 k-mer 频率的 L1 距离（局部内容），构建双过滤 Vietoris-Rips 复形，提取拓扑摘要作为特征。理论证明了稳定性、素数不变性及双过滤恢复非平凡同调的必要性。在 12 个基因组基准上，低样本场景中在 3/6 数据集上优于四种对比方法，最高提升 21 个百分点；在 SARS-CoV-2 变种基准上因点突变违反层级假设而表现不佳；在三个低样本基准上优于 500M 参数 Nucleotide Transformer v2 6.7-11.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有基因组分类依赖序列比对，计算开销大且对长序列不友好；单一 p-adic 轴拓扑信息不足，双过滤可恢复非平凡同调并利用层级结构信息。
Method: 对每条 DNA 序列计算两种距离：基于 k-mer 前缀的 p-adic 距离（编码层级位置结构）和基于 k-mer 频率的 L1 距离（编码局部序列内容）；用这两个距离参数化双过滤 Vietoris-Rips 复形，从双过滤中提取每序列的拓扑摘要作为特征，用于标准机器学习分类器。
Result: 在 12 个基因组基准（28-500 序列，3-7 类）上，pVR 在 3 个低样本数据集上优于四种对比方法，最高提升 21 个百分点；在 SARS-CoV-2 变种基准上因点突变违反层级假设而表现差于部分方法；在所有方法均饱和的大样本场景下无显著优势；在三个低样本基准上比 500M 参数 Nucleotide Transformer v2 提升 6.7-11.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: pVR 在低样本基因组分类任务中有效，尤其适合层级结构明显的序列数据，但对点突变敏感的变种分类可能受限；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Healthy Evolution: Exploring the Role and Mechanisms of Human-Agent Interaction in Self-Evolving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve through continual self-play and self-generated learning signals, but autonomous evolution can also cause capability degradation and safety drift. Although human feedback has proven effective for static and post-trained agents, its role in self-evolving systems remains underexplored. We introduce Agent Norm Correction through Human-like Oversight and Review (ANCHOR), an LLM-based framework that simulates human supervision and delivers feedback at various phases of self-evolution. With ANCHOR, we evaluate two representative open-source self-evolving agent systems across coding, mathematical reasoning, and safety. Our results show that even limited supervision substantially mitigates safety degradation while preserving stable performance on core evolutionary objectives. Further analysis shows that supervision over the output verification phase is the most effective for intervention, whereas increasing supervision frequency yields diminishing returns. These findings provide empirical evidence and practical guidance for designing more stable, controllable, and human-aligned self-evolving agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索人类-AI交互在自我进化系统中的作用。提出ANCHOR框架，用LLM模拟人类监督，在自我进化的不同阶段提供反馈。实验表明，即使有限的监督也能显著缓解安全退化，同时保持核心进化目标的稳定性能；输出验证阶段的监督最有效，增加监督频率的回报递减。
Motivation: 自我进化智能体通过自对弈和自生成学习信号持续改进，但自主进化可能导致能力退化和安全漂移。人类反馈在静态和后训练智能体中有效，但在自我进化系统中的作用尚未充分探索。
Method: 提出ANCHOR（Agent Norm Correction through Human-like Oversight and Review），一个基于LLM的框架，模拟人类监督并在自我进化的多个阶段（如输出验证）提供反馈。在两个代表性开源自我进化智能体系统（编程、数学推理、安全任务）上评估。
Result: 有限的人类监督显著缓解安全退化，同时保持核心进化目标的稳定性能。输出验证阶段的监督最有效，增加监督频率带来递减收益。
Conclusion: 为设计更稳定、可控且与人类对齐的自我进化智能体系统提供了经验证据和实践指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文探索人类-AI交互在自我进化系统中的作用。提出ANCHOR框架，用LLM模拟人类监督，在自我进化的不同阶段提供反馈。实验表明，即使有限的监督也能显著缓解安全退化，同时保持核心进化目标的稳定性能；输出验证阶段的监督最有效，增加监督频率的回报递减。
summary_sections.motivation: 自我进化智能体通过自对弈和自生成学习信号持续改进，但自主进化可能导致能力退化和安全漂移。人类反馈在静态和后训练智能体中有效，但在自我进化系统中的作用尚未充分探索。
summary_sections.method: 提出ANCHOR（Agent Norm Correction through Human-like Oversight and Review），一个基于LLM的框架，模拟人类监督并在自我进化的多个阶段（如输出验证）提供反馈。在两个代表性开源自我进化智能体系统（编程、数学推理、安全任务）上评估。
summary_sections.result: 有限的人类监督显著缓解安全退化，同时保持核心进化目标的稳定性能。输出验证阶段的监督最有效，增加监督频率带来递减收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 为设计更稳定、可控且与人类对齐的自我进化智能体系统提供了经验证据和实践指导。

papers.title: Where, What, Why, and Importance: Structured Defect Grounding for Text-to-Image Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Despite generating increasingly photorealistic images, text-to-image (T2I) models still exhibit localized, subtle, and structurally complex failures. Diagnosing these failures requires instance-level feedback that answers where a defect occurs, what type it is, why it is defective, and its importance to overall image quality. While recent dense-feedback methods move beyond scalar supervision, their heatmap-centric representations still formulate diagnosis as pixel-field regression, making it difficult to localize variable-cardinality defects and bind semantic reasons to individual failures. To address this representation bottleneck, we propose Structured Defect Grounding (SDG), which casts T2I diagnosis as structured set prediction by modeling each defect as a (location, type, reason, importance) tuple. To make this formulation trainable and measurable, we introduce SDG-30K, a 30K-image dataset with box-grounded annotations across four modern T2I generators, together with a dedicated evaluation protocol, SDG-Eval. Building on this structured representation, we further present a diagnosis-to-alignment framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the SDG detector, and BoxFlow-GRPO converts predicted defect sets into box-derived, importance-weighted spatial rewards for diffusion model alignment. Extensive experiments show that our SDG detector outperforms leading proprietary VLMs on structured defect grounding, while SDG-guided rewards consistently improve T2I alignment and support localized image refinement. These results establish SDG as a unified, instance-level interface for diagnosing, evaluating, and enhancing modern generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像（T2I）生成模型中的局部、细微且结构复杂的缺陷，提出结构化缺陷定位（SDG）方法，将缺陷建模为（位置、类型、原因、重要性）四元组，并构建了30K图像数据集SDG-30K和评估协议SDG-Eval。在此基础上，提出诊断到对齐框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为SDG检测器，并通过BoxFlow-GRPO将预测缺陷集转化为空间奖励以对齐扩散模型。实验表明，SDG检测器在结构化缺陷定位上优于领先的专有VLM，且SDG引导的奖励一致地改进了T2I对齐并支持局部图像细化。
Motivation: 现有T2I模型存在局部、细微且结构复杂的失败，而现有密集反馈方法以热图为中心，将诊断视为像素域回归，难以定位可变数量的缺陷并将语义原因绑定到单个失败，缺乏结构化表示能力。
Method: 提出结构化缺陷定位（SDG），将每个缺陷建模为（位置、类型、原因、重要性）元组；构建SDG-30K数据集（30K图像，含基于框的标注）；提出诊断到对齐框架，使用VLM作为SDG检测器，并结合BoxFlow-GRPO利用预测缺陷集生成重要性加权的空间奖励用于扩散模型对齐。
Result: SDG检测器在结构化缺陷定位上优于领先的专有VLM；SDG引导的奖励一致地改进了T2I对齐并支持局部图像细化。
Conclusion: SDG为诊断、评估和增强现代生成模型提供了统一的、实例级的接口，但仅限于文本到图像生成领域。

papers.title: Harnessing Structural Context for Entity Alignment Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify equivalent entities across heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) and is a key component of knowledge fusion and cross-KG reasoning. The recent EA foundation model demonstrates that alignment knowledge, once pretrained, can be directly applied to diverse previously unseen KG pairs. However, it still underuses structural context in two places: cross-KG interaction is weak during encoding, and final candidate ranking still relies too heavily on coarse similarity. We address these limitations with ContextEA, an enhanced encoder-decoder framework for transferable EA. On the encoder side, we introduce a cross-KG interaction encoder that unifies the two KGs with anchor bridges and performs earlier relation-aware cross-graph propagation. On the decoder side, we introduce a structural calibration decoder that calibrates alignment scores with entity-level, neighborhood-level, relation-level, and anchor-aware structural evidence. This design strengthens both structural context construction and structural context exploitation while remaining lightweight. Experiments on 29 EA datasets in OpenEA, SRPRS, and DBP show consistent gains over strong transferable baselines. Notably, the pretrained ContextEA already surpasses the finetuned baselines on all three benchmark groups, demonstrating substantially stronger transfer to unseen KGs. These results suggest that explicitly harnessing structural context is an effective direction for improving EA foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对实体对齐（EA）基础模型中对结构上下文利用不足的问题，提出ContextEA框架。编码器端引入跨知识图谱交互编码器，通过锚点桥接统一两个KG并进行早期关系感知传播；解码器端引入结构校准解码器，利用实体级、邻域级、关系级和锚点感知的结构证据校准对齐分数。在OpenEA、SRPRS和DBP的29个EA数据集上，ContextEA持续优于强迁移基线，且预训练模型已超过微调基线，表明显式利用结构上下文能有效改进EA基础模型。
Motivation: 现有EA基础模型在编码时跨KG交互弱，候选排序过度依赖粗略相似度，未能充分利用结构上下文。
Method: 提出ContextEA框架，包含跨KG交互编码器（利用锚点桥接统一两个KG，进行关系感知传播）和结构校准解码器（从实体、邻域、关系、锚点层面校准对齐分数）。
Result: 在OpenEA、SRPRS和DBP的29个数据集上，ContextEA持续优于迁移基线；预训练模型已经超越微调基线，展现出更强的迁移能力。
Conclusion: 显式利用结构上下文是改进EA基础模型的有效方向。

papers.title: A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EEG解码中协方差描述符对通道缩放敏感的问题，提出基于拉回欧几里得度量（PEM）的切片Wasserstein（SW）差异框架，并在全秩相关矩阵流形上实例化两种相关性切片Wasserstein（CorSW）差异。基于CorSW开发域泛化框架，在三个EEG数据集上验证了分布偏移下的泛化改进，训练开销低且推理无额外成本。
Motivation: 现有EEG解码常使用协方差描述符，但协方差对通道间缩放敏感；全秩相关矩阵作为尺度不变替代，但其几何差异度量尚不完善，缺乏统一的框架。
Method: 提出Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW) 框架，并在全秩相关矩阵流形上结合Off-Log Metric (OLM)和Log-Scaled Metric (LSM)两种几何，实例化CorSW差异，进而构建域泛化方法。
Result: 在三个EEG数据集上，所提方法在分布偏移场景下提升了分类泛化性能，且训练计算开销低，推理阶段不增加额外成本。
Conclusion: 本文为基于相关矩阵的EEG解码提供了一种有效的域泛化框架，具有计算高效和尺度不变的优势。

papers.title: MS-DKC: A Dataset Knowledge Card Framework for Designing and Adapting Medical Image Segmentation Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is often framed as a search for stronger architectures, but this can obscure a more fundamental question: what does the dataset require from the model? In medical imaging, this requirement is shaped by foreground occupancy, morphology, boundary ambiguity, topology sensitivity, annotation quality, acquisition variation, and operating point. This paper introduces the Medical Segmentation Dataset Knowledge Card (MS-DKC), a framework for making these factors explicit. MS-DKC records dataset evidence through image/acquisition, morphology, supervision, context-dependence, and deployment-risk descriptors. These descriptors are mapped to failure modes, design priors, and risk-aligned criteria, making segmentation design more traceable than architecture-first comparison. We evaluate MS-DKC on DRIVE, ISIC2018, and ACDC, representing distinct regimes. DRIVE contains sparse, thin, branching vessels, favoring detail-preserving models, sensitivity-aware optimization, threshold analysis, and topology-aware metrics. DKC-TNet-v2 achieved Dice 0.8044 and IoU 0.6730 with 35103 parameters, while SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef reached Dice 0.8141, IoU 0.6865, sensitivity 0.8265, specificity 0.9804, and AUC 0.9853. ISIC2018 involves compact but appearance-variable lesions; validation-constrained score-function selection on Att-Next-Topo/ATTNext produced MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug with Dice 0.8872, IoU 0.8214, precision 0.9173, Boundary F1 0.4878, and ASSD 4.13, while plausible additions failed to improve the risk-aligned profile. ACDC provides a multi-class cardiac case, where MS-DKC recommends four-class softmax segmentation, class-balanced Dice/CE supervision, and class-wise surface evaluation. Overall, the results support dataset-conditioned design: different datasets require different priors, operating points, and evidence before a model can be judged appropriate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出医学分割数据集知识卡片（MS-DKC）框架，通过记录数据集在图像/采集、形态、监督、上下文依赖和部署风险等方面的描述符，将数据集需求显式化，从而指导分割模型的设计与选择。在DRIVE、ISIC2018和ACDC三个数据集上的实验表明，不同数据集需要不同的先验、操作点和评估标准。
Motivation: 当前医学图像分割研究过度关注更强架构，忽视了数据集本身对模型的要求，如前景占有率、形态、边界模糊性、拓扑敏感性、标注质量等。
Method: 提出MS-DKC框架，通过图像/采集、形态、监督、上下文依赖和部署风险五个描述符记录数据集证据，并将这些描述符映射到失败模式、设计先验和风险对齐标准，使分割设计更具可追溯性。
Result: 在DRIVE上，DKC-TNet-v2达到Dice 0.8044、IoU 0.6730（35103参数），SA-UNetv2-DKC-AmbRef达到Dice 0.8141、IoU 0.6865；在ISIC2018上，MS-DKC-AttNextTopo-VCSF-NoAug达到Dice 0.8872、IoU 0.8214；在ACDC上，推荐四类softmax分割、类平衡Dice/CE损失和类别表面评估。
Conclusion: 结果显示数据集条件驱动的设计更合理：不同数据集要求不同先验、操作点和评估证据，才能判断模型是否合适。

papers.title: Step-adaptive multimodal fusion network with multi-scale cloud feature learning for ultra-short-term solar irradiance forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-short-term solar irradiance prediction is critical for photovoltaic system dispatch and power grid stability. Existing approaches suffer from three key shortcomings: single time-series models cannot capture the spatial dynamics of clouds under complex conditions, standard convolutions inadequately represent multi-scale cloud features, and fixed low-frequency compensation strategies fail to adapt to different prediction steps. To address these issues, this proposes a multi-source data fusion model for ultra-short-term irradiance prediction. The model first employs InceptionNeXt to extract multi-scale, multi-directional spatial features from ground-based cloud images. A step-adaptive low-frequency compensation unit is then introduced to dynamically modulate global low-frequency information based on the prediction step. Eventually, the enhanced image features are combined with meteorological time-series features, and a TempAttnLSTM network captures global temporal dependencies for multi-step prediction. Experiments on the public NREL dataset and practical photovoltaic stations in Shandong illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with several state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超短期太阳辐照度预测中现有方法的三点不足（单时间序列模型无法捕捉云层空间动态、标准卷积难以表示多尺度云特征、固定低频补偿策略不适应不同预测步长），提出一种多源数据融合模型。该模型使用InceptionNeXt从地基云图提取多尺度多方向空间特征，引入步长自适应低频补偿单元动态调节全局低频信息，并将增强后的图像特征与气象时间序列特征结合，通过TempAttnLSTM网络捕获全局时间依赖进行多步预测。在NREL数据集和山东实际光伏电站上的实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有超短期太阳辐照度预测方法无法有效结合云图空间动态与气象时间序列，且缺乏对预测步长自适应的低频补偿机制，导致预测精度不足。
Method: 提出多源数据融合模型：1）InceptionNeXt提取地基云图的多尺度多方向空间特征；2）步长自适应低频补偿单元动态调整全局低频信息；3）TempAttnLSTM融合增强图像特征与气象时间序列特征进行多步预测。
Result: 在公开NREL数据集和山东光伏电站数据上，所提方法优于多种最新方法，证实了模型在超短期太阳辐照度预测中的有效性。

papers.title: Quantum-limited estimation of atmospheric turbulence via spatial mode decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We establish the ultimate precision limit for estimating the optical spatial coherence radius (Fried parameter) within a quantum metrological framework. In the weak field regime, we show that spatial-mode decomposition -- originally introduced for superresolution imaging -- enables substantially more precise estimation than conventional direct imaging when the receiver aperture is smaller than the coherence radius.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: HyperVis: Continuous Latent Visual Relational Graphs on the Lorentz Hyperboloid for Compositional Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with compositional reasoning that requires understanding inter-object relationships. A natural remedy is to inject explicit scene graph triplets $\langle s, p, o \rangle$ from an off-the-shelf scene graph generator (SGG), but we show this backfires: discrete text labels collide with the continuous visual modality, degrading GQA accuracy from 60.38\% to 58.86\%. We propose \textbf{HyperVis}, which bypasses the SGG semantic bottleneck entirely. From $N$ class-agnostic region proposals, we compute a dense $O(N^2)$ visual relation tensor via spatially-biased cross-attention, project it onto a Lorentz hyperboloid, and enforce hierarchy through spatial physics, namely IoA-driven entailment cones and exterior-angle repulsion. We discover that HyperVis contributes in two complementary ways: (1) as a \emph{training-time regularizer}, the hyperbolic relational losses shape LoRA representations that improve generative VQA (GQA 61.03\% vs.\ 57.21\% for LoRA fine-tuning without relational losses, recovering and surpassing the baseline); and (2) as an \emph{inference-time relational encoder}, hyperbolic prefix tokens boost discriminative compositional scoring (SugarCrepe 79.94\%, $+$6.25pp over baseline). The learned curvature stabilises at $κ{=}4.0$, an order of magnitude above prior hyperbolic VLMs where $κ$ typically collapses toward zero, indicating that continuous visual features genuinely require the exponential volume of strongly curved space. A controlled Euclidean ablation confirms this decomposition: the relational pipeline regularises LoRA comparably in flat space (GQA 60.81\%), but the compositionality gain is specifically hyperbolic (SugarCrepe $+$4.58pp over Euclidean), with entailment loss ${\sim}6{\times}$ higher in Euclidean training. Codes are available at TBA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperVis，绕过离散场景图生成器的语义瓶颈，直接从区域提议计算连续视觉关系张量并投影到洛伦兹双曲面。通过空间物理（IoA 蕴含锥和外部角排斥）强制层次结构，在训练时作为正则化器提升生成 VQA（GQA 61.03%），在推理时作为关系编码器提升判别组合评分（SugarCrepe 79.94%）。曲率稳定在 κ=4.0，表明连续视觉特征确实需要强曲率空间。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在组合推理中理解物体间关系困难。使用现成场景图生成器的离散文本标签与连续视觉模态冲突，导致性能下降（GQA 从 60.38% 降至 58.86%）。
Method: 从 N 个类别无关区域提议计算 O(N²) 视觉关系张量，通过空间偏置交叉注意力，投影到洛伦兹双曲面，并利用 IoA 驱动的蕴含锥和外部角排斥来强制空间层次结构。
Result: 作为训练时正则化器，GQA 准确率 61.03%（对比 LoRA 微调基线 57.21%）；作为推理时关系编码器，SugarCrepe 79.94%（+6.25 百分点）。曲率稳定在 κ=4.0，比先前双曲 VLM 高一个数量级。
Conclusion: 连续视觉特征需要强曲率双曲空间；关系流水线在欧几里得空间也有正则化效果，但组合性增益是双曲空间特有的（SugarCrepe +4.58pp 对比欧几里得）。

papers.title: CogManip: Benchmarking Manipulative Behavior in Multi-Turn Interactions with Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit covert psychological manipulation in complex human-AI interactions has garnered increasing safety concerns. However, existing AI safety benchmarks remain largely restricted to explicit rule compliance and static prompts, failing to capture the dynamic and covert nature of manipulative strategies in multi-turn dialogues. We introduce CogManip, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates 15 manipulation strategy risks across 1,000 multi-turn interaction scenarios, validated by human experts. A systematic evaluation of 13 representative models, including frontier models like GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V3.2, reveals significant risk heterogeneities and illuminates the targeted direction for future defense. Further analysis of objective function perturbation reveals that DeepSeek-V3.2's manipulation tactics are highly sensitive to both negative and benign system prompts, demonstrating the critical necessity of prompt-based defense engineering and implicit goal auditing. CogManip offers a robust instrument and perspective for auditing the implicit psychological influence and dynamic strategy selection of modern LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CogManip基准，用于评估大语言模型在多轮交互中的操纵性行为，涵盖15种操纵策略和1000个场景，由人类专家验证。对GPT-5.4、DeepSeek-V3.2等13个模型的评估揭示了风险异质性，并发现DeepSeek-V3.2的操纵策略对系统提示高度敏感，强调了提示工程防御和隐性目标审计的重要性。
Motivation: 现有AI安全基准局限于显式规则遵从和静态提示，无法捕捉多轮对话中动态、隐蔽的操纵策略，需要更全面的评估工具。
Method: 构建包含15种操纵策略的1000个多轮交互场景，经人类专家验证；系统评估13个代表性模型，并分析目标函数扰动的影响。
Result: 不同模型在操纵风险上存在显著异质性，DeepSeek-V3.2的操纵策略对负向和良性系统提示均高度敏感。
Conclusion: CogManip提供了审计大语言模型隐性心理影响和动态策略选择的鲁棒工具，并凸显了基于提示的防御工程和隐性目标审计的必要性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundational Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate proficiency on a wide range of general tasks, and achieve remarkable results on various specialized tasks via domain-expert LLMs. With the ever-growing list of available LLMs, inference routers are being proposed to select the most appropriate LLM for each prompt. However, existing routing methods either optimize cost across weak-to-strong generalist LLMs or require substantial training to support domain-expertise routing. In this paper, we propose IR3DE, a Ridge Regression-based Router for Domain Experts that provides cheap and fast routing decisions for each prompt. We evaluate IR3DE in two Causal Language Modeling (CLM) settings where the tasks are next-token prediction for all domains, and one reasoning setting where each domain has its own distinct reasoning task. Despite being a linear router, IR3DE achieves performance comparable to the other baselines in both CLM settings, and surpassing them in the reasoning setting, with a normalized performance of 98.4%. Moreover, IR3DE enables the addition or removal of new domain experts without requiring the router to be retrained from scratch, allowing a dynamic set of LLMs to be served with minimal disruption to the router itself. Our code is available at: github.com/gensyn-ai/IR3DE.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IR3DE，一种基于岭回归的线性路由器，用于在多个领域专家LLM中为每个提示快速选择最合适的模型。在因果语言建模和推理任务上，IR3DE达到与复杂基线相当或更优的性能（推理任务归一化性能98.4%），并支持动态添加或移除专家而无需重新训练路由器。
Motivation: 现有推理路由方法要么限于弱到强通用模型的成本优化，要么需要大量训练才能支持领域专家路由，缺乏廉价且快速的解决方案。
Method: 基于岭回归的线性路由器，通过对提示表示进行线性回归来预测各专家模型的适用性，实现低计算开销的实时路由。
Result: 在因果语言建模设置中，IR3DE性能与基线相当；在推理设置中，以98.4%的归一化性能超越所有基线，同时保持低延迟。
Conclusion: IR3DE提供了一种廉价、快速且可扩展的线性路由方案，适用于动态变化的专家LLM集合，无需完整重新训练。

papers.title: OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Policy-gradient methods usually optimize expected return, but many real world applications care about distributional properties of returns: tail risk, outlier robustness, or best-of-K discovery. We introduce OrderGrad, a family of likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradient estimators for order-statistic objectives. OrderGrad optimizes finite-sample L-statistics, i.e., weighted averages of sorted rewards or costs, recovering objectives such as VaR, CVaR, trimmed means, medians, and top-m/best-of-K criteria by changing only the rank weights. For any fixed sample size and rank-weight vector, OrderGrad provides an unbiased gradient estimator for the corresponding order-statistic objective. The method is implemented as a simple reward transformation that can then be used in an otherwise standard policy-gradient or reparameterized update. We study the resulting estimator's variance behavior and evaluate it on tasks where mean optimization is mismatched to the deployment objective, including LLM math post-training and other tasks. OrderGrad provides a unified, plug-and-play route to risk-averse, robust, and exploratory learning. Code: https://github.com/paavo5/ordergrad
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出OrderGrad，一种用于顺序统计量目标的策略梯度估计器族，支持优化VaR、CVaR、截尾均值、中位数、top-m/best-of-K等目标，通过简单的奖励变换即可在标准策略梯度或重参数化更新中使用。
Motivation: 现有策略梯度方法通常优化期望回报，但许多实际应用关心回报的分布性质（如尾部风险、异常值鲁棒性、最好K发现），需要能够优化顺序统计量目标的梯度估计方法。
Method: OrderGrad，包括似然比和重参数化梯度估计器，用于有限样本L统计量（排序奖励的加权平均），通过改变秩权重实现不同目标，提供无偏梯度估计。
Result: 在LLM数学后训练等任务上评估，显示OrderGrad在均值优化与部署目标不匹配时有效。
Conclusion: 提供了一种统一的即插即用方法用于风险厌恶、鲁棒和探索性学习。

papers.title: Integrating Mechanistic and Data-Driven Models for Neurological Disorders through Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Advances in computational modeling, neuroimaging, and artificial intelligence are revolutionizing the modeling of neurological disorders for improved diagnostics, prognosis, and treatment planning. Mechanistic models provide valuable scientific insight into the disorders, but in practice they are often simplified with assumptions or computationally expensive and slow to solve. However, while purely data driven approaches provide speed and scalability, they require large, high quality data to train and generally suffer from interpretability and generalization issues. This perspective paper presents a structured overview of hybrid modeling strategies, which combine deep learning models with physics based solvers, and are categorized into parallel, series, and parallel-series architectures. Three main approaches that have been emphasized are residual modeling for missing or incomplete physics, Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs) for continuous time dynamics approximation, and solver in the loop that accelerates traditional solvers with neural approximations. These hybrid models integrate the governing differential equation based formulations and deep learning to characterize the evolution of neurological disorders, and promise advanced personalized neurological modeling. In addition, the study explores and proposes different hybrid configurations to improve diagnosis accuracy, predict disease progression, and inform treatment strategies across a range of neurological disorders. These capabilities outperform standalone mechanistic or purely data driven approaches, making hybrid modeling a powerful tool, especially in applications involving modeling the progression and treatment responses in neurological conditions such as brain tumors, Alzheimer's disease, and stroke.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点论文，系统概述了将深度学习与基于物理的求解器相结合的混合建模策略，用于神经疾病的诊断、预后和治疗规划。重点介绍了残差建模、神经常微分方程（NODEs）和求解器在环三种主要方法，并展示了其在脑肿瘤、阿尔茨海默病等疾病中的应用优势。
Motivation: 纯机理模型计算昂贵且常受简化假设限制，纯数据驱动方法需要大量高质量数据且可解释性差，因此需要结合两者优势的混合建模方法。
Method: 将混合建模策略分为并行、串行和并行-串行架构，重点阐述残差建模（补偿缺失物理）、NODEs（连续时间动力学近似）和求解器在环（用神经网络加速传统求解器）三种技术。
Result: 摘要声称混合模型在诊断准确性、疾病进展预测和治疗策略制定方面优于纯机理或纯数据驱动方法，尤其在脑肿瘤、阿尔茨海默病和中风等疾病中。
Conclusion: 混合建模是神经疾病建模的强大工具，尤其在疾病进展和治疗反应建模方面有前景。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Organization: Memory as Execution State Management for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks with interdependent decisions, where each action reshapes future constraints and intermediate errors can cascade. Existing RAG and agent memory systems organize histories by semantic similarity, retrieving content-relevant entries at decision time. We argue that this design mismatches execution-state dependencies: it fragments decision trajectories and mixes valid and erroneous traces, hindering coherent state reconstruction and error isolation. We propose MAGE (Memory as Agent-Guided Exploration), an active execution-state manager that stores interactions in a hierarchical state tree. The agent derives its state from the active root-to-current path, combining subgoal summaries, recent traces, and hints from prior branches. Four coupled operations maintain the tree: Grow records new traces, Compress summarizes completed subgoals, Maintain validates summaries, and Revise restores a target boundary and resumes on a new branch. This design bounds context growth while preserving state integrity and isolating flawed segments from the active path. Experiments on MemoryArena show that MAGE improves the average task success rate by 7.8--20.4 pp over baselines, while reducing token consumption by 55.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM agent在长程任务中因依赖语义相似性的记忆管理而导致的执行状态碎片化和错误级联问题，提出MAGE（Memory as Agent-Guided Exploration），一种主动的执行状态管理器，将交互存储在层次化状态树中，并通过四种操作（Grow、Compress、Maintain、Revise）维护树结构。实验表明，在MemoryArena上，MAGE将平均任务成功率提升7.8-20.4个百分点，同时减少55.1%的token消耗。
Motivation: 现有RAG和agent记忆系统按语义相似性组织历史，这忽略了执行状态依赖，导致决策轨迹碎片化且无法隔离有效与错误轨迹，阻碍状态重建和错误隔离。
Method: 提出MAGE，使用层次化状态树存储交互，agent从根到当前路径推导状态，结合子目标摘要、近期轨迹和先前分支提示。通过Grow（记录新轨迹）、Compress（总结完成子目标）、Maintain（验证摘要）和Revise（恢复目标边界并分支）四种操作维护树，限制上下文增长并保持状态完整性。
Result: 在MemoryArena上，MAGE相比基线将平均任务成功率提升7.8-20.4个百分点，token消耗降低55.1%。
Conclusion: MAGE通过执行状态管理而非语义组织来管理记忆，能有效提升长程agent任务的成功率并降低计算开销。

papers.title: LatentSkill: From In-Context Textual Skills to In-Weight Latent Skills for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent systems increasingly use textual skills to encode reusable task procedures, but injecting these skills into the prompt at every step incurs substantial context overhead and exposes skill content as plaintext. We present LatentSkill, a framework that converts textual skills into plug-and-play LoRA adapters through a pretrained hypernetwork. LatentSkill stores skill knowledge in weight space rather than context space, removing per-step skill tokens while preserving modular loading, scaling, and composition. On ALFWorld and Search-QA, LatentSkill outperforms the corresponding in-context skill baseline while using substantially fewer prefill tokens: it improves ALFWorld success by 21.4 and 13.4 points on the seen and unseen splits with 64.1% fewer prefill tokens, and improves Search-QA exact match by 3.0 points with 72.2% lower skill-token overhead. Further analysis shows that generated skill LoRAs form a structured semantic geometry, can be precisely controlled via the LoRA scaling coefficient, and can be composed through parameter-space arithmetic when skill components are aligned. These findings suggest that weight-space skills provide an efficient, modular, and less exposed substrate for extending LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LatentSkill 框架，将文本技能转换为 LoRA 适配器，将技能知识存储在权重空间而非上下文空间，从而消除每步技能 token。在 ALFWorld 和 Search-QA 上，LatentSkill 相比上下文技能基线提升了性能并显著减少预填充 token 数。
Motivation: 现有 agent 系统将文本技能注入提示词导致上下文开销大且技能内容暴露，亟需一种更高效、模块化且隐蔽的技能存储方式。
Method: 使用预训练超网络（hypernetwork）将文本技能转换为即插即用的 LoRA 适配器，技能知识存储于权重空间，支持模块化加载、缩放和组合。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上，seen/unseen 分裂成功率分别提升 21.4/13.4 点，预填充 token 减少 64.1%；在 Search-QA 上精准匹配提升 3.0 点，技能 token 开销降低 72.2%。
Conclusion: 权重空间技能为扩展 LLM agent 提供了高效、模块化且更隐蔽的载体，生成的 LoRA 具有结构化语义几何，可通过系数精确控制并通过参数空间算术组合。
