papers.title: AttackPathGNN: Cross-function vulnerability detection in smart contracts using state interference graphs and conjunction pooling
papers.abstract_en: Existing learning-based detectors for Solidity smart-contracts reduce vulnerability detection to syntactic pattern matching within single functions, yet many of the most consequential exploits (The DAO, Cream Finance) exist not in any individual function but in the relationship between functions and in the combination of conditions that made the attack feasible. Thus, we propose AttackPathGNN, a graph neural network (GNN) that reframes detection as reasoning over explicit attack paths. Two architectural choices distinguish it from prior GNN-based detectors: (1)a State Interference Graph that links every pair of functions sharing mutable storage through typed, weighted edges and through directed reentrancy-path edges defined by an explicit five-condition predicate; (2)conjunction pooling, a differentiable AND-aggregator over eight named exploit preconditions whose log-sigmoid form causes the per-function exploit score to collapse whenever any single mitigation (a reentrancy guard, an access-control modifier or SafeMath) is in place. Across five independent training runs, AttackPathGNN attains 92.3+/-0.2% F1 on the SmartBugs Wild held-out test partition (4.3+/-0.3% false-negative rate, 90.8+/-2.5% detection rate on the independently human-labelled SmartBugs Curated benchmark), recovering 6/10 DASP10 categories at 100% on every seed and Reentrancy at 98.7+/-1.8%. Each prediction is emitted with a structured remediation report, turning each verdict into an actionable, function-level audit finding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对现有智能合约漏洞检测只关注单函数模式匹配的问题，本文提出AttackPathGNN，一种基于图神经网络的跨函数漏洞检测方法。该方法通过构建状态干扰图捕捉函数间共享存储的依赖关系，并采用合取池化聚合八种漏洞前提条件。在SmartBugs基准上达到92.3% F1分数，假阴性率仅4.3%，且每次预测附带结构化修复报告。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的检测器将漏洞检测简化为单函数内的语法模式匹配，但许多重大漏洞（如The DAO、Cream Finance）存在于函数间关系及条件组合中，因此需要跨函数推理方法。
Method: 提出AttackPathGNN，包含两个核心设计：（1）状态干扰图，通过带类型和权重的边连接共享可变存储的函数对，并基于五条件谓词定义重入路径边；（2）合取池化，一种可微的AND聚合器，对八个命名漏洞前提条件进行逻辑与操作，当任一缓解措施存在时，函数级漏洞得分迅速归零。
Result: 在五个独立训练运行中，AttackPathGNN在SmartBugs Wild测试集上达到92.3±0.2% F1（假阴性率4.3±0.3%），在人工标注的SmartBugs Curated基准上检测率达90.8±2.5%，其中6/10个DASP10类别达到100%召回，重入检测达98.7±1.8%。
Conclusion: 该方法将检测转化为显式攻击路径推理，并输出结构化修复报告，使每个判定成为可操作的函数级审计发现。

papers.title: Framing, Judging, Steering: An Assessable Competency Model for Teach-ing Students to Reason With Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI makes answers easy and understanding hard, and uncritical use invites cognitive offloading. Schools still measure unaided performance, yet the real task is to produce good work with AI: framing an ill-defined task, judging the output, and steering the model toward a better result. This ability is rarely assessed in its own right; where measured, it collapses into one "prompting" score that cannot diagnose why AI use succeeds or fails. We propose CoRe-3 (Co-Reasoning), a competency model factoring productive AI use into three assessable skills we abbreviate FJS: Framing (specifying an ill-defined task before invoking AI), Judging (evaluating output for errors and unstated assumptions), and Steering (iteratively redirecting the model). Its distinguishing claim is the separation of pre-generation Framing from post-generation Steering, with Judging as the gate between. We ground the skills in theory, state five testable propositions, and instantiate them in CoReasoningLab, an open platform that presents flawed AI output and scores them independently. Over simulated learners (generated and graded by different models), the skills dissociate: each tracks its own manipulated competence while staying flat in the others, and grades become correlated when one competence is shared across all three (convergent and discriminant validity), across grader backends from two providers. Human-rater agreement and outcomes are next; we release the instrument, data, and protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoRe-3能力模型（Co-Reasoning），将学生与生成式AI协作推理分解为Framing、Judging、Steering三个可评估技能，并开发了CoReasoningLab平台进行独立评分。通过模拟学习者实验，验证了三个技能可分离且具有区分和汇聚效度。
Motivation: 当前教育评估主要衡量学生无AI辅助的表现，但实际任务需要学生有效使用AI。现有评估常简化为单一的“提示”分数，无法诊断失败原因。
Method: 提出CoRe-3模型，将AI使用能力分解为Framing（在调用AI前明确任务）、Judging（评估输出中的错误和未说明假设）、Steering（迭代引导模型）。构建CoReasoningLab平台，展示有缺陷的AI输出并独立评分。
Result: 模拟学习者实验中，三个技能各自跟踪其对应能力而其他技能保持不变，共享能力时评分相关，验证了区分效度和汇聚效度。结果跨两个不同提供商的后端一致。
Conclusion: 该模型为评估学生使用生成式AI的能力提供了理论框架和可操作工具，但人类评分一致性及实际效果尚待验证。

papers.title: Video-Rate Streaming Stylization on a Vision-Aware MLLM-Conditioned Edit Diffusion: Asymmetric Batched Inference on a Distilled UNet + MLLM Text Encoder
papers.abstract_en: Aggressive distillation of the diffusion U-Net inverts the per-frame bottleneck of real-time text-to-image pipelines: once the denoiser is a 4-step or 1-step distilled student, the text encoder becomes the critical path. This inversion is most acute in vision-aware edit diffusion, where the encoder is a multimodal large language model (MLLM). We study the case of a 0.39B distilled edit U-Net paired with a 2.13B MLLM text encoder (Qwen3-VL) and present a streaming pipeline targeted at this regime built around three engineering mechanisms: asymmetric side-stream / main-stream CUDA pipelining with batched text-encoder amortisation (and optional static-prompt caching), a compile-friendly ControlNet-LLLite reformulation that folds the entire U-Net + adapter stack into a single fused graph, and a periodic conditioning-refresh schedule with a hook subset that amortises the per-frame conditioning cost. On a single consumer RTX 3090 Ti at 512x512 the pipeline sustains 27.4 fps over a 480-frame run at batch size B=8 and 29.6 fps at B=16, with end-to-end p50 latency of approximately 0.5 and 1.0 seconds respectively; the same operating point measures 54.9 fps on RTX 4090 and 74.1 fps on RTX 5090. We report video-rate streaming throughput rather than interactive low latency, and locate our numbers against same-stack StreamDiffusion re-runs as systems context, not as a benchmark superiority claim. For the trained oil-painting style, the released temporal adapter generalises within in-clip noise to 19 unused DAVIS-2017 sequences and 15 non-DAVIS clips from seven sources; prompt-level generalisation to unseen style families is bounded and reported separately.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology. Code, evaluation harness, and the released v3 Temporal LLLite adapter weights are at https://github.com/otanl/dreamlite-stream (also mirrored to Hugging Face and Zenodo)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散蒸馏后文本编码器成为瓶颈的问题，提出一套视频率流式风格化流水线。通过非对称CUDA流水线、编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite重编和周期性条件刷新，在RTX 3090 Ti上达到27.4fps（512x512，B=8），并展示了跨序列泛化。其工程优化方案主要面向视觉感知扩散编辑场景。
Motivation: 扩散蒸馏使得U-Net不再是实时推理瓶颈，而文本编码器（特别是MLLM）成为关键路径。现有流水线无法充分利用消费级显卡进行视频率流式风格化。
Method: 提出三项工程机制：1）非对称侧流/主流CUDA流水线，配合批处理文本编码器摊销和静态提示缓存；2）编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite重编，将U-Net和适配器堆栈融合为单一图；3）周期性条件刷新调度，通过挂接子集摊销每帧条件生成成本。
Result: 在单张RTX 3090 Ti上，512x512分辨率，B=8时达到27.4fps，B=16时29.6fps，端到端p50延迟约0.5和1.0秒；RTX 4090上54.9fps，RTX 5090上74.1fps。在油画画风上，发布的时间适配器在19个未用DAVIS-2017序列和15个非DAVIS片段上泛化。
Conclusion: 本文专注于视频率流式吞吐而非交互式低延迟，其数字作为系统上下文而非基准优越性声明。提示级泛化到未见风格族是受限的，并单独报告。

summary_sections.method: 提出三项工程机制：1）非对称侧流/主流CUDA流水线，配合批处理文本编码器摊销和静态提示缓存；2）编译友好的ControlNet-LLLite重编，将U-Net和适配器堆栈融合为单一图；3）周期性条件刷新调度，通过挂接子集摊销每帧条件生成成本。
summary_sections.result: 在单张RTX 3090 Ti上，512x512分辨率，B=8时达到27.4fps，B=16时29.6fps，端到端p50延迟约0.5和1.0秒；RTX 4090上54.9fps，RTX 5090上74.1fps。在油画画风上，发布的时间适配器在19个未用DAVIS-2017序列和15个非DAVIS片段上泛化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文专注于视频率流式吞吐而非交互式低延迟，其数字作为系统上下文而非基准优越性声明。提示级泛化到未见风格族是受限的，并单独报告。

papers.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the \emph{world modeling interface} to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the \emph{language reasoning} capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA lies an \emph{autoregressive (AR)} Transformer backbone, instead of a bidirectional diffusion Transformer as in WAMs, to predict the \emph{next state}, comprising the \emph{semantic-level} textual intention and complementary \emph{fine-grained} physical dynamics. The physical dynamics are supervised by the world modeling objective based on a dedicated World Expert, and are leveraged to ease the characterization of the state-action correlation for the Action Expert. WLA leverages meta-queries to make the world prediction \emph{implicitly} impact the action generation so that the former can be disabled during inference. The world prediction can also be activated to enable test-time scaling for improved robot control. Our WLA-0 prototype, with 2B active parameters, achieves 40 ms per inference on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. Evaluations across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that WLA-0 achieves state-of-the-art multi-task and long-horizon learning abilities, e.g., 92.94\% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 Clean and 56.5\% success rate on RMBench. WLA-0 also holds the promise to learn novel tasks directly from \emph{cross-embodiment robot videos} without action annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出世界-语言-动作（WLA）模型，一种新的具身基础模型，融合世界建模与语言推理能力。WLA 以文本指令、图像和机器人状态为输入，联合预测文本子任务、子目标图像和机器人动作，核心是自回归 Transformer 主干。提出 WLA-0 原型（2B 激活参数），在模拟和真实环境中实现多任务和长周期任务最优性能，如 RoboTwin2.0 上 92.94% 成功率。
Motivation: 现有具身模型如世界-动作模型（WAM）缺乏语言推理能力，而视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）缺少世界建模，难以处理复杂长周期任务。
Method: WLA 采用自回归 Transformer 主干预测下一状态（包含语义级文本意图和细粒度物理动态），通过世界专家监督物理动态，并利用元查询使世界预测隐式影响动作生成，可在推理时禁用世界预测以加速，或激活以进行测试时缩放。
Result: WLA-0（2B 参数）在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上每推理 40ms，在 RoboTwin2.0 Clean 上成功率达 92.94%，RMBench 上 56.5%，且能从无动作标注的跨具身机器人视频中学习新任务。
Conclusion: WLA 模型统一了世界建模、语言推理和动作合成，在具身智能任务上达到最先进水平，并具备从跨具身视频学习的能力。

papers.title: The Self-Correction Illusion: LLMs Correct Others but Not Themselves
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that LLM agents struggle to correct errors in their own reasoning traces yet show markedly higher correction rates when identical claims appear under external sources. We ask whether this asymmetry reflects a capability deficit or a role-label artifact: does an agent's willingness to correct a wrong claim depend causally on the chat-template role that carries it, rather than on the claim's content? Our setup keeps the erroneous claim byte-identical across all conditions (SHA-256 verified) and varies only its wrapping role: the agent's own \role{<thought>}, a \role{user} message, a \role{tool} response, or a \role{system <memory>} block. Across 13 model-domain cells covering seven model families and three domains ($n{=}30$ paired tasks per cell), relabeling the claim from \role{<thought>} to an external role lifts the explicit-correction rate by 23 to 93 percentage points, with 10 of 13 cells reaching $p{<}0.001$. Further experiments confirm that the effect is asymmetric, mechanistically decomposable, and robust across domains. The failure to self-correct is not a cognitive deficit; it is a chat-template artifact. We exploit this artifact by designing a prompt-structure-only intervention that requires no training and no model modification, with its strongest role label being domain-dependent: \role{<memory>} dominates on math, while a plain \role{user} message dominates on logical deduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型语言模型（LLM）在自我纠正推理错误时表现不佳，但纠正来自外部角色的相同错误时效果显著。通过保持错误声明字节一致（SHA-256验证），仅改变角色标签（如<thought>、user、tool、system<memory>），在13个模型-领域组合中，将错误声明从<thought>重新标记为外部角色可将显式纠正率提升23-93个百分点。研究认为自我纠正失败并非认知缺陷，而是聊天模板的伪影，并设计了仅基于提示结构的干预方案，无需训练或模型修改。
Motivation: 现有研究显示LLM在自我纠正推理错误时困难，但纠正外部来源的相同错误时效果更好。本文探究这种不对称性是否源于角色标签的人为因素，而非能力缺陷。
Method: 保持错误声明字节内容不变（SHA-256校验），仅改变其在聊天模板中的角色标签（<thought>、user、tool、system<memory>），在7个模型家族、3个领域（共13个模型-领域组合）中测试纠正率变化，并设计无需训练的提示结构干预。
Result: 将角色从<thought>改为外部角色后，显式纠正率提升23-93个百分点，其中10/13的组合p<0.001。不对称性可机制性分解且跨领域鲁棒。
Conclusion: LLM自我纠正失败是聊天模板伪影而非认知缺陷；基于提示结构的干预（最强角色标签依赖领域：数学领域<memory>最优，逻辑推理领域user最优）可有效提升纠正率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: T-FunS3D: Task-Driven Hierarchical Open-Vocabulary 3D Functionality Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D functionality segmentation enables robots to localize functional object components in 3D scenes. It is a challenging task that requires spatial understanding and task interpretation. Current open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods primarily focus on object-level recognition, while scene-wide part segmentation methods attempt to segment the entire scene exhaustively, making them highly resource-intensive and time consuming. Balancing segmentation performance in terms of granularity, accuracy, and speed remains a challenge. As one step towards alleviating this, we introduce T-FunS3D, a task-driven hierarchical open-vocabulary 3D functionality segmentation method that provides actionable perception for robotic applications. Our method takes as input the 3D point cloud and posed RGB-D images of an indoor scene. We construct an open-vocabulary scene graph by extracting instances and their visual embeddings in the environment. Given a task description, T-FunS3D identifies the most relevant instances in the scene graph and locates their functional components leveraging a vision-language model. Experiments on the SceneFun3D dataset demonstrate that T-FunS3D is comparable to state-of-the-art in open-vocabulary 3D functionality segmentation, while achieving faster runtime and reduced memory usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 T-FunS3D，一种面向开放词汇的 3D 功能分割方法，能够根据任务描述在 3D 场景中定位功能性物体部件。该方法输入点云和 RGB-D 图像，构建开放词汇场景图，并利用视觉-语言模型识别与任务最相关的实例及其功能部件。在 SceneFun3D 数据集上，T-FunS3D 在分割性能上与当前最佳方法相当，同时运行更快、内存占用更少。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 分割方法主要关注物体级识别，而场景级部件分割方法资源消耗大、耗时长，难以平衡分割的粒度、准确性和速度。
Method: T-FunS3D 输入 3D 点云和带有位姿的 RGB-D 图像，提取实例及其视觉嵌入构建开放词汇场景图；给定任务描述后，通过视觉-语言模型识别场景图中最相关的实例并定位其功能部件。
Result: 在 SceneFun3D 数据集上，T-FunS3D 在开放词汇 3D 功能分割性能上与最先进方法相当，同时运行速度更快、内存使用更少。
Conclusion: T-FunS3D 为机器人应用提供了可操作的感知，在保持分割性能的同时提升了效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM Explainability with Counterfactual Chains and Causal Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Causal graphs provide a high-level language for making mechanisms transparent. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to recover causal graphs of external-world processes. Instead, in this paper, we use causal graphs to model LLM inference itself, providing stakeholders with a transparent view of how the model perceives and organizes high-level concepts to produce a prediction. We propose a four-phase method for constructing such graphs. Given a target LLM and a set of textual examples, our method discovers class-discriminative, human-interpretable concepts and maps each input to LLM-perceived concept states. We then introduce an MCMC-inspired counterfactual augmentation procedure that expands the sparse observational data through chains of counterfactuals. This enables stable causal discovery with $σ$-CG, yielding informative, interpretable graphs. We apply our method to three LLMs across disease diagnosis, sentiment analysis, and LLM-as-a-judge classification tasks. We evaluate the learned graphs for predictive fidelity and structural stability, and the MCMC-inspired augmentation for convergence and downstream utility. Our results show that the discovered causal graphs capture meaningful dependencies consistent with LLMs' reasoning. Together, this paper provides a foundation for concept-level explainability of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种四阶段方法，利用因果图建模大型语言模型（LLM）自身的推理过程，而非外部世界。通过发现类判别概念、映射概念状态、基于MCMC的反事实数据增强以及σ-CG因果发现，生成可解释的概念级因果图。在三个LLM和疾病诊断、情感分析、LLM-as-a-judge任务上的实验表明，所学因果图能捕捉与LLM推理一致的有意义依赖关系，为LLM概念级可解释性提供了基础。
Motivation: 现有工作使用LLM恢复外部世界的因果图，而本文旨在建模LLM内部推理的高层概念组织，为利益相关者提供透明的推理视角。
Method: 四阶段方法：(1) 发现类判别且人类可解释的概念；(2) 将每个输入映射到LLM感知的概念状态；(3) 引入MCMC启发的反事实增强，通过反事实链扩展稀疏观测数据；(4) 使用σ-CG进行稳定因果发现，生成信息丰富的可解释图。
Result: 在三个LLM和三个分类任务上，评估了预测保真度和结构稳定性，表明因果图能捕捉与LLM推理一致的依赖关系，且MCMC增强收敛良好并提升下游效用。
Conclusion: 本文为LLM的概念级可解释性提供了基础框架，通过因果图揭示模型如何组织概念进行预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring the sensitivity of LLM-based structured extraction to prompt, model, and schema choices in clinical discharge summaries
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used for structured extraction from clinical free-text notes, but the sensitivity of their output to upstream configuration choices is less understood than their accuracy on fixed benchmarks. This work measures that sensitivity without human-annotated ground truth, by holding the extraction task fixed and varying one choice at a time. The fixed schema comprises 17 clinical documentation flags on a three-way yes/no/not_documented value set and a 47-tag vocabulary for the primary admission reason. Three prompt variants expressing this schema were each run at two model sizes on MIMIC-IV v3.1 discharge summaries. Cross-prompt agreement was measured by Cohen's kappa on ICD-stratified subsets. A paired same-note comparison isolated the effect of model choice, and a post-hoc collapse of the three-way flags to binary tested the schema's contribution to disagreement. On the three-way flags, the two models reach the same pooled cross-prompt agreement (median kappa 0.69 and 0.68); the larger model raises agreement on some fields and lowers it on others, a redistribution rather than the absence of an effect. Collapsing the schema to binary dissolves most of the cross-prompt disagreement, locating it on the absence-versus-silence distinction rather than on whether the finding is present. On the multi-class admission categorization, changing the model reassigns the dominant tag on close to half of all notes while changing the prompt phrasing reassigns it on roughly one in eight, and the larger model places far less mass on residual catch-all categories (44% to 26%). These patterns indicate a schema-imposed source of disagreement concentrated on the absence-versus-silence axis and a dominance of model over prompt phrasing on multi-class categorization, identified by a reusable methodology for auditing extraction reproducibility on a population-scale deployment.
papers.comment: 69 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测量了大型语言模型在临床出院小结中进行结构化提取时，输出对提示措辞、模型大小和模式定义的敏感性，无需人工标注真值。通过在MIMIC-IV v3.1上固定提取任务并逐一改变配置，发现跨提示一致性中等（kappa 0.68-0.69），将三值标志压缩为二值后大部分分歧消失，表明分歧集中在缺失与沉默的区别上；在多类入院原因分类中，模型改变比提示改变影响更大。方法本身可复用于临床部署中的提取可重复性审计。
Motivation: 现有研究主要评估LLM在固定基准上的准确率，但对其输出对上游配置（提示、模型、模式）的敏感性理解不足，而这在实际临床部署中会影响提取的一致性。
Method: 固定提取任务（17个临床文档标志+47个入院原因标签），设计三种提示变体，分别在两个模型大小上运行MIMIC-IV v3.1出院小结。使用Cohen's kappa衡量跨提示一致性，通过配对相同病历比较模型选择的影响，并通过将三值标志后验压缩为二值来测试模式对分歧的贡献。
Result: 三值标志上两模型跨提示中位数kappa分别为0.69和0.68；大模型某些字段一致性提高而其他降低。压缩为二值后大部分跨提示分歧消失，分歧在于缺失与沉默。多类分类中改变模型导致近一半病历的主导标签改变，改变提示仅影响约八分之一；大模型减少了对残留其余类别的分配（从44%降到26%）。
Conclusion: 模式定义引入的分歧集中在缺失与沉默轴上，多类分类中模型选择的影响大于提示措辞。该分析框架可复用于人群规模部署中的提取可重复性审计。

papers.title: Fast and Robust Convergence Rate for TD(0) with Linear Function Approximation, Universal Learning Steps and I.I.D. Samples
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the finite-time behavior of the TD(0) temporal-difference method with linear function approximation (LFA). We consider on-policy independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples, a constant learning step, and the Polyak-Juditsky averaging method. We establish a new convergence rate, for the Mean-Square Error (MSE) on the approximated function, that is (i) fast in the sense that it admits an optimal dependency in the number of iterations k (i.e., of order 1/k), (ii) robust to ill-conditioning: it only depends on an initial error and modelindependent constants and (iii) sharp up to a multiplicative constant lower than 11. In particular, it does not depend on the smallest eigenvalue of the uncentered covariance matrix of the linear parametrization, unlike all pre-existing O(1/k) rates in the TD(0) literature. We also introduce PCTD(0), a variant of TD(0), which benefits from better convergence properties under an additional assumption of strong mixing on the Markov Chain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 TD(0) 时序差分方法在线性函数逼近下的有限时间行为，基于 on-policy i.i.d. 样本、常数学习步和 Polyak-Juditsky 平均，证明了逼近函数均方误差的新收敛率：最优 O(1/k) 阶、对病态条件鲁棒（不依赖未中心协方差矩阵的最小特征值）、乘性常数小于 11。此外，还引入 PCTD(0) 变体，在马尔可夫链强混合假设下具有更好的收敛性质。
Motivation: 现有 TD(0) 的 O(1/k) 收敛率依赖线性参数化未中心协方差矩阵的最小特征值，导致对病态条件敏感，需要更鲁棒的收敛性分析。
Method: 采用 on-policy i.i.d. 样本、常数学习步和 Polyak-Juditsky 平均方法，分析 TD(0) 的均方误差；并引入 PCTD(0) 变体，在强混合假设下改进收敛。
Result: 建立新的 MSE 收敛率：O(1/k) 阶，不依赖于最小特征值，且乘性常数小于 11。
Conclusion: 所提收敛率快速且鲁棒，PCTD(0) 在强混合假设下进一步提升收敛性能。

papers.title: Causal Scaffolding for Physical Reasoning: A Benchmark for Causally-Informed Physical World Understanding in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and reasoning about the physical world is the foundation of intelligent behavior, yet state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) still fail at causal physical reasoning, often producing plausible but incorrect answers. To address this gap, we introduce CausalPhys, a benchmark of over 3,000 carefully curated video- and image-based questions spanning four domains: Perception, Anticipation, Intervention, and Goal Orientation. Each question is paired with an expert-annotated causal graph capturing object-attribute-event dependencies, enabling interpretable and fine-grained evaluation of causal understanding. Building on this, we formulate a causal-graph-grounded metric that quantitatively measures how well a model's chain-of-thought reasoning aligns with the correct causal relations, moving beyond answer-only accuracy and enabling systematic diagnosis of VLMs' causal reasoning failures. Using this metric, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of leading VLMs, revealing systematic gaps in capturing causal dependencies and underscoring the need for causality-aware learning. To address these limitations, we further propose Causal Rationale-informed Fine-Tuning (CRFT), which explicitly aligns VLM reasoning with causal structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CRFT substantially enhances both reasoning accuracy and interpretability across multiple model backbones. By unifying dataset curation, causal evaluation, and causality-informed learning, CausalPhys establishes a strong foundation for advancing modern VLMs toward causally grounded physical reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted by KDD 2026 Dataset and Benchmark Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CausalPhys基准，包含3000多个精心策划的视频和图像问题，覆盖感知、预期、干预和目标导向四个领域，每个问题附带专家标注的因果图，用于评估视觉语言模型(VLMs)的因果物理推理能力。还提出因果图驱动的度量标准和因果理由微调(CRFT)方法，实验表明CRFT能提升推理准确性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在因果物理推理任务中常产出看似合理但错误的答案，缺乏对因果关系的系统性理解。
Method: 构建CausalPhys基准，包含专家标注因果图的问题；提出基于因果图的度量标准量化模型推理与正确因果关系的对齐程度；提出因果理由微调(CRFT)，显式对齐VLM推理与因果结构。
Result: 对领先VLMs的综合分析揭示了其在捕捉因果依赖关系上的系统性不足；CRFT在多个模型骨干上显著提升了推理准确性和可解释性。
Conclusion: CausalPhys通过统一数据集、因果评估和因果感知学习，为现代VLMs迈向因果基础物理推理奠定基础。

papers.title: Steering Vectors are an Adversarial Attack Surface
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering has become a popular way to control Large Language Model (LLM) behavior without fine-tuning. Since the technique is plug-and-play, users share datasets and precomputed vectors to steer model activations. However, we show that a \emph{stealth data poisoning attack} silently compromises this pipeline. By substituting $4{-}6\%$ of tokens in the steering dataset, an attacker can silently align the resulting vector with an anti-refusal direction. This jailbreaks the target model while preserving the intended steering effect on benign prompts. Under this threat model, a malicious actor can distribute an apparently safe bundle containing texts, vectors, and weights, alongside an equivalence certificate that the end-user can verify. We test the attack on two open-weight model families and eight model-attribute combinations, observing that poisoned vectors reach an absolute attack success rate (ASR) of $20{-}55\%$, $+19\%$ to $+51\%$ over a clean reference. Finally, we find that a refusal-direction orthogonalization defense can recover ${\approx}82\%$ of the ASR gap without harming benign behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示激活转向（activation steering）管道中的一个隐蔽数据投毒攻击：攻击者通过替换转向数据集中4-6%的token，使计算出的转向向量与反拒绝方向对齐，从而在保持良性提示效果的同时实现模型越狱。在两种开源模型家族和八种模型-属性组合上，中毒向量使绝对攻击成功率（ASR）达到20-55%，比干净参考提升19-51%。作者还提出一种拒绝方向正交化防御方法，可恢复约82%的ASR差距而不损害良性行为。
Motivation: 激活转向作为一种无需微调即可控制大语言模型行为的即插即用技术日益流行，用户共享数据集和预计算向量。但本文指出该管道存在安全漏洞：恶意攻击者可植入中毒向量，通过隐蔽数据投毒实现模型越狱。
Method: 提出隐蔽数据投毒攻击：在转向数据集中随机替换4-6%的token，使生成的转向向量与反拒绝方向对齐，从而在无毒输入上保持预期转向效果，却在拒绝相关输入上导致模型顺从。
Result: 在Llama-2和Mistral等模型上，中毒向量实现20-55%的绝对ASR，相比干净参考提升19-51个百分点；使用拒绝方向正交化防御可恢复约82%的ASR差距，且不损害良性行为。
Conclusion: 激活转向管道面临数据投毒攻击风险，但通过正交化防御可有效缓解。该工作强调了共享转向组件前需要验证其安全性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dead Directions: Geometric Singular Learning
papers.abstract_en: Singular learning theory and information geometry have studied the same parameter spaces in mostly separate vocabularies: the former computes Bayesian invariants in resolved coordinates, the latter works in original coordinates under a non-degeneracy assumption that overparameterised models routinely violate. We bridge them through one primitive, the dead direction: a unit vector along which the Fisher metric degenerates, equivalently a tangent to the analytic singular set with a definite KL order, set by how fast the KL divergence vanishes. The two readings name the same vector; our central move shows its KL order is recoverable as the decay rate of the directional Fisher curvature approaching the singularity, in original parameter coordinates and without a Hironaka resolution. A selection rule on smooth fibres translates this rate into Watanabe's single-direction contribution to the real log canonical threshold, and we extend the recovery to multi-component crossings, multiplicity $m$, the singular fluctuation $ν$ (universal in the KL order for 1D directions), prior-RLCT shifts, and tempered posteriors. We then lift this rate to a deep network: a multi-layer K-FAC factorisation writes each Fisher block as a product of activation- and gradient-side rates with a duality between them, instantiated at modern-network primitives (residual streams, layer normalisation, attention). A quotient theorem carries the rate to the gauge quotient $Θ/G$ under gradient flow on a $G$-invariant metric; SGD qualifies, standard Adam does not, and we construct a $G$-equivariant Adam-family preconditioner (DDCAdam) that does. The bridge yields a parameter-coordinate handle on singular geometry, closed-form per-architecture predictions, and a trajectory-rate readout of Watanabe's triple $(λ, m, ν)$ from one checkpoint's forward and backward passes, without posterior sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在奇异学习理论与信息几何之间建立桥梁，通过一种基本概念“死亡方向”（dead direction）统一了两者。死亡方向是费希尔度量退化的单位向量，其KL阶（KL order）可在原始参数坐标下由方向费希尔曲率（directional Fisher curvature）的衰减率恢复，无需Hironaka分解。该速率可转化为Watanabe的真实对数规范阈值（RLCT）的单方向贡献，并扩展到多分量交叉、重数、奇异涨落等。进一步，该速率可提升至深度网络：通过多层K-FAC分解将每个费希尔块表示为激活侧和梯度侧速率的乘积，并适用于残差流、层归一化、注意力等现代网络原语。在G不变度量下的梯度流中，该速率可传递到规范商空间，SGD适用而标准Adam不适用，本文构造了G等变Adam族预处理器（DDCAdam）。该工作提供了参数坐标下的奇异几何处理方法、每种架构的闭式预测，以及从单个检查点的前向和反向传播中读出Watanabe三元组(λ,m,ν)的轨迹速率方法，无需后验采样。
Motivation: 奇异学习理论与信息几何研究相同的参数空间但使用不同词汇：前者在分解坐标下计算贝叶斯不变量，后者在原始坐标下工作并假设非退化性，而过参数化模型经常违反该假设。本文旨在通过死亡方向这一原始概念桥接两者，使得可以在原始参数坐标下处理奇异几何。
Method: 提出死亡方向的概念及其KL阶的恢复方法：在原始参数坐标下，通过方向费希尔曲率在奇异点附近的衰减率获得KL阶，无需Hironaka分解。然后通过平滑纤维上的选择规则转换该率为Watanabe单方向对真实对数规范阈值的贡献，并扩展到多重分量、重数m、奇异涨落ν等。对于深度网络，使用多层K-FAC分解将每个费希尔块分解为激活侧和梯度侧速率的乘积，并应用于残差流、层归一化、注意力等结构。最后通过商定理将速率传递到规范商空间，并构造G等变Adam族预处理器（DDCAdam）。
Result: 摘要声称该方法恢复了Watanabe的单方向RLCT贡献，并扩展到多分量交叉、重数m、奇异涨落ν（在1D方向上是KL阶的普遍量）、先验-RLCT偏移以及温度后验。在深度网络中，通过K-FAC分解将速率与激活和梯度侧速率联系起来，并证明了SGD合格而标准Adam不合格，但所提出的DDCAdam合格。从单个检查点的前向和反向传播中可读出Watanabe三元组(λ,m,ν)，无需后验采样。
Conclusion: 本文构建了一个参数坐标下的奇异几何处理框架，提供了每种架构的闭式预测，以及从训练轨迹中直接读出Watanabe奇异不变量（λ,m,ν）的方法，避免了后验采样。该方法有望加深对深度网络泛化行为的理解。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要声称该方法恢复了Watanabe的单方向RLCT贡献，并扩展到多分量交叉、重数m、奇异涨落ν（在1D方向上是KL阶的普遍量）、先验-RLCT偏移以及温度后验。在深度网络中，通过K-FAC分解将速率与激活和梯度侧速率联系起来，并证明了SGD合格而标准Adam不合格，但所提出的DDCAdam合格。从单个检查点的前向和反向传播中可读出Watanabe三元组(λ,m,ν)，无需后验采样。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文构建了一个参数坐标下的奇异几何处理框架，提供了每种架构的闭式预测，以及从训练轨迹中直接读出Watanabe奇异不变量（λ,m,ν）的方法，避免了后验采样。该方法有望加深对深度网络泛化行为的理解。

papers.title: Bidirectional Search for Longest Paths: Case for Front-to-Front Heuristics
papers.abstract_en: Bidirectional heuristic search can potentially reduce search effort for problems amenable to backward search. Therein, it is well-known that front-to-front heuristics can reduce the number of node expansions, but their overhead is so high that overall runtime almost always increases. We propose BiXDFBnB, a bidirectional depth-first branch-and-bound algorithm that adapts the Single-Frontier Bidirectional Search (SFBDS) framework - originally developed for shortest-path (MIN) problems - to the Generalized Longest Simple Path (GLSP) setting. Because SFBDS inherently operates on paired states, front-to-front (F2F) heuristic evaluation arises naturally and avoids the overhead typically associated with bidirectional frontier management. We show that this adaptation can be successfully applied to maximization (MAX) problems while efficiently handling overlapping constraints. BiXDFBnB is applied to several types of longest-path problems: Longest Simple Path (LSP), Snakes, and Coil-in-the-Box (CIB). Empirical evaluation shows that the new algorithm frequently reduces the number of node expansions and, in some cases, also improves overall runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BiXDFBnB，一种基于SFBDS框架的双向深度优先分支限界算法，用于解决最长简单路径问题（GLSP）。该算法自然利用前向-前向（F2F）启发式评估，避免了传统双向搜索的开销。实验表明在LSP、Snakes、Coil-in-the-Box问题上减少了节点扩展，有时也提升了运行时间。
Motivation: 双向启发式搜索中，前向-前向启发式虽能减少节点扩展，但开销大导致运行时间增加。本文试图将SFBDS框架从最短路径拓展到最长路径问题，以利用F2F启发式的优势。
Method: 提出了BiXDFBnB算法，适应了SFBDS框架到最大化问题，通过配对状态自然产生F2F启发式评估，并处理重叠约束。
Result: 在LSP、Snakes、Coil-in-the-Box问题上，BiXDFBnB经常减少节点扩展，部分情况下也改善了整体运行时间。
Conclusion: 证明了将SFBDS框架适配到最长路径问题是可行的，并能有效利用F2F启发式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning of Robot Safety Policies via Adversarial Synthetic Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose an agentic gamification framework for hazard-informed learning of robot safety policies through synthetic scenarios. We model scenario generation as an adversarial game between two agents: a Red Team that explores the space of potential failures by constructing hazardous situations, and a Blue Team that incrementally refines safety policies to prevent them. This iterative process enables efficient discovery of high-risk edge cases that are unlikely to be captured through random simulation or manual enumeration. By combining classical risk modeling with adversarial scenario generation and modern learning paradigms, this work provides a scalable pathway for embedding safety into Physical AI systems operating in complex real-world environments. The paper describes ongoing work. The contribution is a problem formulation and a proposed solution architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个对抗性游戏框架，通过红队（Red Team）和蓝队（Blue Team）的对抗过程，自动生成合成危险场景以学习机器人安全策略。该框架结合经典风险建模与对抗式场景生成，旨在高效发现高风险的边缘情况，为物理AI系统在复杂真实环境中嵌入安全性提供可扩展路径。论文当前为进行中工作，主要贡献是问题形式化和架构设计。
Motivation: 现有机器人安全策略学习往往依赖随机仿真或手动枚举，难以覆盖高风险的边缘情况。
Method: 将场景生成建模为两个智能体之间的对抗游戏：红队探索潜在故障空间并构造危险场景，蓝队逐步改进安全策略以规避这些场景。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅描述框架设计及预期优势。
Conclusion: 论文目前是进行中工作，主要贡献在于问题形式化和解决方案架构。

papers.title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided image editing has advanced rapidly with diffusion models and unified multimodal foundation models. However, most existing methods remain confined to single-turn settings, overlooking the more realistic scenario of multi-turn in-context editing, where users iteratively refine an image through a sequence of instructions. In this setting, a model must follow each new instruction while preserving accumulated session-level constraints, challenged by two coupled failure modes: long-context dilution, where sparse textual constraints become difficult to recover from growing interleaved image-text histories, and state contamination, where earlier editing mistakes degrade subsequent generations. We introduce Edit-R2, a novel reinforcement learning post-training framework for unified multimodal models. Edit-R2 reconstructs the operative session intent, which effectively consolidates scattered historical constraints into an explicit reasoning trace before each editing turn. It further enables multi-turn RL over both reasoning and generation through a unified objective that jointly optimizes intent reconstruction generation in discrete text space and flow-matching image generation in continuous latent space, while a trajectory filtering mechanism suppresses corrupted rollouts to stabilize training under state contamination. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce MICE-Bench, a large-scale benchmark for multi-turn in-context editing with automated metrics for instruction following (IF), content consistency (CC), and global awareness (GA) over accumulated session constraints. Experiments show that Edit-R2 substantially improves multi-turn in-context editing and achieves competitive performance compared against strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多轮上下文图像编辑中的长上下文稀释和状态污染问题，提出Edit-R2强化学习后训练框架。方法通过重构会话意图来整合历史约束，并对推理和生成进行联合多轮RL优化，同时使用轨迹过滤稳定训练。实验在MICE-Bench上表明Edit-R2显著提升了多轮图像编辑性能。
Motivation: 现有方法局限于单轮编辑，忽略了多轮场景中长上下文稀释和状态污染问题，导致模型难以跟随序列指令并保持累积约束。
Method: Edit-R2框架基于统一多模态模型，重构会话意图（将分散历史约束转化为显式推理轨迹），通过统一目标联合优化离散文本空间的意图重构生成和连续潜空间的流匹配图像生成，并采用轨迹过滤机制抑制受损轨迹以稳定训练。
Result: 摘要报告Edit-R2在多轮上下文编辑任务上显著提升，并在MICE-Bench上相比强基线具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过重构会话意图和多轮RL可以解决多轮图像编辑中的上下文稀释和状态污染问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faithful, Enriched, and Precise: Benchmarking Natural-Science Illustration Generation by T2I models
papers.abstract_en: Scientific illustrations are essential tools for communicating research findings, especially in natural science, where they visualize complex concepts and processes. As Text-to-Image (T2I) models become increasingly capable, researchers have started to use them for scientific illustration generation. However, existing benchmarks often assess outputs at a holistic level, overlooking fine-grained elements, while scientific reasoning ability and output conciseness remain under-quantified. We introduce FEPBench, a benchmark built from carefully selected high-quality scientific illustrations across multiple disciplines and layout types. With the assistance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and human experts, we provide fine-grained atom set annotations and systematically evaluate T2I models along three dimensions: instruction faithfulness, reasoning enrichment, and semantic precision. Our evaluation further decomposes model performance across visual, textual, relation, and layout elements. Results show that even state-of-the-art (SOTA) closed-source models, such as GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro, still suffer from text-rendering bottlenecks, limited reasoning enrichment, and difficulty balancing generation richness with precision. These findings provide practical guidance for improving and deploying T2I models in scientific illustration generation. Benchmark data, atom set annotations, and evaluation code will be released by us.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 FEPBench，一个用于评估文本到图像（T2I）模型在自然科学插图生成中性能的基准。该基准包含多学科高质量插图的细粒度原子集标注，从指令忠实性、推理丰富性和语义精确性三个维度进行评估。实验发现，即使是最先进的闭源模型（如 GPT Image 2 和 Nano Banana Pro）仍在文本渲染、推理丰富性以及生成丰富性与精确性平衡方面存在瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有的 T2I 模型评估基准多在整体层面衡量输出，忽视了细粒度元素，且科学推理能力和输出简洁性尚未被量化。
Method: 基于精选的多学科高质量科学插图，借助多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和人类专家提供细粒度原子集标注，构建 FEPBench 基准。评估沿指令忠实性、推理丰富性和语义精确性三个维度进行，并进一步分解为视觉、文本、关系和布局元素。
Result: 即使是最先进的闭源模型（如 GPT Image 2 和 Nano Banana Pro）仍存在文本渲染瓶颈、推理丰富性有限以及难以平衡生成丰富性与精确性的问题。
Conclusion: 这些发现为改进和部署 T2I 模型于科学插图生成提供了实用指导，基准数据、标注和评估代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Short paper: Models in the dark -- Rectification and erasure under GDPR in ML supply chains
papers.abstract_en: The rights to rectification and erasure, as established under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), are central to protecting individuals' privacy. However, their effective enforcement in machine learning (ML) systems remains challenging. Existing work has largely addressed these rights from either a legal or a technical perspective in isolation and disregards the fact that models are produced in complex supply chains involving multiple actors across development, distribution, and deployment. This paper presents a holistic survey of challenges in implementing the rights to rectification and erasure in ML models. Drawing on academic literature and guidance from data protection authorities, we find that many GDPR requirements cannot yet be technically met in practice. Our findings further suggest that issues arising in ML supply chains are insufficiently addressed in research. To tackle this gap, we introduce the notion of models in the dark -- derived models created further downstream in an ML chain without sufficient transparency or traceability -- and analyse the urgent challenges posed by this phenomenon. By adopting an interdisciplinary perspective, this work contributes to bridging the gap between legal requirements and the technical implementation of data subject rights in ML, ultimately supporting the development of trustworthy artificial intelligence.
papers.comment: accepted for presentation at Annual Privacy Forum 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统调研了GDPR下机器学习模型中纠正权和删除权的实施挑战，指出许多法律要求目前技术上无法满足，并发现ML供应链中的问题（如下游衍生模型缺乏透明度和可追溯性）研究不足。作者引入“暗模型”（models in the dark）概念，强调跨学科视角弥合法律与技术差距的必要性。
Motivation: GDPR赋予个人数据纠正和删除权，但ML系统中难以有效执行；现有研究孤立分析法律或技术方面，忽视了ML供应链中多参与方的复杂性。
Method: 对学术文献和数据保护机构指南进行系统性调研，从跨学科视角分析法律要求与技术实施之间的差距。
Result: 发现许多GDPR要求在实践中尚无法技术实现，尤其是ML供应链中衍生模型的不透明性和不可追溯性问题未被充分研究。
Conclusion: 需要跨学科方法综合法律与技术，以支持可信人工智能的发展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EML-CD: Causal Mechanism Recovery via EML Symbolic Trees in Structure Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural network (NN)-based nonlinear causal discovery methods recover DAG structure but leave each causal mechanism as a black box. Waxman et al. argued that extracting causal mechanisms from NN weights is ill-posed. We propose EML-CD, a framework that integrates the EML operator (capable of composing elementary functions from a single binary operator) into causal structure learning, with interpretable mechanism recovery as the primary objective. EML-CD represents each edge mechanism as a gated EML binary tree and automatically discovers closed-form causal equations. Analytical Jacobians can be directly computed from the output equations, enabling quantitative understanding of causal effects. On real data (Sachs protein signaling, d=11), EML-CD achieves SHD=11.2 +/- 0.4 (5-seed mean; baselines are single deterministic runs), on par with PC/GES within seed variance and below CAM, while attaching closed-form equations to each detected edge (precision 0.756, recall 0.365). In a controlled bivariate test with known mechanisms, EML-CD recovers 10 of 11 elementary function families faithfully (held-out shape correlation >= 0.96; only high-frequency sine is partial). On a symbolic synthetic benchmark, EML-CD attains a substantially lower and more stable held-out mechanism f-MSE than a fixed SINDy dictionary (mean 3.67 vs. 7644, the latter inflated by catastrophic extrapolation on one seed), although its structure recovery (SHD 14.0) only matches the dictionary and stays below specialized optimizers; on the Causal Chambers light-tunnel subset, a depth-2 model improves F1 over linear OLS-BIC (0.444 vs. 0.273).

papers.title: A Pre-Registered Causal Partition of Self-Consistency Elicitation and Reward Design in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning even when the reward signal is spurious -- assigning credit to the group-plurality answer rather than a ground-truth verifier. Practitioners commonly interpret naive = acc(TRUE) - acc(RANDOM) as the reward-design effect. We prove this estimand is systematically biased: it conflates self-consistency elicitation (sharpening the policy toward its modal answer via majority pseudo-reward) with genuine reward-design signal. Using a controlled tabular-GRPO simulator we derive an exact telescoping decomposition total = null + elicit + rd and measure each term across five prior-strength levels. The reward-design fraction of the naive estimator ranges from 0.139 at weak prior (ps=0.20) to 0.05 at strong prior (ps=0.80), with the elicitation term flipping sign at the self-consistency crossover. A pre-registered 2x2x2 factorial confirms non-additivity (interaction ratio 0.385; AxC effect -0.089). A points-vs-bounds pilot gate shows strong-prior regimes are point-identified while near-crossover regimes are only bounded. Re-audits of two named published results yield ELICITATION DOMINATED (elicitation share 0.98) and REWARD DESIGN DOMINATED (rd share 1.18) verdicts respectively, demonstrating the diagnostic value of the partition. We pre-commit to submit regardless of flip outcome; a non-flip is a finding of equal standing. We release a reusable one-command harness for any alignment paper to run the same audit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习从可验证奖励（RLVR）中自洽性引发（self-consistency elicitation）与奖励设计（reward design）的混杂问题，提出一种预注册的因果分解方法。通过一个受控的表格GRPO模拟器，作者将朴素估计量分解为null、elicit和rd三项，并测量各分量在不同先验强度下的比例。预注册的2x2x2析因实验证实了非可加性。对两个已发表结果的重新审计分别判定为“自洽性主导”和“奖励设计主导”。
Motivation: 现有RLVR实践中，常用朴素估计量naive = acc(TRUE) - acc(RANDOM)作为奖励设计效应，但该估计量存在系统性偏差，混淆了自洽性引发与真正的奖励设计信号。需要一种精确分解方法来分离这两种效应。
Method: 通过一个受控的表格GRPO模拟器，推导出精确的 telescoping 分解 total = null + elicit + rd，并测量各分量在五个先验强度水平下的取值。随后进行预注册的2x2x2析因实验验证非可加性，并设计 points-vs-bounds pilot gate 来识别参数区域的可识别性。
Result: 在弱先验（ps=0.20）下，奖励设计分量占朴素估计量的0.139；在强先验（ps=0.80）下降至0.05。自洽性引发项在交叉点处符号翻转。析因实验显示非可加性（交互比0.385；AxC效应-0.089）。对两个已发表结果的审计分别得到自洽性引发占0.98和奖励设计占1.18的裁决。
Conclusion: 所提出的分解方法具有诊断价值，能够区分RLVR中自洽性引发与奖励设计的相对贡献。作者承诺无论结果是否翻转均提交，并发布可复现的命令行工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Be Multimodal or Not to Be: Query-Adaptive Audio-Visual Person Retrieval via Active Modality Detection
papers.abstract_en: When retrieving a person from a video archive by voice and face, should the system be multimodal or not? In real-world broadcast archives, unlike curated benchmarks, a target may be heard but unseen, seen but unheard, or both. Fusing scores from an absent modality injects noise, degrading precision below the best unimodal system. We propose a query-adaptive framework that detects active modalities via cross-modal score consistency: when both modalities are active, files retrieved by one also score highly on the other; this agreement breaks down when a modality is absent. Classifiers driven by these cross-modal features achieve 89% detection accuracy. On the BBC Rewind corpus (with over 12,000 broadcast videos) the adaptive system attains 94.2% P@1, outperforming speaker-only (82.9%), face-only (93.4%), and fixed fusion (90.0%), recovering 64% of the gap to an oracle with ground-truth modality labels (96.6%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文针对实际广播档案中目标可能只有声音、只有画面或两者兼备的情况，提出一种查询自适应框架，通过跨模态分数一致性检测活跃模态，并在缺失模态时避免融合噪声。在BBC Rewind语料库上，自适应系统达到94.2% P@1，优于单模态和固定融合方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态检索系统在目标模态缺失时融合分数会引入噪声，降低精度，而实际广播档案中经常出现模态缺失情况。
Method: 提出基于跨模态分数一致性的活跃模态检测方法：当两个模态都活跃时，一个模态检索的高分文件在另一模态也得分高；当模态缺失时，这种一致性会破坏。训练分类器利用这些跨模态特征达到89%检测准确率。
Result: 在BBC Rewind语料库（超过12,000个广播视频）上，自适应系统达到94.2% P@1，优于仅说话人（82.9%）、仅人脸（93.4%）和固定融合（90.0%），恢复了与全知模态标签（96.6%）之间64%的差距。
Conclusion: 作者强调所提查询自适应框架能有效处理模态缺失问题，并在大规模真实广播档案中取得显著提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Addressing Imbalance in Multi-Label Data via Label-Specific Distance-based Oversampling
papers.abstract_en: The complex imbalanced label distribution poses a crucial challenge to multi-label classification, as most classifiers are biased towards the majority class and high-frequent labels. Oversampling is an efficient and flexible solution that augments instances to provide a more balanced training dataset for multi-label classifiers. Most existing oversampling methods create synthetic instances in a heuristic way that essentially relies on neighborhood information retrieved using Euclidean distance within the entire feature space. However, they fail to consider the varying semantic relevance of features to different labels, leading to label inconsistency among proximate neighbors and further introducing label confusion and overfitting to synthetic instances. To overcome the above issue, we propose a novel sampling approach called Label-Specific Distance-based Multi-Label Oversampling (LSDMLO) that creates more useful and well-labeled synthetic instances to address the imbalance in multi-label datasets. LSDMLO derives the label-specific distance to identify label-consistent neighbors based on the weighted pertinent feature space, which facilitates selecting seed instances that express more label correlations in boundary areas and generating synthetic instances aligned with the label distribution of original data. The comprehensive experiments verify that the proposed LSDMLO outperforms the state-of-the-art multi-label sampling approaches under various base classifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多标签数据中标签分布不平衡问题，提出了一种基于标签特异性距离的过采样方法LSDMLO。该方法通过加权相关特征空间定义标签特异性距离，以识别标签一致的近邻，从而生成更符合原始数据标签分布的合成样本。实验表明，该方法在多种基分类器下优于现有多标签过采样方法。
Motivation: 现有过采样方法在全局特征空间中使用欧氏距离，忽略了特征对不同标签的语义相关性不同，导致近邻标签不一致，引入标签混淆和过拟合。
Method: 提出标签特异性距离（label-specific distance），基于加权相关特征空间识别标签一致的近邻，选择边界区域中表达更多标签关联的种子样本，生成与原始数据标签分布对齐的合成实例。
Result: 综合实验表明，该方法在多种基分类器下优于最先进的多标签过采样方法。
Conclusion: LSDMLO通过标签特异性距离解决了多标签过采样中标签不一致的问题，但未提及对极端不平衡或大规模数据集的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards World Models in Biomedical Research
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of biomedicine is to understand, predict and ultimately control the dynamic mechanisms by which biological systems respond to perturbations, disease progression and therapeutic intervention. Although foundation models and large language models have accelerated biomedical data interpretation, most current systems remain focused on static pattern recognition rather than prospective simulation of biological futures. Here we propose biomedical world models as a paradigm for AI-driven discovery. These models learn latent representations of molecular, cellular, tissue and clinical states, together with intervention-conditioned dynamics that allow future trajectories to be simulated before actions are taken. We discuss how biomedical world models could function as data engines, environment simulators and scientific planning substrates across applications including virtual cells, organoids, virtual patients and surgical simulation. We outline the data infrastructure, evaluation benchmarks, safety constraints and governance frameworks required. Biomedical world models may provide a foundation for simulation-guided, closed-loop and experimentally actionable biomedical discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生物医学世界模型（biomedical world models）作为AI驱动发现的新范式，旨在学习分子、细胞、组织和临床状态的潜在表示以及干预条件动力学，从而在行动前模拟未来轨迹。讨论了其在虚拟细胞、类器官、虚拟患者和手术模拟中的应用，并概述了所需的数据基础设施、评估基准、安全约束和治理框架。
Motivation: 当前大多数生物医学AI系统专注于静态模式识别，缺乏对生物系统未来状态的预测性模拟能力，限制了对扰动、疾病进展和治疗干预的动态机制理解与控制。
Method: 提出生物医学世界模型，学习分子、细胞、组织、临床状态的潜在表示，并结合干预条件动力学，实现未来轨迹的模拟。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的定量结果，主要讨论概念框架和应用前景。
Conclusion: 生物医学世界模型可能为模拟引导、闭环和可操作的生物医学发现提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Better Literary Translation: A Multi-Aspect Data Generation and LLM Training Approach
papers.abstract_en: Literary translation poses unique challenges due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data and the need to balance expression fluency with literary effect. We present a multi-aspect iterative refinement framework that generates high-quality translation references and preference data through specialized LLM translators, each targeting a distinct quality dimension. We leverage the generated data for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Experiments show that our generated references outperform the original ground truth for SFT by 8.65 CEA100 points. For reinforcement learning, we find that DPO leads to performance degradation in this setting, while leveraging an explicit reward model for GRPO yields an additional 1.51 point improvement. We attribute this to the stability of two-stage training and GRPO's online exploration capability. Our resulting models, LitMT-8B and LitMT-14B, achieve 67.25 and 69.07 CEA100 respectively on the MetaphorTrans English-to-Chinese literary translation benchmark, competitive with Claude Sonnet 4.5 at 68.43, and demonstrate strong generalization to out-of-domain literary work (i.e., O. Henry).

papers.title: Retrospective Harness Optimization: Improving LLM Agents via Self-Preference over Trajectory Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: AI agents rely on a harness of skills, tools, and workflows to solve complex problems. Continually improving this harness is essential for adapting to new tasks. However, existing optimization methods typically require ground-truth validation sets, yet such labeled data is difficult to acquire in practical deployment settings. To address this problem, we introduce Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO), a self-supervised method that optimizes the agent harness using only past trajectories. Specifically, RHO selects a diverse coreset of challenging tasks from past trajectories and re-solves them in parallel. The agent analyzes these rollouts using self-validation and self-consistency, then generates candidate harness updates and selects the most effective one by its own pairwise self-preference. We evaluate RHO across three diverse domains, spanning software engineering, technical work, and knowledge work. Notably, a single optimization round improves the pass rate on SWE-Bench Pro from 59% to 78% without any external grading. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that RHO effectively targets prior failure modes. As a result, the optimized harness alters the agent's behavior patterns and sustains higher accuracy during long-horizon sessions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO)，一种利用历史轨迹自监督优化 AI agent 技能、工具和工作流的框架。方法通过从过去轨迹中选取多样化的困难任务子集并重新求解，利用自验证和自一致性分析生成候选更新，并通过成对自偏好选择最佳更新。在三个领域（软件工程、技术工作和知识工作）上评估，在 SWE-Bench Pro 上将通过率从 59% 提升至 78%，无需外部标注。
Motivation: 现有 AI agent 的优化方法通常需要真实标注的验证集，但在实际部署中获取此类标注数据困难。本文旨在无需外部标注的情况下，仅利用历史轨迹优化 agent 的 harness（技能、工具和工作流组合）。
Method: 提出 RHO，包含三步：1) 从历史轨迹中选取多样化的困难任务核心集（coreset）；2) 并行重新求解这些任务，并通过自验证和自一致性分析 rollout；3) 生成候选 harness 更新，并通过 agent 自身的成对自偏好（pairwise self-preference）选择最有效的更新。
Result: 在 SWE-Bench Pro 上，单轮优化将 pass rate 从 59% 提升至 78%，无需外部评分。在软件工程、技术工作和知识工作三个领域均有效。分析显示 RHO 针对历史失败模式进行优化，优化后的 harness 改变了 agent 的行为模式并维持了长会话的准确性。
Conclusion: RHO 是一种无需外部标注的 self-supervised 方法，能有效利用历史轨迹优化 agent harness，提升复杂任务处理能力。局限性：论文未明确说明扩展性（如轨迹数量增大时的计算成本）或对特定领域依赖程度。

papers.title: Finding Most Influential Sets
papers.abstract_en: Identifying most influential sets (MIS) - size-$k$ subsets whose removal maximally changes a target estimand - is typically infeasible because it requires searching over $\binom{n}{k}$ subsets. For estimands with linear-fractional leave-set-out effects, we show that MIS selection reduces to a one-parameter sequence of top-$k$ problems. Dinkelbach's method yields an algorithm with $\mathcal{O}(n)$ cost per iteration and finite termination. For fixed residualized inputs, the algorithm returns a globally optimal set for the univariate ratio objective, including the oracle-residualized partial linear model. With estimated nuisance functions, uniform denominator and generated-score stability imply approximation to the first-order oracle orthogonal-score objective; exact set recovery follows under a separation condition. Simulations and applications show that the method recovers exact MIS that were previously computationally inaccessible.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何高效找出对目标估计量影响最大的大小为k的子集。对于具有线性分式留出集效应的估计量，证明该问题可化为一参数序列的top-k问题，并利用Dinkelbach方法提出O(n)每轮迭代且有限终止的算法。对于固定残差输入，算法返回单变量比率目标的全局最优集；对于估计的干扰函数，在均匀分母和生成得分稳定性条件下近似一阶正交得分目标，并在分离条件下实现精确集恢复。模拟和应用表明该方法能恢复先前计算上不可及的精确MIS。
Motivation: 识别最影响集（MIS）通常需要对所有大小为k的子集进行穷举搜索，计算上不可行。本文旨在为具有线性分式留出集效应的估计量提供高效算法。
Method: 利用Dinkelbach方法将MIS问题转化为一参数序列的top-k问题，提出每轮迭代O(n)成本且有限终止的算法。考虑固定残差输入和估计干扰函数两种情形，分别给出全局最优性和近似保证。
Result: 模拟和应用表明该方法能恢复精确的MIS，而这些集在以往是无法通过计算获得的。
Conclusion: 本文为线性分式效应下的MIS问题提供了计算上高效且具有理论保证的算法，拓展了可处理的问题范围。

papers.title: MemoryCard: Topic-Aware Multi-Modal Clue Compression for Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Long-video question answering remains challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), as answer-relevant evidence is often sparse, transient, and temporally dispersed across lengthy video contexts. Existing frame-centric approaches improve efficiency through uniform sampling, query-aware frame selection, visual-token compression, and adaptive resolution strategies. However, they still rely on isolated and fragmented frames as the fundamental evidence units, limiting VLMs' ability to effectively capture coherent event-level semantics. To address this limitation, we propose MemoryCard, a video-memory-based augmentation framework that organizes long videos into self-contained Memory Cards. Specifically, MemoryCard first performs a self-reading process over videos and aligned utterances to segment the video into semantically coherent units, each corresponding to a distinct topic or event. For each unit, it generates an event-level video gist and selects representative visual moments, which are then rendered into unified Memory Cards for retrieval and question answering. Experimental results demonstrate that MemoryCard consistently improves long-video QA performance under comparable visual-token budgets, achieving up to a 21.8% relative improvement in accuracy. All code is available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MemoryCard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemoryCard，一种基于视频记忆的增强框架，通过自阅读过程将长视频分割为语义连贯的Memory Cards，每个卡片对应一个主题或事件，生成事件级视频摘要和代表性视觉时刻，并渲染成统一格式用于检索和问答。实验表明，在可比视觉标记预算下，该方法在长视频问答上准确率相对提升最高达21.8%。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖孤立、碎片化的帧作为证据单元，限制了大模型捕获连贯事件级语义的能力，难以处理长视频中稀疏、短暂且时间分散的答案相关证据。
Method: MemoryCard框架：先对视频和对齐文本进行自阅读，将视频分割为语义连贯的单位（每个对应一个主题或事件）；对每个单位生成事件级视频摘要并选择代表性视觉时刻；最后将这些内容渲染为统一的Memory Cards，用于检索和问答。
Result: 在可比视觉标记预算下，长视频问答准确率相对提升最高达21.8%。代码已开源。
Conclusion: MemoryCard通过将长视频组织为自包含的记忆单元，有效增强了VLMs捕获事件级语义的能力，提升了长视频问答性能。

papers.title: Unveiling the Unknown: Open Vocabulary Object Detection with Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection seeks to identify novel object categories that were not part of the training data. Many knowledge distillation-based approaches have shown promising performance by transferring knowledge from pre-trained vision-language models to object detection. However, these methods often overlook structured, image-specific relationships between objects, such as interactions and spatial arrangements. This oversight can significantly restrict the effectiveness of detecting novel categories. To address this issue, we propose a Scene-guided Relational Modeling detection framework. This framework utilizes scene graphs to capture structured semantic and spatial relationships between candidate regions and their contextual objects. It explicitly models interactions among neighboring regions and incorporates a Relation Attention Module to implicitly amplify the key relational cues extracted from the scene graph. Furthermore, we present a scene-based textual alignment branch that distills category knowledge from captions to guide relational alignment. This approach facilitates a seamless integration of visual relations with semantic information for enhanced detection performance. Comprehensive experiments show that our model achieves superior performance compared to other OVOD methods, improving the AP for novel categories on COCO and LVIS datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中忽视对象间结构化关系的问题，提出场景引导关系建模框架（Scene-guided Relational Modeling）。该框架利用场景图捕获候选区域间的语义和空间关系，显式建模相邻区域交互，并通过关系注意力模块隐式强化关键关系线索；同时引入基于场景的文本对齐分支，从描述中蒸馏类别知识以指导关系对齐。在COCO和LVIS数据集上，新颖类别的平均精度（AP）优于现有开放词汇检测方法。
Motivation: 现有基于知识蒸馏的开放词汇检测方法忽略对象间结构化的、图像特定的关系（如交互和空间排列），限制了新颖类别检测效果。
Method: 提出Scene-guided Relational Modeling检测框架，使用场景图建模结构化语义和空间关系，包含显式交互建模的Relation Attention Module，以及从描述中蒸馏类别知识的场景文本对齐分支。
Result: 在COCO和LVIS数据集上，新颖类别的AP优于其他开放词汇检测方法。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架有效整合视觉关系与语义信息，提升了开放词汇检测性能。

papers.title: CamFlow+: Hybrid Motion Bases for 2D Camera Motion Estimation with Stabilization Applications
papers.abstract_en: Estimating 2D camera motion is fundamental to computer vision and computational photography. Existing homography-based methods work well for planar scenes or pure rotation, but struggle with camera translation, depth variation, and local parallax; local homography and mesh-based models improve flexibility but still rely on piecewise planar assumptions. We introduce CamFlow+, a hybrid-basis framework that represents 2D camera motion directly in dense-flow space. CamFlow+ combines homography-derived physical bases, stochastic bases sampled from homography flows, and depth-translational bases derived from depth and camera intrinsics, relaxing the single-plane constraint while preserving camera-motion regularity. A depth-aware smoothness term further regularizes translation-induced parallax in continuous-depth regions while preserving motion changes near depth boundaries. We evaluate CamFlow+ on GHOF-Cam, a camera-motion benchmark that masks out dynamic objects and ill-posed occlusion regions in an optical-flow benchmark to isolate camera-induced motion. Experiments show that CamFlow+ improves sparse and dense camera-motion estimation. In digital video stabilization, CamFlow+ also improves global and local stability, achieving the best top-1 preference rate in a blind user study. Code and datasets will be available on the project page: https://lhaippp.github.io/CamFlow+.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CamFlow+，一个基于混合基的框架，用于在密集光流空间中直接表示2D相机运动。该方法结合了单应性导出的物理基、从单应性流中采样的随机基以及基于深度和相机内参的深度平移基，从而放宽了单平面约束同时保持相机运动规律。通过深度感知平滑项进一步正则化连续深度区域中平移引起的视差，同时保留深度边界附近的运动变化。实验表明，CamFlow+在稀疏和密集相机运动估计上均有提升，并在数字视频稳定化任务中取得最佳用户偏好率。
Motivation: 现有基于单应性的方法在相机平移、深度变化和局部视差时表现不佳；局部单应性和网格模型虽提升灵活性但仍依赖分段平面假设。需要一种更通用的表示来直接估计2D相机运动。
Method: CamFlow+采用混合基框架，将2D相机运动表示为密集光流空间中的线性组合，包含三种基：单应性导出的物理基、从单应性流中采样的随机基、以及从深度和相机内参导出的深度平移基。同时引入深度感知平滑项以处理平移视差。
Result: 在GHOF-Cam基准上，CamFlow+改进了稀疏和密集相机运动估计。在数字视频稳定化应用中，CamFlow+提升了全局和局部稳定性，并在盲法用户研究中获得最佳top-1偏好率。
Conclusion: CamFlow+通过混合基表示有效解决了非平面场景下的2D相机运动估计问题，并成功应用于视频稳定化。代码和数据集将开源。

papers.title: Self-Learning Expression Deformations for Data-Efficient Gaussian Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Modeling dynamic facial expressions using 3D Gaussian representations remains challenging due to their unstructured nature. Conventional Gaussian avatar pipelines require extensive multiview and sequential expression data, limiting scalability and accessibility. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive Gaussian Expression (SAGE), a framework for self-learning expression-induced Gaussian deformations that enables high-fidelity, animatable avatars from minimal input data. Our method jointly optimizes 2D Gaussian surfels and a Signed Distance Field (SDF) to enforce compact, surface-aligned Gaussian distributions, while a self-supervised expression learning phase replaces long training sequences with geometric and appearance consistency constraints. This design allows flexible deployment across multiple reconstruction regimes: in the multiview setting, only a single frame (timestep) is required instead of thousands; in the monocular setting, only head rotations are needed without expression sequences; and in the one-shot setting, no pretraining or priors are necessary. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves reconstruction and animation quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while reducing data requirements by several orders of magnitude. Our results highlight the potential of self-supervised Gaussian deformation learning as a step toward accessible, data-efficient avatar creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自自适应高斯表情（SAGE）框架，通过自监督学习表情驱动的形变，从极少量输入数据（如单帧多视图、仅头部旋转的单目、无需预训练的单次拍摄）生成高保真、可动画化的3D高斯头像。该方法联合优化2D高斯面元和有符号距离场，实现紧凑的表面对齐高斯分布，并利用几何和外观一致性约束替代长训练序列。实验表明，其重建和动画质量可比肩现有方法，同时将数据需求降低数个数量级。
Motivation: 现有基于3D高斯表示的头像方法依赖大量多视图和序列表情数据，限制了可扩展性和易用性。
Method: 提出SAGE框架，联合优化2D高斯面元与有符号距离场（SDF）以强制紧凑的表面对齐分布，并通过自监督表情学习阶段，利用几何和外观一致性约束替代长训练序列。
Result: 在多视图设置中仅需单帧（时间步）而非数千帧，在单目设置中仅需头部旋转而无表情序列，在单次拍摄设置中无需预训练或先验。重建和动画质量与最先进方法相当，数据需求降低数个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自监督高斯形变学习有望成为数据高效头像创建的有效途径。

papers.title: DBHN-Net: Dual-Branch Hybrid Neural Network For Low-Complexity Monaural Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Although artificial neural network (ANN) based speech enhancement (SE) methods demonstrate excellent performance, the high computational complexity and high energy consumption hinder their deployment in practical front-end processing tasks.} Currently, the spiking neural networks (SNNs) have shown potential in reducing power consumption. However, the discrete binary activation and complex spatio-temporal dynamics of SNNs often result in information loss. The current challenge therefore focuses on how to maintain performance and reduce computational complexity. To address this issue, this work propose a Dual-Branch Hybrid Neural (DBHN) Network. 1) In terms of network architecture: A dual-branch network integrating ANN and SNN was designed, where the SNN branch reduces power consumption while the ANN branch addresses information loss; The BandSplit and Time-Frequency (TF) -Mamba modules were developed to simultaneously compress energy consumption and enhance model performance; Spiking Feature Extraction Group (SFEG) and Information Transformation Block (ITB) components were implemented with residual connections to mitigate information loss while further refining feature representations. 2) To facilitate inter-branch information fusion: An Interaction module was designed to promote information exchange at various stages of the dual-branch network; A TF-Cross Attention-Fusion module was designed to perform time-frequency domain fusion of dual-branch information while data-adaptively guiding the SNN branch to retain more critical information. Results show that the proposed model maintains superior performance across three public datasets while achieving an average 7.5 fold reduction in computational complexity compared to baseline models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于ANN的语音增强方法计算复杂度和能耗高的问题，本文提出了一种双分支混合神经网络（DBHN），融合ANN和SNN：SNN分支降低功耗，ANN分支弥补信息损失；同时设计了BandSplit、TF-Mamba、SFEG、ITB等模块以及跨分支交互与融合机制。在三个公开数据集上，该方法在保持优异性能的同时，计算复杂度平均降低7.5倍。
Motivation: 基于ANN的语音增强方法性能好但计算复杂度和能耗高，而SNN虽功耗低但存在信息损失，需要一种兼顾性能与低复杂度的方法。
Method: 提出DBHN网络：双分支结构（ANN+SNN），SNN分支降低功耗，ANN分支补偿信息损失；包含BandSplit和TF-Mamba模块压缩能耗并提升性能，SFEG和ITB组件通过残差连接减少信息丢失；设计Interaction模块和TF-Cross Attention-Fusion模块促进双分支信息融合，并自适应引导SNN保留关键信息。
Result: 在三个公共语音增强数据集上，DBHN在保持SOTA性能的同时，计算复杂度相比基线模型平均降低7.5倍。
Conclusion: DBHN通过ANN-SNN双分支混合架构及多尺度融合模块，在语音增强任务上实现了性能与计算复杂度的良好平衡，有助于实际前端部署。

papers.title: Knowledge Manifold: A Riemannian Geometric Framework for Semantic Mapping and Geodesic Analysis of Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: We present the knowledge manifold: a Riemannian geometric space in which a corpus of documents is arranged according to semantic positional relationships derived from character n-gram TF-IDF representations. The framework proceeds in five tightly coupled stages. First, each document is converted to a character-level n-gram TF-IDF vector (4-7 grams, up to 250,000 features, L2-normalized) and embedded in a two-dimensional knowledge map via constrained stress minimization with repulsion, variance, and centering regularizers. Second, knowledge at an arbitrary query point is estimated through Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) interpolation using a cubic-spline kernel, yielding an interpolated TF-IDF feature vector that can be linguistically characterized. Third, directional knowledge gradients at 0, 45, and 90 degrees are computed from the SPH interpolation map, and pairwise directional similarity is quantified via inner product and cosine similarity. Fourth, a Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) model, with a Constant x RBF + White kernel fitted on a 10-dimensional SVD projection, provides a Bayesian posterior mean, uncertainty estimate, and per-document contribution rate at the query point. Fifth, geodesics in the knowledge space are obtained by minimizing a discrete Riemannian path energy derived from the SPH-induced metric tensor, using L-BFGS-B with seven deterministic initial-path candidates. We apply the formulation to a corpus of 20 papers in fiber-reinforced composite materials and aerospace structural mechanics, showing that the semantic map recovers meaningful research clusters, geodesic paths reveal natural conceptual bridges between distant topics, and SPH/GPR interpolation enables the generation of virtual knowledge: hypothetical paper abstracts describing unstudied but geometrically predicted research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识流形（knowledge manifold）框架，将文献语料库嵌入黎曼几何空间，通过字符n-gram TF-IDF向量和约束应力最小化构建二维语义地图，结合平滑粒子流体动力学插值、高斯过程回归和离散黎曼路径能量最小化实现语义映射、知识梯度分析和测地线计算。在纤维增强复合材料和航空航天结构力学领域的20篇论文上验证，语义地图恢复有意义的研究聚类，测地线揭示概念桥梁，SPH/GPR插值可生成假设性虚拟知识。
Motivation: 现有文献分析方法难以捕捉语义位置关系和连续知识变化，缺乏几何化的语义映射框架来支持知识插值、方向梯度分析和测地线路径发现。
Method: 五阶段框架：1）字符n-gram TF-IDF向量（4-7元，最多25万特征，L2归一化）通过带排斥、方差和居中的约束应力最小化嵌入二维地图；2）用平滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）三次样条核在任意查询点插值TF-IDF向量；3）计算0/45/90度方向知识梯度，用内积和余弦相似度量化方向相似性；4）在10维SVD投影上拟合Constant×RBF+White核的高斯过程回归，得到后验均值、不确定性和每文档贡献率；5）用L-BFGS-B最小化基于SPH度量张量的离散黎曼路径能量（7条确定性初始路径）获取测地线。
Result: 在20篇论文语料上，语义地图恢复有意义的聚类，测地线连接远距离主题并揭示概念桥梁，SPH/GPR插值可生成描述未研究但几何预测的研究方向的虚拟论文摘要。
Conclusion: 知识流形框架为科学文献的语义映射和测地线分析提供几何化方法，能生成虚拟知识并揭示概念结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reducing Hallucinations in Complex Question Answering using Simple Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (long version)
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have fundamentally transformed the landscape of Natural Language Processing. Despite these advances, LLMs and LLM-based systems remain prone to a variety of failure modes. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as a common deployment scenario seeking to both avoid the well known risk of the LLM "hallucinating" information, and to enable reasoning and question answering over proprietary information that the LLM did not have access to during training without resorting to expensive model fine-tuning. In this work, we explore the idea of using a lightweight graph structure with a relatively simple graph schema, to support the RAG subsystem via a dedicated toolset. We design an agentic system with a variety of vector search and graph query tools operating over a structured dataset based on a curated subset of English Wikipedia articles, and evaluate its performance on questions from MoNaCo, a challenging Wikipedia QA benchmark of complex query answering tasks. Our results show that the introduction of graph-based tools can significantly increase the precision and recall of factual correctness, can halve the number of hallucinated answers, and achieves the highest fine-grained truthfulness score among the three evaluated scenarios. All this with a modest increase in token usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于简单图结构的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，通过专用工具集支持RAG子系统，减少大语言模型在复杂问答中的幻觉。系统结合向量搜索和图查询工具，在MoNaCo基准上测试，结果显示图工具能显著提高事实正确性的精确率和召回率，将幻觉答案数量减半，并以适度token开销获得最高细粒度真实性分数。
Motivation: 大语言模型容易产生幻觉，RAG系统虽能缓解但仍有不足，需要更有效的结构来支持事实性检索。
Method: 设计一个智能代理系统，包含多种向量搜索和图查询工具，基于英文维基百科子集的结构化数据集，使用轻量级图结构和简单图模式。
Result: 在MoNaCo基准上，图工具的引入显著提高事实正确性的精确率和召回率，将幻觉答案数量减半，并获得最高细粒度真实性分数，且token使用量仅适度增加。
Conclusion: 基于图的RAG方法能有效减少幻觉，提升复杂问答的准确性，且开销可控。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model
papers.abstract_en: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit predictions for test errors and representation alignment. Our analysis shows that the impact of pre-training on LoRA is summarized by an effective noise term, from which we derive prescriptions for the optimal pre-training procedure. We also demonstrate a regime with a mismatch between the value of the test error and representation quality, and propose an application of our theory to active fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对注意力模型中的低秩适应（LoRA）建立高维统计理论。作者提出一个可解框架，其中单头注意力层先在大数据任务预训练，再通过秩一LoRA在有限数据微调。在高维极限下，两阶段均可通过序参数渐近刻画，给出测试误差与表示对齐的解析预测。理论揭示预训练对LoRA的影响等价于一个有效噪声项，并据此推导最优预训练策略。
Motivation: 现有LoRA理论缺乏对预训练与微调相互作用的精确统计刻画，尤其是在高维注意力模型中的行为尚不明晰。
Method: 引入可解框架：单头注意力层先预训练再微调，微调采用秩一LoRA更新。在高维极限下，通过有限序参数集合对两阶段进行渐近分析，得到测试误差和表示对齐的显式表达式。
Result: 理论表明预训练对LoRA的影响可归结为一个有效噪声项，由此给出最优预训练方案的解析条件；并发现测试误差与表示质量之间可能存在不匹配的区域。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为理解LoRA在注意力模型中的行为提供了精确解析工具，并可用于指导主动微调等应用。

papers.title: Resonant Minds: Closed-Loop Social Avatars with Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Creating lifelike digital humans with genuine social intelligence requires unifying cognitive reasoning and multimodal generation within a coherent framework. Current approaches treat these as separate tasks: Large Language Models excel at dialogue but lack embodied expression, while diffusion-based talking head models achieve visual fidelity but ignore social cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a closed-loop dual-agent framework integrating perception, social reasoning, and expression into a continuous interaction cycle. The perception module analyzes partners' multimodal behaviors from video, while the social reasoning module infers hidden mental states through Theory of Mind and selects responses via an ensemble mechanism. The expression module then generates emotion-controllable dual-agent videos synthesizing both speaker speech and expression alongside listener reactive behaviors, capturing bidirectional dynamics absent in prior work. We construct a hierarchical Persona-Scenario dataset with psychologically grounded personas and private social goals to support evaluation under information asymmetry. Experiments on this dataset demonstrate competitive or superior performance on both dialogue quality and video generation metrics. Notably, our method surpasses even the full-information Script mode on key dialogue quality dimensions, suggesting that explicit mental state inference under uncertainty can elicit more thoughtful dialogue than unrestricted information access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个闭环双智能体框架，将感知、社会推理（通过心智理论）和表情生成统一起来，用于创建具有社会智能的数字化身。该方法在构建的层次化Persona-Scenario数据集上展示了竞争性或优越的对话质量和视频生成性能，并表明在不确定性下进行显式心智状态推断可以比完全信息访问产生更周到的对话。
Motivation: 当前方法将认知推理和多模态生成视为独立任务，缺乏统一框架来创建具有真正社会智能的数字化身。
Method: 提出闭环双智能体框架，包括感知模块（分析视频中的多模态行为）、社会推理模块（通过心智理论推断隐藏心理状态并使用集成机制选择响应）和表情生成模块（生成情绪可控的双智能体视频，捕获双向动态）。
Result: 在层次化Persona-Scenario数据集上，该方法在对话质量和视频生成指标上表现竞争性或优越性，在关键对话质量维度上甚至超过了完全信息的Script模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在不确定性下进行显式心智状态推断可以产生更周到的对话，表明该方法对于创建具有社会智能的数字化身的有效性。

papers.title: Representing Research Attention as Contextually Structured Flows
papers.abstract_en: Research attention is widely used as an indicator of visibility, influence, and societal uptake, yet it is typically represented as aggregated counts that do not preserve how attention develops across contexts over time. This creates a mismatch between how attention is interpreted and how it is represented. We propose attention flows as contextually structured representations that encode the organisation of attention and its evolution over time. We evaluate whether these representations capture transferable structure by constructing a benchmark based on analogy-style reasoning across research outputs. Comparing signal, sequence, and flow-based representations, we find that flow representations more effectively support structural comparison, particularly in settings where attention is shaped by temporal progression or context distributions. We further show that learned flow representations improve robustness under partial observation and structural perturbation. Overall, these results support modelling attention as a contextually structured phenomenon and provide a basis for more informative approaches to research evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at STi 2026 - International Conference on Science and Technology Indicators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将研究注意力表示为上下文结构化的流（attention flows），以捕捉注意力在不同上下文中的发展演化，并构建类比推理基准评估不同表示方法。实验表明，基于流的表示比信号或序列表示更有效地支持结构比较，尤其在注意力受时间进程或上下文分布影响时，且学习到的流表示在部分观测和结构扰动下更鲁棒。
Motivation: 传统研究注意力表示为聚合计数，丢失了注意力随上下文和时间演化的结构信息，导致解释与表示不匹配。
Method: 提出注意力流表示，编码注意力的组织结构和时间演化；构建基于类比推理的基准，对比信号、序列和流三种表示。
Result: 流表示在结构比较任务上优于信号和序列表示，尤其在时间进程或上下文分布影响显著时；学习到的流表示对部分观测和结构扰动具有更好的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 研究支持将注意力建模为上下文结构化现象，为更信息丰富的研究评估提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Staying with the Uncertainty: Uncertainty-Scaffolding Strategies for Artificial Moral Advisors in LLM-to-LLM Simulated Conversations
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly deployed as Artificial Moral Advisors (AMA) in a variety of contexts: what kind of conversational patterns should they display? In this paper, we study how AMA can help their interlocutors "stay with the uncertainty". We propose three modes of uncertainty (Perspective-Multiplying, Tension-Preserving, Process-Reflecting) and compare them against three control conditions (Baseline, Persuasive, Sycophantic). A user-agent LLM engages in a dialogue on an ethical dilemma with an AMA following a specific uncertainty strategy, and completes pre- and post-conversation questionnaires. We further examine the effect of two persona prompt formats (Declarative and Narrative). We found that (1) no single model dominates as a simulated user agent, with open models aligning with human ambiguity through between-persona divergence and closed models through within-persona hedging; (2) declarative personas better capture initial stance diversity while narrative personas show more realistic belief revision; (3) all six AMA strategies produce distinguishable conversational patterns; and (4) uncertainty strategies differ not in how much stance revision they produce, but in the quality of engagement they sustain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型作为人工道德顾问（AMA）时，如何通过不确定性支撑策略帮助对话者“停留在不确定性中”。提出了三种不确定性模式（视角倍增、张力保持、过程反思），并与三种控制条件（基线、说服、谄媚）比较。在用户代理与AMA的道德困境对话中，通过前后问卷评估效果。结果发现：没有单一模型主导模拟用户代理；声明式角色能更好捕捉初始立场多样性，叙事式角色表现出更现实信念修正；所有六种策略产生可区分的对话模式；不确定性策略在立场修正量上无差异，但在参与质量上不同。
Motivation: 现有AMA在对话中常追求确定性或说服，但可能抑制用户的反思和不确定性容忍。论文探索如何让AMA帮助用户“与不确定性共处”，设计不同的不确定性策略并评估其效果。
Method: 构建LLM到LLM的模拟对话框架：用户代理与AMA就道德困境对话，AMA采用三种不确定性策略或三种控制条件。使用两种角色提示格式（声明式与叙事式）。通过前后问卷测量立场变化和参与质量。
Result: 摘要报告：（1）没有单一模型主导作为模拟用户代理，开源模型通过角色间分歧模拟人类模糊性，闭源模型通过角色内对冲；（2）声明式角色更好捕捉初始立场多样性，叙事式角色表现更现实信念修正；（3）所有六种AMA策略产生可区分的对话模式；（4）不确定性策略在立场修正量上无差异，但在参与质量上不同。
Conclusion: 论文强调不确定性策略的价值不在于改变立场多少，而在于维持更丰富、更具反思性的对话参与。未来工作可探索真实人类交互。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Retry Policy Gradients in Continuous Action Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Retry-based objectives such as pass@K and max@K optimize the best return obtained from multiple sampled trajectories, and recent work has shown that they can promote exploration without explicit exploration bonuses. In discrete action spaces, ReMax was shown to do so by adapting to return uncertainty. In this work, we introduce pathwise derivative estimators for retry objectives and use them to extend ReMax to continuous action spaces. We study the resulting learning dynamics and show that, even with deterministic rewards, ReMax can encourage stochastic exploration by reshaping the policy-gradient landscape. In particular, it alters gradients both in direction, biasing updates toward higher policy entropy, and in magnitude, damping gradients and slowing convergence. We further show that Adam's adaptive normalization can mitigate this damping, depending on its numerical stabilization parameter. Empirically, we instantiate this objective as ReMax Actor-Critic (ReMAC), an off-policy actor--critic algorithm that optimizes the ReMax objective using a pathwise derivative estimator. Our experiments show that ReMAC can promote higher policy entropy without entropy regularization and achieves performance comparable to SAC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续动作空间中的重试目标（pass@K/max@K）提出路径导数估计器，将ReMax方法扩展到连续动作空间，并实例化为ReMAC算法。研究表明，即使奖励是确定性的，ReMax也能通过重塑策略梯度景观促进随机探索，但会减缓收敛；Adam的自适应归一化可缓解该问题。实验显示ReMAC无需熵正则化即可实现与SAC相当的性能。
Motivation: 离散动作空间中的ReMax已能通过重试目标促进探索，但连续动作空间中缺乏相应方法。
Method: 引入路径导数估计器优化重试目标，扩展ReMax至连续动作空间，提出ReMAC（ReMax Actor-Critic）离策略演员-评论家算法。
Result: ReMAC无需熵正则化即可实现高策略熵，性能与SAC相当；但重试梯度会阻尼梯度并减慢收敛，Adam的数值稳定参数可缓解此问题。
Conclusion: 重试策略梯度可作为连续动作空间中促进探索的通用方法，但需注意其收敛特性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Denser Credit Is Not Enough: Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents require reinforcement learning methods that can assign credit to intermediate decisions under sparse and delayed rewards. Recent group-based methods such as GiGPO improve over GRPO by constructing step-level advantages at repeated anchor states. However, we show that such dense credit can be statistically unreliable: under limited rollouts, rare but lucky actions may receive overly large advantages, producing divergent anchor bias and late-stage training oscillation. We propose Evidence-Calibrated Policy Optimization (ECPO), a critic-free policy optimization algorithm that calibrates step-level credit before policy updates. ECPO combines Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage, which groups rollouts by canonical actions and shrinks low-count estimates, with Variance-Gated Credit Weighting, which suppresses anchor states dominated by within-action noise. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B show that ECPO consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving GiGPO by +5.2/+7.3 success points on ALFWorld/WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B while adding only 0.1% additional advantage-computation overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长周期LLM agent训练中稀疏延迟奖励下的信用分配问题，提出基于证据校准的策略优化（ECPO），通过校准步骤级信用避免密集信用的统计不可靠性。在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明，ECPO在Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B上分别比GiGPO提升+5.2/+7.3个成功率点，且额外计算开销仅0.1%。
Motivation: 现有基于组的方法（如GiGPO）通过构建步骤级优势实现密集信用分配，但在有限rollout下，稀有但幸运的动作可能获得过大优势，导致锚定偏差和训练振荡。
Method: 提出ECPO，包含两个组件：Evidence-Calibrated Action Advantage（按规范动作分组rollout并收缩低计数估计）和Variance-Gated Credit Weighting（抑制受动作内噪声主导的锚定状态）。
Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，ECPO在Qwen2.5-1.5B上分别比GiGPO提升+5.2和+7.3个成功率点，且额外优势计算开销仅0.1%。
Conclusion: ECPO通过校准步骤级信用，在不引入critic的情况下有效缓解了密集信用分配中的统计不可靠性问题。
Relevance: 0
