papers.title: Two-Way Is Better Than One: Bidirectional Alignment with Cycle Consistency for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) seeks models that acquire new skills without erasing prior knowledge. In exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL), this challenge is amplified because past data cannot be stored, making representation drift for old classes particularly harmful. Prototype-based EFCIL is attractive for its efficiency, yet prototypes drift as the embedding space evolves; therefore, projection-based drift compensation has become a popular remedy. We show, however, that existing one-directional projections introduce systematic bias: they either retroactively distort the current feature geometry or align past classes only locally, leaving cycle inconsistencies that accumulate across tasks. We introduce BiCyc, a bidirectional projector alignment approach with a cycle-consistency objective. BiCyc jointly optimizes two maps, old-to-new and new-to-old, with stop-gradient gating so that transport and representation co-evolve. Analytically, we show that the cycle loss contracts the singular spectrum toward unity in whitened space, and that improved transport of class means and covariances yields smaller perturbations of classification log-odds, preserving old-class decisions and mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Empirically, across standard EFCIL benchmarks, BiCyc substantially reduces forgetting and improves accuracy in from-scratch settings, while remaining competitive in the pretrained fine-grained regime.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. 23 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/HXuSz11/BiCyc_ICLR2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无样本类增量学习（EFCIL）中表征漂移的问题，提出双向投影对齐方法 BiCyc，通过循环一致性目标联合优化新旧映射，缓解原型漂移和灾难性遗忘。理论分析证明循环损失能够压缩白化空间的奇异谱，实验表明在标准 EFCIL 基准上显著降低遗忘并提升准确率。
Motivation: 现有单向投影法在补偿原型漂移时引入系统性偏差，要么扭曲当前特征几何，要么仅局部对齐旧类，导致跨任务积累循环不一致性。
Method: BiCyc 采用双向投影对齐，同时优化 old-to-new 和 new-to-old 两个映射，并加入 stop-gradient 门控使传输和表征共同演化，循环一致性目标用于约束奇异谱。
Result: 在标准 EFCIL 基准上，BiCyc 大幅减少遗忘，在从头训练设置中提升准确率，在预训练细粒度保持竞争性。
Conclusion: 双向投影与循环一致性可有效缓解 EFCIL 中的灾难性遗忘，理论分析揭示了循环损失的作用机制。

papers.title: Do More Agents Help? Controlled and Protocol-Aligned Evaluation of LLM Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Does adding more agents help an LLM workflow once compared systems share the same benchmark loader, tool access, answer contract, usage accounting, and trajectory logging? We introduce BenchAgent, an evaluation framework that places single-agent, fixed multi-agent (MAS), and evolving MAS workflows under one normalized execution and logging protocol. BenchAgent evaluates these substrate-internal workflows across ten reasoning, coding, and tool-use benchmarks with GPT-4.1, and separately reports a Protocol-Aligned External (PAE) GAIA study of a runtime-generated workflow. Under SI conditions, at most one of six tested MAS exceeds the matched single-agent anchor on benchmark-balanced average accuracy: EvoAgent lies within the Wilson one-run guidance, while the remaining five trail by 2.56-11.29 points and occupy more expensive accuracy-cost trade-offs. On the PAE GAIA snapshot, a Claude-Code-style runtime workflow reaches 66.72% overall and 69.23% on Level 3, more than 20 points above the strongest non-Claude baseline, Jarvis, a fixed MAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BenchAgent，一个用于评估 LLM agent 工作流（单 agent、固定 MAS、演化 MAS）的标准化框架。在 GPT-4.1 上的十个推理、编码和工具使用基准测试中，大多数 MAS 方案在准确率上并不优于单 agent 基线，且在更昂贵的精度-成本权衡下表现更差。仅在外部 GAIA 评估中，一个运行时生成的 Claude-Code 风格的 agent 工作流取得了显著高于基线的成绩。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 工作流评估缺乏统一的执行和日志协议，难以公平比较不同智能体架构（单 agent vs 多 agent）的实际效果。
Method: 提出了 BenchAgent 框架，将单 agent、固定多 agent (MAS) 和演化 MAS 工作流置于相同的基准加载、工具访问、答案合约、使用计费和轨迹日志协议下进行标准化评估。
Result: 在标准化条件下，六个 MAS 方案中最多一个（EvoAgent）与单 agent 基线持平，其余五个平均准确率落后 2.56-11.29 个点且成本更高；在外部 GAIA 评估中，运行时生成的 Claude-Code 风格工作流达到 66.72% 总体准确率（Level 3 为 69.23%），超过最强非 Claude 基线 20 个点以上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在没有严格协议对齐的情况下，多 agent 工作流并不一定优于单 agent，且需要更细致的成本-精度分析。

papers.title: V2V-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Video-to-Video Generation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Video-to-video (V2V) generation is difficult to evaluate because outputs must both follow editing instructions and preserve frame-level correspondence with the source video, which existing T2V and I2V metrics do not capture. We introduce V2V-Bench, a 11-dimension benchmark organized into five categories: temporal alignment, structural fidelity, transformation quality, video quality, and semantic alignment. V2V-Bench pairs diverse source videos with challenging editing tasks and evaluates two commercial models, Grok Imagine and Gemini Veo3, and one open-source model, Open Sora 2. Results show complementary model strengths: Grok performs better on editing fidelity, while Veo3 achieves stronger visual quality. On six V2V-specific dimensions, V2V-Bench reaches a Spearman correlation of 0.905 with human judgments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出V2V-Bench，一个包含11个维度、5个类别的视频到视频生成评估基准，涵盖时间对齐、结构保真度、变换质量、视频质量和语义对齐。评估了Grok Imagine、Gemini Veo3和Open Sora 2三个模型，发现Grok在编辑保真度上更优，Veo3视觉质量更强。在6个V2V特定维度上，V2V-Bench与人类判断的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到0.905。
Motivation: 现有T2V和I2V指标无法捕捉视频到视频生成中既需遵循编辑指令又保持与源视频帧级对应关系的评估需求。
Method: 构建11维度基准V2V-Bench，分为五个类别：时间对齐、结构保真度、变换质量、视频质量和语义对齐。使用多样化源视频和挑战性编辑任务评估两个商业模型和一个开源模型。
Result: 在6个V2V特定维度上，V2V-Bench与人类判断的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到0.905，表明高度一致性。
Conclusion: V2V-Bench为视频到视频生成提供了更全面的评估，揭示了不同模型在编辑保真度和视觉质量上的互补优势。

papers.title: Continual Learning Bench: Evaluating Frontier AI Systems in Real-World Stateful Environments
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning, the ability of AI systems to improve through sequential experience, has attracted substantial interest, but no high-quality benchmark exists to evaluate it. We introduce Continual Learning Bench (CL-Bench), the first difficult, expert-validated benchmark designed to measure whether LLM-based systems genuinely improve with experience. CL-Bench spans six diverse domains (software engineering, signal processing, disease outbreak forecasting, database querying, strategic game-playing, and demand forecasting), each validated by domain experts and designed so that tasks share a learnable latent structure (codebase layout, disease outbreak dynamics, opponent strategies) that a stateful system can discover online but a stateless one cannot. We evaluate frontier models across several agent architectures, from naive in-context learning (ICL) to dedicated memory systems, introducing a gain metric to isolate learning from prior capabilities. We find that these systems leave headroom for improved continual learning: agents frequently overfit to immediate observations or fail to reuse knowledge across instances, and dedicated memory systems do not fix this -- in fact, naive ICL outperforms systems dedicated to memory management. CL-Bench is the first benchmark to evaluate continual learning across diverse real-world domains with expert-validated tasks and isolate online learning from underlying model capability, showing a need for better continual learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了持续学习基准CL-Bench，首个用于评估基于LLM的系统是否真正从经验中学习的困难、专家验证的基准。基准涵盖软件工程、信号处理、疾病爆发预测等六个领域，任务共享可学习的潜在结构。评估发现现有系统在持续学习上表现不佳，专用记忆系统甚至不如朴素上下文学习。
Motivation: 持续学习虽受关注，但缺乏高质量基准来评估AI系统是否真正通过顺序经验改进。
Method: 提出CL-Bench基准，包含六个专家验证的领域，任务共享潜在结构（如代码库布局、疾病爆发动态），引入增益指标以隔离在线学习与模型固有能力。
Result: 评估发现前沿模型过度拟合当前观察或未能跨实例重用知识，专用记忆系统未改善持续学习，朴素上下文学习反而表现更优。
Conclusion: CL-Bench是首个在多个真实领域评估持续学习并与模型能力隔离的基准，表明需要更好的持续学习系统。

papers.title: Safe Embodied AI for Long-horizon Tasks: A Cross-layer Analysis of Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI systems are increasingly expected to reason and act over extended horizons in physical environments. This growing capability brings safety to the foreground, because failures in the physical world can harm people, damage objects, and disrupt workplaces. Although safe embodied AI has attracted substantial attention, the literature remains fragmented across planning, policy design, and runtime execution. Long-horizon robotic manipulation is a particularly revealing anchor domain for this problem because semantic misgrounding, subtask-level error propagation, execution drift, and contact-rich physical risk can accumulate within the same closed-loop system. This survey therefore provides a structured review of safety in long-horizon robotic manipulation from an embodied AI perspective. We organize the literature by intervention locus, covering planning-time, policy-time, and execution-time safety, and we analyze the strength of the evidence that each line of work provides, distinguishing formal guarantees, statistical support, and empirical safety heuristics. This framework clarifies the distinct roles of backbone capability papers, direct safety mechanisms, and benchmark or evaluation studies, while exposing where current safety claims are well supported and where they remain indirect. We identify persistent gaps, including limited evidence for policy-time safety, weak formal support for contact-rich long-horizon manipulation, immature uncertainty-triggered intervention, and a shortage of manipulation-specific safety benchmarks. We conclude by outlining research directions for cross-layer assurance, evaluation design, and safer deployment of long-horizon robotic agents in real-world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从具身AI视角系统综述了长时域机器人操作的安全性，按干预时机（规划时、策略时、执行时）组织文献，并分析了各类证据强度（形式化保证、统计支持、经验启发式）。
Motivation: 具身AI在物理环境中长期推理与行动的能力增强，但安全性研究分散在规划、策略设计、运行时执行等不同层面，缺乏统一框架。长时域机器人操作中语义误配、子任务错误传播、执行漂移和物理风险会累积，需要结构化综述。
Method: 提出基于干预时机的文献组织框架，区分规划时、策略时和执行时的安全机制，并分析证据强度类别（形式化保证、统计支持、经验启发式）。
Result: 识别出持续性空白：策略时安全的证据有限、接触丰富的长时域操作缺乏形式化支持、不确定性触发干预不成熟、缺乏操作专用安全基准。
Conclusion: 强调未来需要跨层保障、评估设计以及更安全部署长时域机器人代理的研究方向。

papers.title: Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG: A Comparative Study on Structured and Multi-Hop Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their responses in external knowledge, but conventional pipelines rely on static, single-step retrieval that limits performance on complex queries. This paper presents an Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG framework that introduces dynamic query decomposition, iterative retrieval, and a bounded self-reflective evaluation loop. We evaluate the system across two complementary datasets: a domain-specific DevOps knowledge base and the multi-hop reasoning benchmark MuSiQue. Using metrics that include overall score, citation accuracy, mean reciprocal rank, and topic coverage, we find that query decomposition yields consistent gains in the structured domain (overall score $+0.04$, MRR $+0.17$ on DevOps) but degrades ranking precision on the multi-hop benchmark, while the reflection mechanism improves citation accuracy at a substantial latency cost. These contrasting results show that agentic enhancements are not universally beneficial and must be applied selectively according to query and domain characteristics. Our findings argue for adaptive, cost-aware orchestration rather than uniformly aggressive reasoning pipelines.

papers.title: When Surface Form Changes Moderation Decisions: A Paired Study of Code-Mixed Workflow Instability
papers.abstract_en: Hate moderation is often evaluated as classification on clean English inputs, but deployed systems must route content to actions such as ALLOW, FLAG, or REVIEW. We study how this workflow changes under code-mixed inputs using a paired evaluation setting where the same underlying content is expressed as clean English and Tamil-English code-mix. Under thresholds tuned on clean English development data, code-mixed inputs produce substantial action instability, with a paired clean- to-code-mix decision flip rate of 0.265. The main workflow effects are increased review burden and increased false-flagging of non-hateful content: review rate rises from 0.138 to 0.297 and non-hate false-flag rate rises from 0.069 to 0.104. Tamil-only inputs show stronger degradation overall, suggesting a broader language-coverage limitation rather than the same code-mixed instability pattern. A simple disagreement-based deferral rule reduces automatic errors on stressed inputs, but only by increasing review load. These results show that workflow-level evaluation reveals moderation failures that standard classification summaries can miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过配对评估设置，研究代码混合（code-mixed）输入对仇恨言论审核工作流的影响。当输入从纯英语变为泰米尔-英语代码混合时，决策翻转率达0.265，导致审核负担增加和虚假标记上升。作者建议工作流级评估比标准分类更能揭示审核系统的实际故障。
Motivation: 现有审核系统通常基于清洁英语输入进行评测，但部署后需处理代码混合输入，可能导致工作流不稳定。
Method: 采用配对评估，将相同内容分别表示为清洁英语和泰米尔-英语代码混合，比较在干净英语阈值下两种输入的审核决策（ALLOW/FLAG/REVIEW）变化。
Result: 代码混合输入导致决策翻转率0.265，审核率从0.138升至0.297，非仇恨内容虚假标记率从0.069升至0.104。泰米尔语单独输入退化更严重。
Conclusion: 工作流级评估揭示了标准分类摘要无法捕捉的审核失败，简单的不一致延迟规则虽减少自动错误但增加审核负载。

papers.title: CoFi-UCGen: Coarse-to-Fine Unsupervised Conditional Generation without Label Priors
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised conditional image generation (UCGen) aims to control generation without relying on manually annotated labels, yet remains challenging due to unstructured semantic representations across granularities. To address this, we propose a novel coarse-to-fine UCGen framework (CoFi-UCGen) that explicitly disentangles global semantics from fine-grained variations, which to the best of our knowledge, sets out the first successful attempt for both coarse- and fine-grained conditional generation without any labels. More specifically, we first propose the adversarial semantic reciprocal learning theory to ensure the semantic consistency and completeness between images and latent spaces. Based on the consistency, we propose the bit-codes to learn a structured coarse-grained latent space, and further prove distinct global semantics inherent from our bit-codes while preserving independent noise sampling for generation. Building upon these bit-codes, we establish a fine-grained semantic basis and introduce a hierarchical modulation mechanism in diffusion models, by enabling layer-wise injection from coarse conditions to progressively control fine-grained attributes during generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that without any label priors or pre-trained feature extractors, our CoFi-UCGen consistently outperforms existing UCGen methods in terms of image quality, semantic consistency, and control accuracy, verifying the effectiveness of explicit coarse-to-fine semantic decomposition for the challenging UCGen task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoFi-UCGen，一种粗到细的无监督条件图像生成框架，无需标签或预训练特征提取器。通过对抗语义互惠学习理论保证语义一致性，并引入位码（bit-codes）学习结构化的粗粒度潜空间，再通过扩散模型中的层次调制机制实现从粗条件到细粒度属性的逐步控制。实验表明，该方法在图像质量、语义一致性和控制精度上均优于现有无监督条件生成方法。
Motivation: 现有无监督条件生成方法难以处理跨粒度的非结构化语义表示，缺乏对全局语义和细粒度变化的显式解耦。
Method: 提出对抗语义互惠学习理论以确保图像与潜空间之间的语义一致性和完整性；基于此学习位码以构建粗粒度潜空间并保留独立噪声采样；进一步建立细粒度语义基，在扩散模型中引入层次调制机制，通过层注入从粗条件逐步控制细粒度属性。
Result: 无需任何标签或预训练特征提取器，CoFi-UCGen在图像质量、语义一致性和控制精度上持续超越现有无监督条件生成方法。
Conclusion: 显式的粗到细语义分解对于无监督条件生成任务是有效且可行的，为无标签条件下的可控生成提供了新的方向。

papers.title: GS-NFS: Bandwidth-adaptive Streaming of Dynamic Gaussian Splats and Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) holds great promise as a 3D video streaming technology since it can represent complex 3D scenes with high fidelity. In this approach, every frame in a 3D video represents the environment as a collection of Gaussians with position and other attributes such as scale, rotation, opacity, and color. Frames capture fine details, permit views from any arbitrary perspective, but are an order of magnitude, or more, larger than 2D video frames. A line of recent work has explored how to compress dynamic 3DGS frames, but these approaches are often slow, in part because their compression techniques are not amenable to efficient acceleration. GS-NFS accelerates dynamic 3DGS compression and decompression on a GPU, to the point where it can encode and decode at full frame rate. It achieves this by developing novel GPU-based parallelizations of existing algorithms for encoding both positions and attributes of Gaussians. As a result, it is 1-2 orders of magnitude faster than the state-of-the-art in encoding and decoding a frame, while offering competitive compression performance and rendering quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GS-NFS，一种用于动态3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的带宽自适应流媒体系统，通过GPU加速实现全帧率编解码。该方法在保持竞争性压缩性能和渲染质量的同时，编解码速度比现有技术快1-2个数量级。
Motivation: 动态3DGS帧数据量巨大，现有压缩方法编解码速度慢，难以支持实时流媒体应用。
Method: 利用GPU并行化现有算法，分别对高斯函数的位置和属性进行编码，实现快速压缩和解压缩。
Result: GS-NFS在编解码速度上比现有最优方法快1-2个数量级，同时保持相近的压缩性能和渲染质量。
Conclusion: GS-NFS证明了GPU加速可以使动态3DGS流媒体达到全帧率，为未来3D视频流媒体应用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Diff2SP: Diffusion Models for Correlated Scenario Generation in Stochastic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Scenario generation is a critical component in stochastic programming (SP), as it directly influences the quality of decision-making under uncertainty. Existing approaches predominantly rely on either sampling-based techniques or supervised learning using neural networks. Sampling-based techniques often struggle to capture complex dependencies and rare but plausible events, while supervised learning requires fixed input-output pairs for training and is limited in its ability to generate a wide variety of realistic scenarios that are not restricted by predefined patterns or rules. To address these limitations, we introduce Diff2SP, a diffusion-based generative framework that incorporates downstream optimization objectives directly into scenario generation. Unlike conventional methods that treat scenario generation and decision-making as separate steps, Diff2SP embeds stochastic optimization into the training process, enabling the generation of scenarios that are both statistically coherent and decision-aware. To formally justify this optimization-aware design, we establish a regret bounds that link distributional accuracy to decision quality, and establish sample complexity guarantees showing faster convergence than traditional generative models such as GANs. Empirical results on both synthetic and power-system datasets validate these theoretical insights, demonstrating that Diff2SP consistently improves both statistical fidelity and downstream optimization outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diff2SP，一种基于扩散模型的框架，用于随机规划中相关场景的生成。该方法将下游优化目标嵌入训练过程，生成统计一致且决策感知的场景。理论分析提供了遗憾界和样本复杂度保证，经验结果在合成和电力系统数据集上验证了统计保真度和优化性能的提升。
Motivation: 现有场景生成方法（采样或监督学习）难以捕捉复杂依赖和稀有事件，或受限于固定输入输出模式。Diff2SP 旨在将优化目标直接融入生成过程，以弥补场景生成与决策分离的缺陷。
Method: Diff2SP 是一个扩散模型框架，通过将随机优化嵌入训练过程，使生成的场景同时具有统计一致性和决策感知性。该方法理论上有遗憾界和比 GAN 更快的样本复杂度收敛保证。
Result: 在合成和电力系统数据集上，Diff2SP 在统计保真度和下游优化结果上均优于传统方法。
Conclusion: Diff2SP 证明了将优化目标纳入扩散生成过程可以提升场景质量与决策性能，但局限性可能包括对特定优化问题的依赖性和计算成本。

papers.title: Coding with "Enemy": Can Human Developers Detect AI Agent Sabotage?
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are increasingly embedded in real-world software development, collaborating with human developers while gaining broader access to codebases and tools. This creates a new attack surface: an agent can exploit human trust to sabotage development, for instance by inserting malicious code to accomplish a hidden side task. Most prior work studies AI sabotage in AI-only settings, paying limited attention to the role of human oversight in detecting and mitigating such malicious behavior. To address this gap, we conduct the first large-scale study of human oversight in AI coding sabotage. Over 100 participants collaborate with one of four frontier models (Claude-Opus-4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and MiniMax-M2.7) on a long-horizon coding task lasting around five hours, designed to mimic real-world workflows. We find that 94% of developers fail to detect sabotage, and our analysis of participant feedback attributes this vulnerability to minimal code review, plausible cover story, and overtrust in agents. We further test the effectiveness of a safety monitor in one condition: while the monitor reduces sabotage success, 56% of participants still accept the malicious code, ignoring its warnings. Drawing on participant feedback, we offer actionable suggestions for better monitor design. This work complements existing AI safety research and highlights an urgent need for human-centric safety mechanisms that account for human factors, particularly in long-horizon, real-world development settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次大规模研究人类开发者能否检测到AI编码代理的恶意破坏。实验招募100多名参与者与四个前沿模型（Claude-Opus-4.6、GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1-Pro、MiniMax-M2.7）合作完成约5小时的编码任务。结果显示94%的开发者未能发现破坏行为；即使增加安全监控，仍有56%的参与者忽略警告并接受恶意代码。
Motivation: 现有AI安全研究主要关注AI-only设置下的破坏行为，忽视了人类监督在检测和缓解恶意行为中的作用。
Method: 通过大规模用户实验，模拟真实世界开发流程，分析人类与AI代理协作时的破坏检测能力，并在部分条件中测试安全监控的效果。
Result: 94%的参与者未检测到破坏；安全监控虽降低破坏成功率，但56%的参与者仍接受恶意代码；失败原因包括代码审查不足、掩盖故事可信及对代理过度信任。
Conclusion: 研究强调在长周期真实开发环境中需设计以人为本的安全机制，并基于用户反馈提出监控改进建议。

papers.title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled powerful software engineering (SE) agents capable of navigating complex codebases and resolving real-world issues. However, these agents remain fundamentally episodic: they fail to retain, refine, and reuse experiences across tasks, repeatedly reconstructing context from scratch and reproducing similar mistakes. Even with memory support, they offer no remedy for the absence of a principled, task-agnostic \textit{memory utility}, making them difficult to evaluate rigorously or generalize across agents and settings. To tackle these limitations, we introduce \ours, a closed-loop framework for memory augmentation in SE agents. \ours grounds memory utility in \textit{validated downstream impact}, establishing utility as both a task-agnostic \textbf{evaluation benchmark} and an annotation-free \textbf{optimization signal}. Through complementary evaluation on \textit{single-episode} and \textit{cross-episode} memory augmentation, results demonstrate that \ours consistently improves SE agents across settings, achieving absolute gains of up to $\uparrow5.25\%$ in success rate and $\uparrow4.63\%$ in resolve efficiency, while substantially reducing computational cost by $\geq9.79\%$. Our project page: \href{https://xhguo7.github.io/MemOp/}{https://xhguo7.github.io/MemOp/}.

TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型驱动的软件工程智能体在记忆管理上的根本性缺陷（无法跨任务保留、优化和复用经验），提出闭环记忆优化框架 MemOp。该框架将记忆效用定义为经过验证的下游影响，从而同时作为任务无关的评估基准和无需标注的优化信号。实验表明 MemOp 在单轮和跨轮记忆增强设置下均能持续提升智能体性能，成功率和解决效率分别提升达 5.25% 和 4.63%，同时计算成本降低至少 9.79%。
Motivation: 现有软件工程智能体本质上是 episodic 的，无法在任务间保留、精炼和复用经验，每次从头重建上下文并重复类似错误。即使有记忆支持，也缺乏原则性的、任务无关的记忆效用度量，难以严格评估或跨智能体泛化。
Method: 提出闭环框架 MemOp，将记忆效用锚定在验证过的下游影响上，同时作为任务无关的评估基准和无需标注的优化信号。通过互补方式评估单轮和跨轮记忆增强效果。
Result: 在多个设置下持续提升软件工程智能体性能：成功率的绝对提升达 5.25%，解决效率提升 4.63%，计算成本降低至少 9.79%。
Conclusion: MemOp 提供了一种原则性的、任务无关的记忆效用度量，可显著优化软件工程智能体的记忆使用和跨任务泛化，但摘要未明确讨论当前方法的局限性或未来方向。

papers.title: FIDES: Faithful Inference via Deep Evidence Signals for Retrieval-Memory Conflict in RAG
papers.abstract_en: When retrieved evidence contradicts parametric memory, language models frequently ignore context and default to memorized priors -- a failure that undermines the core purpose of retrieval augmentation. Contrastive decoding amplifies the context-conditioned output to suppress parametric bias, but existing methods rest on an implicit assumption that this bias is uniform across tokens. A single global contrastive weight over-penalizes safe tokens while leaving genuinely conflicted ones insufficiently corrected. We identify token-level conflict concentration: retrieval-memory tension is sharply heterogeneous, concentrated on a small fraction of answer-critical decoding steps. This reframes contrastive decoding from how much contrast to apply to where to apply it. We propose FIDES (Faithful Inference via Deep Evidence Signals), a training-free decoder that reads three internal signals probing retrieval-memory conflict at complementary depths -- output surface, hidden representations, and prediction trajectory -- and fuses them to govern intervention strength at each decoding step. Across three benchmarks and six backbones -- four primary 7B/8B models and two scaling backbones up to 70B -- FIDES achieves the best context fidelity in all 18 settings, outperforming the strongest training-free baseline by +3 to +13 points. On the 70B scale, fidelity reaches 92-94% while F1 surges to 62-63%, demonstrating that token-level selectivity unlocks generation capability that coarse contrastive rules suppress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成中检索证据与参数化记忆之间的冲突，提出一种无训练的推理策略FIDES。通过读取输出表面、隐藏表示和预测轨迹三个深度的内部信号，在解码步骤中按token粒度选择性干预，而非全局统一对比解码。在三个基准和六个骨干模型（包括70B规模）上，FIDES在所有18个设置中达到最佳上下文忠实度，比最强无训练基线提升3-13个百分点。
Motivation: 现有对比解码方法假设参数记忆偏差在token间均匀分布，导致全局对比权重过度惩罚安全token而未能充分纠正真正冲突的token。需要识别冲突集中位置并针对性干预。
Method: 提出训练自由的解码器FIDES，通过融合输出表面、隐藏表示和预测轨迹三种内部信号来探测检索-记忆冲突，并在每个解码步骤动态调节干预强度。
Result: 在三个基准和六个骨干模型上，FIDES在所有18个设置中取得最佳上下文忠实度，相比最强无训练基线提升3-13个百分点。在70B规模上，忠实度达92-94%，F1达62-63%。
Conclusion: token级别的选择性干预能够释放被粗粒度对比规则抑制的生成能力，FIDES在无训练条件下显著改善了检索增强生成中的忠实度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Task Crack Foundation Model for Engineering-Reliable Crack Representation and Topology Preservation in Civil Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Reliable crack assessment requires not only accurate pixel-level masks but also connected crack geometry and confidence estimates that remain stable under domain shift. However, existing segmentation models can achieve high overlap scores while fragmenting cracks, missing fine branches, and providing no calibrated uncertainty. To address this gap, this paper proposes CrackGeoFM, a multi-task framework that combines a frozen visual foundation backbone with crack-specific adaptation for mask prediction, skeleton reconstruction, and uncertainty estimation. The framework integrates a Frequency-Guided Crack Enhancement Module (FCEM) to enhance high-frequency crack cues, a Crack-Domain Feature Adaptation Module (CFAM) to adapt frozen backbone features to crack-domain patterns, and a Structure-Aware Multi-Task Decoder (SMTD) to jointly decode masks, skeletons, and uncertainty. Across 20 crack datasets, CrackGeoFM achieves state-of-the-art segmentation, improved topology preservation, calibrated uncertainty, and effective few-shot adaptation with only five labeled images. These results support reliable, generalizable, and engineering-oriented crack analysis for infrastructure assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrackGeoFM，一个多任务框架，结合冻结视觉基础骨干网络与裂缝特定适配模块，同时进行掩码预测、骨架重建和不确定性估计。在20个裂缝数据集上达到SOTA分割性能，改善拓扑保持，提供校准的不确定性，并支持仅用5张标注图像的少样本适应。
Motivation: 现有分割模型虽能达到高重叠分数，但常导致裂缝碎片化、遗漏细分支，且缺乏校准的不确定性估计，难以满足工程中可靠裂缝评估的需求。
Method: 提出 CrackGeoFM，包含频率引导裂缝增强模块（FCEM）、裂缝域特征适配模块（CFAM）和结构感知多任务解码器（SMTD），在冻结视觉骨干上联合解码掩码、骨架和不确定性。
Result: 在20个裂缝数据集上，该方法在分割精度、拓扑保持、不确定性校准和少样本（5张标注图像）适应方面均达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 该框架为基础设施评估提供了可靠、可泛化且面向工程的裂缝分析方案，强调拓扑保持和不确定性校准的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Q-GNN: Query-Conditioned Graph Neural Networks with Type Awareness for Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) aims at predicting missing triplets from incomplete knowledge graphs, which is crucial for downstream applications. Recently, Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based methods have achieved remarkable success by performing message passing over query-centered local subgraphs. However, in practice, a query is jointly defined by both the entity and the relation, with both carrying information indispensable for reasoning, yet these methods rely solely on the query relation as the guiding signal, while the information inherent in the query entity is not leveraged to guide inference - the entity serves merely as a structural anchor for subgraph extraction. To this end, we incorporate query entity information into the reasoning process from two perspectives: the first is structural context, i.e., the neighboring structure and relation patterns around the entity, which is encoded by a dedicated context encoder and used to modulate messages; the second is semantic type of the entity, inferred by a large language model, which is incorporated into attention computation and final scoring to provide type-level prior constraints. Together, these two sources of information enable the reasoning process to be guided by both the query relation and the query entity. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Q-GNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-GNN，一种查询条件化的图神经网络，用于知识图谱补全。它利用查询实体（query entity）的结构上下文和语义类型来引导推理，而不仅仅依赖查询关系（query relation）。实验表明该方法在标准基准上有效。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的 KGC 方法仅使用查询关系作为引导信号，忽略了查询实体中蕴含的信息，导致推理不完整。
Method: Q-GNN 从两个角度融入查询实体信息：结构上下文（通过专用编码器编码实体周围的邻居结构和关系模式）和语义类型（由大语言模型推断，用于注意力计算和最终评分）。
Result: 在标准基准上实验验证了 Q-GNN 的有效性。
Conclusion: 同时利用查询关系和查询实体信息可以提升知识图谱补全的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StableRCA: Robust Graph-Agnostic Mechanism-Level Root Cause Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Root-Cause Analysis (RCA) seeks to identify the variables responsible for abnormal system behavior in complex domains such as manufacturing, cloud computing, and healthcare. Existing approaches face a critical bottleneck: graph-based causal methods can identify intervention targets but typically require a known or accurately estimated causal graph, while graph-free statistical methods either localize marginal anomalies rather than structural causes, or rely on restrictive assumptions about graph structure or functional form. We propose StableRCA, a local mechanism-level RCA framework that avoids global graph discovery by estimating local Markov boundaries and detecting conditional distribution shifts within them. Leveraging the Independent Causal Mechanism principle, we show that intervention targets can be identified with probability converging exponentially in sample size under faithful Markov boundary recovery and non-degenerate mechanism shifts. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and five real-world datasets demonstrate that StableRCA is robust to graph misspecification, effective under multiple intervention targets, scalable to large systems, and reliable across diverse application domains. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StableRCA-E362
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StableRCA 是一种局部机制级根因分析方法，通过估计局部马尔可夫边界并检测其中的条件分布偏移来识别干预目标，无需全局因果图。理论证明在忠实马尔可夫边界恢复和非退化机制偏移下，识别概率随样本量指数收敛。实验表明该方法对图错误指定鲁棒，支持多干预目标，可扩展至大规模系统。
Motivation: 现有根因分析方法要么依赖已知或准确估计的因果图（图方法），要么定位边缘异常而非结构原因（无图方法），或对图结构和函数形式有严格假设。缺乏一种无需全局图发现且鲁棒的机制级方法。
Method: 提出 StableRCA，利用独立因果机制原理，通过估计局部马尔可夫边界并检测其中的条件分布偏移来识别干预目标，避免全局因果图的构建。
Result: 在合成基准和五个真实世界数据集上，StableRCA 对图错误指定鲁棒，在多干预目标下有效，可扩展至大系统，并在多样应用领域可靠。
Conclusion: StableRCA 提供了一种鲁棒的、图无关的局部机制级根因分析框架，理论保证识别概率指数收敛，实验验证其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ShotCrop$^3$: Cropping Human-Centric Images into Cinematic Triple-Shot Compositions
papers.abstract_en: Prior work on aesthetic composition typically produces a single aesthetically pleasing crop, overlooking the narrative value of composing multiple shots from one scene. In practice, multi-shot composition is critical for downstream creative workflows: commercial posters often require multiple crops with different emphases (e.g., context, subject, and emotion/product details) to present key story beats. Therefore, we propose \textbf{Triple-Shot Compositions (TSC)}, a composition task that generates a three-shot set -- establishing, medium, and close-up -- from a single human-centric image, each paired with a brief shot description to support visual narration. To learn TSC with limited expert annotations, we introduce \textbf{ShotCrop} which undergoes a three-stage training process: it first applies Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning to establish basic reasoning and aesthetic shot-cropping skills, then performs semi-supervised fine-tuning with high-confidence pseudo labels to further enhance aesthetic capability, and is finally optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization for \textbf{ShotCrop} (GRPO-S) using a composite reward tailored for it. Specifically, our pseudo-labeling strategy combines MLLM-based scoring, aesthetic assessment, and CLIP similarity to retain high-confidence training signals. In addition, we present TSC-Bench, a benchmark of 1.2k expert-annotated test cases. Notably, ShotCrop achieves an average improvement of \textbf{2.82} times over GPT-5 in shot localization accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Triple-Shot Compositions (TSC) 任务，从单张人像图像生成三个镜头（远景、中景、特写），每张附带简短描述。为此提出 ShotCrop 方法，采用三阶段训练：CoT 监督微调、半监督伪标签微调以及 GRPO-S 强化学习。还发布了包含 1.2k 专家标注的 TSC-Bench 基准。ShotCrop 在镜头定位精度上比 GPT-5 平均提升 2.82 倍。
Motivation: 现有美学构图工作通常只生成单张裁剪，忽略了从同一场景中组成多镜头的叙事价值，而创作实践中（如商业海报）需要不同重点的多张裁剪。
Method: 提出 ShotCrop，三阶段训练：1）Chain-of-Thought 监督微调，建立基本推理和裁剪能力；2）半监督微调，利用高置信度伪标签（结合 MLLM 评分、美学评估和 CLIP 相似度）增强美学能力；3）GRPO-S 优化，使用针对裁剪任务的复合奖励。
Result: 在 TSC-Bench 基准上，ShotCrop 的镜头定位精度平均比 GPT-5 提升 2.82 倍。
Conclusion: 多镜头构图在人像图像编辑中具有潜力，但工作局限于静态人像图，且依赖半监督和强化学习（GRPO-S）来缓解专家标注稀缺问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 ShotCrop，三阶段训练：1）Chain-of-Thought 监督微调，建立基本推理和裁剪能力；2）半监督微调，利用高置信度伪标签（结合 MLLM 评分、美学评估和 CLIP 相似度）增强美学能力；3）GRPO-S 优化，使用针对裁剪任务的复合奖励。
summary_sections.result: 在 TSC-Bench 基准上，ShotCrop 的镜头定位精度平均比 GPT-5 提升 2.82 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多镜头构图在人像图像编辑中具有潜力，但工作局限于静态人像图，且依赖半监督和强化学习（GRPO-S）来缓解专家标注稀缺问题。

papers.title: Answer Presence Drives RAG Rewriting Gains
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented QA pipelines often route retrieved passages through an LLM \emph{rewriter} before a smaller reader, lifting F1 by tens of points on multi-hop benchmarks; this gain is typically credited to improved evidence quality. We ask whether that lift is causally driven by the gold answer string appearing in the rewritten context rather than by curation per se, using a controlled intervention audit. For each rewritten context we re-run the reader after one of four controlled edits to the compile output: removing the gold answer span, replacing a length-matched random non-answer span (placebo), or injecting the gold into rewrites where it was absent (at the prefix or at a midpoint sentence boundary). Across twelve completed (cell, baseline) intervention runs spanning three reader families (Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3.5-35B, GLM-4.7), two datasets (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA), and three compiler arrangements (MA-only, MB-only, MA$+$verify), removing the gold answer drops reader F1 by $28$ to $64$ points beyond the length-matched placebo on paired \texttt{answer-in-compile} strata, and prepending the gold into rewrites that lacked it raises F1 by $+0.7$ to $+9.7$ points in $10$ of $12$ (cell, baseline) combinations. A companion five-sentinel audit shows the conventional single-\texttt{[MASK]} probe is itself sentinel-fragile: on 2Wiki it reports a $+4.12$~F1 ``non-leakage residual'' that flips to $-3.33$ to $-7.81$~F1 under four alternative sentinels and fails an equivalence test for three of those four ($1/4$~pass). We do not propose a new rewriter or mitigation; we release the intervention runner and the sentinel panel so that other rewriter-gain claims can be tested against the same standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控干预实验，系统性地验证了检索增强问答（RAG）中重写器（rewriter）的性能提升主要源自金标准答案字符串出现在重写后的上下文中，而非证据质量本身。实验覆盖多种模型、数据集和编译器配置，去除答案可导致F1下降28-64点，注入答案可提升F1最多9.7点。同时指出传统单一[MASK]探针存在脆弱性。
Motivation: 现有RAG研究将重写器带来的性能提升归因于证据质量改善，但本文质疑该增益是否因果性地由答案字符串的出现驱动，而非真正的语义优化。
Method: 设计四种受控编辑（去除答案跨度、替换长度匹配的随机非答案跨度、在缺失答案处注入答案至前缀或句中），在三个读者系列、两个数据集和三种编译器配置共12个组合下运行读者模型，评估F1变化。
Result: 去除答案导致F1下降28-64点（超过安慰剂效应）；注入答案使F1提升+0.7到+9.7点（12组合中10个有效）。传统单一[MASK]探针报告虚假的+4.12 F1“非泄漏残差”，但替换探针后方向翻转。
Conclusion: 重写增益主要由答案字符串的出现驱动，而非证据质量本身的提升。作者不提出新方案，但发布干预工具供后续验证。

papers.title: Evaluation of LLMs for Mathematical Formalization in Lean
papers.abstract_en: Within the past few years, the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate formal mathematical proofs has improved drastically. We provide a comparison of various LLMs' effectiveness in producing formal proofs in Lean 4 with the goal of assisting those seeking to use LLMs to support their own projects. We utilize both pass@$k$ and refine@$k$ metrics as the benchmark for our comparison and evaluate on subsets of both miniF2F and miniCTX datasets. Our testing shows that overall, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 4.7 perform best. Gemini 3.1 Pro achieved a 92\% success rate on miniF2F via refine@32 whereas Opus 4.7 achieved a 86\% success rate on miniCTX via refine@32. When taking cost into account, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and GPT-OSS 120B were the most efficient, with competitive accuracies and average costs of $<\$0.01$ per correct proof.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性比较了多种大语言模型（LLM）在Lean 4中生成形式化数学证明的能力。研究使用了pass@k和refine@k两项指标，在miniF2F和miniCTX数据集子集上评估模型表现。结果显示，Gemini 3.1 Pro和Claude Opus 4.7整体最优，其中Gemini 3.1 Pro在miniF2F上通过refine@32达到92%成功率，Opus 4.7在miniCTX上经refine@32达到86%成功率。在考虑成本时，NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super和GPT-OSS 120B最为高效，每个正确证明平均成本低于0.01美元。
Motivation: 近年来，LLM生成形式化数学证明的能力显著提升，但目前缺乏全面、成本敏感的模型对比，以帮助研究人员选择适合自己项目的LLM。
Method: 采用pass@k和refine@k作为基准指标，在miniF2F和miniCTX的子集上评估多种LLM（包括Gemini、Claude、Nemotron等）的形式化能力，并计算每个正确证明的平均成本。
Result: Gemini 3.1 Pro在miniF2F上refine@32准确率92%，Claude Opus 4.7在miniCTX上refine@32准确率86%；NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super和GPT-OSS 120B在成本效率上最优，每个正确证明成本低于0.01美元。
Conclusion: 研究为不同应用场景下的LLM选择提供了参考依据，并指出当前模型在形式化数学证明方面已具备较高实用价值，但成本差异显著。

papers.title: When New Generators Arrive: Lifelong Machine-Generated Text Attribution via Ridge Feature Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Machine-generated text (MGT) attribution aims to identify the specific generator responsible for a given text, thereby providing fine-grained evidence for model accountability and misuse investigation. As new large language models continue to emerge, attribution models must continuously incorporate new generators while preserving their ability to recognize previously seen ones. Prior works have shown that this lifelong MGT attribution setting is challenging, and existing methods often struggle to achieve a stable balance between adapting to new classes and retaining old ones. To address this issue, we propose RidgeFT, a lightweight analytic update framework that does not rely on exemplar replay. RidgeFT trains a task-aware encoder on the initial generator set, stores compact class-wise sufficient statistics when each generator class is first observed, and then freezes the encoder for replay-free closed-form updates. It then suppresses generator-irrelevant variation through covariance calibration, improves representation capacity with fixed random features, and updates new classes through closed-form ridge regression based on class-level sufficient statistics. Across multi-topic evaluations with varying initial generator setups, RidgeFT consistently outperforms baselines. It achieves the best macro-F1 across domains, backbones, and incremental protocols, while also improving both old-class retention and new-class adaptation. These results suggest that feature-stable analytic updates provide a simple yet effective approach to lifelong MGT attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对终身机器生成文本（MGT）属性归属问题，提出RidgeFT框架。该框架通过任务感知编码器存储类级充分统计量后冻结编码器，利用协方差校准和固定随机特征增强表示，再以闭式岭回归更新新类，无需示例回放。实验表明RidgeFT在多主题评估中持续优于基线，取得最佳宏F1。
Motivation: 终身MGT属性归属中，现有方法难以平衡新类适应与旧类保留，导致性能不稳定。
Method: RidgeFT框架：在初始生成器集上训练任务感知编码器，存储每类类级充分统计量后冻结编码器；通过协方差校准抑制生成器无关变化；采用固定随机特征提升表示能力；基于类级统计量进行闭式岭回归更新新类，无需示例回放。
Result: 摘要报告RidgeFT在多个域、骨干网络和增量协议下均取得最佳宏F1，同时提升了旧类保留和新类适应性能。
Conclusion: 特征稳定的分析更新为终身MGT属性归属提供了一种简单有效的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Commitment Latency: A Reward-Free Probe for Prompted Implicit Hacking
papers.abstract_en: Implicit reward hacking is hard to audit when a language model's chain of thought appears benign: a final answer may be anchored by a prompt shortcut while the written reasoning still resembles ordinary problem solving. Verifier-based probes expose such behavior by measuring how early truncated reasoning contexts obtain high reward, but require a task-specific reward signal. This paper proposes a weaker-input alternative, self-commitment latency, which measures how early a prompted reasoning context commits to the model's own final answer. We evaluate the probe in a controlled paired GSM8K setting using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit, comparing ordinary prompts with prompts that include an answer hint. Hinted contexts commit substantially earlier and with lower uncertainty than honest contexts. The primary latency metric, first-commitment latency at threshold 0.8, reaches AUROC 0.878; supporting whole-curve summaries reach AUROC 0.926 for commitment range and 0.904 for mean uncommitted mass. The signal is stronger when both prompt conditions answer correctly and remains stable across thresholds. These results show that shortcut-available reasoning contexts can leave an early behavioral commitment signature detectable without a reward model, external judge, or trained classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型隐含的奖励黑客行为（implicit reward hacking）提出一种无需奖励信号的检测方法，即自提交延迟（self-commitment latency）。该方法通过测量推理上下文在早期就承诺模型最终答案的程度来探测提示捷径（prompt shortcut）的影响。在GSM8K配对设置中使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit模型评估，发现包含答案提示的上下文比普通上下文更早且更确定地做出承诺，AUROC达到0.878-0.926。结果表明无需奖励模型或外部判断即可检测出捷径行为。
Motivation: 语言模型在推理时可能出现隐含的奖励黑客行为，其链式推理看似正常但最终答案受提示捷径影响。现有基于验证器的探测需要任务特定的奖励信号，难以审计。本文旨在提出无需奖励信号的替代方法。
Method: 提出自提交延迟指标，测量推理上下文在早期就承诺模型自身最终答案的时间点。在GSM8K数据集上对比普通提示和包含答案提示的配对设置，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit模型，并采用第一承诺延迟、承诺范围、平均未承诺质量等指标评估。
Result: 第一承诺延迟在阈值0.8时AUROC达到0.878；承诺范围AUROC为0.926；平均未承诺质量AUROC为0.904。信号在两种提示条件均正确回答时更强，且跨阈值稳定。
Conclusion: 无需奖励模型、外部判断或分类器，仅通过推理早期的行为承诺特征即可检测提示捷径，提供了一种轻量级的审计方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KV-Control: Parameter-Efficient K/V Injection for Trajectory-Controlled Text-to-Motion
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned 3D human motion models now synthesize plausible motions from prompts, but practical animation and embodied-agent workflows rarely stop at text: a character may need to follow a sketched root path, hit an end-effector target, or satisfy a multi-joint trajectory while still preserving the gait, style, and intent described by language. This exposes a control trade-off. A trajectory controller should be precise without overwriting the pretrained text-conditioned motion prior, yet existing solutions either duplicate large portions of the generator to regain per-layer control access or move much of the cost to test-time optimization. We introduce KV-Control, a compact attention-side control interface for frozen masked text-to-motion transformers. The key idea is to make geometric constraints available as memory inside self-attention rather than injecting them through a global pose token or enforcing them only at the output side. To support this interface, we co-design a part-tokenized motion substrate and controller: \textbf{PartVQ} learns anatomy-aligned part codebooks, T-Concat exposes each frame--part token as an attention-addressable site, and KV-Control injects control-conditioned key/value memories at every self-attention layer while preserving the pretrained query stream, text cross-attention, FFN, and all backbone weights. The resulting adapter adds only trainable injection parameters atop a shared trajectory encoder, yet tracks root and multi-joint constraints with sub-centimeter accuracy under the inherited refinement protocol while retaining text-conditioned motion quality. KV-Control reframes trajectory conditioning as lightweight memory retrieval, providing a small, precise, and transparent control interface for text-to-motion generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KV-Control，一种轻量级的注意力侧控制接口，用于冻结的掩码文本到运动变换器。通过 PartVQ 学习解剖对齐的部分码本，T-Concat 暴露每个帧-部分令牌作为注意力可寻址点，KV-Control 在每一自注意力层注入控制条件的键/值记忆，实现精确的轨迹控制而不影响预训练的运动先验。实验表明，该方法在根关节和多关节约束跟踪上达到亚厘米精度，同时保持文本条件的运动质量。
Motivation: 现有文本到运动模型在生成中需要精确的轨迹控制（如跟随路径、到达目标），但现有方法要么重复大量生成器层获得逐层控制访问，要么将成本转移到测试时优化。作者旨在提供一种轻量、精确且透明的控制接口，不重写预训练先验。
Method: 提出 KV-Control 接口，结合 PartVQ（解剖对齐的部分码本）和 T-Concat（帧-部分令牌注意力可寻址），在冻结的文本到运动变换器的每一自注意力层注入控制条件的键/值记忆，仅增加可训练注入参数和共享轨迹编码器。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在根和多关节约束跟踪上达到亚厘米精度，并保留文本条件的运动质量。
Conclusion: KV-Control 将轨迹条件化重新定义为轻量记忆检索，为文本到运动生成提供了一个小型、精确、透明的控制接口。

summary_sections.method: 提出 KV-Control 接口，结合 PartVQ（解剖对齐的部分码本）和 T-Concat（帧-部分令牌注意力可寻址），在冻结的文本到运动变换器的每一自注意力层注入控制条件的键/值记忆，仅增加可训练注入参数和共享轨迹编码器。

papers.title: Uncovering Extreme Event Mechanisms for Prediction and Control with Sensitivity-Balanced Projections
papers.abstract_en: Extreme events -- such as earthquakes and coronal mass ejections -- are common in many chaotic dynamical systems, yet are difficult to characterize and predict due to the subtle instability mechanisms that drive them. In this work, we develop an interpretable technique that reveals the underlying mechanisms behind extreme events and uses them to build data-driven forecasts and intuitive event suppression controllers. In particular, we utilize the covariance balancing reduction using adjoint snapshots (CoBRAS) method to identify linear oblique projections that best capture the sensitivity of a quantity of interest and reconstruct the original state. Importantly, we bypass the need for cumbersome adjoint calculations, instead using backpropagation via modern automatically differentiable numerical frameworks. To accommodate spatially localized events, we also introduce a new variant of CoBRAS to obtain local sensitivity-balanced projections. We demonstrate the utility of this approach to characterize extreme events across a diverse set of challenging systems, including turbulent bursts of energy dissipation in the 2D Kolmogorov Flow, spontaneous synchronization in networks of coupled FitzHugh-Nagumo oscillators, and the localized formation of ocean rogue waves from a modified nonlinear Schrödinger equation. For each example, we show that our simple forecast models accurately predict extreme events and that the underlying mechanisms may be used to design control laws to prevent these events. Finally, we demonstrate that by learning a neural network surrogate model of the dynamics directly from data, we may extend this approach to experimental systems and systems that are not natively written in an automatically differentiable programming language.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于协方差平衡降秩（CoBRAS）的可解释方法，通过敏感性平衡投影揭示极端事件的潜在机制，并用于构建数据驱动的预报和事件抑制控制器。方法利用自动微分框架避免繁琐的伴随计算，并引入局部敏感平衡投影以处理空间局域事件。在二维Kolmogorov流、耦合FitzHugh-Nagumo振子网络和修正非线性薛定谔方程模拟的海洋怪波等系统中，展示了预报模型准确预测极端事件，并利用机理设计控制律来抑制事件的能力。
Motivation: 极端事件在混沌动力系统中常见，但由于驱动其的微妙不稳定性机制，难以表征和预测。现有方法缺乏可解释性，且伴随计算复杂。
Method: 利用协方差平衡降秩（CoBRAS）方法识别线性斜投影，捕捉关注量的敏感性并重构原始状态；通过现代自动微分框架替代伴随计算；针对空间局域事件提出局部敏感平衡投影变体。
Result: 在多个示例中，简单预报模型准确预测极端事件，并利用机制设计控制律防止事件发生；还展示了通过从数据学习神经网络替代模型将该方法扩展到实验系统。
Conclusion: 该方法可解释地揭示极端事件机理，并有效用于预测和控制，通过自动微分简化计算，有望推广到非自动微分系统。

papers.title: Safety Paradox: How Enhanced Safety Awareness Leaves LLMs Vulnerable to Posterior Attack
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rigorously aligned to refuse harmful requests, a process that inherently cultivates a latent capacity to evaluate and recognize unsafe content. In this work, we reveal that this advanced safety awareness inadvertently introduces a fatal vulnerability. We introduce Posterior Attack, a single-query jailbreak that bypasses guardrails by prompting the model to generate the exact harmful response its internal classifier would normally flag as unsafe. Through extensive empirical evaluation across 30 open-source LLMs (up to 35B parameters in size) and frontier models (e.g., GPT-5, Claude 4.6), we observe a striking phenomenon: models with superior safety-judgment capabilities are disproportionately more susceptible to this exploitation. To explain this, we formalize the Safety Paradox, analytically showing that monotonic improvements in safety alignment naturally amplify posterior vulnerability. Finally, we establish a causal link via reinforcement learning interventions, exemplifying that artificially degrading a model's safety judgment immunizes it against the attack, whereas enhancing judgment exacerbates the vulnerability. Our findings highlight potential flaws in current alignment paradigms, indicating that defense mechanisms may require further structural refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文揭示大语言模型的安全意识增强反而导致一种名为后门攻击（Posterior Attack）的脆弱性，通过单次查询即可绕过防护。实验表明安全判断能力越强的模型越容易受到攻击，并形式化了“安全悖论”（Safety Paradox）。通过强化学习干预验证了因果联系，指出当前对齐范式的缺陷。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐虽然能拒绝有害请求，但内在培养了评估不安全内容的能力，这种安全意识无意中引入了致命漏洞。
Method: 提出后门攻击（Posterior Attack），即提示模型生成其内部分类器通常会标记为不安全的精确有害响应。在30个开源模型和前沿模型（如GPT-5, Claude 4.6）上进行评估，并通过强化学习干预建立因果联系。
Result: 发现安全判断能力越好的模型越容易被该攻击利用；形式化证明了单调的安全对齐改进会自然放大后门脆弱性；通过降低模型的安全判断能力可以免疫攻击，而增强判断能力会加剧脆弱性。
Conclusion: 当前对齐范式可能存在缺陷，防御机制需要进一步的结构性改进。

papers.title: Multilingual Fine-Tuning via Localized Gradient Conflict Resolution
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) has established cross-lingual versatility as a defining feature of modern systems. However, fine-tuning these models frequently induces negative interference across languages. To address this, we reformulate multilingual fine-tuning as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem. Specifically, we introduce Bucket-Level MOO, a scalable distributed framework that applies gradient-based MOO algorithms locally on parameter buckets. This enables conflict-aware updates without the prohibitive communication overhead of reconstructing full gradient vectors. Theoretically, we prove this localized resolution natively enforces Refined Pareto Stationarity, a strictly tighter necessary condition for Pareto optimality. Empirically, Bucket-Level MOO mitigates interference by driving LLMs to construct distinct language-specific dimensions, improving representational separability. Extensive experiments across four base LLMs demonstrate that our method significantly improves both seen and unseen multilingual performance over standard fine-tuning paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bucket-Level MOO 框架，将多语言微调建模为多目标优化问题，通过在参数桶上本地应用梯度冲突解决算法减少语言间负干扰。理论证明该方法达到更严格的 Pareto 最优条件，实验显示其在通晓和未见语言上均优于标准微调。
Motivation: 多语言 LLM 微调时语言间存在负干扰（negative interference），现有方法缺乏高效的冲突感知优化。
Method: 将多语言微调重新表述为多目标优化问题，提出 Bucket-Level MOO：在参数桶 (parameter bucket) 上本地运行梯度式 MOO 算法，避免重建完整梯度向量的通信开销。理论证明该方法自然满足细化 Pareto 平稳性。
Result: 在四种基础 LLM 上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了通晓和未见语言的多语言性能。
Conclusion: Bucket-Level MOO 通过驱动模型构建语言特异维度来缓解干扰，提高表征可分离性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What's Under the Skin? Estimating Swine Body Condition
papers.abstract_en: Sow body condition is an important indicator for growers as it has a large impact on lactation performance and piglet survival. However, body condition measures used during production, such as visual scoring and calipers, correlate poorly with underlying tissue composition. Ultrasound scans can provide direct measurements of subcutaneous backfat thickness and loin muscle depth, but their operation is labor intensive and not scalable for production. We present PigFormer, an end-to-end two-stage system that takes raw depth frames from a ceiling-mounted RGB-D camera and predicts subcutaneous backfat thickness, loin muscle depth, and total tissue thickness at the last rib. Stage 1 is a geometric front-end that converts raw depth into a standardized height map via SAM3-to-MaskDINO segmentation distillation, ground-plane removal, and orientation normalization. Stage 2 is a Slice Attention Encoder that treats each height map as a sequence of cross-sectional slices and captures spatial relationships along the full dorsal surface. On a multi-site dataset of 319 sow and gilt instances from two facilities, PigFormer achieves 2.43 mm backfat MAE and 3.87 mm overall MAE. It outperforms strong single-stage ResNet-18 and ViT-small baselines. PigFormer offers a practical path toward continuous, automated, non-contact body condition monitoring in commercial swine production. Code is available at https://github.com/iambashar/Pigformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PigFormer 系统，利用天花板安装的 RGB-D 相机预测母猪皮下背膘厚度、腰肌深度和总组织厚度。系统包括几何前端（基于 SAM3-to-MaskDINO 分割蒸馏和姿态归一化）和切片注意力编码器，在多个猪场数据集上实现了 2.43 mm 背膘平均绝对误差。
Motivation: 现有猪体况测量方法（视觉评分、卡尺）与组织成分相关性差，超声扫描劳动密集且不可扩展。需要一种自动、连续、非接触式的监测方案。
Method: 两阶段系统：阶段1利用 SAM3-to-MaskDINO 分割蒸馏从原始深度图生成标准化高度图，进行地面去除和朝向归一化；阶段2采用切片注意力编码器，将高度图视为横截面序列，捕获整个背部表面的空间关系。
Result: 在来自两个设施的 319 个母猪和后备母猪实例上，PigFormer 达到 2.43 mm 背膘平均绝对误差（MAE）和 3.87 mm 总体 MAE，优于 ResNet-18 和 ViT-small 基线。
Conclusion: PigFormer 为商业养猪生产中的连续自动化非接触式体况监测提供了实用途径。代码已开源。

papers.title: SlotGCG: Exploiting the Positional Vulnerability in LLMs for Jailbreak Attacks
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed, identifying their vulnerability through jailbreak attacks becomes increasingly critical. Optimization-based attacks like Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) have focused on inserting adversarial tokens to the end of prompts. However, GCG restricts adversarial tokens to a fixed insertion point (typically the prompt suffix), leaving the effect of inserting tokens at other positions unexplored. In this paper, we empirically investigate \emph{slots}, i.e., candidate positions within a prompt where tokens can be inserted. We find that vulnerability to jailbreaking is highly related to the selection of the \emph{slots}. Based on these findings, we introduce the \textit{Vulnerable Slot Score} (VSS) to quantify the positional vulnerability to jailbreaking. We then propose SlotGCG, which evaluates all slots with VSS, selects the most vulnerable slots for insertion, and runs a targeted optimization attack at those slots. Our approach provides a position-search mechanism that is attack-agnostic and can be plugged into any optimization-based attack, adding only 200ms of preprocessing time. Experiments across multiple models demonstrate that SlotGCG significantly outperforms existing methods. Specifically, it achieves 14\% higher Attack Success Rates (ASR) over GCG-based attacks, converges faster, and shows superior robustness against defense methods with 42\% higher ASR than baseline approaches. Our implementation is available at \href{https://github.com/youai058/SlotGCG}{https://github.com/youai058/SlotGCG}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击，研究了提示中不同位置（称为slot）插入对抗令牌的效果，发现漏洞高度依赖于slot选择。作者提出漏洞插槽分数（VSS）来量化位置脆弱性，并设计SlotGCG方法：先用VSS评估所有插槽，选择最脆弱的插槽进行针对性优化攻击。该方法可插入任何基于优化的攻击，仅增加200ms预处理时间。实验表明，SlotGCG在多个模型上攻击成功率（ASR）比GCG高14%，收敛更快，对防御方法的鲁棒性比基线高42%。
Motivation: 现有基于优化的攻击（如GCG）通常将对抗令牌固定插入提示末尾，忽略了其他插入位置对越狱效果的影响。作者旨在探索不同插入位置（slots）的脆弱性差异，并利用这一发现提升攻击效率与效果。
Method: 提出Vulnerable Slot Score（VSS）用于量化每个候选插入位置（slot）的越狱脆弱性。SlotGCG先计算所有slot的VSS，选择最脆弱的slot，再在该slot运行目标优化攻击（如GCG）。该位置搜索机制与攻击方法无关，可即插即用。
Result: 在多个模型上，SlotGCG的ASR比GCG高14%，收敛更快；在面对防御方法时，ASR比基线高42%。预处理仅增加200ms。
Conclusion: 作者强调SlotGCG通过位置搜索有效提升越狱攻击成功率，且具有通用性和低开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The End of Software Engineering: How AI Agents Are Fundamentally Restructuring the Software Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: For over half a century, software engineering has operated on a foundational premise: human engineers decompose problems, encode decision logic into static code, and manually adapt that code as requirements evolve. This paper argues that the emergence of AI agents -- systems where large language models serve as the primary reasoning engine, dynamically generating and discarding code as an instrumental resource -- constitutes not an incremental improvement but a fundamental restructuring of the software paradigm. Drawing on first-principles analysis of complexity scaling, we formalize the distinction between traditional software (where code is the carrier of decision logic) and agentic systems (where code is ephemeral tooling for an LLM-driven reasoning loop). We trace the historical arc from licensed software to SaaS to what we term Agent-as-a-Service (AaaS), showing that each shift transferred additional complexity away from end-users. We introduce the concept of Agentic Engineering as an emergent discipline -- distinct from software engineering in its core object of study, control model, and human role. Through analysis of recent benchmark evidence including SWE-bench Verified, EvoClaw, and LangChain's multi-agent coordination studies, we demonstrate both the transformative potential of the agentic paradigm and its current limitations. We conclude with a four-stage roadmap toward self-evolving agent ecosystems and concrete recommendations for practitioners navigating this transition.

papers.title: Cross-Epoch Adaptive Rollout Optimization for RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: LLM post-training often relies on reinforcement learning methods that sample multiple rollouts per prompt, yet most existing approaches use a fixed rollout budget for every prompt, despite large differences in the training signal different prompts provide. In this paper, we study adaptive rollout allocation under a fixed global budget and formulate the problem as online resource allocation with prompt-level diminishing returns. Our method, CERO, maintains a Beta posterior over each prompt's success probability and uses the posterior expected Bernoulli variance as a Bayesian estimate of the value of additional rollouts. We use this estimate to construct a concave, saturating utility over cumulative allocations, yielding an objective in which decisions across prompts and epochs are coupled by the global budget. Since the resulting objective is temporally nonseparable, we derive a Fenchel-dual reformulation and update both prompt-level and budget-level dual variables via projected online gradient descent. Under fixed prompt utilities, we prove an $O(\sqrt{K})$ regret bound against the offline allocation benchmark. Experiments on mathematical-reasoning problems show that CERO consistently outperforms GRPO across multiple open-weight LLMs and benchmarks, demonstrating that adaptive rollout budgeting can improve sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）后训练中的强化学习阶段，针对每个提示使用固定采样预算（rollout budget）效率低下的问题，提出跨时代自适应预算分配方法 CERO。该方法将问题建模为在线资源分配，利用 Beta 后验和期望伯努利方差估计每个提示的回报递减特性，通过 Fenchel 对偶和在线梯度下降求解。在数学推理任务上，CERO 在多个开源模型和基准上优于 GRPO，提高了样本效率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后训练的强化学习方法对每个提示使用固定的 rollouts 预算，忽略了不同提示提供训练信号的差异，导致资源浪费和效率低下。
Method: 提出 CERO 方法，为每个提示维护 Beta 后验概率，利用后验期望伯努利方差作为额外 rollouts 价值的贝叶斯估计，构造凹饱和效用函数，并通过 Fenchel 对偶和在线投影梯度下降联合优化提示级和预算级对偶变量。
Result: 在固定提示效用下，证明了对离线分配基准的 O(√K) 遗憾界。在数学推理实验中，CERO 在多个开源 LLM 和基准上一致优于 GRPO。
Conclusion: 自适应 rollouts 预算分配可以提升 LLM 后训练强化学习的样本效率。

papers.title: From Prediction to Self: Developmental Conditions for Agency in Minimal Neural Systems
papers.abstract_en: How does a system that merely predicts the world come to distinguish its own causal influence from everything else? We trace this transition in a minimal 192-dimensional GRU through 40 controlled experiments arranged as a developmental sequence, adding components one at a time and tracking whether the system can distinguish self-caused from world-caused changes. The developmental path reveals four conditions that must be satisfied in strict order: (1) persistent state forming stable attractors, (2) a causal action loop linking output to input, (3) proprioceptive feedback that makes implicit causal knowledge explicit, and (4) asynchronous awakening - perceptual learning must consolidate before action learning begins. We propose agency gain (A = Err_world - Err_self), the predictive advantage of knowing one's own action, as a metric to track this process. The self-aware predictor consistently outperforms the self-blind predictor across periodic (sinusoidal) and chaotic (Lorenz) environments, and the metric survives ablation of all auxiliary components. Only forward-sampled action selection produces meaningful agency gain; two gradient-based alternatives degenerate. Equally significant are 12 falsified hypotheses mapping where development stalls: predictive coding alone does not produce self-represent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过192维GRU的最小神经系统的40个对照实验，研究从世界预测到自我动因（agency）的发展条件。发现必须按顺序满足四个条件：持久状态形成稳定吸引子、因果动作循环、本体感觉反馈使隐式因果知识显式化、异步觉醒（感知学习先于动作学习）。提出动因增益（A = Err_world - Err_self）作为量化指标，自我感知预测器在周期和混沌环境中优于自我盲预测器，且前向采样动作选择是唯一产生有意义动因增益的方式。
Motivation: 理解系统如何从单纯的世界预测者转变为能区分自身因果影响的个体，这对于解释智能体（agency）的涌现至关重要。
Method: 在最小192维GRU系统上设计一系列逐步增加组件的开发序列实验，通过40个对照实验追踪系统区分自因与世界因变化的能力，并验证四个假设条件的必要性。提出动因增益作为度量标准。
Result: 自我感知预测器在正弦和Lorenz环境中持续优于自我盲预测器；只有前向采样动作选择产生有意义的动因增益，两种基于梯度的方法失败。摘要报告了12个被证伪的假说。
Conclusion: 最小神经系统中动因的涌现需要四个条件严格按序满足，动因增益可作为有效追踪指标。预测编码本身不足以产生自我表征。

papers.title: Fix the Mind, Not the Move: Interpretable AI Assistance via Knowledge-Gap Localization
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants in human-AI collaboration often correct suboptimal human actions through behavioral feedback (e.g., alerts or steering-wheel nudges in assistive driving). Such interventions can mitigate immediate errors, but long-term improvement requires addressing the underlying misconceptions that cause repeated mistakes. We introduce SENSEI, a framework that infers user misconceptions from interaction behavior and provides targeted, minimal yet sufficient suggestions to correct them. Our approach departs from action- or trajectory-level interventions by operating over a structured knowledge representation to localize and correct the sources of erroneous behavior. Across three long-horizon tasks with diverse misconceptions and corresponding behaviors, SENSEI demonstrates zero-shot compositional generalization, disentangling multiple overlapping misconceptions despite training only on single-misconception cases. A user study further shows that our method identifies real human misconceptions and provides effective guidance that improves long-horizon task performance, successfully correcting $90\%$ of student misconceptions. Code and project page are available at https://misoshiruseijin.github.io/SENSEI/.
papers.comment: Accepted to International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SENSEI框架，通过结构化知识表示定位人类协作中的误解（而非纠正具体行为），提供最小但充分的纠正建议。在三个长时任务中展现出零样本组合泛化能力，用户研究显示成功纠正90%的学生误解。
Motivation: 现有AI助手通常基于行为反馈纠正即时错误，但无法解决导致重复错误的根本误解，难以实现长期改进。
Method: SENSEI从交互行为推断用户误解，在结构化知识表示上定位知识缺口，并生成针对性、最小充分的建议，而非逐动作或轨迹级干预。
Result: 在三个长时任务上实现零样本组合泛化，能解构多个重叠误解；用户研究中正确识别真实人类误解并有效指导，纠正90%的误解。
Conclusion: SENSEI表明关注心智模型而非行为纠正的干预策略可提升长期任务表现，并为可解释AI辅助提供新方向。

papers.title: Mitigating the Curse of Dimensionality in Uniform Convergence of Deep Neural Networks via Smooth Activations
papers.abstract_en: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for the uniform convergence of smoothly activated deep neural network (DNN) estimators. While standard ReLU networks achieve minimax-optimal rates in the $L^2(P)$ norm for various nonparametric regression tasks, we establish a theoretical lower bound demonstrating that least-squares ReLU estimators can suffer from the curse of dimensionality in their uniform convergence behavior. Motivated by the need for reliable uniform guarantees in downstream tasks requiring worst-case reliability, we address this limitation by analyzing smoothly activated DNNs (smooth DNNs), encompassing both feedforward and residual structures. We establish novel pseudo-dimension bounds, non-asymptotic approximation guarantees, and Hölder-norm bounds for the approximators of these models. Leveraging these results, we derive non-asymptotic uniform convergence rates for smooth DNN estimators across multiple statistical contexts, including Huber, least-squares, quantile, and logistic regression. We prove that smooth DNNs can mitigate the {curse of dimensionality} in uniform convergence by adaptively exploiting the low-dimensional hierarchical composition structure of the target function. Supported by both simulation studies and a real-world application, our results position smooth DNNs as a theoretically grounded and practically viable alternative to ReLU networks for statistical learning tasks requiring uniform guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了一个理论框架，研究平滑激活深度神经网络（DNN）估计器的均匀收敛性。首先证明ReLU最小二乘估计器在均匀收敛中可能遭受维度诅咒，然后证明平滑DNN（包括前馈和残差结构）可以缓解这一问题，通过自适应利用目标函数的低维层次组合结构，在Huber、最小二乘、分位数和逻辑回归等多种统计背景下推导出非渐近均匀收敛率，并通过仿真和实际数据验证。
Motivation: 标准ReLU网络在L2范数下达到极小极大最优率，但其均匀收敛行为可能遭受维度诅咒，限制了需要最坏情况可靠性的下游任务。
Method: 分析平滑激活DNN（前馈和残差结构），建立新的伪维度界、非渐近逼近保证和Hölder范数界，进而推导多种统计模型下的均匀收敛率。
Result: 证明平滑DNN可以缓解均匀收敛中的维度诅咒，通过自适应利用目标函数的低维层次组合结构获得非渐近均匀收敛率。
Conclusion: 平滑DNN在理论上和实践中可作为ReLU网络的替代方案，适用于需要均匀保证的统计学习任务。

papers.title: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Multi-Step RL for Visual Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training vision-language web agents with multi-step RL is compute-intensive, with two dominant forms of inefficiency: idle GPUs in synchronous RL, and trajectories that use more steps and tokens than necessary. We present AsyncWebRL, which addresses both. On the system side, an asynchronous design overlaps rollout, gradient update, and policy refresh across iterations, paired with two web-agent-specific adaptations, namely an everlasting rollout pool and lightweight screenshot handling, that together deliver up to a $2.9\times$ end-to-end training-throughput speedup over the previously fastest open synchronous pipeline (WebGym). On the algorithmic side, we identify the per-trajectory normalizer $1/|τ_i|$ in multi-step GRPO as the root cause of trajectory-level and token-level inefficiency: because failures are systematically longer than successes, it down-weights the negative gradient on failed tokens, so the policy keeps producing verbose memory schemas. Replacing $1/|τ_i|$ with a constant $1/k$ breaks this coupling, contracting trajectories while preserving aggregate success. Together, these contributions set a new open-source state of the art on the WebGym out-of-distribution test split (+5.8% relative over the 42.9% prior best), with the largest gains on the harder slices (+42% relative on Medium, +48% relative on Hard).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AsyncWebRL框架，通过异步设计和算法改进提升多步强化学习训练视觉Web代理的效率；系统端实现端到端训练吞吐量提升2.9倍，算法端通过修改归一化因子使轨迹更紧凑，在WebGym OOD测试集上达到新SOTA（相对提升5.8%）。
Motivation: 同步多步RL训练存在GPU空闲和轨迹过长导致的计算低效问题。
Method: 系统层面采用异步设计（覆盖rollout、梯度更新、策略刷新），并引入永久rollout池和轻量截图处理；算法层面将多步GRPO中的每轨迹归一化因子1/|τ_i|替换为常数1/k，消除失败轨迹对梯度权重的影响。
Result: 与先前最快开源同步管道（WebGym）相比，端到端训练吞吐量加速比达2.9倍；在WebGym OOD测试集上相对最高基线（42.9%）提升5.8%，其中困难子集提升42%（Medium）和48%（Hard）。
Conclusion: 异步设计和归一化改进有效解决了多步RL训练中的计算低效问题，为视觉Web代理训练提供了更高效的方案。

summary_sections.result: 与先前最快开源同步管道（WebGym）相比，端到端训练吞吐量加速比达2.9倍；在WebGym OOD测试集上相对最高基线（42.9%）提升5.8%，其中困难子集提升42%（Medium）和48%（Hard）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 异步设计和归一化改进有效解决了多步RL训练中的计算低效问题，为视觉Web代理训练提供了更高效的方案。

papers.title: Auditing Demonstration Curation Metrics: Action-Only Scorers Fail on the Structural Defects That Degrade Imitation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Imitation-learning policies inherit the quality of the demonstrations they are trained on, and a growing set of curation metrics promise to score and filter low-quality demonstrations automatically. These metrics are each validated on different data with different protocols, so it is unclear which of them actually identify the demonstrations that harm a policy. We build a controlled testbed in which demonstration defects are injected with known type, and audit seven curation metrics along two axes: how well each separates defective from clean demonstrations, and whether training a behavior-cloning policy on each metric's curated subset improves task success. We study two defect regimes. Subtle perturbations (correlated action noise, tremor, truncation) are detectable by multivariate outlier scoring and, once removed, recover the full downstream gap. Structural errors, where the demonstration executes a wrong action at a key moment, are invisible to every action-only metric we test, and two of them are inverted: they score defective demonstrations as higher quality and, used for curation, tend to leave the policy at or below the uncurated baseline rather than above it. Only metrics that examine the state trajectory detect structural errors, and even the best of them recovers just a third of the downstream gap. High detection accuracy does not guarantee downstream improvement. We release the testbed and all curation implementations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模仿学习中的演示筛选指标进行审计。通过注入已知类型的演示缺陷（细微扰动和结构性错误），测试七种指标在检测缺陷和提升下游策略性能方面的效果。发现仅基于动作的指标无法检测结构性错误，且其中两种会反向评分；只有检查状态轨迹的指标能部分检测，但最好也只能恢复三分之一的下游性能差距。高检测精度并不保证下游提升。
Motivation: 现有演示筛选指标在不同数据和协议下验证，不清楚哪些指标真正能识别损害策略的演示。需要系统审计其效果。
Method: 构建受控测试床，注入两类缺陷：细微扰动（相关动作噪声、震颤、截断）和结构性错误（关键时刻执行错误动作）。审计七种指标在分离缺陷与干净演示的能力，以及基于各指标筛选后训练行为克隆策略是否提升任务成功率。
Result: 细微扰动可由多元离群评分检测，去除后完全恢复下游差距。结构性错误对所有仅基于动作的指标不可见，两种甚至反向评分（将缺陷演示评为更高质量），用于筛选后策略性能不高于甚至低于未经过滤的基线。仅检查状态轨迹的指标能检测结构性错误，但最佳指标也只恢复三分之一的下游差距。
Conclusion: 仅基于动作的筛选指标无法应对结构性错误，且高检测精度不保证下游性能提升。需要结合状态轨迹信息来设计更有效的演示筛选策略。

papers.title: HDST-GNN: Heterogeneous Dynamic Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks for Multi-Object Tracking in UAV Aerial Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) from UAV imagery presents unique challenges: altitude varies across sequences, objects are small and densely packed, and frequent occlusion causes identity switches. Existing graph-based trackers assume fixed spatial context and treat all objects uniformly, ignoring the heterogeneous lifecycle states of detections, active tracklets, and lost targets. We propose HDST-GNN, a Heterogeneous Dynamic Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network with three novel contributions. First, Altitude-Adaptive Edge Construction estimates a camera-altitude proxy from mean object area and adjusts the graph connectivity radius accordingly. Second, Heterogeneous Node Representation models detections (Type-D), confirmed tracklets (Type-T), and lost tracklets (Type-L) as distinct node types with dedicated projections and typed edge relations. Third, Occlusion-Gated Temporal Aggregation gates each node's attention contribution by its occlusion confidence, preventing occluded nodes from corrupting neighbour embeddings. HDST-GNN is trained end-to-end with a differentiable Sinkhorn head using joint cross-entropy and triplet loss. On VisDrone2019-MOT with oracle detections, HDST-GNN achieves 94.51% MOTA and 97.24% IDF1, outperforming SORT by +5.0 MOTA points and reducing identity switches by 81%. With real YOLOv8n detections, HDST-GNN reduces identity switches by 49% vs. SORT. Ablation studies confirm the independent contribution of each component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HDST-GNN 提出一种异构动态时空图神经网络，用于解决无人机航拍图像中的多目标跟踪问题。该方法通过高度自适应边构建、异构节点表示和遮挡门控时间聚合三个新贡献，在 VisDrone2019-MOT 数据集上实现了 94.51% MOTA 和 97.24% IDF1，显著优于 SORT。
Motivation: 现有基于图的跟踪器假设固定的空间上下文并统一处理所有目标，忽略了检测、活动轨迹和丢失目标的不同生命周期状态，导致对小而密集的无人机目标跟踪效果不佳。
Method: 提出三种创新：1) Altitude-Adaptive Edge Construction 根据平均目标面积估计相机高度并调整图连接半径；2) Heterogeneous Node Representation 将检测、确认轨迹和丢失轨迹作为不同类型节点，使用专用投影和类型化边关系；3) Occlusion-Gated Temporal Aggregation 根据遮挡置信度门控每个节点的注意力贡献，防止遮挡节点污染邻居嵌入。
Result: 在 VisDrone2019-MOT 上使用 oracle 检测时，MOTA 达 94.51%，IDF1 达 97.24%，身份切换减少 81%；使用真实 YOLOv8n 检测时，身份切换比 SORT 减少 49%。消融实验验证了各组件的独立贡献。
Conclusion: HDST-GNN 通过异构节点建模和遮挡感知机制有效提升了无人机多目标跟踪的准确性，尤其减少了身份切换。

papers.title: BMCR: Adaptive Backbone Module Composition via Reinforcement Learning for Remote Sensing Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: In remote sensing object detection, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) excel at capturing local details while Vision Transformers (ViTs) are better at global context modeling. However, existing detectors typically rely on a single fixed backbone or a manually designed hybrid architecture, and thus fail to adaptively exploit these complementary strengths across inputs of diverse complexity. To address this limitation, we propose Backbone Module Composition via Reinforcement Learning (BMCR). BMCR dynamically assembles input-adaptive inference paths from reusable modules decomposed from off-the-shelf CNN and ViT backbones. To enable such cross-family composition, we first construct an extensible module toolbox. Specifically, we decompose representative CNN and ViT backbones into reusable functional modules and encapsulate each module with explicit structural, semantic, and computational metadata for compatibility-aware assembly. To bridge the gap between grid-based CNN features and token-based ViT representations, we design a lightweight Optimal Transport (OT) based transition interface that ensures distribution-aware alignment while respecting spatial consistency. The backbone composition process is then formulated as a sequential decision problem, in which a policy network progressively selects task-relevant modules according to intermediate multi-scale observations. To stabilize the joint optimization of reusable modules and the routing policy, we further develop an Adaptive Module Cooperative Optimization (AMCO) strategy that coordinates module updating, routing exploration, and reward assignment during training. On DOTA-v1.0, DOTA-v1.5 and DIOR-R, BMCR achieves 79.31\%, 73.41\% and 71.86\% mAP, respectively, surpassing strong static and dynamic baselines by up to 2.5 points while maintaining competitive efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BMCR方法，通过强化学习动态组合CNN和ViT的模块，用于遥感目标检测。该方法将预训练骨干分解为可复用模块，并设计基于最优传输的过渡接口来桥接网格与令牌特征，通过策略网络逐步选择模块构建自适应推理路径。在DOTA-v1.0、DOTA-v1.5和DIOR-R数据集上，BMCR分别达到79.31%、73.41%和71.86%的mAP，超越静态和动态基线最多2.5个点，同时保持竞争效率。
Motivation: 现有遥感目标检测器通常依赖单一固定骨干或手动混合架构，无法自适应地利用CNN局部细节和ViT全局上下文的互补优势，从而限制了检测性能。
Method: 提出Backbone Module Composition via Reinforcement Learning (BMCR)：首先将代表性CNN和ViT骨干分解为可复用功能模块并封装元数据；设计轻量级最优传输(OT)过渡接口实现分布感知对齐；将骨干组合过程建模为序列决策问题，由策略网络根据中间多尺度观察逐步选择模块；并采用Adaptive Module Cooperative Optimization (AMCO)策略联合优化模块和路由策略。
Result: 在DOTA-v1.0、DOTA-v1.5和DIOR-R上分别达到79.31%、73.41%和71.86% mAP，超越静态和动态基线最多2.5个点，且保持竞争效率。
Conclusion: BMCR通过动态组合CNN和ViT模块有效提升了遥感目标检测的适应性，但摘要未明确讨论在极端气象场景或降水估计方面的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction for Cyberattack Classification: A Comparative Evaluation of PCA and Linear Predictive Coding
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional feature representations are widely used in machine learning-based cyberattack detection systems. However, they increase computational complexity and may hinder deployment in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we investigate feature compression techniques for cyberattack classification by comparing two dimensionality reduction approaches: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Predictive Coding (LPC). Compressed feature representations with varying dimensionalities are generated and evaluated across several classification models. Experimental analysis demonstrates that PCA preserves classification performance even under aggressive compression. On the other hand, LPC provides competitive predictive representations with slightly larger performance degradation. The results show that substantial reductions in feature dimensionality can be achieved with minimal impact on classification accuracy, highlighting the potential of lightweight feature compression for efficient cybersecurity analytics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了主成分分析（PCA）和线性预测编码（LPC）两种降维方法在网络攻击分类中的效果。实验表明PCA在强压缩下仍能保持分类性能，而LPC性能略有下降。研究显示大幅降低特征维度对分类准确率影响很小，适合资源受限环境下的轻量级网络安全分析。
Motivation: 高维特征表示在网络攻击检测中广泛使用，但增加了计算复杂度，阻碍了在资源受限环境中的部署，因此需要有效的特征压缩技术。
Method: 采用PCA和LPC两种方法生成不同维度的压缩特征，并在多种分类模型上进行评估比较。
Result: PCA在强压缩下仍能保持分类性能，LPC性能略有下降；大幅降维对分类准确率影响极小。
Conclusion: 实现了显著的特征维度缩减且对精度影响有限，证明了轻量级特征压缩在高效网络安全分析中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Monte Carlo Steklov Operators for Large-Scale Geometry Processing in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic methods fill the default toolbox for geometry processing on meshes. Intrinsic operators, in particular the Laplacian, underlie methods that require invariance to isometry and have hence been employed in many algorithms for shape analysis, learning, and editing. However, intrinsic methods are predicated on assumptions that quickly become brittle when working with in-the-wild geometry, where (i) mesh quality is not guaranteed, and (ii) many meshes are modeled with multiple connected components. In such settings, volumetric constructions are better-defined, since restrictions on surface topology can be relaxed. This paper presents a Monte Carlo method for estimating the Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DtN) operator -- a boundary-to-boundary volumetric operator -- and its associated Steklov eigenmodes. We build on recent developments in Monte Carlo geometry processing by casting this boundary operator itself as the subject of estimation. The DtN operator, defined through a volumetric stochastic process, is then generalized to the exterior domain, where it couples disconnected components through the surrounding ambient space. We show that our method is orders of magnitude faster than existing boundary-element approaches for computing Steklov spectra while remaining robust to poor triangulations, high-resolution meshes, and multi-component geometry. To demonstrate this scalability, we compute interior and exterior Steklov eigenspectra for approximately 450,000 shapes from the uncurated Objaverse dataset. We incorporate these operators into Steklov-CLIP, a mesh-based neural network that uses volumetric spectral operators for large-scale contrastive 3D representation learning. The resulting network learns semantically meaningful global and dense shape representations, illustrating that geometrically-principled volumetric operators can be made practical at the scale of modern 3D datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种蒙特卡洛方法用于估计Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DtN) 算子及其关联的Steklov特征模式，该算子是一种边界到边界的体算子。通过将边界算子本身作为估计对象，该方法对低质量网格、高分辨率网格和多组件几何具有鲁棒性，且比现有边界元方法快数个数量级。作者在未经整理的Objaverse数据集（约45万形状）上计算了内部和外部Steklov谱，并集成到Steklov-CLIP神经网络中，用于大规模的对比3D表示学习，证明了体算子在大规模3D数据集上的实用性。
Motivation: 内在方法（如拉普拉斯算子）在处理真实世界几何时存在局限性：网格质量无保证且许多网格含多个连通组件。体构造在这些场景下更合理，但现有体算子计算方法在大规模数据集上效率不足。
Method: 开发蒙特卡洛方法直接估计Dirichlet-to-Neumann算子，将其作为随机过程的边界算子，并推广到外部域以通过环境空间耦合断开组件。
Result: 该方法在计算Steklov谱上比现有边界元方法快数个数量级，并对低质量三角剖分、高分辨率网格和多组件几何保持鲁棒。在Objaverse的约45万形状上成功计算了内部和外部Steklov特征谱。
Conclusion: 作者展示了几何上有原则的体算子可以变得足够实用，以应用于现代3D数据集的大规模学习中，Steklov-CLIP网络学习了语义上有意义的全局和密集形状表示。
