summary_sections.result: MSAT在复杂几何问题Heat2D-CG上达到相对L2误差0.0101，比FNO提升3.7倍；推理时间34秒，远低于Mamba-NO的120812秒。物理正则项在扩散问题上有益，但在混沌和回流问题上损害泛化。理论误差界与边界复杂度κ相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: MSAT在非规则几何PDE求解上优于傅里叶方法，但物理正则项并非通用有益，存在先验误指定边界。论文提供了架构选择的理论和经验指导。

papers.title: SHRED: Retain-Set-Free Unlearning via Self-Distillation with Logit Demotion
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to selectively remove memorized content such as private data, copyrighted text, or hazardous knowledge, without costly full retraining. Most existing methods require a retain set of curated examples to prevent catastrophic degradation of general model utility, creating an extra data dependency that complicates deployment. We propose SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlearning method built on a key insight: not all tokens within a forget set instance carry memorized information equally. High-information tokens concentrate the model's memorized knowledge, while low-information tokens reflect general language competence. SHRED operates in two stages. (1) Selection: We perform a forward pass on a forget set instance, collect per-token autoregressive probabilities, and select the bottom (lowest probability, highest Shannon information) as forget positions; the remaining positions are retained as benign anchors. (2) Training: We construct modified KL targets that demote the memorized token's logit at forget positions while preserving the original distribution at benign positions. The model is then trained via a single top KL self-distillation objective that simultaneously drives forgetting and utility preservation. We evaluate SHRED across four standard unlearning benchmarks and demonstrate that it establishes a new Pareto-optimal trade-off between forget efficacy and model utility, outperforming retain-set-dependent methods. Our analysis shows that SHRED is robust against relearning attacks and membership-inference attacks, and it maintains stable utility even after many sequential unlearning runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHRED，一种无需保留集的大语言模型机器遗忘方法，通过自蒸馏和logit降级实现。方法在四个标准遗忘基准上达到新的帕累托最优权衡，既有效遗忘又保持模型效用，且对重学习和成员推理攻击鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法通常需要保留集来防止模型效用退化，这引入了额外的数据依赖并增加了部署复杂性。本文旨在消除这一依赖，提出一种无需保留集的遗忘方法。
Method: SHRED分两阶段：(1) 选择阶段，对遗忘集实例进行前向传播，根据token概率选择低概率高信息量的token作为遗忘位置，其余作为良性锚点；(2) 训练阶段，构建修改的KL散度目标，在遗忘位置降级logit，在良性位置保持原始分布，通过单一自蒸馏目标同时驱动遗忘和效用保持。
Result: 在四个标准遗忘基准上，SHRED建立了新的帕累托最优权衡，遗忘效果和模型效用均优于依赖保留集的方法。它还对重学习攻击和成员推理攻击具有鲁棒性，并能在多次连续遗忘后保持稳定的模型效用。
Conclusion: SHRED证明了无需保留集的遗忘是可行的，且能达到甚至超越有保留集方法的表现，同时具有更好的鲁棒性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Query-efficient model evaluation using cached responses
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating a new model on an existing benchmark is often necessary to understand its behavior before deployment. For modern evaluation frameworks, generating and evaluating a response for all queries can be prohibitively expensive. In practice, responses from previously-evaluated models are often cached -- creating a potential opportunity to use this additional information to decrease the number of queries required to accurately evaluate a new model. In this paper, we introduce an approach for predicting benchmark performance that leverages cached model responses based on the Data Kernel Perspective Space (DKPS), a method for quantifying the relationship between models in the black-box setting. Theoretically, we show that DKPS-based methods are query-efficient under certain conditions. Empirically, we demonstrate that DKPS-based methods achieve the same mean absolute error as baselines with a substantially decreased query budget. We conclude by proposing an offline method for selecting a set of queries that maximizes the goodness-of-fit on reference models, improving prediction accuracy over random query selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用缓存模型响应来减少评估新模型所需查询次数的方法。基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）量化黑盒模型间关系，理论证明其查询高效性，实验表明在相同误差下显著降低查询预算。最后提出离线查询选择方法优化预测精度。
Motivation: 现代评估框架中，对新模型在基准上的评估需要大量查询，成本高昂，而先前评估的模型响应往往被缓存但未充分利用。
Method: 利用缓存模型响应，基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）预测新模型在基准上的性能，并理论上证明其查询高效性。还提出离线查询选择方法，基于参考模型拟合优度最大化。
Result: 实验表明，DKPS方法在达到相同平均绝对误差的前提下，显著降低了查询预算。离线查询选择方法相比随机选择提升了预测精度。
Conclusion: 本文方法在查询高效模型评估方面有潜力，但未提及局限性和适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Training for Visual Foresight Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual Foresight VLA (VF-VLA) has become a prominent architectural choice in the recent VLA due to its impressive performance. Nevertheless, the inherent design of VF-VLA makes it particularly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts. Because the quality of action directly depends on the accuracy of the predicted future visual information, OOD conditions affect both stages at once. To address this vulnerability, we propose Test-Time Training Visual Foresight VLA ($T^3$VF), a test-time training approach motivated by the observation that the predicted future image and its subsequent observation form a natural supervision pair. To further address the practical challenges that arise from indiscriminate test-time updates, we introduce an adaptive update filtering mechanism. Empirically, $T^3$VF mitigates the OOD vulnerability of VF-VLA at a modest additional inference cost, without requiring any architectural modification or auxiliary modules.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Continual Adaptation at Scale (CATS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测试时训练方法 $T^3$VF，用于增强视觉预见性 VLA（VF-VLA）模型在分布外（OOD）场景下的鲁棒性。通过利用预测的未来图像与后续观测形成的自然监督对进行自适应更新，并引入自适应更新过滤机制以避免无效更新。实验表明，该方法在不改变模型架构或增加辅助模块的情况下，以较小的推理开销缓解了 OOD 脆弱性。
Motivation: VF-VLA 架构因动作质量直接依赖于未来视觉信息的预测准确性，对分布外（OOD）变化特别敏感，导致两个阶段同时退化。
Method: 提出测试时训练方法 $T^3$VF，利用预测的未来图像与真实观测之间的自然监督对进行在线更新，并设计自适应更新过滤机制来抑制盲目更新。
Result: 该方法在温和的额外推理成本下有效缓解了 VF-VLA 在 OOD 条件下的性能下降，无需架构修改或辅助模块。
Conclusion: 论文认为测试时训练是提升 VF-VLA 鲁棒性的有效途径，但当前方法可能仍面临计算开销和过滤机制调参的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards an Inferentialist Account of Information Through Proof-theoretic Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Information is one of the most widely-discussed concepts of the current era. However, a great deal of insightful work notwithstanding, it is yet to be given wholly convincing logical or mathematical foundations. Without them, we lack adequate reasoning tools for understanding the complex ecosystems of systems upon which the society depends. We seek to rectify this by taking a first step towards developing an inferentialist semantic theory of information. There are three key interacting components. First, conceptual analysis: the metaphysics of information. Dretske expressed the key concepts of information in terms of intentionality, truth, and transmissibility. We replace truth with inferability, and trace the consequences of this replacement. Second, logic: proof-theoretic semantics (P-tS) provides a mathematical-logical realization of inferentialist reasoning. Using P-tS, we develop the first steps towards a mathematical-logical theory of an inferentialist primitive unit of information, the 'inferon'. This proof-theoretic approach counterpoints the model-theoretic view of information articulated in situation theory. Furthermore, we argue that it facilitates addressing all three components of van Benthem and Martinez's categorization of the understandings of information, as range, as correlation, and as code. Our focus is on information-as-correlation. Third, systems: the P-tS tools we develop provide the basis for a mathematical account of distributed systems modelling -- a key tool from informatics for understanding the organization of information processing systems. This yields a reasoning-based theory of information flow in models of distributed systems. Overall, we seek to give a conceptually rigorous mathematical-logical account of information and its role within informatics, grounded in inference and reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于推理主义 (inferentialist) 的信息语义理论，通过证明论语义 (proof-theoretic semantics) 构建信息的基本单元“inferon”，以替代传统模型论视角。该理论包含概念分析、逻辑基础和系统建模三个相互作用的部分，旨在为信息提供严谨的数学逻辑基础，并应用于分布式系统建模。
Motivation: 信息缺乏令人信服的逻辑或数学基础，导致社会依赖的复杂系统生态系统缺乏足够的推理工具。
Method: 采用三部分方法：概念分析（用可推理性替代真值）、逻辑（基于证明论语义提出“inferon”作为信息基本单元）、以及系统建模（将所发展的工具用于分布式系统的数学描述）。
Result: 声称该理论能够涵盖 van Benthem 和 Martinez 对信息的三种理解（范围、相关性、代码），尤其聚焦于信息作为相关性 (information-as-correlation)，并为分布式系统中的信息流提供基于推理的数学基础。
Conclusion: 目标在于给出一个概念严谨的、基于推理和推理的信息数学逻辑理论，并阐明其在信息学 (informatics) 中的作用。

papers.title: Tamaththul3D: High-Fidelity 3D Saudi Sign Language Avatars from Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D sign language avatar reconstruction methods are developed and evaluated exclusively on Western sign languages, and no 3D parametric annotations exist for any Arabic Sign Language dataset, a gap that blocks the development of avatar-based accessibility applications for the Arab Deaf community. We release the first SMPL-X parametric annotations for the Ishara-500 Saudi Sign Language dataset, enabling quantitative evaluation and downstream sign language generation for Arabic Sign Language. We introduce Tamaththul3D, a reconstruction pipeline that aligns hand and body estimates through geometric inverse kinematics on the forearm chain followed by 2D-supervised shoulder refinement. The closed-form integration is decoupled from the specific choice of body and hand estimators: any SMPL-X-compatible body estimator and any MANO-compatible hand estimator can be substituted, as we demonstrate by swapping each module independently. Tamaththul3D achieves up to 32% lower hand error than prior methods, runs 32x faster than the strongest baseline, and generalizes across five typologically distinct sign languages without dataset-specific adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有3D手语虚拟形象重建仅针对西方手语的问题，首次为沙特手语数据集Ishara-500提供SMPL-X参数化标注，并提出Tamaththul3D重建管道，通过几何逆运动学对齐手部和身体估计，再通过2D监督优化肩部。该方法与具体身体/手部估计器解耦，可替换模块。在多种手语上，手部误差降低达32%，推理速度比最强基线快32倍，且无需数据集特定适配即可泛化至五种不同类型手语。
Motivation: 现有3D手语虚拟形象重建方法只针对西方手语开发，缺乏阿拉伯手语数据集及其3D参数化标注，阻碍了面向阿拉伯聋人群体的虚拟形象可访问性应用开发。
Method: 提出Tamaththul3D管道：先通过几何逆运动学（inverse kinematics）在前臂链上对齐手部和身体估计，再进行2D监督的肩部优化。该集成方法不依赖特定身体/手部估计器，可替换任何SMPL-X兼容的身体估计器和MANO兼容的手部估计器。
Result: 手部误差较先前方法降低32%，推理速度比最强基线快32倍，并在五种不同类型手语上（无需数据集适配）展现出泛化能力。
Conclusion: 首次为阿拉伯手语数据集提供SMPL-X参数化标注，并证明所提方法在多种手语上的通用性和高效性，为手语虚拟形象的实用化奠基。

papers.title: Learning to Theorize the World from Observation
papers.abstract_en: What does it mean to understand the world? Contemporary world models often operationalize understanding as accurate future prediction in latent or observation space. Developmental cognitive science, however, suggests a different view: human understanding emerges through the construction of internal theories of how the world works, even before mature language is acquired. Inspired by this theory-building view of cognition, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize, a learning paradigm for inferring explicit explanatory theories of the world from raw, non-textual observations. We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a probabilistic neural model that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model. In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena. Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Learning-to-Theorize范式，从原始非文本观测中学习显性解释性世界理论。具体实现为Neural Theorizer (NEO)，通过概率神经模型将观测归纳为可执行组合程序（思维语言），实验表明这种解释驱动的泛化使观测能被理解为生成程序。
Motivation: 现有世界模型将理解等同于未来预测，但认知科学表明理解源于内部理论构建，因此需要新范式从观测中推断解释性理论。
Method: 引入Learning-to-Theorize范式，实例化为NEO，学习作为思维语言的潜在程序，通过共享转移模型执行，理论表示为可执行组合程序。

papers.title: Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings that require nuanced ethical reasoning, yet existing bias evaluations treat model outputs as simply "biased" or "unbiased." This binary framing misses the gradual, context-sensitive way bias actually emerges. We address this gap in two stages: behavioral profiling and mechanistic validation. In the behavioral stage, we introduce the Moral Sensitivity Index (MSI), a metric that quantifies the probability of biased output across a graduated, seven-tier stress test ranging from abstract numerical problems to scenarios rooted in historical and socioeconomic injustice. Evaluating four leading models (Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.5, Llama 3, and Gemini 1.5), we identify distinct behavioral signatures shaped by alignment design: for instance, Gemini 1.5 reaches 72.7% MSI by Tier 5 under socioeconomic framing, while Claude exhibits sharp suppression consistent with identity-based safety training. We then verify these behavioral patterns mechanistically. We select criminal-bias scenarios, which produced the highest MSI scores across models, as probes and apply logit lens, attention analysis, activation patching, and semantic probing to a controlled set of six models spanning three capability tiers: small language models (SLMs), instruction-tuned base models, and reasoning-distilled variants. Circuit-level analysis reveals a U-curve of bias: SLMs exhibit strong criminal bias; scaling to instruction-tuned models eliminates it; reasoning distillation reintroduces bias to SLM-like levels despite identical parameter counts, suggesting distillation compresses reasoning traces in ways that reactivate shallow statistical associations. Critically, the socially loaded cues that drive high MSI scores activate the same bias-driving circuits identified mechanistically, providing cross-stage validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在伦理推理中的偏见评估过于二元化的问题，提出分两阶段的方法：行为剖析和机制验证。引入道德敏感性指数（MSI）进行七级压力测试，评估四个主流模型，发现不同对齐设计导致不同行为特征。其次，以犯罪偏见场景为探针，对六个模型（涵盖SLM、指令微调基础模型、推理蒸馏变体）进行电路级分析，揭示了偏见的U形曲线：SLM有强偏见，指令微调消除偏见，推理蒸馏重新引入偏见。
Motivation: 现有偏见评估将模型输出简单分为“有偏”或“无偏”，忽视了偏见逐渐出现的上下文敏感性。
Method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段行为剖析，提出MSI指标进行七级压力测试；第二阶段机制验证，选取犯罪偏见场景，应用logit lens、注意力分析、激活修补、语义探针对六个模型进行电路级分析。
Result: 发现不同对齐设计的模型有不同的行为特征，例如Gemini 1.5在第五级社会经济框架下MSI达72.7%，Claude表现为抑制。电路分析揭示偏见的U形曲线：SLM强偏见，指令微调消除，推理蒸馏重新引入。
Conclusion: 论文强调跨阶段验证了高层行为与底层电路的一致性，提示推理蒸馏可能通过压缩推理痕迹而重新激活浅层统计关联。

papers.title: Controllable and Verifiable Process Data Synthesis for Process Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Process reward models (PRMs) rely on high-quality process supervision data, yet existing construction methods often provide limited control over error location, error type, and trajectory consistency. We propose a controllable and verifiable framework for synthesizing process supervision data for PRMs. Our framework first constructs a correct symbolic reasoning chain, injects a template-aware error into an intermediate step, recomputes subsequent steps under the corrupted state, and verifies that the injected step is not derivable from its prefix. The resulting paired trajectories are prefix-invalid at the first error while remaining trajectory-consistent after symbolic recomputation, and are translated into aligned natural-language processes for PRM training and evaluation. Experiments show that the synthesized data improve Best-of-8 reranking on logical reasoning benchmarks and transfer to mathematical reasoning. Step-level evaluation further shows that first-error localization remains substantially more challenging than overall step classification, highlighting the need for fine-grained and verifiable process supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可控且可验证的框架，用于合成过程监督数据以训练过程奖励模型（PRMs）。该框架在正确的符号推理链中注入模板感知的错误，重新计算后续步骤，并验证注入步骤不可从前缀推导，生成前缀无效且轨迹一致的配对数据，再翻译为对齐的自然语言过程。实验表明合成数据提升了逻辑推理基准上的Best-of-8重排序性能，并迁移到数学推理。
Motivation: 现有过程奖励模型依赖高质量过程监督数据，但构建方法对错误位置、错误类型和轨迹一致性的控制有限。
Method: 框架首先构建正确的符号推理链，在中间步骤注入模板感知的错误，在错误状态下重新计算后续步骤，验证注入步骤不可从前缀推导，从而生成配对轨迹，再转换为自然语言过程。
Result: 合成数据在逻辑推理基准上提升了Best-of-8重排序性能，并迁移到数学推理；步骤级评估表明首个错误定位比整体步骤分类更具挑战性。
Conclusion: 需要细粒度且可验证的过程监督数据来提升过程奖励模型。

papers.title: JI-ADF: Joint-Individual Learning with Adaptive Decision Fusion for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Skin lesion classification is essential for early dermatological diagnosis, yet many existing computer-aided systems rely primarily on dermoscopic images and underutilize the multimodal evidence routinely available in clinical practice. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{JI-ADF}, a trimodal deep learning framework that integrates dermoscopic images, clinical photographs, and structured patient metadata for clinically grounded skin lesion classification. The proposed architecture combines joint multimodal representation learning with modality-specific auxiliary supervision and an adaptive decision fusion mechanism that dynamically calibrates modality contributions on a per-sample basis. To enhance cross-modal reasoning while preserving modality-specific evidence, we further introduce a multimodal fusion attention (MMFA) module. We evaluate JI-ADF on the large-scale MILK10k benchmark, which reflects real-world clinical acquisition conditions and severe class imbalance. The proposed method demonstrates strong and well-balanced performance across lesion categories, improving sensitivity and Dice score while maintaining high specificity and good calibration. Extensive analyses, including modality ablation, calibration evaluation, and Grad-CAM visualization, further confirm the robustness and clinically meaningful behavior of the model. These results indicate that JI-ADF provides a reliable and practical foundation for multimodal skin lesion classification in real-world clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JI-ADF，一个三模态深度学习框架，融合皮肤镜图像、临床照片和结构化患者元数据用于皮肤病变分类。框架结合联合多模态表示学习、模态特定辅助监督和自适应决策融合，并引入多模态融合注意力模块。在MILK10k基准上，该方法在各类病变中表现均衡，提升了灵敏度和Dice分数，同时保持高特异性和良好校准。
Motivation: 现有计算机辅助皮肤病变分类系统多依赖单一皮肤镜图像，未能充分利用临床实践中常规可用的多模态证据。
Method: JI-ADF采用联合-个体学习架构，包含联合多模态表示学习、模态特定辅助监督和自适应决策融合机制，并设计多模态融合注意力模块增强跨模态推理。
Result: 在MILK10k大规模基准上，JI-ADF在各类病变中取得均衡性能，提高了灵敏度和Dice分数，同时保持高特异性和良好校准。模态消融、校准评估和Grad-CAM可视化验证了模型的鲁棒性和临床意义。
Conclusion: JI-ADF为实际临床环境下的多模态皮肤病变分类提供了可靠且实用的基础。

papers.title: Calibrated Surprise: An Information-Theoretic Account of Creative Quality
papers.abstract_en: In the era of large language models, creative writing quality lacks a computable theoretical anchor. The dominant approaches are rubric scoring -- decomposing holistic aesthetic judgment into sub-scores -- and RLHF preference signals -- replacing quality with group votes. Both bypass the statistical structure of the text itself. This paper provides an information-theoretic foundation to fill this gap. We propose 'calibrated surprise' as the information-theoretic essence of excellent creative writing. This judgment matches reading intuition and covers its opposite. This literary judgment admits a precise mathematical formulation. Under full-dimensional constraints Y, feasible writing choices are forced into an extremely narrow space. The rare survivors are, from the unconstrained perspective, exactly the least predictable choices. Both are measured precisely by Shannon mutual information I(X;Y) = H(X) - H(X|Y) -- 'calibrated' corresponds to H(X|Y) approaching 0; 'surprising' corresponds to H(X) going high. The subtraction structure of the formula naturally separates 'well-grounded surprise' from 'pure noise'. We use token-level logprobs from Qwen1.5-7B as an operational proxy for the ideal reader's probability distribution. Across 20 pairs (12 Chinese / 8 English) of high-quality vs. systematically degraded literary passages, 20/20 pairs support the core prediction: high-quality passages have systematically higher I(X;Y) than their degraded versions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“校准惊讶度”（calibrated surprise）作为创造性写作质量的信息论基础，用香农互信息 I(X;Y) 量化，其中高互信息代表高质量。用 Qwen1.5-7B 的 token 级 logprobs 作为理想读者概率分布的代理，在 20 对高质量 vs 降质文学段落中验证了预测。
Motivation: 现有创意写作质量评估缺乏可计算的理论锚点，常用评分法和 RLHF 偏好信号都绕过了文本自身的统计结构。
Method: 提出“校准惊讶度”，将高质量写作定义为在完整约束下稀有且最不可预测的选择，用互信息 I(X;Y) 定量刻画，其中 H(X|Y)→0 对应“校准”，H(X) 高对应“惊讶”。
Result: 在 20 对（12 中文/8 英文）高质量与降质文学段落中，所有 20 对都支持核心预测：高质量段落具有系统性更高的 I(X;Y)。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法填补了创造性写作质量的理论空白，提供了信息论解释。

papers.title: Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个五阶段的AI素养发展连续体（0未参与、1不加批判的使用、2知情使用、3批判性评估、4改进），用于高等教育中诊断学生AI使用的发展取向。基于北卡罗来纳州立大学的设计实施案例（2024-2026年，超330参与者），观察到参与者行为从非参与或盲目使用向知情使用转变，持续的学科嵌入体验产生更强的批判性评估和改进导向实践。文章认为AI素养应被理解为发展性能力而非单纯工具采用。
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架缺乏诊断起点和进展路径的指导，学生常处于回避或盲目依赖两个极端。
Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体，并基于大学课程和研讨会的设计实施案例进行观察性研究。
Result: 参与者表现出从非参与或盲目使用向知情使用的行为转变，持续的学科嵌入体验产生更强的批判性评估和改进实践证据。
Conclusion: AI素养应被理解为在学科和社会背景下理解、评估和负责任应用AI系统的发展性能力，而非单纯工具采用。

papers.title: RAS: a Reliability Oriented Metric for Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition systems often produce confident yet incorrect transcriptions under noisy or ambiguous conditions, which can be misleading for both users and downstream applications. Standard evaluation based on Word Error Rate focuses solely on accuracy and fails to capture transcription reliability. We introduce an abstention-aware transcription framework that enables ASR models to explicitly abstain from uncertain segments. To evaluate reliability under abstention, we propose RAS, a reliability-oriented metric that balances transcription informativeness and error aversion, with its trade-off parameter calibrated by human preference. We then train an abstention-aware ASR model through supervised bootstrapping followed by reinforcement learning. Our experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in transcription reliability while maintaining competitive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAS（可靠性导向指标）用于评估语音识别系统的转录可靠性，并引入一种允许模型对不确定片段主动弃权（abstention）的框架。通过监督引导和强化学习训练弃权感知的ASR模型，实验表明在保持竞争性精度的同时显著提升了转录可靠性。
Motivation: 标准WER指标仅关注准确性，无法捕捉高置信度下错误转录的问题，这在噪声或模糊条件下对用户和下游应用具有误导性。
Method: 提出弃权感知转录框架，允许ASR模型显式弃权不确定片段；设计RAS指标平衡转录信息量和错误规避，其权衡参数通过人类偏好校准；采用监督引导（bootstrapping）后接强化学习训练弃权感知模型。
Result: 摘要报告在保持竞争性精度的同时，转录可靠性获得实质性提升。
Conclusion: RAS指标和弃权框架能有效提升ASR系统在困难条件下的可靠性，且无需牺牲过多准确性。

papers.title: RAT: RunAnyThing via Fully Automated Environment Configuration
papers.abstract_en: Automating repository-level software engineering tasks is a foundational challenge for autonomous code agents, largely due to the difficulty of configuring executable environments. However, manual configuration remains a labor-intensive bottleneck, necessitating a transition toward fully automated environment configuration. Existing approaches often rely on pre-defined artifacts or are restricted to specific programming languages, limiting their applicability to diverse real-world repositories. In this paper, we first propose RAT (RunAnyThing), a modular and extensible agent framework for fully automated configuration across programming languages on arbitrary repositories. RAT adopts a multi-stage pipeline that integrates language-aware abstraction, image initialization, specialized configuration toolset, and robust sandbox. Furthermore, to enable rigorous evaluation, we propose RATBench, a benchmark reflects the comprehensive coverage of real-world repositories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RAT achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Environment Setup Success Rate (ESSR) by an average of 36.1% over strong baselines.

TL;DR: 本文提出RAT，一个模块化可扩展的代理框架，用于全自动配置任意仓库的跨编程语言环境。采用多级流水线集成语言感知抽象、镜像初始化、专用配置工具集和鲁棒沙箱。还提出RATBench基准，实验表明RAT将环境设置成功率平均提升36.1%。

papers.title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 50 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Open-H-Embodiment，迄今为止最大的医疗机器人视频与同步运动学开放数据集，涵盖50多个机构、多种机器人平台（如da Vinci、dVRK、CMR Versius等）。基于该数据集，作者训练了两个基础模型：GR00T-H（视觉-语言-动作模型）在结构化缝合基准中达到25%的端到端完成率（其他模型为0%），并在29步体外缝合序列中实现64%平均成功率；Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator是首个能从单个检查点支持9个手术平台的多种具身仿真的动作条件世界模型。结果表明，开放的大规模医疗机器人数据收集可成为基础研究和社区基础设施的关键推动力。
Motivation: 现有医疗机器人数据集规模小、单一具身、缺乏开放共享，限制了基础模型的发展，从而阻碍了自主医疗机器人技术的进步。
Method: 联合50多个机构收集了多种机器人平台（包括da Vinci、dVRK、CMR Versius等）的手术操作、机器人超声和内窥镜视频及同步运动学数据，构建了最大规模开放数据集。基于该数据，训练了GR00T-H（视觉-语言-动作模型）和Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator（动作条件世界模型）。
Result: GR00T-H在结构化缝合基准中实现25%试验的完全端到端完成（其他模型为0%），并在29步体外缝合序列中达到64%平均成功率。Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator首次从单个检查点支持9种手术平台的多种具身仿真，可用于策略评估和合成数据生成。
Conclusion: 开放的大规模医疗机器人数据收集可以作为关键基础设施，推动机器人学习、世界模型等领域的进步。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Layer Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in natural language understanding and reasoning, while recent extensions that incorporate visual inputs enable them to process multimodal information. Despite these advances, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) incur substantial computational and memory costs, hindering deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing layer pruning methods typically rely on local similarity metrics or static proxy signals, failing to capture the global and dynamic evolution of representations across model depth, which often leads to the removal of transition-critical layers. To address this limitation, we propose a topology-aware layer pruning framework for LVLMs. Specifically, we represent layer wise hidden states as point clouds and models their evolution using \textit{simplicial complexes}. By leveraging \textit{zigzag persistent homology}, we quantify inter-layer topological consistency and enable adaptive pruning that preserves critical representational transitions. Extensive experiments on diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing pruning methods across a wide range of sparsity ratios. Our code is available at https://github.com/zpc456/TopoVLM.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been withdrawn by the authors. It reproduced the methodology of Gardinazzi et al., arXiv:2410.11042, without citation, and utilized code and data from the associated repository (github.com/RitAreaSciencePark/ZigZagLLMs) without disclosure or violate the MIT License. A revised future version with full attribution may be prepared. For any feedback, please contact Pengcheng Zheng
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种拓扑感知的层剪枝框架（TopoVLM），用于大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）。该方法将层间隐藏状态表示为点云，利用单纯复形和之字形持久同调（zigzag persistent homology）量化层间拓扑一致性，从而保留关键表示转换层。实验表明，该方法在多种稀疏率下优于现有剪枝方法。但该论文已被作者撤回，原因是未引用原始方法并违规使用代码和数据。
Motivation: 现有层剪枝方法依赖局部相似性或静态代理信号，无法捕捉表示随模型深度的全局动态演变，常导致移除过渡关键层。
Method: 将层间隐藏状态建模为点云，用单纯复形表示，通过之字形持久同调量化拓扑一致性，实现自适应剪枝。
Result: 在多个多模态基准上，所提框架在广泛稀疏率下一致优于现有剪枝方法。
Conclusion: 拓扑感知的剪枝能更好地保留表示转换关键层，但本文存在学术诚信问题已被撤回。

papers.title: From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution
papers.abstract_en: In many robotic tasks, agents must traverse a sequence of spatial regions to complete a mission. Such problems are inherently mixed discrete-continuous: a high-level action sequence and a physically feasible continuous trajectory. The resulting trajectory and action sequence must also satisfy problem constraints such as deadlines, time windows, and velocity or acceleration limits. While hybrid temporal planners attempt to address this challenge, they typically model motion using linear (first-order) dynamics, which cannot guarantee that the resulting plan respects the robot's true physical constraints. Consequently, even when the high-level action sequence is fixed, producing a dynamically feasible trajectory becomes a bi-level optimization problem. We address this problem via reinforcement learning in continuous space. We define a Markov Decision Process that explicitly incorporates analytical second-order constraints and use it to refine first-order plans generated by a hybrid planner. Our results show that this approach can reliably recover physical feasibility and effectively bridge the gap between a planner's initial first-order trajectory and the dynamics required for real execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人任务中混合规划（hybrid planning）产生的运动轨迹与真实物理约束不匹配的问题，提出用强化学习在连续空间中精化一阶规划轨迹。方法将二阶动力学约束显式纳入马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），通过强化学习调整轨迹以恢复物理可行性。实验表明该方法能可靠地弥合规划器初始一阶轨迹与真实动力学之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有混合时间规划器通常使用线性（一阶）动力学建模运动，无法保证生成的轨迹满足机器人真实的物理约束（如速度、加速度限制），导致规划结果在真机执行时不可行。
Method: 定义一个连续空间的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），显式引入分析形式的二阶约束，并利用强化学习对混合规划器生成的一阶轨迹进行精化（refine），使其满足动力学可行性。
Result: 方法能可靠地恢复物理可行性，有效弥合规划器初始一阶轨迹与实际执行所需动力学之间的差距。
Conclusion: 本文强调用强化学习精化一阶规划轨迹是解决混合规划中动力学可行性问题的有效途径，但局限性可能在于需要为每个新任务重新训练或面临样本效率问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities across a diverse spectrum of multimodal tasks, it yet remains an open question whether these architectures genuinely comprehend geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures and contextual priors as statistical shortcuts. Existing evaluations fail to isolate this mechanism, conflating semantic reasoning with texture mapping and relying on imprecise annotations that inadvertently leak environmental cues. To address this gap, we introduce $\textbf{BareBones}$, a zero-shot benchmark designed to stress-test pure geometric shape comprehension. We curate pixel-level silhouettes of geometrically distinct classes across six datasets: five established segmentation sources (ImageNet-S, DIS5K, ThinObject5K, PASCAL VOC, CUB-200) and our novel flagship collection, WTP-Bench, establishing a noise-free geometric taxonomy. WTP-Bench is an extreme, fine-grained visual puzzle that forces models to identify inter-class geometric concepts from boundary contours alone. Our evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight VLMs (eg. GPT-4.1, Gemini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, LLaVA) reveals a consistent, severe performance collapse under RGB deprivation, a phenomenon we term the $\textit{Texture Bias Cliff}$. By documenting universal structural blindspots, BareBones establishes a rigorous yardstick for genuine geometric grounding. Project Page: https://eternal-f1ame.github.io/WTP-Bench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BareBones 基准，用于严格测试视觉语言模型（VLM）在零样本设置下的纯几何形状理解能力。通过去除 RGB 纹理、仅保留像素级轮廓，评估了 26 个 VLM（包括 GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA 等），发现所有模型在缺乏纹理信息时性能严重下降，作者称之为“纹理偏差悬崖”（Texture Bias Cliff）。
Motivation: 现有评估无法隔离 VLM 对几何结构的真正理解，常与纹理映射和上下文先验混淆，且标注不精确导致环境线索泄露。
Method: 构建了包含六个数据集的像素级轮廓基准（ImageNet-S、DIS5K、ThinObject5K、PASCAL VOC、CUB-200 及新提出的 WTP-Bench），WTP-Bench 是一种极细粒度的视觉谜题，迫使模型仅从边界轮廓识别几何概念。
Result: 在 26 个 VLM 上的评估显示，去除 RGB 纹理后模型性能出现一致且严重的下降，证实了纹理偏差悬崖的存在。
Conclusion: BareBones 揭示了 VLM 在几何理解上的结构性盲点，为评估真实几何基础提供了严格标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network for High-Dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii Equations on Unbounded Domains
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces the Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network (SD-FSNN), a novel computational framework for solving high-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equation (GPE) on unbounded domain. The proposed method circumvents the curse-of-dimensionality that plagues traditional discretizations and the computational bottlenecks of gradient-based neural network solvers through a synergistic combination of techniques. First, a prescribed Gaussian envelope encodes the far-field decay of the wavefunction, enabling a space-time separation where the spatial approximation is handled by a frozen, single-hidden-layer neural network with data-driven sampled features. This yields a gradient-free formalism where spatial derivatives are analytically precomputed and time-dependence is evolved via reduced ODEs. Second, a stochastic-dimension sampler provides a conditionally unbiased estimate of the spatial operator by evaluating only a small subset of spatial dimensions at each time step, essentially reducing computational and memory costs. Discrete conservation laws are also enforced, ensuring long-term stability. Extensive numerical experiments on GPE in up to 1000 dimensions demonstrate that SD-FSNN achieves significantly higher accuracy and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods, including PINNs, randomized feature methods, and tensor-network approaches. The results confirm that SD-FSNN effectively mitigates the Kolmogorov $n$-width barrier for frozen-basis models on structured solution manifolds.

Result: 在高达1000维的Gross-Pitaevskii方程数值实验中，SD-FSNN在精度和效率上显著优于PINNs、随机特征方法和张量网络等现有方法。
Conclusion: SD-FSNN有效减轻了冻结基模型在结构化解流形上的Kolmogorov n-宽度障碍，为高维非线性PDE求解提供了高效框架。

papers.title: SUPERNOVA: Eliciting General Reasoning in LLMs with Reinforcement Learning on Natural Instructions
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved reasoning in formal domains such as mathematics and code, but extending these gains beyond STEM remains challenging. Extending RLVR beyond STEM is fundamentally constrained by the lack of high-quality verifiable training data. In this work, we introduce SUPERNOVA, a framework for curating RLVR data from natural instruction datasets, which are a rich source of expert-annotated data but are underexplored for RLVR training. Through 100+ controlled RL experiments, we systematically study how to utilize these dataset for RLVR and how data curation decisions affect downstream reasoning performance . In particular, we investigate three data designs: (a) source task selection, (b) task mixing, and (c) synthetic interventions. Our analysis reveals that source task selection has a significant impact on downstream reasoning performance. Moreover, selecting tasks based on their performance for individual target tasks outperforms strategies based on overall average performance and synthetic interventions do not improve reasoning. Guided by these insights, we construct SUPERNOVA, a high-quality RLVR dataset of 25K instances curated from natural instruction datasets. We show that training Qwen3-0.6B on SUPERNOVA outperforms the base Qwen3-0.6B, yielding a relative gain of 64.4pp on BigBench Extra Hard (BBEH), a challenging benchmark comprising 23 complex reasoning tasks. Importantly, we find that gains from SUPERNOVA generalize to unseen benchmarks, larger model scales, and newer model families. Overall, our findings provide practical insights for curating human-annotated resources to extend RLVR to general reasoning. Models, Data, Code at https://github.com/asuvarna31/supernova.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SUPERNOVA框架，从自然指令数据集中筛选高质量的可验证奖励数据，用于强化学习训练，从而将RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）从数学、代码等正式领域推广到一般推理。在Qwen3-0.6B上训练后，BigBench Extra Hard相对提升64.4个百分点，且泛化到未见基准和更大模型。
Motivation: RLVR在STEM领域表现优异，但受限于缺乏高质量可验证训练数据，难以扩展到一般推理任务。自然指令数据集虽富含专家标注但未被充分利用。
Method: 通过100+受控RL实验，系统研究源任务选择、任务混合和合成干预三种数据设计策略，并基于分析构建包含25K实例的SUPERNOVA数据集。
Result: 在Qwen3-0.6B上，SUPERNOVA训练相比基线相对提升64.4pp（BigBench Extra Hard），且收益泛化到未见基准、更大规模和更新模型家族。
Conclusion: 为利用人工标注资源扩展RLVR到一般推理提供了实用指导，强调源任务选择对下游性能的关键影响。

papers.title: PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir simulation workflows face a fundamental data asymmetry: input parameter fields (geostatistical permeability realizations, porosity distributions) are free to generate in arbitrary quantities, yet existing neural operator surrogates require large corpora of expensive labeled simulation trajectories and cannot exploit this unlabeled structure. We introduce \textbf{PI-JEPA} (Physics-Informed Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture), a surrogate pretraining framework that trains \emph{without any completed PDE solves}, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields under per-sub-operator PDE residual regularization. The predictor bank is structurally aligned with the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting decomposition of the governing equations, dedicating a separate physics-constrained latent module to each sub-process (pressure, saturation transport, reaction), enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 labeled simulation runs. On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves $1.9\times$ lower error than FNO and $2.4\times$ lower error than DeepONet at $N_\ell{=}100$, with 24\% improvement over supervised-only training at $N_\ell{=}500$, demonstrating that label-free surrogate pretraining substantially reduces the simulation budget required for multiphysics surrogate deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PI-JEPA，一种无需完整PDE求解的替代预训练框架，利用算子分裂潜在预测从无标注参数场中学习，适用于耦合多物理模拟。在单相达西流实验中，仅用100个标注模拟即可达到比FNO低1.9倍、比DeepONet低2.4倍误差，显著降低替代模型部署所需的模拟预算。
Motivation: 储层模拟工作流存在数据不对称：输入参数场（如渗透率实现）可任意生成，但现有神经算子替代模型需要大量昂贵的标注模拟轨迹，无法利用无标注结构。
Method: 引入物理信息联合嵌入预测架构（PI-JEPA），采用掩码潜在预测和无标签参数场上的每子算子PDE残差正则化；预测器库与Lie–Trotter算子分裂分解对齐，为每个子过程（压力、饱和度输运、反应）分配专用物理约束潜在模块。
Result: 在单相达西流上，Nℓ=100时PI-JEPA误差比FNO低1.9倍、比DeepONet低2.4倍；Nℓ=500时比纯监督训练提升24%。
Conclusion: 无标签替代预训练可大幅减少多物理场替代部署所需的模拟预算，微调仅需少量标注运行（如100次）。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Ontology-Constrained Neural Reasoning in Enterprise Agentic Systems: A Neurosymbolic Architecture for Domain-Grounded AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by hallucination, domain drift, and the inability to enforce regulatory compliance at the reasoning level. We present a neurosymbolic architecture implemented within the Foundation AgenticOS (FAOS) platform that addresses these limitations through ontology-constrained neural reasoning. We introduce a three-layer ontological framework--Role, Domain, and Interaction ontologies--grounding LLM-based enterprise agents. We formalize asymmetric neurosymbolic coupling: current enterprise systems constrain agent inputs (context assembly, tool discovery, governance thresholds) but not outputs, and we propose mechanisms extending this coupling to output-side validation (response checking, reasoning verification, compliance enforcement). A controlled experiment (1,800 runs across five industries and three LLMs: Claude Sonnet 4, Qwen 2.5 72B, Gemma 4 26B) finds ontology-coupled agents significantly outperform ungrounded agents on Metric Accuracy (p < .001) and Role Consistency (p < .001) across all three models with large effect sizes (Kendall's W = .46-.64). Improvements are greatest where LLM parametric knowledge is weakest--particularly in Vietnam-localized domains, where ontology lift is 2x that of English domains. Contributions: (1) a formal three-layer enterprise ontology model; (2) a taxonomy of neurosymbolic coupling patterns; (3) ontology-constrained tool discovery via SQL-pushdown scoring; (4) a proposed framework for output-side ontological validation; (5) empirical evidence for the inverse parametric knowledge effect--ontological grounding value is inversely proportional to LLM training-data coverage of the domain; (6) cross-model replication establishing model-independence; (7) a production system serving 22 industry verticals with 650+ agents.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 6 tables, 6 figures, 1 algorithm, 65 references. Replication study: 1,800 runs (600 per model) across 5 regulated industries (3 English, 2 Vietnamese) and 3 LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Qwen 2.5 72B, Gemma 4 26B). v3 changes: deep-review trim from 34pp. Code and data: https://github.com/frank-luongt/faos-research/tree/main/RA-3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号架构，通过三层本体（角色、领域、交互）约束LLM在企业代理系统中的推理，并在FAOS平台实现。控制实验（1800次运行，5个行业，3个LLM）表明本体耦合代理在度量准确性和角色一致性上显著优于未耦合代理，且本体提升在越南本地化领域效果更佳（2倍于英文域）。
Motivation: 企业采用LLM受限于幻觉、领域漂移和无法在推理层面执行法规合规，现有系统缺乏有效的本体约束机制。
Method: 提出三层本体框架（角色、领域、交互本体），并形式化非对称神经符号耦合：当前系统仅约束输入（上下文组装、工具发现、治理阈值），本文扩展至输出端验证（响应检查、推理验证、合规执行）。
Result: 在5个行业（3个英文、2个越南语）和3个LLM（Claude Sonnet 4, Qwen 2.5 72B, Gemma 4 26B）上，本体耦合代理在Metric Accuracy和Role Consistency上显著优于未耦合代理（p < .001），效应量中等至大（Kendall's W = .46-.64）。越南本地化域中本体提升是英文域的2倍。
Conclusion: 本体约束神经推理可有效提升LLM在企业场景中的准确性和角色一致性，且本体价值与LLM训练数据覆盖度成反比（逆参数知识效应）。

papers.title: Neural Collapse Dynamics: Depth, Activation, Regularisation, and Feature Norm Threshold
papers.abstract_en: Neural collapse (NC) -- the convergence of penultimate-layer features to a simplex equiangular tight frame -- is well understood at equilibrium, but the dynamics governing its onset remain poorly characterised. We identify a simple and predictive regularity: NC occurs when the mean feature norm reaches a model-dataset-specific critical value, fn*, that is largely invariant to training conditions. This value concentrates tightly within each (model, dataset) pair (CV < 8%); training dynamics primarily affect the rate at which fn approaches fn*, rather than the value itself. In standard training trajectories, the crossing of fn below fn* consistently precedes NC onset, providing a practical predictor with a mean lead time of 62 epochs (MAE 24 epochs). A direct intervention experiment confirms fn* is a stable attractor of the gradient flow -- perturbations to feature scale are self-corrected during training, with convergence to the same value regardless of direction (p>0.2). Completing the (architecture)x(dataset) grid reveals the paper's strongest result: ResNet-20 on MNIST gives fn* = 5.867 -- a +458% architecture effect versus only +68% on CIFAR-10. The grid is strongly non-additive; fn* cannot be decomposed into independent architecture and dataset contributions. Four structural regularities emerge: (1) depth has a non-monotonic effect on collapse speed; (2) activation jointly determines both collapse speed and fn*; (3) weight decay defines a three-regime phase diagram -- too little slows, an optimal range is fastest, and too much prevents collapse; (4) width monotonically accelerates collapse while shifting fn* by at most 13%. These results establish feature-norm dynamics as an actionable diagnostic for predicting NC timing, suggesting that norm-threshold behaviour is a general mechanism underlying delayed representational reorganisation in deep networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经崩溃（Neural Collapse）的动力学过程，发现当平均特征范数达到一个模型-数据集特定的临界值 fn* 时，神经崩溃发生，且该值在不同训练条件下高度稳定。通过实验揭示了深度、激活函数、正则化和宽度对崩溃速度的影响规律，并建立了特征范数动力学作为预测神经崩溃时间的实用诊断工具。
Motivation: 神经崩溃在平衡态已被充分理解，但其发生的动力学机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示神经崩溃开始的条件和驱动因素。
Method: 通过大量实验观察平均特征范数的轨迹，识别出临界阈值 fn*，并分析各种训练条件（深度、激活函数、权值衰减、宽度）对 fn* 和崩溃速度的影响。
Result: 神经崩溃在特征范数低于 fn* 后约62个epoch（MAE 24个epoch）发生；fn* 几乎不受训练条件影响（CV<8%）；深度对崩溃速度有非单调影响；激活函数同时影响速度和 fn*；权值衰减存在三个区域；宽度加速崩溃但仅轻微改变 fn*。
Conclusion: 特征范数阈值行为是深度网络中延迟表示重组的一般机制，可作为预测神经崩溃时间的可靠诊断工具。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 特征范数阈值行为是深度网络中延迟表示重组的一般机制，可作为预测神经崩溃时间的可靠诊断工具。

papers.title: Nonlinear Factor Decomposition via Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A Spectral Approach to Asset Return Analysis
papers.abstract_en: KAN-PCA is an autoencoder that uses a KAN as encoder and a linear map as decoder. It generalizes classical PCA by replacing linear projections with learned B-spline functions on each edge. The motivation is to capture more variance than classical PCA, which becomes inefficient during market crises when the linear assumption breaks down and correlations between assets change dramatically. We prove that if the spline activations are forced to be linear, KAN-PCA yields exactly the same results as classical PCA, establishing PCA as a special case. Experiments on 20 S&P 500 stocks (2015-2024) show that KAN-PCA achieves a reconstruction R^2 of 66.57%, compared to 62.99% for classical PCA with the same 3 factors, while matching PCA out-of-sample after correcting for data leakage in the training procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KAN-PCA，一种使用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）作为编码器、线性映射作为解码器的自编码器，用于非线性因子分解。理论证明当激活函数强制线性时退化为经典 PCA。在 20 只 S&P 500 股票 2015-2024 年的数据上，KAN-PCA 用 3 个因子实现 66.57% 的重建 R²，高于经典 PCA 的 62.99%，但纠正数据泄露后样本外性能持平。
Motivation: 经典 PCA 的线性假设在市场危机时失效，资产间相关结构剧烈变化导致解释方差不足，需要非线性分解方法捕捉更多方差。
Method: 采用 KAN 作为编码器（每个边学习 B 样条函数）并配合线性解码器，通过自编码框架实现非线性主成分分析。
Result: 在 20 只 S&P 500 股票上，3 因子 KAN-PCA 重建 R² 为 66.57%，比经典 PCA 高 3.58 个百分点；但纠正训练数据泄露后样本外表现与 PCA 无差异。
Conclusion: KAN-PCA 在样本内能提取更多方差，但样本外优势依赖于数据泄露的避免，其实际应用需谨慎处理时间序列划分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trace2Skill: Distill Trajectory-Local Lessons into Transferable Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on domain-specific skills, yet manually authoring such skills does not scale, and skills generated purely from parametric knowledge often miss critical operational pitfalls. We introduce Trace2Skill, a framework that consolidates broad execution trajectories in parallel into a unified skill directory through inductive reasoning over agent experience. Trace2Skill supports both deepening existing human-written skills and creating useful skills from weak LLM-generated drafts. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of Trace2Skill across diverse domains, including office workflows, math reasoning, and vision QA. Importantly, the evolved skills are not merely memorized artifacts of the trajectories used to create them: they often transfer across model scales, across model families, and to out-of-distribution settings. For example, skills evolved from Qwen3.5-35B trajectories improve a Qwen3.5-122B agent by up to $57.65$ percentage points on WikiTableQuestions. Further analyses show that Trace2Skill outperforms sequential skill editing and ReasoningBank-style retrieval memories, compresses recurring failures and workarounds into standard operating procedures (SoPs), and yields portable skills that can be reused without parameter updates or test-time retrieval.
papers.comment: Work in Progress. May version add more experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trace2Skill 框架，通过归纳推理将大量执行轨迹提炼为可迁移的技能目录，支持增强人工编写的技能或从弱 LLM 草稿创建实用技能。实验表明，该技能在办公工作流、数学推理和视觉问答等多个领域有效，且能跨模型规模和家族迁移，例如从 Qwen3.5-35B 轨迹得出的技能使 Qwen3.5-122B 在 WikiTableQuestions 上提升 57.65 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 智能体依赖领域特定技能，但手动编写难以规模化，纯参数化知识生成的技能常缺失关键操作细节，因此需要自动从执行轨迹中提炼可迁移技能。
Method: Trace2Skill 框架并行处理执行轨迹，通过归纳推理将经验整合为统一的技能目录，支持深化已有技能和从弱草稿创建技能，无需参数更新或测试时检索。
Result: 摘要报告在多个领域有效，技能可跨模型规模、家族及分布外场景迁移，例如 Qwen3.5-35B 的技能使 Qwen3.5-122B 在 WikiTableQuestions 上提升 57.65 个百分点，且优于顺序技能编辑和 ReasoningBank 式检索记忆。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Trace2Skill 可将重复失败和变通方案压缩为标准操作程序 (SoP)，产生可移植的技能，但未提及对气象领域的适用性。

papers.title: Brain-CLIPLM: Semantic Compression for EEG-to-Text Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Decoding natural language from non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) remains constrained by low signal-to-noise ratio and limited information bandwidth. This raises a central question: can sentence-level language be reliably recovered from such signals? Under realistic information constraints, this direct-recovery assumption may be too strong. We introduce a semantic compression hypothesis: non-invasive EEG may preserve recoverable semantic anchors rather than the full lexical--syntactic form of a sentence. From this perspective, direct sentence reconstruction is overly fine-grained relative to the recoverable information scale of EEG. To address this mismatch, we propose Brain-CLIPLM, a two-stage framework that decomposes EEG-to-text decoding into semantic-anchor recovery and anchor-guided sentence reconstruction. Stage 1 uses contrastive learning to align word-level EEG evidence with a fixed keyword vocabulary and recover ordered semantic anchors. Stage 2 uses a retrieval-grounded large language model with chain-of-thought reasoning prompts to reconstruct sentence meaning from these anchors, following a granularity matching principle that aligns decoding complexity with the recoverable neural information scale. On the combined Zurich Cognitive Language Processing (ZuCo) benchmark, Brain-CLIPLM achieves 67.6\% Top-5 and 85.0\% Top-25 sentence retrieval accuracy, with the strongest performance at intermediate anchor granularity. Control analyses, including a permutation test, show that EEG-derived anchors carry sentence-specific information beyond language-model priors. These findings suggest that EEG-to-text decoding is better framed as recovering compressed semantic content before anchor-guided sentence reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非侵入式EEG信号低信噪比和信息带宽有限的问题，提出语义压缩假设：EEG可能仅保留可恢复的语义锚点而非完整句子。基于此，提出Brain-CLIPLM两阶段框架，先通过对比学习对齐EEG证据与固定关键词词汇恢复有序语义锚点，再用检索增强大语言模型结合思维链提示重建句子。在ZuCo基准上，该方法在句子检索任务中达到Top-5 67.6%和Top-25 85.0%的准确率，中间锚点粒度表现最佳。控制分析表明EEG衍生的锚点包含句子特定信息。
Motivation: 非侵入式EEG信号低信噪比且信息带宽有限，直接恢复完整词汇句法形式过于强假设，需要一种与可恢复信息尺度匹配的解码方法。
Method: 两阶段框架：阶段1使用对比学习将词级EEG证据与固定关键词词汇对齐，恢复有序语义锚点；阶段2使用基于检索的大语言模型结合思维链推理提示，从这些锚点重建句子含义，遵循粒度匹配原则。
Result: 在ZuCo基准上，句子检索准确率达到Top-5 67.6%和Top-25 85.0%，中间锚点粒度性能最佳。置换检验等控制分析证明EEG锚点包含句子特定信息，超越语言模型先验。
Conclusion: EEG-to-text解码应重新构建为两步：先恢复压缩的语义内容（语义锚点），再进行锚点引导的句子重建，以匹配神经信息的可恢复尺度。

papers.title: From Causal Discovery to Dynamic Causal Inference in Neural Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Time-varying causal models provide a powerful framework for studying dynamic scientific systems, yet most existing approaches assume that the underlying causal network is known a priori - an assumption rarely satisfied in real-world domains where causal structure is uncertain, evolving, or only indirectly observable. This limits the applicability of dynamic causal inference in many scientific settings. We propose Dynamic Causal Network Autoregression (DCNAR), a two-stage neural causal modeling framework that integrates data-driven causal discovery with time-varying causal inference. In the first stage, a neural autoregressive causal discovery model learns a sparse directed causal network from multivariate time series. In the second stage, this learned structure is used as a structural prior for a time-varying neural network autoregression, enabling dynamic estimation of causal influence without requiring pre-specified network structure. We evaluate the scientific validity of DCNAR using behavioral diagnostics that assess causal necessity, temporal stability, and sensitivity to structural change, rather than predictive accuracy alone. Experiments on multi-country panel time-series data demonstrate that learned causal networks yield more stable and behaviorally meaningful dynamic causal inferences than coefficient-based or structure-free alternatives, even when forecasting performance is comparable. These results position DCNAR as a general framework for using AI as a scientific instrument for dynamic causal reasoning under structural uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态因果网络自回归（DCNAR）框架，将数据驱动的因果发现与时变因果推断结合，用于神经时间序列分析。第一阶段学习稀疏有向因果网络，第二阶段将其作为结构先验进行时变因果估计，无需预先指定网络结构。在多国面板时间序列数据上，DCNAR生成的动态因果推断比基线更稳定且行为上有意义。
Motivation: 现有动态因果模型通常假设因果网络已知，但现实中因果结构往往不确定、变化或间接可观察，限制了在科学领域的应用。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用神经自回归因果发现模型从多变量时间序列学习稀疏有向因果网络；第二阶段将学到的结构作为先验，用于时变神经网络自回归，动态估计因果影响。
Result: 在多国面板时间序列数据上，DCNAR的因果推断在因果必要性、时间稳定性和结构变化敏感性方面优于基于系数或无结构的方法，即使预测性能相近。
Conclusion: DCNAR可作为在结构不确定下进行动态因果推理的通用框架，将AI用作科学工具。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Multi-Armed Sequential Hypothesis Testing by Betting
papers.abstract_en: We consider a variant of sequential testing by betting where, at each time step, the statistician is presented with multiple data sources (arms) and obtains data by choosing one of the arms. We consider the composite global null hypothesis $\mathscr{P}$ that all arms are null in a certain sense (e.g. all dosages of a treatment are ineffective) and we are interested in rejecting $\mathscr{P}$ in favor of a composite alternative $\mathscr{Q}$ where at least one arm is non-null (e.g. there exists an effective treatment dosage). We posit an optimality desideratum that we describe informally as follows: even if several arms are non-null, we seek $e$-processes and sequential tests whose performance are as strong as the ones that have oracle knowledge about which arm generates the most evidence against $\mathscr{P}$. Formally, we generalize notions of log-optimality and expected rejection time optimality to more than one arm, obtaining matching lower and upper bounds for both. A key technical device in this optimality analysis is a modified upper-confidence-bound-like algorithm for unobservable but sufficiently "estimable" rewards. In the design of this algorithm, we derive nonasymptotic concentration inequalities for optimal wealth growth rates in the sense of Kelly [1956]. These may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考虑多臂赌博机场景下的序贯假设检验问题，统计学家每步需从多个数据源中选择一个并获取数据，以检验所有臂均为零的全局零假设。文章推广了单臂情形下的对数最优性和期望拒绝时间最优性到多臂情形，并给出了匹配的上下界。关键技术是一种修正的上置信界算法，用于不可观测但可估计的奖励，并导出了非渐近浓度不等式。
Motivation: 传统序贯假设检验通常假设数据完全可观测，但许多实际场景中只能通过选择臂来获取部分数据，且需要同时检验多个假设。本文旨在设计在此类多臂选择情形下仍能保持最优性的检验方法。
Method: 推广 log-最优性和期望拒绝时间最优性到多臂情形，提出一种类似上置信界（UCB）的算法用于选择臂，并利用 Kelly 准则下的最优财富增长率推导非渐近浓度不等式。
Result: 获得多臂情形下对数最优和期望拒绝时间最优的匹配上下界，建立了理论最优性保证。
Conclusion: 本文为多臂赌博机环境下的序贯假设检验提供了理论最优方法，主要贡献在于推广最优性概念并给出可实现的算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InfoDensity: Rewarding Information-Dense Traces for Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) with extended reasoning capabilities often generate verbose and redundant reasoning traces, incurring unnecessary computational cost. While existing reinforcement learning approaches address this by optimizing final response length, they neglect the quality of intermediate reasoning steps, leaving models vulnerable to reward hacking. We argue that verbosity is not merely a length problem, but a symptom of poor intermediate reasoning quality. To investigate this, we conduct an empirical study tracking the per-token predictive entropy of large reasoning models across reasoning trajectories. We find that high-quality reasoning traces exhibit two consistent properties: low uncertainty convergence and fast uncertainty descent. These findings suggest that high-quality reasoning traces are informationally dense, that is, reasoning steps contribute to reaching a low uncertainty level relative to the total reasoning length. Motivated by this, we propose InfoDensity, a reward framework for RL training that captures both properties through a single suffix-max envelope of the entropy trajectory, weighted by a length scaling term that favors achieving equivalent quality more concisely. Experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that InfoDensity outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析大型推理模型在推理轨迹中的每令牌预测熵，发现高质量推理轨迹具有低不确定性收敛和快速不确定性下降两个性质，并基于此提出InfoDensity奖励框架，在数学和通用推理基准上取得了更好的准确率-效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法仅优化最终回答长度，忽略了中间推理步骤的质量，导致冗余推理和不必要的计算成本。
Method: 提出InfoDensity，一种在RL训练中使用的奖励框架，通过熵轨迹的单一后缀最大包络捕获两个性质，并加权长度缩放项以鼓励更简洁地达到等效质量。
Result: 在数学和通用推理基准上，InfoDensity在准确率-效率权衡上优于现有最先进基线。
Conclusion: 高质量推理轨迹是信息密集的，通过奖励信息密集的轨迹可以提高推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Chain: A Causal Analysis of LLM Faithfulness to Intermediate Structures
papers.abstract_en: In schema-guided reasoning (SGR) pipelines, LLMs produce explicit intermediate structures -- rubrics, checklists, or verification queries -- before committing to a final decision. SGR is increasingly adopted because it promises controllability: practitioners expect to inspect, edit, and override these structures to steer the outcome. But does the promise hold? We introduce a causal evaluation protocol to measure it: by selecting tasks where a deterministic function maps intermediate structures to decisions, every controlled edit implies a unique correct output. Across 12 models and 4 benchmarks, models appear self-consistent with their own intermediate structures but fail to update predictions after intervention -- revealing that apparent faithfulness is fragile once the intermediate structure changes. When derivation of the final decision from the structure is delegated to an external tool, this fragility largely disappears; stronger prompting yields only limited improvements, while preference optimization substantially improves intervention faithfulness. Overall, intermediate structures in schema-guided pipelines function as influential context rather than stable causal mediators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于模式的推理（SGR）流程中LLM对中间结构的忠实性进行因果分析。通过因果评估协议，在12个模型和4个基准上发现，模型看似与自己的中间结构一致，但干预后预测未更新，表明忠实性脆弱。将最终决策委托给外部工具可大幅改善，而偏好优化显著提升干预忠实性，提示中间结构更似有影响力的上下文而非稳定因果中介。
Motivation: SGR流程因承诺可操控性而被广泛采用，但中间结构是否能真正因果性地影响LLM决策尚未得到严格验证。现有评估仅关注表面一致性，忽略了干预下的因果忠实性。
Method: 引入因果评估协议，选择中间结构与决策之间存在确定性函数的任务，对中间结构进行受控编辑并观察输出变化。在12个模型和4个基准上比较模型自身推理、外部工具推导、强提示及偏好优化等设置。
Result: 模型看似与自身中间结构一致，但干预后预测未更新，表面忠实性脆弱；委托外部工具推导决策时脆弱性大幅消失；强提示改进有限，偏好优化显著提升干预忠实性。
Conclusion: SGR流程中的中间结构主要作为有影响力的上下文（influential context）而非稳定的因果中介（causal mediators）发挥作用；偏好优化是提升干预忠实性的有效手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge Activation: AI Skills as the Institutional Knowledge Primitive for Agentic Software Development
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise software organizations accumulate critical institutional knowledge - architectural decisions, deployment procedures, compliance policies, incident playbooks - yet this knowledge remains trapped in formats designed for human interpretation. The bottleneck to effective agentic software development is not model capability but knowledge architecture. When any knowledge consumer - an autonomous AI agent, a newly onboarded engineer, or a senior developer - encounters an enterprise task without institutional context, the result is guesswork, correction cascades, and a disproportionate tax on senior engineers who must manually supply what others cannot infer. This paper introduces Knowledge Activation, a framework that specializes AI Skills - the open standard for agent-consumable knowledge - into structured, governance-aware Atomic Knowledge Units (AKUs) for institutional knowledge delivery. Rather than retrieving documents for interpretation, AKUs deliver action - ready specifications encoding what to do, which tools to use, what constraints to respect, and where to go next - so that agents act correctly and engineers receive institutionally grounded guidance without reconstructing organizational context from scratch. AKUs form a composable knowledge graph that agents traverse at runtime - compressing onboarding, reducing cross - team friction, and eliminating correction cascades. The paper formalizes the resource constraints that make this architecture necessary, specifies the AKU schema and deployment architecture, and grounds long - term maintenance in knowledge commons practice. A Yahoo deployment surveying 67 engineers shows statistically significant developer-experience gains - 2.6 hours per week saved, Net Promoter Score +35. Organizations that architect their institutional knowledge for the agentic era will outperform those that invest solely in model capability.
papers.comment: Preprint. 59 pages, 11 figures. v2 is a major revision: adds an enterprise case study (a Yahoo deployment evaluated by an anonymous 67-engineer survey), with findings integrated into the abstract, introduction, discussion, and conclusion; methodology tightened and references expanded
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识激活框架，将机构知识封装为原子知识单元（AKU），使AI代理能直接执行任务而非解释文档。AKU构成可组合的知识图，代理在运行时遍历，从而减少新员工培训时间、跨团队摩擦和纠错级联。在雅虎的67名工程师调查中，每周节省2.6小时，净推荐值提升35。
Motivation: 企业软件机构积累的关键知识（架构决策、部署流程、合规策略等）仍保存在仅适合人类阅读的格式中，导致AI代理和工程师缺乏机构上下文，引发猜测、纠错级联和对高级工程师的过度依赖。
Method: 提出知识激活框架，将AI技能（AI Skills）开放标准细化为结构化、可治理的原子知识单元（AKU），AKU包含行动就绪的规范（做什么、用什么工具、遵循什么约束、下一步去哪里），并形成可组合的知识图供代理运行时遍历。
Result: 在雅虎部署中，67名工程师的调查显示每周节省2.6小时，净推荐值（NPS）提升35。
Conclusion: 总结认为，为代理时代构建机构知识架构的组织将胜过仅投资模型能力的组织。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Means: Topological Causal Effects under Persistent-Homology Ignorability
papers.abstract_en: Average treatment effects (ATE) and conditional average treatment effects (CATE) are foundational causal estimands, but they target changes in expected outcomes and can miss treatment-induced changes in the shape of outcome distributions. A canonical failure mode occurs when control outcomes are unimodal, treated outcomes become bimodal, and both distributions have the same mean. In such cases mean-based causal estimands are zero even though the geometry and topology of the outcome law change substantially. This paper develops a topological causal framework based on persistent homology. We formalize a persistent-homology ignorability condition, define topological analogues of CATE and ATE, and prove that these estimands are identifiable up to an explicit error bound under approximate topological ignorability. We also clarify a subtle but important point: a marginal persistence-diagram effect is not identified from conditional topological ignorability alone because persistent homology does not in general commute with mixtures over covariates. To preserve the original intuition while ensuring scientific correctness, we retain the marginal effect as a motivating quantity, but place the mathematically sound conditional estimands at the center of the theory. A synthetic experiment with mean-preserving topology change shows that mean-based causal estimands remain near zero while the proposed topological effect increases sharply and remains recoverable after adjustment for confounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了基于持续同调的拓扑因果框架，解决平均治疗效应（ATE）在分布形状变化时失效的问题。形式化了持续同调可忽略性条件，定义了拓扑版本的CATE和ATE，证明了在近似拓扑可忽略性下因果量可识别并带有误差界。通过合成实验表明，当均值不变但拓扑结构改变时，拓扑因果效应显著增长，而均值效应接近零。
Motivation: 传统的平均因果效应（ATE/CATE）只关注期望变化，会遗漏治疗导致的分布形状改变（如单峰变双峰但均值相同）。这种情形下均值效应为零，但概率分布的几何拓扑发生了实质变化，现有因果推断方法无法捕捉。
Method: 引入持续同调（persistent homology）构造拓扑因果框架。提出持续同调可忽略性条件，定义拓扑CATE和拓扑ATE，并证明在近似拓扑可忽略性下这些因果量是可识别的，并给出显式误差界。讨论了边缘持久性图效应不能仅由条件拓扑可忽略性识别的问题，将条件因果量作为理论核心。
Result: 合成实验中，在保持均值不变的拓扑改变情形下，均值因果效应接近零，而提出的拓扑因果效应显著增大，且在调整混杂后仍可恢复。
Conclusion: 拓扑因果框架能够捕捉均值效应无法反映的分布形状变化，是对传统因果推断的补充。方法依赖近似拓扑可忽略性假设，边缘效应需要进一步理论处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Robustness of Langevin Dynamics to Score Function Error
papers.abstract_en: We consider the robustness of score-based generative modeling to errors in the estimate of the score function. In particular, we show that Langevin dynamics is not robust to the $L^2$ errors (more generally $L^p$ errors) in the estimate of the score function. It is well-established that with small $L^2$ errors in the estimate of the score function, diffusion models can sample faithfully from the target distribution under fairly mild regularity assumptions in a polynomial time horizon. In contrast, our work shows that even for simple distributions in high dimensions, Langevin dynamics run for any polynomial time horizon will produce a distribution far from the target distribution in Total Variation (TV) distance, even when the $L^2$ error (more generally $L^p$) of the estimate of the score function is arbitrarily small. Considering such an error in the estimate of the score function is unavoidable in practice when learning the score function from data, our results provide further justification for diffusion models over Langevin dynamics and serve to caution against the use of Langevin dynamics with estimated scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究得分生成模型中Langevin动力学对得分函数估计误差的鲁棒性。理论证明即使得分函数的L²误差任意小，在高维简单分布上多项式时间内的Langevin动力学也无法以总变差距离逼近目标分布，而扩散模型在相同条件下可以成功采样。
Motivation: 扩散模型和Langevin动力学是两类主流得分生成模型，但后者对实际中不可避免的得分估计误差的鲁棒性缺乏理论分析。
Method: 通过构造反例，证明在多项式时间内，即使得分函数L²误差任意小，Langevin动力学产生的分布与目标分布的总变差距离仍远离零。
Result: Langevin动力学对得分函数的L²（及更一般的Lᵖ）误差不具备鲁棒性；这一结论在简单高维分布上成立。
Conclusion: 该结果为扩散模型优于Langevin动力学提供了理论依据，并警示在实际中应避免使用估计得分的Langevin动力学。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beam-Plasma Collective Oscillations in Intense Charged-Particle Beams: Dielectric Response Theory, Langmuir Wave Dispersion, and Unsupervised Detection via Prometheus
papers.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical and computational framework for beam-plasma collective oscillations in intense charged-particle beams at intermediate energies (10-100 MeV). In Part I, we formulate a kinetic field theory governed by the Vlasov-Poisson system, deriving the Lindhard dielectric function and random phase approximation (RPA) polarization tensor for three beam distribution functions. We prove via the dielectric function epsilon(omega,q)=0 the existence of undamped Langmuir wave modes above a critical beam density n_c, obtain explicit beam-plasma dispersion relations, and show that Landau damping vanishes above the particle-hole continuum. The plasma frequency Omega_p^2 = ne^2/(m*epsilon_0) is fixed by the f-sum rule independently of distribution shape; higher dispersion coefficients depend on velocity moments. Space charge effects drive anomalous beam broadening with sqrt(n-n_c) onset and Friedel oscillations at q=2k_F. The beam-plasma transition belongs to the 3D Ising universality class via renormalization group analysis. In Part II, we validate these predictions using Prometheus, a beta-VAE trained on static structure factor data S(q) from particle-in-cell (PIC) beam simulations. Prometheus detects collective plasma oscillation onset in Gaussian and uniform distributions, confirms their absence in the degenerate Fermi gas (n_c -> 0), and resolves the Kohn anomaly at q=2k_F. Dispersion analysis of S(q,omega) from PIC simulations verifies the distribution-independent Omega_p predicted by the f-sum rule. All six validation checks pass. Predicted signatures -- density-tunable plasma resonances at omega_p proportional to sqrt(n), anomalous beam broadening with sqrt(n-n_c) onset, and Friedel oscillations -- are accessible at existing intermediate-energy beam facilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于强流带电粒子束中束-等离子体集体振荡的理论和计算框架。第一部分从Vlasov-Poisson系统出发，推导了Lindhard介电函数和随机相位近似极化张量，证明了存在无阻尼朗缪尔波模式的条件，并给出了显式的束-等离子体色散关系。第二部分使用基于beta-VAE的Prometheus模型，在粒子模拟的静态结构因子数据上验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 强流带电粒子束中的集体振荡现象对加速器物理和等离子体物理具有重要影响，但尚缺乏系统的理论框架和高效的计算检测方法。
Method: 第一部分采用动力学场论，推导了介电函数和色散关系；第二部分使用基于beta-VAE的无监督学习模型Prometheus，从粒子模拟数据中检测集体振荡的onset。
Result: 理论预测了临界密度以上的无阻尼朗缪尔波、f-sum规则固定的等离子体频率、空间电荷效应导致的异常束展宽和Friedel振荡。Prometheus模型成功检测到集体振荡的onset，验证了六项检验。
Conclusion: 该框架为束-等离子体集体振荡提供了统一的理论描述，并展示了无监督学习在物理检测中的有效性。预测的特征可在现有中能量束流设施中观测。

summary_sections.motivation: 强流带电粒子束中的集体振荡现象对加速器物理和等离子体物理具有重要影响，但尚缺乏系统的理论框架和高效的计算检测方法。
summary_sections.method: 第一部分采用动力学场论，推导了介电函数和色散关系；第二部分使用基于beta-VAE的无监督学习模型Prometheus，从粒子模拟数据中检测集体振荡的onset。
summary_sections.result: 理论预测了临界密度以上的无阻尼朗缪尔波、f-sum规则固定的等离子体频率、空间电荷效应导致的异常束展宽和Friedel振荡。Prometheus模型成功检测到集体振荡的onset，验证了六项检验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为束-等离子体集体振荡提供了统一的理论描述，并展示了无监督学习在物理检测中的有效性。预测的特征可在现有中能量束流设施中观测。

papers.title: Global Cross-Modal Geo-Localization: A Million-Scale Dataset and a Physical Consistency Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal Geo-localization (CMGL) matches ground-level text descriptions with geo-tagged aerial imagery, which is crucial for pedestrian navigation and emergency response. However, existing studies are constrained by narrow geographic coverage and simplistic scene diversity, failing to reflect the immense spatial heterogeneity of global architectural styles and topographic features. To bridge this gap and facilitate universal positioning, we introduce CORE, the first million-scale dataset dedicated to global CMGL. CORE comprises 1,034,786 cross-view images sampled from 225 distinct geographic regions across six continents, offering an unprecedented variety of perspectives in varying environmental conditions and urban layouts. We leverage the zero-shot reasoning of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to synthesize high-quality scene descriptions rich in discriminative cues. Furthermore, we propose a physical-law-aware network (PLANET) for cross-modal geo-localization. PLANET introduces a novel contrastive learning paradigm to guide textual representations in capturing the intrinsic physical signatures of satellite imagery. Extensive experiments across varied geographic regions demonstrate that PLANET significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for robust, global-scale geo-localization. The dataset and source code will be released at https://github.com/YtH0823/CORE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了CORE，首个百万级全球跨模态地理定位数据集，包含103万张跨视角图像，覆盖六大洲225个区域。同时提出物理一致性学习框架PLANET，利用大型视觉语言模型合成场景描述，并通过对比学习对齐文本与卫星图像的内在物理特征。实验表明PLANET在全局地理定位任务上显著超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有跨模态地理定位研究受限于地理覆盖范围小和场景多样性不足，无法反映全球建筑风格和地形的空间异质性。需要大规模数据集和能捕获卫星图像物理特征的方法。
Method: 构建百万级全球数据集CORE；利用大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）零样本合成高质量场景描述；提出物理一致性网络PLANET，通过对比学习引导文本表征学习卫星图像的固有物理签名。
Result: 在跨区域实验中，PLANET显著优于现有最先进方法，建立了鲁棒的全球尺度地理定位新基准。
Conclusion: CORE数据集和PLANET方法为全球跨模态地理定位提供了规模化数据和可泛化的物理一致性学习范式。

papers.title: MAviS: A Multimodal Conversational Assistant For Avian Species
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained understanding and species-specific multimodal question answering are vital for advancing biodiversity conservation and ecological monitoring. However, existing multimodal large language models face challenges when it comes to specialized topics like avian species, making it harder to provide accurate and contextually relevant information in these areas. To address this limitation, we introduce the MAviS-Dataset, a large-scale multimodal avian species dataset that integrates image, audio, and text modalities for over 1,000 bird species, comprising both pretraining and instruction-tuning subsets enriched with structured question-answer pairs. Building on the MAviS-Dataset, we introduce MAviS-Chat, a multimodal LLM that supports audio, vision, and text and is designed for fine-grained species understanding, multimodal question answering, and scene-specific description generation. Finally, for quantitative evaluation, we present MAviS-Bench, a benchmark of over 25,000 QA pairs designed to assess avian species-specific perceptual and reasoning abilities across modalities. Experimental results show that MAviS-Chat outperforms the baseline MiniCPM-o-2.6 by a large margin, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results and demonstrating the effectiveness of our instruction-tuned MAviS-Dataset. Our findings highlight the necessity of domain-adaptive multimodal LLMs for ecological applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有多模态大模型在鸟类等专业领域理解不足的问题，构建了大规模多模态鸟类数据集MAviS-Dataset（含1000+鸟类，图像、音频、文本），并提出多模态LLM MAviS-Chat用于细粒度物种理解、多模态问答和场景描述。此外还构建了包含25000+QA对的基准MAviS-Bench。实验表明MAviS-Chat显著超越基线MiniCPM-o-2.6，达到开源最优。
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在鸟类等专业领域难以提供准确和上下文相关的信息，限制了生物多样性保护和生态监测。
Method: 构建了MAviS-Dataset（预训练+指令微调子集），提出MAviS-Chat多模态LLM（支持图像、音频、文本），以及评估基准MAviS-Bench（25000+QA对）。
Result: 实验结果显示MAviS-Chat大幅优于基线MiniCPM-o-2.6，达到开源最优，验证了指令微调数据集的有效性。
Conclusion: 研究强调了领域自适应多模态LLM在生态应用中的必要性。

papers.title: Specialization of softmax attention heads: insights from the high-dimensional single-location model
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head attention enables transformer models to represent multiple attention patterns simultaneously. Empirically, head specialization emerges in distinct stages during training, while many heads remain redundant and learn similar representations. We propose a theoretical model capturing this phenomenon, based on the multi-index and single-location regression frameworks. In the first part, we analyze the training dynamics of multi-head softmax attention under SGD, revealing an initial unspecialized phase followed by a multi-stage specialization phase in which different heads sequentially align with latent signal directions. In the second part, we study the impact of attention activation functions on performance. We introduce the Bayes-softmax attention, which achieves optimal prediction performance in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于多指标（multi-index）和单位置（single-location）回归框架，提出了一个理论模型来解释多头softmax注意力（multi-head softmax attention）中专化（specialization）现象的涌现。分析了SGD训练动力学，揭示了从初始非专化阶段到多阶段专化阶段的转变，其中不同头部依次与潜在信号方向对齐。还引入了贝叶斯softmax注意力（Bayes-softmax attention），在该设置下达到了最优预测性能。
Motivation: 多头注意力在实践中表现出头部专化现象，但许多头部学习到相似表示，存在冗余。现有理论缺乏对专化动态及其成因的深入理解。
Method: 构建基于多指标和单位置回归的理论模型，分析SGD下多头softmax注意力的训练动力学，并通过引入贝叶斯softmax注意力研究注意力激活函数的影响。
Result: 理论分析揭示了训练中存在初始非专化阶段和随后的多阶段专化过程；贝叶斯softmax注意力在该设置下达到最优预测性能。
Conclusion: 该理论模型捕捉了多头注意力中专化涌现的阶段性特征，并为注意力激活函数的设计提供了理论指导。

papers.title: GIPO: Gaussian Importance Sampling Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown strong promise for advancing multimodal agents beyond supervised imitation. However, RL remains limited by poor data efficiency, particularly in settings where interaction data are scarce and quickly become outdated. To address this challenge, GIPO (Gaussian Importance sampling Policy Optimization) is proposed as a policy optimization objective based on truncated importance sampling, replacing hard clipping with a log-ratio-based Gaussian trust weight to softly damp extreme importance ratios while maintaining non-zero gradients. Theoretical analysis shows that GIPO introduces an implicit, tunable constraint on the update magnitude, while concentration bounds guarantee robustness and stability under finite-sample estimation. Experimental results show that GIPO achieves state-of-the-art performance among clipping-based baselines across a wide range of replay buffer sizes, from near on-policy to highly stale data, while exhibiting superior bias--variance trade-off, high training stability and improved sample efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/distanceLu/GIPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GIPO（高斯重要性采样策略优化）目标，用基于对数比的高斯信任权重替代硬裁剪，以软方式抑制极端重要性比率，同时保持非零梯度。理论分析表明该目标引入隐式可调约束，有限样本下的集中界保证鲁棒性和稳定性。实验在多种经验回放缓冲区大小下达到裁剪基线中的最优性能，表现出更好的偏差-方差权衡、训练稳定性和样本效率。
Motivation: 强化学习后训练在多模态智能体上表现优异，但存在数据效率低的问题，尤其在交互数据稀缺且易过时的情况下。
Method: 基于截断重要性采样的策略优化目标，使用对数比的高斯信任权重替代硬裁剪，对更新幅度施加隐式可调约束。
Result: 在从近策略到高度陈旧数据的多种回放缓冲区大小下，GIPO 在裁剪基线中达到最优性能，具有更优的偏差-方差权衡、高训练稳定性和改进的样本效率。
Conclusion: GIPO 通过软约束机制有效提升了策略优化的数据效率和稳定性，适用于数据陈旧性变化大的场景。

papers.title: Benchmarking Emergent Coordination in Large-Scale LLM Populations: An Evaluation Framework on the MoltBook Archive
papers.abstract_en: As multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems scale, evaluating their emergent coordination dynamics becomes increasingly critical. However, current evaluation paradigms-focused on single agents or small, explicitly structured groups-fail to capture the self-organization and viral information dynamics that arise in large, decentralized populations. We introduce a systematic evaluation framework to benchmark role specialization, information diffusion, and cooperative task resolution in open agent environments. We demonstrate this framework on the MoltBook Observatory Archive, a dataset of 2.73M interactions among 90,704 autonomous agents, establishing quantitative baselines for emergent coordination. Our evaluation reveals a pronounced core-periphery structure (silhouette 0.91), heavy-tailed cascade distributions ($α= 2.57$), and severe coordination overhead in decentralized task resolution (Cohen's $d = -0.88$ against a single-agent baseline). By providing standardized evaluation tasks and empirical baselines, our framework enables the rigorous comparison of future multi-agent protocols and establishes evaluation itself as an object of scientific study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个系统性的评估框架，用于对大规模去中心化LLM智能体群体中的角色专业化、信息扩散和协作任务解决进行基准测试，并在包含2.73M次交互和90,704个自主智能体的MoltBook观测档案馆数据集上建立了定量基线。
Motivation: 当前评估范式集中于单智能体或小规模显式结构群体，无法捕捉大规模去中心化群体中出现的自组织和病毒式信息动态，因此需要新的评估方法。
Method: 设计了一个包含标准化评估任务和实证基线的框架，用于开放智能体环境中的涌现协调基准测试，并在MoltBook数据集上演示。
Result: 揭示了明显的核心-外围结构（轮廓系数0.91）、重尾级联分布（α=2.57）以及去中心化任务解决中的严重协调开销（Cohen's d=-0.88，相对于单智能体基线）。
Conclusion: 该框架为未来多智能体协议提供了严格比较的基础，并将评估本身确立为科学研究的对象。
