papers.title: Learning-Augmented Online Minimization with Dual Predictions
papers.abstract_en: We present learning-augmented algorithms for two general classes of online minimization problems: metrical task systems and laminar set cover. Both algorithms achieve improved theoretical guarantees using machine-learned predictions of an optimal solution to the dual linear program. Unlike optimal primal solutions, which can change drastically under tiny instance perturbations, these dual solutions are much more stable, which ensures the existence of good (and learnable) predictions for families of similar instances. While previous work has used dual predictions in offline settings and for online maximization problems, our algorithms are, to the best of our knowledge, the first demonstration that such dual predictions can be effective for online minimization. Our theoretical results are complemented by experiments on the $k$-server problem and the parking permit problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用机器学习对偶线性规划解的学习增强算法，应用于度量任务系统和层集合覆盖两类在线最小化问题。实验在k-服务问题和停车许可问题上验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 在线最小化问题中，最优原始解对实例扰动敏感，而最优对偶解更稳定，因此可学习。之前工作仅将对偶预测用于离线或在线最大化问题，本文首次展示其对在线最小化的有效性。
Method: 设计学习增强算法，通过机器学习预测对偶线性规划的最优解，利用其稳定性指导在线决策，同时保持理论保证。
Result: 在度量任务系统和层集合覆盖上取得改进的理论保证，实验表明在k-服务问题和停车许可问题上的有效性。
Conclusion: 对偶预测能够有效提升在线最小化算法的性能，尤其在实例相似性高时，预测的可学习性得到保证。

papers.title: Deep Learning-assisted AMD Staging based on OCT and OCT Angiography
papers.abstract_en: To develop and evaluate deep learning models for automated grading of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) severity using optical coherence tomography (OCT) and OCT angiography (OCTA) data. Two hundred seventy-one participants aged >= 50 years with varying AMD severities. Central macular 6 x 6 mm OCT/OCTA volumes were acquired using a swept-source OCTA system (SOLIX; Visionix/Optovue Inc., CA). AMD severity was graded into four stages (No AMD, Early AMD, Intermediate AMD, and Advanced AMD) according to the AREDS simplified severity scale. Three deep learning models were developed using different input modalities: (1) biomarker maps derived from segmented pathological features, including retinal fluid, drusen, geographic atrophy (GA), and macular neovascularization (MNV); (2) two-dimensional (2D) en face OCT and OCTA projections; and (3) three-dimensional (3D) OCT/OCTA volumes. EfficientNet-based architectures were trained using normalized inputs, data augmentation, and five-fold cross-validation. A total of 2,030 OCT/OCTA volumes from 351 eyes of 271 participants were analyzed. All models demonstrated strong AMD staging performance with substantial agreement with the reference standard (QWK >= 0.83). The biomarker-based model achieved the highest overall performance (QWK = 0.85 +/- 0.03, mean +/- standard deviation) and the best detection of early AMD (F1-score = 0.59 +/- 0.14). The 3D model achieved performance comparable to the 2D OCT/OCTA model (QWK = 0.83 +/- 0.04 vs. 0.83 +/- 0.09), while the 2D OCT/OCTA model showed the highest precision (0.79 +/- 0.06) and most accurately identified eyes without AMD. Deep learning models using OCT/OCTA data can accurately and automatically grade AMD severity. Among the evaluated approaches, the biomarker-based model provided the most balanced performance and showed particular value for early AMD detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文开发并评估了基于OCT和OCTA数据自动分级年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）严重程度的深度学习模型。使用三种输入模态：生物标志物图谱、2D en face投影和3D体积，基于EfficientNet架构进行训练和五折交叉验证。生物标志物模型表现最佳（QWK=0.85±0.03），尤其对早期AMD检测有优势。所有模型均展现出与参考标准的高度一致性（QWK≥0.83）。
Motivation: 现有的AMD分级依赖人工判读，缺乏自动化、高效率且准确的多模态分级方法。利用OCT和OCTA的多模式信息有望提高分级性能。
Method: 构建三种深度学习模型：1) 基于分割病理特征（视网膜液、玻璃膜疣、地理萎缩、黄斑新生血管）的生物标志物图谱；2) 2D en face OCT和OCTA投影；3) 3D OCT和OCTA体积。均采用EfficientNet架构，结合归一化输入、数据增强和五折交叉验证。
Result: 共分析351只眼睛的2030个OCT/OCTA体积。所有模型QWK≥0.83；生物标志物模型最高（QWK=0.85±0.03），早期AMD检测F1-score=0.59±0.14；2D模型识别无AMD眼精度最高（0.79±0.06）；3D模型与2D模型性能相当（QWK均为0.83）。
Conclusion: 基于OCT/OCTA的深度学习模型能够准确自动分级AMD严重程度，其中生物标志物模型性能最均衡，对早期AMD检测具有临床价值。

papers.title: Pattern Selectivity is Not Task-Causal Structure: A Cross-Architecture Mechanistic Study of Composed-Task Circuits in 1B-Class Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We test whether a single screen-and-ablate recipe -- identify attention-head circuits by task-pattern selectivity, then verify by causal ablation against a matched-random null -- produces consistent mechanistic claims across model families. The recipe ports across pipelines; the specific circuit it identifies does not. Across four composed tasks (indirect-object identification, greater-than, successor sequences, variable binding) and three 1B-class language models from distinct training pipelines (Pythia 1B / Pile / dense; OLMo 1B / DCLM / dense; OLMoE 1B-7B / DCLM / mixture-of-experts), we run a unified protocol with the matched-random null sampled across ten seeds per cell. The resulting 12 (task, model) cells contain no two that share the same primary causal screen at comparable effect size: the same task, with the same behavioral capability, is implemented through different attention-pattern types across models. We introduce a five-category screen-outcome taxonomy -- primary cause, secondary cause, correlate, interferer, null -- with quantitative thresholds, and show that all five outcomes appear in the panel. We propose a falsifiable hypothesis: the MoE model in our panel builds composed-task circuits on top of a foundational previous-token positional substrate (the prev-token-circuit ablation is the strongest causal screen on 3 of 4 tasks for OLMoE 1B-7B), with the IOI exception consistent with IOI being a final-position name-copying task whose structure directly probes a different pattern. The hypothesis comes with explicit predictions for other MoE language models. We frame the methodology honestly: the spectral participation-ratio signal from the companion methodology paper is a general indicator of specialized computation; what makes a finding task-specific is the task-pattern screen plus a per-model causal verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试一个统一的筛选-消融方法是否能在不同模型家族中产生一致的机械可解释性声明。实验覆盖四个组合任务（间接宾语识别、大于、后继序列、变量绑定）和三个1B类语言模型（Pythia 1B密集、OLMo 1B密集、OLMoE 1B-7B MoE）。结果发现没有两个（任务, 模型）单元共享相同的主要因果模式：同一任务在不同模型中以不同注意力模式实现。作者提出五种分类结果（主因、次因、相关物、干扰物、空），并假设MoE模型在基础的“前一个token”位置子结构上构建组合任务电路。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法常假设同一任务在不同模型中由相似电路实现，但缺乏跨架构验证。
Method: 采用统一的筛选-消融协议：先用任务模式选择性识别注意力头回路，再通过因果消融与匹配随机空假设比较。在12个（任务, 模型）单元上运行，每个单元十个随机种子。
Result: 12个单元中没有两个共享相同的主要因果模式；同一任务在不同模型中以不同注意力模式实现。提出五类分类：主因、次因、相关物、干扰物、空。
Conclusion: 模式选择性不是任务因果结构；跨架构的机械解释需要逐模型验证。提出可证伪的假设：MoE模型基于前一个token位置子结构构建电路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SHALA-LLM: Smartly Handling Ambiguous Labels in Aligning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Many human-centered tasks, including natural language inference (NLI) and emotion recognition (ER), have multiple plausible interpretations, leading to label ambiguity and challenging disagreements across human annotators. As LLMs are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, faithfully modeling such ambiguity is essential to identify contested inputs, preserve variability in ambiguous cases, and capture the full distribution of human judgments. Yet, existing LLM alignment approaches have predominantly assumed a single correct label, excluding annotator disagreement during optimization. Instead of treating this ambiguity as noise, we show how to treat it as information that improves model behavior through a new algorithm called SMARTLY HANDLING AMBIGUOUS LABELS IN ALIGNING LLMS (SHALA-LLM). This reinforcement learning framework provides a new way for LLMs to learn directly from annotator distributions while dynamically prioritizing highly ambiguous samples during optimization. Experiments on ambiguity-sensitive NLI and ER benchmarks, including ChaosNLI, GoEmotions, and MSP-Podcast, demonstrate that SHALA-LLM improves agreement with annotator label distributions, e.g. on ChaosNLI, it reduces Jensen-Shannon Distance by up to 62.1%. At the same time, SHALA-LLM improves F1 by up to 16.7%, showing that modeling annotator disagreement can also strengthen classification performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHALA-LLM，一种强化学习框架，用于在LLM对齐中处理标注者之间的分歧（标签模糊性）。该方法从标注者分布中学习，并在优化中动态优先处理高模糊样本。在ChaosNLI、GoEmotions、MSP-Podcast等基准上，SHALA-LLM减少了与标注者分布的Jensen-Shannon距离（最多62.1%），并提升了F1分数（最多16.7%）。
Motivation: 许多人类中心任务（如自然语言推理、情感识别）存在多个合理解释，导致标签模糊和标注者分歧。现有LLM对齐方法假设单一正确标签，忽略了标注者不一致性。
Method: 提出SHALA-LLM，一种强化学习框架，直接从标注者分布中学习，并在优化中动态优先处理高模糊样本。
Result: 在ChaosNLI、GoEmotions、MSP-Podcast上，SHALA-LLM减少了Jensen-Shannon距离（最多62.1%），提升了F1分数（最多16.7%）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调建模标注者分歧可以提升分类性能，并改进与人类判断分布的一致性。

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Retinal Microvasculature Restoration in OCT Angiography
papers.abstract_en: Optical coherence tomographic angiography (OCTA) is a powerful technique for imaging retinal microvasculature. However, acquiring reliable quantification of retinal blood flow and areas of retinal nonperfusion is challenging because of imaging artifacts. Existing methods primarily focus on noise suppression, projection artifact removal, or signal enhancement to improve the image quality of OCTA in cross-sectional or two-dimensional (2D) en face projections, while neglecting the intrinsic three-dimensional vascular architecture. In this study, we propose a deep learning-based algorithm for restoring capillary anatomical vasculature from a single OCTA volume. The network consists of an EfficientNet-B5 encoder and a decoder incorporating concurrent spatial and channel squeeze-and-excitation modules, connected via skip connections to preserve spatial resolution. Three adjacent B-frames are used as input to predict the restored middle B-frame. We evaluated the performance of the model using the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) against ground truth generated from averaging multiple scans. The results show that the proposed model significantly (both p < 0.001) improved image quality compared with the original single OCTA volume, with a PSNR of 26.16 +/- 1.26 vs. 22.23 +/- 0.78 and an SSIM of 0.91 +/- 0.02 vs. 0.72 +/- 0.03. The proposed model also significantly (p < 0.001) improved microvascular fidelity, measured by the Dice coefficient overlap between the model output and ground truth, in both 2D and 3D by at least 3.8% and 51.2%, respectively, across several different vascular slabs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的三维视网膜微血管恢复算法，利用单次OCTA体数据重建毛细血管解剖结构。网络采用EfficientNet-B5编码器与包含空间和通道压缩-激励模块的解码器，以三个相邻B帧预测中间帧。模型显著提升了图像质量（PSNR和SSIM）以及微血管保真度（Dice系数），在2D和3D上分别提升至少3.8%和51.2%。
Motivation: 现有OCTA图像处理方法主要关注横截面或二维投影中的噪声抑制、伪影去除或信号增强，忽略了三维血管架构，导致血流和非灌注区域的量化受限于成像伪影。
Method: 提出包含EfficientNet-B5编码器和带空间-通道压缩-激励模块解码器的深度网络，通过跳跃连接保持空间分辨率，使用三个相邻B帧预测恢复的中间B帧。
Result: 在PNSR和SSIM上，模型输出（26.16±1.26, 0.91±0.02）显著优于原始单次OCTA体数据（22.23±0.78, 0.72±0.03），p<0.001；Dice系数在2D和3D上分别提升至少3.8%和51.2%。
Conclusion: 该算法能有效恢复单次OCTA体数据中的毛细血管解剖结构，改善微血管保真度，但摘要未提及跨数据集泛化性或临床验证。

papers.title: Evidence-Guided Neural Architecture Selection under Uncertainty for Subject-Specific Blood Glucose Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Reliable neural architecture selection is an open challenge in time-series forecasting under limited, noisy, and heterogeneous data, where standard heuristic architecture design and validation approaches fail to ensure accurate and reliable prediction and generalization. We propose EVIDENT (EVidence-based IDEntification of Neural archiTectures), a framework for architecture selection that integrates Bayesian training, evidence-based ranking, and task-specific validation under uncertainty. The framework explores the candidate architecture pool and identifies the lowest-capacity model that satisfies a prescribed validation criterion. We demonstrate this method using temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for individualized blood glucose forecasting in type 1 diabetes patients. The results show that EVIDENT systematically rejects both under- and over-parameterized TCN architectures on population-level diabetes data, while identifying models that generalize reliably to unseen patients. When multiple architectures are competitive, the framework further supports plausibility-weighted ensemble predictions that enhance predictive performance. Compared with a random-search baseline, EVIDENT identified smaller architectures with more consistent forecasting performance on unseen patients. These findings establish EVIDENT as a strategy to neural architecture discovery, enabling reliable model selection for high-consequence forecasting in data-limited and heterogeneous settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EVIDENT 框架，用于在有限、噪声和异构数据下进行基于证据的神经网络架构选择。该框架结合贝叶斯训练、基于证据的排名和不确定性下的任务特定验证，自动从候选架构池中选择满足验证标准的最低容量模型。在 1 型糖尿病患者的个性化血糖预测任务中，使用时序卷积网络 (TCN) 验证了该方法：EVIDENT 系统性地拒绝了过参数化和欠参数化的架构，并识别出能可靠泛化到未见病人的模型。此外，当多个架构竞争时，框架支持基于似然加权的集成预测以提升性能。与随机搜索基线相比，EVIDENT 找到了更小且预测性能更一致的架构。
Motivation: 在有限、噪声和异构数据下进行时间序列预测时，标准启发式架构设计无法保证准确可靠的预测和泛化，需要一种系统性的神经架构选择方法。
Method: 提出 EVIDENT 框架，包含贝叶斯训练、基于证据的架构排名和任务特定验证，通过探索候选架构池并选择满足预设验证标准的最低容量模型。

papers.title: Mamba-Assisted Non-Markovian Closure for Reduced-Order Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Reduced-order modeling of high-dimensional dynamical systems is often hindered by the non-Markovian closure term that represents the effect of unresolved variables on the resolved dynamics. Inspired by the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, in which the closure takes the form of a memory functional of the resolved trajectory, we recast closure modeling as a sequence modeling problem and propose the Mamba-Assisted Closure (MAC) framework: a Mamba-based sequence model, trained to predict the closure from the resolved trajectory, is coupled with the reduced-order governing equations through a numerical integrator to advance the resolved variables in time. A key feature of the framework is its exploitation of the dual representation of state-space models -- the model is trained in a sequence-to-sequence fashion via the convolutional form, and deployed for step-by-step autoregressive rollout via the recurrent form, yielding both efficient long-trajectory training and constant per-step inference cost. On the viscous Burgers' equation and the chaotic two-scale Lorenz '96 system, the MAC model substantially outperforms the Markovian reduced-order model, the GRU-based sequence model, and the Wilks method in predictive accuracy and long-time rollout stability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维动力系统降阶建模中的非马尔可夫闭包问题，提出Mamba辅助闭包（MAC）框架。该框架将闭包建模为序列建模问题，使用Mamba状态空间模型从已解析轨迹预测闭包，并通过双重表示（卷积形式训练、递归形式部署）实现高效训练和推理。在粘性Burgers方程和混沌两尺度Lorenz '96系统上，MAC模型在预测精度和长时间稳定性上显著优于马尔可夫降阶模型、GRU序列模型和Wilks方法。
Motivation: 高维动力系统的降阶建模常因非马尔可夫闭包项（表示未解析变量对已解析变量的影响）而受阻，现有方法难以有效处理该闭包项。
Method: 提出MAC框架：基于Mamba的序列模型从已解析轨迹预测闭包项，并与降阶控制方程通过数值积分器耦合；利用状态空间模型的双重表示，以卷积形式进行序列到序列训练，以递归形式进行自回归推理，实现高效长轨迹训练和恒定每步推理成本。
Result: 在粘性Burgers方程和混沌两尺度Lorenz '96系统上，MAC模型在预测精度和长时间展开稳定性上显著优于马尔可夫降阶模型、GRU序列模型和Wilks方法。
Conclusion: MAC框架通过将非马尔可夫闭包建模为序列建模问题，有效提升了降阶模型的预测性能和长期稳定性。

papers.title: Biomazon: A Multimodal Dataset for 3D Forest Structure and Biomass Modeling in the Amazon Basin
papers.abstract_en: Accurate, spatially explicit characterization of tropical forest structure is essential for carbon accounting and ecosystem monitoring, yet most ML pipelines predict canopy-top height proxies (e.g., RH95/RH98) or AGBD as separate scalar targets, rather than learning the forest vertical structure as an ordered profile. The community lacks a ML-ready multimodal benchmark for predicting the entire GEDI RH profile jointly with AGBD, or for evaluating methods that enforce physically consistent ordering across RH percentiles. We address this with Biomazon, a 20 m multimodal benchmark dataset over the Amazon Basin that pairs GEDI RH and AGBD targets with multi-sensor predictors (Sentinel-1/2, ALOS-2 PALSAR-2, Copernicus DEM, Dynamic World LULC, and AlphaEarth embeddings) under standardized spatial splits and evaluation protocols. Using a shared encoder-decoder with task-specific heads as a baseline framework, we conduct a comprehensive ablation study of (i) backbone/model scale, (ii) modality contributions, and (iii) the use of auxiliary embeddings under standalone and fusion settings, and we report both single-target and joint-target results to quantify tradeoffs under a unified training protocol. Finally, we contextualize baseline performance through regionally aligned comparisons against existing gridded products, including GEDI L4D RH10-RH98 and AGBD, at matching temporal scale. Biomazon, together with the accompanying protocols and baseline results, establishes a reference benchmark for future work on structurally consistent RH-profile prediction and structure-biomass modeling in tropical forests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Biomazon，一个 20 米分辨率的多模态基准数据集，覆盖亚马逊流域，用于联合预测 GEDI RH 剖面和地上生物量密度 (AGBD)。数据融合了 Sentinel-1/2、ALOS-2 PALSAR-2、Copernicus DEM、Dynamic World LULC 和 AlphaEarth 嵌入，并提供标准化空间划分和评估协议。基于共享编码器-解码器基线，论文进行了模型规模、模态贡献和辅助嵌入的消融研究，并报告了单目标和联合目标结果。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法通常将森林冠层高度代理（如 RH95/RH98）或 AGBD 作为独立标量预测，缺乏学习森林垂直结构有序剖面的多模态基准，难以保证 RH 百分位数间的物理一致性。
Method: 构建 Biomazon 数据集，将 GEDI RH 和 AGBD 作为目标，与多传感器预测因子配对，采用共享编码器-解码器架构配合任务特定头，进行消融实验分析骨干网络规模、模态贡献和辅助嵌入的影响。
Result: 通过区域一致性比较现有网格产品（如 GEDI L4D RH10-RH98 和 AGBD），在匹配时间尺度上量化基线性能，展示了单目标和联合目标预测的权衡。
Conclusion: Biomazon 为热带森林的结构一致 RH 剖面预测和结构-生物量建模提供了参考基准和基线结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Environment-Robust Representation Learning with Empirical Bayes
papers.abstract_en: We consider multi-environment prediction problems. We assume the environments change the distribution of a latent variable, while the mechanisms generating observed covariates and targets remain stable conditional on that variable. For example, hospitals or clinical cohorts may differ in the prevalence of latent patient states, even though the relationships between those states, physiological measurements, and outcomes remain unchanged. Given a dataset from multiple environments, we formulate a Bayesian model for such problems and derive the corresponding variational objective. We show that this objective decomposes into per-environment terms and an additional cross-environment balancing term induced by the model's structure. We use an empirical Bayes method to set the prior and incorporate it into the objective. Based on this objective, we develop an amortized variational algorithm for posterior approximation, and use the resulting learned latent variables to form predictions in new environments.We study our approach through simulations and real-world studies of astronomical source identification, microbiome-based disease detection, and ICU sepsis prediction. Across these settings, our method outperforms previous approaches for prediction in new environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多环境预测问题，提出一种基于经验贝叶斯（Empirical Bayes）的环境鲁棒表示学习方法。该方法假设环境改变潜变量的分布，而观测变量与目标的条件生成机制稳定，通过变分目标分解为环境内项和跨环境平衡项，并采用摊销变分算法进行后验近似。在模拟实验及天文源识别、微生物组疾病检测、ICU脓毒症预测等真实任务中，新环境预测性能优于先前方法。
Motivation: 多环境预测中，环境分布变化导致模型泛化困难，现有方法常忽略环境间共享的稳定条件机制。
Method: 构建贝叶斯模型，推导出含跨环境平衡项的变分目标，用经验贝叶斯设定先验并融入目标，开发摊销变分算法学习潜变量用于新环境预测。
Result: 在模拟和天文源识别、微生物组疾病检测、ICU脓毒症预测任务上，新环境预测性能优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 所提方法有效利用跨环境结构提升多环境预测鲁棒性。

papers.title: Should Demand Models Incorporate Competitor Prices? Oblivious Learning and Algorithmic Collusion
papers.abstract_en: On a platform with many sellers, should a pricing algorithm explicitly model competitors' prices when learning demand? Classical learning arguments suggest an affirmative answer: ignoring competitors induces model misspecification and inefficiency. In contrast, recent work on algorithmic collusion suggests that strategic obliviousness -- deliberately ignoring competitor prices -- may facilitate collusive outcomes and improve profits. We study this modeling choice in a stylized competitive market with unknown noisy demand, in which multiple sellers repeatedly set prices and estimate demand via iterated least squares, and either incorporate competitors' prices into their demand models (informed) or ignore them (oblivious). We first show that, relative to a monopolist, an oblivious seller in a competitive market must explore more aggressively to compensate for the loss of dynamic competitor information. Building on this insight, we characterize market dynamics when all sellers are oblivious and show that prices converge to the competitive outcome under sufficient exploration, while a continuum of pseudo-equilibria arises when exploration decays. Analyzing the resulting price trajectories, we uncover an excursion phenomenon that gives rise to transient collusive patterns that dissipate as learning progresses. In markets with both oblivious and informed sellers, the informed strictly out-earn the oblivious. Read as a strategy game, the modeling choice has a unique Nash equilibrium: the all-informed market, in which prices converge to the competitive outcome efficiently. Overall, our results indicate that collusive patterns are not robust and are not sustained by oblivious modeling; therefore, incorporating competitor information, together with sufficient price exploration, remains a reliable strategy for sellers in competitive markets.
papers.comment: Preliminary version "Oblivious Learning, Price Exploration and Collusive Dynamics" accepted at EC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多卖家平台中定价算法是否应显式建模竞争对手价格。通过迭代最小二乘估计需求，比较 oblivious（忽略对手价格）和 informed（包含对手价格）两种策略。结果表明，oblivious 需要更激进探索，但可能产生临时合谋模式；长期看，informed 策略收益更高，市场达到完全竞争均衡。
Motivation: 经典学习理论认为应包含对手价格以避免模型误设，但近期算法合谋工作提示故意忽略对手价格可能促进合谋。论文旨在澄清这一建模选择的长期影响。
Method: 在具有未知噪声需求的市场中，多个卖家重复定价并通过迭代最小二乘估计需求，分别采用 oblivious 或 informed 的模型选择，分析市场动态和价格轨迹。
Result: Oblivious 卖家需要更激进探索以补偿信息缺失；当所有卖家 oblivious 且探索充分时，价格收敛到竞争结果；探索衰减时出现伪均衡；存在临时合谋模式但随学习消散。混合市场中 informed 卖家收益严格更高；建模选择博弈的唯一纳什均衡是所有 informed 的市场。
Conclusion: 合谋模式不稳健，不能被 oblivious 建模维持；包含竞争对手信息并结合充分的价格探索是可靠策略。

papers.title: TabSODA: Tabular Diffusion based Imputation with Skip Pattern Detection and Ordinal Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Missing data imputation in large-scale surveys faces two challenges that are not well handled by current tabular diffusion methods. First, \emph{structural skips}, cells made inapplicable by questionnaire design, should not be imputed but are often conflated with item nonresponse. Second, \emph{ordinal} responses encode ordered categories, yet most pipelines treat them as nominal levels through one-hot or analog-bit encodings. We introduce \textbf{TabSODA} (\textbf{Tab}ular diffusion with \textbf{S}kip pattern detection and \textbf{O}r\textbf{d}inal \textbf{A}wareness), an Expectation-Maximization (EM)-based diffusion imputer built on the Elucidated Diffusion Model (EDM) framework. TabSODA propagates structural skips through the denoising loss and reverse-time sampler, and represents ordinal variables with cumulative-probit scalar latents while retaining analog-bit encodings for nominal variables. When a codebook skip mask is available, TabSODA uses it directly; otherwise, the TabSODA+SKIP variant estimates the mask from raw responses and questionnaire order using a CART-based skip-pattern miner. On Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health (PATH) study and the National Survey on Drug Use and Health (NSDUH), two nationally representative U.S.\ surveys, TabSODA reduces ordinal MACE by up to $23.7\%$ and improves categorical accuracy by up to $9\%$ over the strongest baseline across MCAR, MAR, and MNAR masking. The skip miner achieves near-perfect precision on both datasets, allowing TabSODA+SKIP to closely track the codebook-mask variant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabSODA 是一种基于扩散模型的表格数据插补方法，专门处理大规模调查中的结构跳转和有序变量问题。它通过期望最大化框架整合跳过模式检测和有序感知，在人口健康调查数据上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有表格扩散方法无法区分结构跳转（不应插补）和项目无回答，且大多将有序变量视为名义变量，导致插补失真。
Method: 基于 Elucidated Diffusion Model 框架，结合跳过模式传播和累积概率标量潜变量表示有序变量，并可选地使用 CART 算法从问卷顺序估计跳过掩码。
Result: 在 PATH 和 NSDUH 调查数据上，TabSODA 将有序 MACE 降低最多 23.7%，分类准确率提高最多 9%，且跳过检测达到近乎完美的精确度。
Conclusion: TabSODA 有效解决了大规模调查中结构跳转和有序变量两个难题，在多种缺失机制下均取得最优性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: TabSODA 是一种基于扩散模型的表格数据插补方法，专门处理大规模调查中的结构跳转和有序变量问题。它通过期望最大化框架整合跳过模式检测和有序感知，在人口健康调查数据上显著优于现有基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有表格扩散方法无法区分结构跳转（不应插补）和项目无回答，且大多将有序变量视为名义变量，导致插补失真。
summary_sections.method: 基于 Elucidated Diffusion Model 框架，结合跳过模式传播和累积概率标量潜变量表示有序变量，并可选地使用 CART 算法从问卷顺序估计跳过掩码。

summary_sections.conclusion: TabSODA 有效解决了大规模调查中结构跳转和有序变量两个难题，在多种缺失机制下均取得最优性能。

papers.title: Recovering Physically Plausible Human-Object Interactions from Monocular Videos
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose RePHO, a method to reconstruct physically plausible human-object interactions (HOI) from monocular videos. While existing kinematic-based approaches produce visually plausible motion, they often result in physically implausible artifacts such as interpenetration and object floating. To overcome these issues, we introduce a physics-guided reconstruction framework. We begin with a kinematic estimate and then refine it by training a policy with reinforcement learning (RL). This policy is optimized to reproduce the interaction in a physics simulator. Because kinematic estimates are typically noisy, naive RL training can fail. Therefore, we propose an adaptive sampling strategy with a dual self-updating mechanism that can identify the frames with the most informative and reliable kinematic reconstruction. Our process progressively improves reconstruction quality and yields physically consistent HOI sequences. We demonstrate our approach on two standard HOI benchmarks and achieve clear improvements in physical plausibility metrics over state-of-the-art methods. Project Page: https://dingbang777.github.io/RePHO/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RePHO方法，从单目视频中重建物理合理的人-物交互（HOI）。现有基于运动学的方法会产生穿透或物体漂浮等伪影，作者引入物理引导的重建框架：先获得运动学估计，再通过强化学习（RL）训练策略在物理仿真器中复现交互。针对运动学估计噪声导致的RL训练失败问题，提出自适应采样策略和双自更新机制，逐步提升重建质量。在两个标准HOI基准上，物理合理性指标优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有运动学方法重建的人-物交互常出现穿透、物体漂浮等物理不合理的伪影，需要一种保证物理一致性的重建方法。
Method: 提出物理引导的重建框架：先进行运动学估计，再通过强化学习训练策略在仿真器中复现交互；为应对运动学估计噪声，设计了自适应采样策略与双自更新机制，识别信息量最可靠的运动学重建帧。
Result: 在两个标准HOI基准上，物理合理性指标明显优于当前最优方法。
Conclusion: RePHO能有效从单目视频恢复物理合理的交互序列，但方法依赖仿真器和强化学习训练，可能对复杂场景计算成本较高。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An interpretable and trustworthy AI framework for large-scale longitudinal structure-pain association studies using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI)
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To develop an interpretable and trustworthy AI framework that combines deep learning based MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) prediction with interpretable statistical modeling to study structure-pain relationships at scale using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI). Materials and Methods: We first developed a deep learning framework to predict MOAKS features directly from knee MRIs and incorporated conformal prediction to provide prediction uncertainty quantification. This uncertainty-aware strategy enables explicit filtering of model outputs, retaining only high-confidence MOAKS predictions at the knee level. Second, we applied a longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) to examine associations between key structural abnormalities and four complementary knee pain measurements. Results: Among the three MRI-defined abnormalities (i.e., bone marrow lesions (BML), cartilage loss (CART), and meniscal extrusion (ME)), our framework substantially improved the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and some other metrics. For example, MCC increased from 0.69 to 0.91 for BML, from 0.45 to 0.80 for CART, and from 0.59 to 0.89 for ME. Using these high-confidence predictions, we expanded the sample size to 2,175 knees for the LCMM analysis. Two distinct pain trajectories were identified (rapid and stable pain progression). The estimated odds ratios (95% CI) for the rapid progression group were 1.62 (1.12-2.35) for BML, 1.83 (1.24-2.70) for CART loss, and 2.50 (1.75-3.57) for ME. Conclusion: These results highlight the importance of these structural abnormalities as risk factors for pain and functional progression in osteoarthritis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释且可信的AI框架，结合深度学习预测MRI骨关节炎膝关节评分（MOAKS）与可解释统计建模，在大规模骨关节炎倡议（OAI）数据中研究结构-疼痛关联。框架使用共形预测提供不确定性量化，并通过纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）识别出快速和稳定两种疼痛轨迹，发现骨髓病变、软骨丢失和半月板挤压是显著风险因素。
Motivation: 现有结构-疼痛关联研究受限于手动评分成本高、样本量小，且缺乏不确定性量化，导致结果不可靠。需要一种可扩展、可解释且可信的方法来大规模分析骨关节炎的结构异常与疼痛关系。
Method: 首先开发深度学习模型从膝盖MRI直接预测MOAKS特征，并集成共形预测（conformal prediction）以提供预测不确定性，仅保留高置信度的预测。然后应用纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）分析关键结构异常与四种互补膝盖疼痛测量的关联。
Result: 在骨髓病变（BML）、软骨丢失（CART）和半月板挤压（ME）三个异常中，MCC分别从0.69提升至0.91、0.45至0.80、0.59至0.89。LCMM分析纳入2,175个膝盖，识别出快速与稳定疼痛进展轨迹，快速进展组中BML、CART和ME的优势比（95% CI）分别为1.62（1.12-2.35）、1.83（1.24-2.70）和2.50（1.75-3.57）。
Conclusion: 研究强调了BML、CART和ME作为骨关节炎疼痛及功能进展的重要风险因素，展示了深度学习结合统计建模在大规模纵向研究中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LightVesselNet: An Ultra-Lightweight Sub-100K Parameter Network for Retinal Blood Vessel Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Retinal blood vessel segmentation plays a vital role in the early detection of diabetic retinopathy and glaucoma. While recent deep learning models have achieved great segmentation accuracy, they typically require heavy computational resources, making real-world deployment on edge devices difficult. In this paper, we propose LightVesselNet, an efficient neural network designed for retinal vessel segmentation in a resource-constrained environment. Despite containing only 75K parameters, LightVesselNet performs competitively with much larger models. The network employs a compact encoder decoder architecture enhanced with channel and spatial attention mechanisms, a multi-scale feature aggregation module at the bottleneck, and a subpixel upsampling strategy in the decoder. A dedicated edge residual connection preserves fine vessel detail throughout decoding. Extensive experiments on five publicly available datasets: DRIVE, STARE, CHASEDB1, FIVES, and HRF, yield sensitivity scores of 0.8189, 0.8499, 0.8640, 0.8634, 0.8096, and Dice coefficients of 0.8070, 0.8072, 0.8181, 0.8649, and 0.7686, respectively. LightVesselNet shows improved efficiency (Performance vs Parameter or GFlops) compared to State-of-the-Art models. Cross-dataset evaluation confirms the model's generalisation capability. Overall, LightVesselNet is a strong candidate for deployment in low-resource clinical settings and mobile screening tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightVesselNet，一个仅含 75K 参数的极轻量级网络，用于视网膜血管分割。该网络采用紧凑的编码器-解码器架构，结合通道与空间注意力、瓶颈处的多尺度特征融合以及亚像素上采样策略，并通过边缘残差连接保持精细血管细节。在 DRIVE、STARE、CHASEDB1、FIVES 和 HRF 五个公开数据集上，取得了与大型模型竞争的性能（Dice 系数最高 0.8649，灵敏度最高 0.8640），且计算效率优于现有方法。跨数据集评估证实了其泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有视网膜血管分割深度学习模型精度高但计算资源需求大，难以在边缘设备或资源受限的临床环境中部署。
Method: 提出 LightVesselNet，超轻量级编码器-解码器网络，包含通道与空间注意力模块、瓶颈处多尺度特征聚合模块、解码器中亚像素上采样策略，以及保持血管细节的边缘残差连接。总参数量仅 75K。
Result: 在五个数据集上，灵敏度分别达 0.8189、0.8499、0.8640、0.8634、0.8096，Dice 系数分别为 0.8070、0.8072、0.8181、0.8649、0.7686。性能与参数或 GFlops 比值优于现有最先进模型。跨数据集评估验证了泛化性。
Conclusion: LightVesselNet 在极低参数量的情况下实现了有竞争力的分割性能，适合部署在低资源临床环境和移动筛查工具中。

papers.title: TopoPult-SSL: Gland-Mask-Free Cross-Device Meibomian Gland Segmentation via Self-Distilled Weak Clinical Priors
papers.abstract_en: Every new clinical imaging device creates a domain shift where dense gland masks are expensive yet cheap clinical signals -- eyelid outlines, Pult grades, morphometric ratios -- are routinely recorded. We present TopoPult-SSL, a two-stage framework for cross-device meibomian gland segmentation. Stage 1 adapts a source-trained model without target gland masks in the training loss, using four weak-prior anchors driven by target eyelid masks and clinical metadata only. Stage 2, when target gland masks are available, distils complementary Stage-1 teachers into a single compact student via supervised self-distillation. We develop and validate the technique on the public MGD-1k to CAMG research benchmark (1,000 to 100 images, different device), where the distilled model achieves Dice 0.716+/-0.006 (best 0.726), surpassing UA-MT (0.710) and the ensemble teacher (0.720) -- with a single pass. The gland-mask-free Stage-1 variant reaches Precision 0.694 vs. 0.30-0.34 for SAM/MedSAM (p<0.001), enabling deployment without dense gland contouring. Code and reproducibility scripts are released.

TL;DR: 本文提出TopoPult-SSL，一种两阶段框架用于跨设备睑板腺分割。第一阶段无需目标设备腺体掩码，仅利用眼睑轮廓和临床元数据作为弱先验；第二阶段在有目标掩码时通过自蒸馏将互补的教师模型蒸馏为紧凑学生模型。在MGD-1k到CAMG基准上，蒸馏模型Dice达到0.716±0.006，优于UA-MT和教师集成，无掩码变体精确度显著高于SAM/MedSAM。

Method: 两阶段框架：阶段1通过四个弱先验锚点（目标眼睑掩码和临床元数据）适配源模型，训练损失中不使用目标腺体掩码；阶段2在有目标掩码时，通过监督自蒸馏将互补的阶段1教师模型蒸馏为单个紧凑学生模型。

papers.title: PJ-RoPE: A Fourier-Jet-Affine Position Space for Relative Attention
papers.abstract_en: We unify RoPE's Fourier phase, Jordan-RoPE's finite jets, and ALiBi's affine recency into a single learnable relative-position space, and study which regions of this space are selected by different tasks. PJ-RoPE is a Fourier-Jet-Affine formulation for relative attention, with an optional Poincare-type reading as the affine completion of a homogeneous Fourier-jet positional representation. Algebraically, the same primitives form a finite constant-coefficient difference module: simple roots of the lag-shift operator give Fourier/RoPE characters, repeated nonzero roots give Jordan/Fourier jets, and the repeated unit root gives ALiBi-like affine recency. The framework separates scalar PJ-bias kernels from exact PJ-rotary feature transforms, introduces adaptive sector diagnostics, and uses LC/rapidity coordinates to stabilize high-order jets. Controlled probes verify sector containment and selection; small language runs expose an affine/recency boundary; music-token streams provide the clearest case where LC/affine variants remain strong while carrying measurable high-order corrections; and LC diagnostics show a scale-stability gain coupled to phase-resolution loss.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ybzhang-nxu/Poincare_Rope
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PJ-RoPE，一种将 RoPE 的傅里叶相位、Jordan-RoPE 的有限 jets 和 ALiBi 的仿射近因性统一到一个可学习相对位置空间的框架。该框架通过常系数差分模的代数结构解释不同位置编码，引入自适应扇区诊断和 LC/rapidity 坐标稳定高阶 jets，并通过受控探针和小语言模型、音乐令牌流实验验证了不同任务对位置空间区域的选择和特性。
Motivation: 现有相对位置编码（如 RoPE、Jordan-RoPE、ALiBi）各自独立，缺乏统一的理论框架来理解不同任务如何选择和组合这些位置表示。
Method: 提出傅里叶-jet-仿射（PJ-RoPE）公式，将位置空间建模为常系数差分模：简单根对应 RoPE 傅里叶特征，重复非零根对应 Jordan jets，重复单位根对应 ALiBi 仿射近因。框架包含标量 PJ-bias 核与精确 PJ-rotary 特征变换，并引入自适应扇区诊断和 LC/rapidity 坐标来稳定高阶 jets。
Result: 受控探针验证了扇区包含和选择；小语言模型运行暴露了仿射/近因边界；音乐令牌流显示 LC/affine 变体保持强性能的同时携带可测量的高阶校正；LC 诊断表明尺度稳定性增益伴随着相位分辨率损失。
Conclusion: PJ-RoPE 提供了一个统一的、可解释的相对位置空间，能够根据任务需求自适应地选择不同的位置编码区域，为设计更灵活的位置编码机制提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks. SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长时间运行任务的AI代理设计，指出当前持续行动模式不适合需要持续关注的任务，提出SentinelBench基准。该基准包含100个任务，覆盖10个合成web环境（如邮件、日历、金融等），测量任务完成度、反应时间和资源使用。在三个模型和两个浏览器代理上的实验建立了性能基线，并展示了代理设计选择对关键指标的显著影响。
Motivation: 现有AI代理默认采用持续行动策略（如频繁调用工具、刷新页面），不适合等待外部事件的长时间任务，需要一种基于持续关注（sustained attention）的监测策略。缺乏评估此类任务的基准。
Method: 提出SentinelBench，一个开源的时间演化监测任务基准，包含100个任务和10个合成web环境，每个环境重放脚本化事件序列，要求代理在动态变化的网页中导航和推理。基准测量任务完成度、反应时间和资源使用，以评估响应性与成本之间的权衡。
Result: 在三个模型和两个浏览器代理上报告实验结果，建立了性能基线，表明代理设计选择（如监测策略）会显著影响关键指标。
Conclusion: SentinelBench能够区分不同代理行为在长时间监测任务上的有意义差异，为未来比较提供基准。

papers.title: A Taxonomy of Runtime Faults in Model Context Protocol Servers
papers.abstract_en: MCP (Model Context Protocol) enables LLMs (Large Language Models) to interact with external tools and data sources via a standardized protocol. Its rapid adoption in tool-augmented Artificial Intelligence (AI) workflows has introduced new reliability challenges, such as configuration parameters that are accepted but not enforced at runtime, leading to unintended default behavior, whose runtime fault characteristics remain empirically unexamined. We present the first empirical taxonomy of runtime faults in MCP servers. We manually analyzed 837 MCP-specific runtime fault threads from 473 actively maintained MCP server GitHub repositories and derived a taxonomy using a bottom-up open coding procedure. The taxonomy comprises 11 top-level categories and 27 subcategories (73 leaf fault types), covering recurrent failures across protocol interactions, tool invocations, schema enforcement, state management, model-provider integration, security validation, and timeouts or explicit cancellations of in-progress operations. To assess the taxonomy's external validity, we surveyed 55 MCP server developers. Respondents reported experiencing an average of 20 of the 27 fault subcategories, and no category remained unobserved. These results indicate that the taxonomy reflects widely observed runtime failures in MCP-based systems and shall assist AI software maintenance and evolution in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器中的运行时故障进行实证分类。作者手动分析了473个活跃MCP服务器GitHub仓库中的837个故障线程，采用自底向上的开放式编码方法，构建了一个包含11个顶级类别、27个子类别（73个叶子故障类型）的分类体系。对55名MCP服务器开发者的调查显示，受访者平均经历过27个子类别中的20个，且所有类别均被观察到，表明该分类体系反映了基于MCP系统的常见运行时故障。
Motivation: MCP被广泛用于增强LLM与外部工具和数据的交互，但其运行时故障特征尚未得到系统性的实证研究。现有问题包括配置参数被接受但未在运行时强制执行，导致意外默认行为。
Method: 通过手动分析473个MCP服务器GitHub仓库中的837个故障线程，采用自底向上的开放式编码方法构建故障分类体系，并通过55名开发者的问卷调查评估其外部有效性。
Result: 分类体系包含11个顶级类别和27个子类别（73个叶子类型），覆盖协议交互、工具调用、模式执行、状态管理、模型提供者集成、安全验证及超时/取消等故障。调查中开发者平均经历20个子类别，所有类别均被报告。
Conclusion: 该分类体系反映了MCP系统中广泛观察到的运行时故障，有助于AI软件的维护与演进。

papers.title: A prism hierarchy of learning regimes in large linear autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Theoretical studies of machine learning models commonly consider different limiting regimes in which the learning dynamics of gradient descent becomes theoretically tractable. It is, however, desirable to have a systematically obtained picture of all qualitatively different extreme learning regimes for a particular type of models. In this paper we propose such a picture for large weight-tied linear autoencoders characterized by input and latent dimensions, initialization magnitude, and training set size. This model is nonlinear in the weights and its gradient flow does not have a general theoretical solution. We show that at the level of the formal loss-expansion hierarchy, its extreme regimes are naturally associated with faces of a triangular prism. In particular, there are five basic extreme regimes associated with the 2-faces of the prism: (1) large-data, (2) small-data, (3) mean-field, (4) narrow-latent, and (5) free. For regimes (1,2,3,4), we derive explicit expressions for both train and population limiting loss evolutions under gradient flow, obtaining very good agreement with experimental results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模权值绑定线性自编码器（large weight-tied linear autoencoders），提出一个系统性的学习机制棱镜层次结构。在该模型中，极端学习机制自然地与三棱柱的面对应，共有五个基本极端机制：大数据、小数据、平均场、窄潜变量和自由机制。对于前四个机制，作者推导了梯度流下训练损失和群体损失的显式演化表达式，并与实验结果高度吻合。
Motivation: 机器学习模型的理论研究通常考虑不同的极限机制，但缺乏对特定模型所有定性不同的极端学习机制的系统性刻画。本文旨在为大规模线性自编码器提供这样一幅完整图景。
Method: 通过形式化损失展开层次（loss-expansion hierarchy），将极端机制与三棱柱的面对应，识别出五个基本极端机制，并针对其中四个机制推导梯度流下训练损失和群体损失的解析解。
Result: 对于大数据、小数据、平均场和窄潜变量四种机制，推导出训练和群体损失在梯度流下的显式演化表达式，实验验证与理论高度一致。
Conclusion: 本文系统地刻画了大规模线性自编码器的极端学习机制，揭示了不同机制之间的几何联系，并为后续更复杂模型的理论分析提供了框架。

papers.title: Uncertainty Aware Functional Behavior Prediction and Material Fatigue Assessment for Circular Factory
papers.abstract_en: Returned products in circular factories re-enter production with heterogeneous degradation states, usage histories, and remaining capability. Reuse cannot be decided from the current inspection alone, because future function fulfillment and component integrity may evolve differently under the next service scenario. Existing PHM approaches support degradation prediction, but often target fixed operating conditions or isolated component benchmarks, while material-fatigue assessment is rarely linked to system-level functional prognosis. This paper addresses this gap for an angle grinder by combining uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level fatigue assessment in an instance-specific reliability workflow. The proposed framework combines the current tool state with recent force--torque usage windows. A convolutional encoder extracts loading patterns from spindle forces and shaft torque, and an LSTM backbone predicts nine functional variables as Gaussian mean and variance estimates. In parallel, the same loading history is translated into output-shaft fatigue information through finite-element-supported stress reconstruction, S--N/Miner damage evaluation with Haibach extension, and Paris-law crack-growth analysis. A streaming replay algorithm consolidates both branches into functional, material, and system reliability trajectories. Held-out tests show mean \(2\%\)-tolerance accuracy of 0.9652 across nine outputs. Thermal variables are predicted near-perfectly, while drive motor current and load speed remain the most demanding dynamic outputs, with \(R^2\) values of 0.9750 and 0.9924. Torque history is especially important for these variables, and the conventional LSTM outperforms GRU and xLSTM in the short-history setting. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对循环工厂中返回产品的异质退化状态和剩余能力评估问题，提出一个结合不确定性感知功能预测与组件级疲劳评估的可靠性框架。该框架利用卷积编码器提取力-扭矩加载模式，LSTM预测九个功能变量为高斯分布参数，同时通过有限元应力重建和裂纹扩展分析进行疲劳评估，最终生成功能、材料和系统可靠性轨迹。
Motivation: 循环工厂中返回产品具有异质退化状态和未知使用历史，仅凭当前检查无法决定是否重用，因为未来功能表现和完整性可能变化。现有PHM方法多针对固定工况或孤立组件，且材料疲劳评估与系统级功能预测脱节。
Method: 提出一个实例特定的可靠性工作流，结合当前工具状态和最近力-扭矩使用窗口。卷积编码器提取主轴力和轴扭矩的加载模式，LSTM骨干网络预测九个功能变量（高斯均值和方差）。同时，同一加载历史通过有限元应力重建、S-N/Miner损伤评估（含Haibach扩展）和Paris律裂纹扩展分析转化为输出轴疲劳信息。流式重放算法将两条分支整合为功能、材料和系统可靠性轨迹。
Result: 留出测试显示九个输出上的平均2%容差准确率为0.9652。热变量预测近乎完美，而驱动电机电流和负载速度是最困难的动态输出，R²分别为0.9750和0.9924。扭矩历史对这些变量尤为重要，在短历史设置中传统LSTM优于GRU和xLSTM。可靠性校准对驱动电机电流最具信息量。
Conclusion: 该框架将不确定性感知功能预测与组件级疲劳评估相结合，为循环工厂中产品重用决策提供更全面的可靠性信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GITCO: Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization in TSFMs
papers.abstract_en: Patch-based Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) suffer from context poisoning: structurally anomalous patches capture disproportionate attention and silently degrade zero-shot forecast quality. We propose improving TSFM accuracy at inference time by optimizing the input context rather than modifying model weights. We present GITCO (Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization), a lightweight three-component framework: Gate, Router, and Critic that selectively identifies and suppresses harmful patches without any parameter updates. Evaluated on TimesFM 2.5 across 53 GIFT-Eval datasets under K-fold cross-validation, GITCO achieves an average +1.95% MASE reduction on TimesFM 2.5 while capturing 89.9% of the improvement upper bound. We introduce context sensitivity profiles as a new characterizable property of TSFMs: the mapping from time series meta-features to expected accuracy improvement under inference-time context intervention, shaped jointly by model architecture and the statistical structure of the data.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GITCO（Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization），一种轻量级三组件框架（门控、路由、批评器），在推理时优化输入上下文以提升基于补丁的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的零样本预测精度，无需更新模型参数。在 TimesFM 2.5 和 53 个 GIFT-Eval 数据集上，平均 MASE 降低 1.95%，达到改进上限的 89.9%。
Motivation: 基于补丁的 TSFM 存在上下文中毒问题：结构异常的补丁会吸引过多注意力，静默地降低零样本预测质量。现有方法多修改模型权重，本文旨在通过推理时输入优化来提升精度，避免参数更新。
Method: GITCO 包含三个组件：Gate（门控）识别有害补丁、Router（路由）分配注意力权重、Critic（批评器）评估补丁影响，协同工作以选择性地抑制异常补丁，无需额外训练或微调。
Result: 在 TimesFM 2.5 上，跨 53 个 GIFT-Eval 数据集做 K 折交叉验证，平均 MASE 降低 1.95%，捕获了改进上限的 89.9%。
Conclusion: 本文引入上下文敏感度轮廓（context sensitivity profiles）作为 TSFM 的新可表征属性，描述时间序列元特征与推理时上下文干预下预期精度提升的映射关系，受模型架构和数据统计结构共同影响。

papers.title: A Model of Multi-turn Human Persuadability Using Probabilistic Belief Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can shift human beliefs across high-stakes domains, but most persuasion studies rely on pre/post belief change. These endpoint measures identify whether persuasion occurred, yet miss where and how beliefs moved within a dialogue. We present PERSUASIONTRACE, a framework for studying persuasion in human-LLM interaction. Built on a web-based experimental platform, PERSUASIONTRACE contributes a tool for multi-turn persuasion studies and a process-level evaluation protocol: it records multi-turn belief reports from human or simulated targets of persuasion, annotates persuader turns with rhetorical dimensions (logos/pathos/ethos), and evaluates simulators by fidelity to real human belief dynamics. Using this framework, we find that human targets group into two clusters of multi-turn belief updates and exhibit susceptibility to rhetorical strategies, and that LLMs are persuasive across generic and personalized topics, text and audio modalities, and multi-turn interactions. Prior work has chiefly used vanilla-prompted LLMs to simulate human targets, but we show that these simulators fail to replicate human belief dynamics. We introduce a Bayesian-network simulated target that maintains an explicit latent belief state over time so each persuader message yields cognitively realistic belief updates. In human-likeness evaluation, our Bayesian target scores near a human reference (81 vs 80), while baseline LLM targets score substantially lower (64). PERSUASIONTRACE reframes persuasion evaluation from endpoint movement alone to process fidelity, providing a stronger basis for scientific analysis and safer optimization of persuasive systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PERSUASIONTRACE框架，用于研究人机交互中的多轮说服过程。该框架记录人类或被模拟目标的多轮信念报告，标注说服者的修辞维度（logos/pathos/ethos），并通过贝叶斯网络模拟目标实现认知真实的信念更新。实验发现人类目标可分为两类多轮信念更新模式，且LLM在多种条件下具有说服力，但直接使用LLM模拟人类目标会失败。
Motivation: 现有说服研究多依赖前/后信念变化（端点测量），无法捕捉对话中信念如何逐步移动。缺乏对多轮说服过程层面的系统分析工具。
Method: 开发PERSUASIONTRACE框架，包含：基于Web的实验平台、多轮信念报告记录、说服者话语的修辞维度标注、以及贝叶斯网络模拟目标（显式维护潜在信念状态，实现认知真实的信念更新）。
Result: 人类目标聚为两类多轮信念更新模式；LLM在通用和个性化主题、文本和音频模态、多轮交互中均有效；贝叶斯网络模拟目标的人类相似度评分（81）接近人类参考（80），而基线LLM模拟目标得分较低（64）。
Conclusion: PERSUASIONTRACE将说服评估从端点变化转向过程保真度，为说服系统的科学分析和安全优化提供了更强的基础。

papers.title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
papers.abstract_en: Modern video diffusion models generate increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, motivating their use as candidate world simulators. Yet it remains unclear whether these models internally encode physical structure, or merely reproduce motion patterns seen during training. We study this question by probing video diffusion models along latent trajectories corresponding to real videos with known physical plausibility. To obtain such trajectories, we approximately invert the deterministic sampling process by integrating the learned velocity field backward from a clean video latent to noise, giving access to the model's intermediate states and attention maps. Using these recovered trajectories, we show that physical plausibility is linearly decodable from diffusion transformer states across IntPhys and InfLevel, reaching around 81.27% average accuracy and outperforming dedicated representation-learning baselines such as V-JEPA and VideoMAE. Surprisingly, this signal is absent from the VAE latent input and emerges inside the denoising transformer itself, despite the model not being trained with a self-supervised predictive objective. These findings suggest that physically meaningful representations can arise as a byproduct of generative denoising.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过反向扩散过程获取视频扩散模型在潜在空间中的轨迹，并从中解码物理合理性，发现扩散Transformer内部状态线性编码了物理结构，准确率约81.27%，超越了V-JEPA和VideoMAE等基准。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型作为世界模拟器的潜力引发关注，但尚不清楚它们是否真正编码物理结构，还是仅记忆训练数据中的运动模式。
Method: 通过近似反转确定性采样过程，从干净视频潜在反向积分速度场到噪声，恢复中间状态和注意力图，然后从这些轨迹中线性解码物理合理性。
Result: 在IntPhys和InfLevel基准上，扩散Transformer状态线性解码物理合理性的平均准确率达到81.27%，优于专门的自监督表示学习方法。
Conclusion: 物理上有意义的表示可以作为生成性去噪的副产品出现，且该信号源自去噪Transformer内部而非VAE潜在输入。

papers.title: Multimarginal flow matching with optimal transport potentials
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful framework for learning dynamic transport maps between two empirical distributions. However, less explored is the setting with intermediate observed marginals that can help constrain the flows between the endpoints. This "multimarginal" regime is central to modeling temporal evolution in dynamical systems in many scientific domains that can sample sequential distributions. We tackle this problem with a novel approach that leverages the connection between FM and dynamic optimal transport (OT), softly steering the flow towards the intermediate marginals through potential terms in the dynamic OT action. By extending the conditional FM learning target to incorporate these potentials, we derive an efficient, simulation-free algorithm for multimarginal FM that offers considerable flexibility in the spatiotemporal dynamics of the learned flows. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and training efficiency of OT-potential FM (OTP-FM) on diverse single-cell RNA sequencing, oceanographic, and meteorological datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/Bexorg-Inc/OTP-FM.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, and a 27 page appendix. Accepted to the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多边缘流匹配（Multimarginal Flow Matching）方法，利用最优输运势（OT potentials）软约束中间边缘分布，扩展条件流匹配学习目标，得到无模拟训练算法OTP-FM。在单细胞RNA-seq、海洋学和气象数据集上展示了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有流匹配主要处理两个端点分布，但许多科学问题中存在中间观测边缘分布，如何利用这些中间分布约束端点之间的流尚未充分探索。
Method: 利用流匹配与动态最优输运的联系，在动态OT作用量中加入势项软引导流经过中间边缘分布。通过扩展条件流匹配学习目标以包含这些势，推导出高效的无模拟多边缘流匹配算法（OTP-FM）。
Result: 在单细胞RNA-seq、海洋学和气象数据集上取得最先进性能和训练效率。
Conclusion: 该算法在时空动力学上提供灵活性，适用于多种动态系统建模。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: Gradient descent at the Edge of Stability: free energy model and kinetic description of the two-layer network
papers.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of gradient descent in the Edge of Stability regime, where the learning rate is large enough to induce persistent oscillations in the loss and the sharpness. We propose a continuous-time effective model that tracks the evolution of the average trajectory coupled with the time-averaged covariance of its fast oscillations. Our analysis reveals that the natural quantity to monitor in such unstable regimes is an effective free energy, which combines the original risk functional with a curvature-related "entropic" term. Our model allows us to track the envelope of the oscillations even in situations where its dynamics evolve on similar timescales as the averaged weights. Otherwise stated, we can track the spikes that occur during the training of some neural network architectures. For wide two-layer neural networks optimized under stable non-vanishing oscillations, we derive a mean-field limit that results in a novel kinetic equation describing the joint distribution of weights and their fluctuations. We show that this equation can be interpreted as a Wasserstein-2 gradient flow of a macroscopic free energy. Finally, we provide numerical evidence on matrix factorization and deep learning tasks (CIFAR-10) to demonstrate the model's accuracy in capturing the envelope of the oscillations and the predictive power of the effective free energy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了梯度下降在稳定性边缘（Edge of Stability）的动力学，其中学习率足够大以引起损失和锐度的持续振荡。作者提出了一个连续时间有效模型，追踪平均轨迹的演化与快速振荡的时均协方差，并揭示了应监测的有效自由能。对于宽两层神经网络，推导出描述权重及其波动联合分布的平均场极限和动力学方程，并在矩阵分解和CIFAR-10上验证了模型捕捉振荡包络的准确性。
Motivation: 梯度下降在稳定性边缘的动力学尚未被充分理解，特别是当学习率大到引起持续振荡时，如何描述平均轨迹与快速振荡的耦合是一个理论空白。
Method: 提出一个连续时间有效模型，结合原始风险泛函与曲率相关的“熵”项形成有效自由能，并推导出宽两层神经网络在稳定非零振荡下的平均场极限和动力学方程。
Result: 模型能准确捕捉振荡包络，数值实验在矩阵分解和CIFAR-10上验证了有效自由能的预测能力。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解神经网络训练中的不稳定动力学提供了理论框架，但主要针对宽两层网络，扩展至更深或更复杂架构需进一步研究。

papers.title: I Know What You Meme, Even If it Emerged Today: Understanding Evolving Memes through Open-World Knowledge Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal memes are dynamic and often require up to date background knowledge for interpretation. Existing methods often overlook such knowledge or rely on fixed parametric knowledge of pretrained models that may be incomplete, outdated, or unavailable for emerging memes. We introduce Query Retrieve Conclude, a zero shot framework that identifies missing knowledge, retrieves open web evidence, and synthesizes evidence grounded background knowledge for meme understanding and detection. We also introduce a curated meme understanding benchmark of recent memes from 2024 to 2026 with external background knowledge annotations. Experiments on three meme understanding datasets and five meme detection tasks show that our framework improves knowledge recovery, meme understanding and downstream detection over zero shot baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态多模态模因需要最新背景知识的问题，提出Query Retrieve Conclude零样本框架，通过识别缺失知识、检索开放网络证据并合成背景知识来改进模因理解与检测。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上优于零样本基线。
Motivation: 现有模因理解方法依赖预训练模型的固定参数知识，难以处理新兴模因所需的最新背景知识。
Method: 提出Query Retrieve Conclude框架：首先查询识别缺失知识，然后从开放网络检索证据，最后合成证据驱动的背景知识，用于零样本模因理解与检测。
Result: 在三个模因理解数据集和五个检测任务上，该方法提升了知识恢复、模因理解和检测性能，优于零样本基线。
Conclusion: 该框架能够动态获取开放世界知识，有效应对新兴模因的理解需求。

papers.title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the global structure of reasoning while supporting a compact latent reasoning process. We evaluate the method across multiple model families, including LLaMA and Qwen, at different scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves performance, especially on challenging multi-step tasks, approaching explicit CoT accuracy and outperforming prior iCoT distillation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现隐式思维链（iCoT）方法中隐藏状态推理轨迹具有低秩结构，并提出了低秩蒸馏框架，通过在共享低秩张量子空间中对齐师生轨迹的一阶和二阶统计量来转移推理能力。在多个模型家族（LLaMA、Qwen）和数学推理基准上，该方法提升了性能，尤其是多步任务，接近显式CoT准确率，并优于之前的iCoT蒸馏方法。
Motivation: 隐式思维链方法虽旨在内化推理，但通常不如显式CoT提示。本文从隐藏状态推理轨迹的低秩结构观察出发，旨在提出更好的蒸馏方法以提升隐式推理性能。
Method: 提出低秩蒸馏框架，在共享低秩张量子空间中，使用一阶和二阶统计量对齐教师和学生模型的推理轨迹，从而转移推理能力。

papers.title: Statistically Reliable LLM-Based Ranking Evaluation via Prediction-Powered Inference
papers.abstract_en: With PRECISE, we extended Prediction-Powered Inference to produce bias-corrected estimates of ranking evaluation metrics by combining a small human-labeled set with a large LLM-judged set. PPI is provably unbiased regardless of the LLM judge's error profile. We make it applicable to hierarchical metrics like Precision@K, where annotations are per-document but the metric is per-query, by reducing the output-space computation from O(2^|C|) to O(2^K). On the ESCI benchmark, augmenting 30 human annotations with Claude 3 Sonnet judgments reduces the standard error of Precision@4 estimates from 4.45 to 3.50 (a 21% relative reduction). In a production system, our framework correctly identified the best of three system variants from 100 human labels and 2 hours of domain-expert annotation; A/B testing confirmed this ranking with +407 bps in daily sales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRECISE，通过预测驱动推理（PPI）结合少量人工标注和大量LLM标注，实现对排名评估指标的无偏估计。该方法适用于层次化指标如Precision@K，并将输出空间计算复杂度从O(2^|C|)降至O(2^K)。在ESCI基准上，将30个人工标注与Claude 3 Sonnet判断结合，使Precision@4的标准误差从4.45降至3.50（相对降低21%）。在生产系统中，用100个人工标签和2小时专家标注正确识别最佳系统变体，A/B测试确认该排名带来+407 bps的日销售额增长。
Motivation: 现有依赖LLM进行排名评估的方法可能存在偏差，且标准误差较大。需要一种统计可靠的无偏估计方法。
Method: 扩展预测驱动推理（PPI），通过组合小规模人工标注集和大规模LLM判断集，对排名评估指标进行偏差校正。对于层次化指标如Precision@K，引入输出空间约简技术，将复杂度从指数级降至多项式级。
Result: 在ESCI基准上，使用30个人工标注+Claude 3 Sonnet判断，Precision@4的标准误差降低21%。在生产系统中，用100个人工标签正确识别最优系统，A/B测试确认排名，日销售额增长+407 bps。
Conclusion: PRECISE提供了统计可靠的LLM排名评估方法，可减少人工标注需求，并在实际部署中验证了有效性。

papers.title: What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models are typically organized around roles, pipelines, and turn schedules, while the content that agents pass to one another is often left as unconstrained natural language. However, this free-form communication can rapidly inflate token usage, consume the shared context window, and ultimately affect both system performance and inference cost. We analyze five common inter-agent communication strategies across two MAS topologies, finding that no fixed strategy is universally optimal. Instead, effective inter-agent messages consistently preserve action-centered information needed by downstream agents. Building on this, we propose the PACT (Protocolized Action-state Communication and Transmission), which treats inter-agent communication as a public state-update problem and projects each raw agent output into a compact action-state record before it enters shared history. Across different MAS topologies, PACT consistently improves the performance-cost trade-off, achieving comparable or stronger task performance with substantially fewer tokens. The gains extend to production coding harnesses: PACT lifts OpenHands' resolve rate at -10% tokens-per-resolved, and is resolve-neutral on SWE-agent while halving input tokens. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/PACT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中智能体间通信策略的效率问题。通过分析五种常见通信策略，发现保持面向动作（action-centered）的信息能提升系统性能。作者提出PACT（Protocolized Action-state Communication and Transmission）协议，将智能体输出转化为紧凑的动作状态记录，从而减少令牌消耗并改善性能-成本权衡。在多个拓扑结构上，PACT以更少的令牌实现与基线相当或更强的任务性能，并在生产编码工具OpenHands和SWE-agent上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 多智能体系统中，智能体间使用无约束的自然语言通信会导致令牌使用量激增、上下文窗口消耗增大，进而影响系统性能和推理成本。现有方法未针对通信内容进行优化。
Method: 提出PACT协议，将智能体间通信视为公共状态更新问题，将每个原始智能体输出投影为紧凑的动作状态记录再存入共享历史。该方法通过形式化通信内容，减少冗余信息。
Result: 在多种多智能体拓扑结构上，PACT以显著更少的令牌实现了与基线相当或更强的任务性能。在OpenHands上，以-10%的令牌/解决率提高了解决率；在SWE-agent上，在保持解决率不变的同时将输入令牌减半。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过协议化动作状态通信，可以有效提升多智能体系统的性能-成本权衡，为大规模部署提供了实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents operate in two distinct regimes: open-weight agents amenable to reinforcement learning (RL) and black-box agents whose behaviour must be controlled purely at test time. Although black-box agents are often backed by state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, API-only access precludes parameter-level optimization, rendering most RL methods inapplicable. To address this limitation, we turn to a known equivalence between RL and Bayesian inference. We propose Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC) to directly sample from the optimal policy of a black-box agent rather than training it through RL. The optimal policy is a posterior over trajectories whose prior we define as the fixed black-box LLM agent. We employ Sequential Monte Carlo to sample from this posterior by learning a value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying black-box model unchanged. We validate AMC on three diverse environments from the AgentGym benchmark, demonstrating significant improvements over prompting baselines and even outperforming Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as we scale the test-time compute of our method. AMC demonstrates the feasibility of performing principled RL-style optimization of black-box LLM agents. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/Agentic-Monte-Carlo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑盒LLM agent无法进行参数级强化学习的问题，利用RL与贝叶斯推断的等价性，提出Agentic Monte Carlo (AMC)方法，通过序贯蒙特卡洛直接从最优策略的后验分布中采样，而无需修改底层模型。在AgentGym基准的三个环境中，AMC优于提示基线，并在测试时计算扩展下超越GRPO。
Motivation: 黑盒LLM agent通常由闭源API驱动，无法进行参数级优化，使得大多数强化学习方法不适用。
Method: 将最优策略视为轨迹上的后验分布，以固定黑盒LLM agent为生成先验，通过学习价值函数引导轨迹，并采用序贯蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte Carlo）从该后验中采样。
Result: 在AgentGym基准的三个不同环境中，AMC显著优于提示基线，并在增加测试时计算资源时超越Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)。
Conclusion: AMC证明了对黑盒LLM agent进行原则性强化学习风格优化的可行性，为API-only场景下的agent控制提供了新思路。

papers.title: Do Models Share Safety Representations? Cross-Model Steering for Safe Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in generative modeling has made safety control a central challenge, yet existing approaches remain largely model-specific, requiring retraining or tailored interventions for each new architecture. In this work, we ask whether safety can be represented as a portable latent direction, learned once and reused across heterogeneous generators. We introduce the first framework for cross-model safety steering, in which a safety direction is estimated in a source LLM from paired safe-unsafe prompts, transported to a target generator through a lightweight alignment fitted on benign data alone, and applied at inference time. Crucially, our pipeline never accesses unsafe data on the target side, isolating whether safety can be transferred through shared representation geometry. Beyond a single global direction, we also identify a multi-vector extension that captures category-specific safety behaviors, enabling more selective control. We evaluate our approach in text-to-image and text-to-video generation across diverse source-target model pairs. Across models, transferred safety directions achieve ASR reduction and CLIP-Score/FID trade-offs comparable to directions learned natively on the target model using unsafe data, while requiring no target-side unsafe data. This indicates that safety improvements do not come at the expense of generation quality. Our results point to a modular view of safety: safety-relevant behavior is not purely model-local, but can be controlled through latent directions that persist across models. This suggests a new path toward lightweight, reusable safety mechanisms that do not require target-side unsafe data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个跨模型安全引导框架，在源语言模型上从成对安全/不安全提示中学习安全方向，并通过仅使用良性数据训练的轻量级对齐将其迁移到目标生成器，无需目标侧不安全数据。在文本到图像和文本到视频生成中，迁移的安全方向实现了与本地学习方向相当的攻击成功率降低和生成质量保持。
Motivation: 现有安全控制方法多为模型特定，需要重新训练或定制干预，缺乏可迁移性，限制了安全机制的复用。
Method: 在源LLM中从配对提示估计安全方向，通过仅用良性数据训练的轻量级对齐将方向传输到目标生成器，并提出了多向量扩展以捕获类别特定安全行为。
Result: 在多个源-目标模型对中，迁移的安全方向实现了与目标模型本地学习方向相当的ASR降低和CLIP-Score/FID权衡，且无需目标侧不安全数据。
Conclusion: 安全相关行为可通过跨模型持续的潜在方向控制，表明安全机制可以模块化、可复用，无需目标侧不安全数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Personal AI Agent for Camera Roll VQA
papers.abstract_en: We study the personal camera roll visual question answering setting. In this setting, a conversational AI assistant can access a user's personal camera roll and retrieve relevant photos to answer queries, ranging from simple factual questions (e.g., ``Name of the food I tried yesterday?'') to more open-ended ones (e.g., ``Recommend some dishes I have never eaten before''). Given the vast nature of the personal camera roll (i.e., multiple years, hundreds to thousands of photos), a successful AI assistant needs to understand a long-horizon, highly personalized visual content stream in order to navigate and locate the correct and/or relevant information. To support this, we collect and manually annotate questions that mimic real-world usage. The final dataset, camroll, contains 50 users, 31,476 images, and 2,500 QA pairs. We further design camroll-agent, a conversational AI agent equipped with hierarchical memory and a minimal set of tools for efficient navigation over large, personalized visual memory. Experimental results show that camroll-agent outperforms numerous baselines and methods for long-context understanding AI agents system. Together, the camroll dataset and camroll-agent highlight the gap in AI agents' long-context reasoning: personalized visual memory requires different approaches from standard long-context textual memory, especially when consistency, visual details, and user-specific context are present.
papers.comment: Project page, code, and demo: https://thaoshibe.github.io/camroll
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究个人相机胶卷的视觉问答任务，提出了camroll数据集（50用户、31476张图片、2500个问答对）和camroll-agent对话AI代理，该代理采用分层记忆和最小工具集实现高效导航。实验表明camroll-agent在长上下文理解上优于多种基线方法。
Motivation: 现有AI代理在处理长期、高度个性化的相机胶卷视觉内容时难以准确导航和定位相关信息，且标准长上下文文本记忆方法不适用于个性化视觉记忆。
Method: 收集并手动标注模拟真实用法的问答对构建camroll数据集；设计camroll-agent，配备分层记忆和最小工具集，用于高效导航大规模个性化视觉记忆。
Result: 实验结果显示camroll-agent在多项指标上优于多种基线以及长上下文理解的AI代理方法。
Conclusion: 个性化视觉记忆需要不同于标准长上下文文本记忆的方法，尤其是在一致性、视觉细节和用户特定上下文方面。

papers.title: Anomaly Detection for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators using LSTM Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: Electro-Hydrostatic Actuators (EHAs) are widely used in aerospace and industrial systems, where timely detection of sensor anomalies is essential to ensure safe and reliable operation. However, the large volume and high sampling frequency of EHA sensor data pose challenges for accurate and efficient anomaly detection. Conventional statistical and classical machine-learning methods such as Z-score, Interquartile Range (IQR), Median Absolute Deviation (MAD), Isolation Forest, Gaussian Mixture, and k-means often fail to capture the temporal dependencies inherent in EHA signals, resulting in limited detection accuracy and elevated false-alarm rates. Furthermore, systematic evaluations of data-driven anomaly detection approaches for EHA systems remain scarce, particularly under varying operational conditions. This study presents an offline anomaly-detection framework for univariate EHA sensor signals, focusing on temperature and pressure data collected from a controlled test bench. The method employs a reconstruction-based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) autoencoder, calibrated and evaluated using validation-set reconstruction-error distributions. Performance is assessed across multiple fault-injection scenarios using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, complemented by sensitivity analyses under varying operating conditions. The LSTM autoencoder achieved an average accuracy of 99.0\%, precision up to 100\%, recall between 90.2\% and 99.6\%, and F1-scores from 93.1\% to 99.8\%, demonstrating high detection sensitivity and a very low false-alarm rate across all evaluated sensors. These results highlight the feasibility of data-driven offline anomaly detection for EHAs. Future work will focus on adapting the developed framework for an online (real-time) environment.

papers.title: Learning Manifold and Itô Dynamics with Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) stay accurate under irregular sampling while taking far fewer integration steps than standard neural differential equations, summarising a finely sampled driver by its log-signature and advancing the hidden state over coarse intervals using the log-ODE method. This efficiency rests on the shuffle algebra, the algebraic counterpart of Stratonovich calculus. This reliance means NRDEs cannot expose the quadratic-variation terms Itô dynamics require, nor the ordered covariant derivatives that govern Itô flows on connection-equipped manifolds. Ameliorating this, we introduce Branched Neural Rough Differential Equations (B-NRDEs), a Hopf-algebraic framework that recasts the NRDE log-ODE step as geometric numerical integration on the state-space manifold, matching the driving algebra to the governing calculus: Grossman--Larson rooted trees for Euclidean Itô dynamics, Munthe-Kaas--Wright planar rooted trees for ordered covariant derivatives on manifolds, and the shuffle algebra in the classical Stratonovich case. This yields intrinsic coarse-step dynamics that exactly preserve manifold constraints. Finally, we introduce a branched signature-kernel objective to enable Itô-consistent law matching by making quadratic-variation terms visible during training. On rough Bergomi volatility, sim-to-real $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ dynamics forecasting, and SPD covariance dynamics, B-NRDEs offer a unified, effective approach to stochastic and manifold-valued dynamics beyond the Euclidean--Stratonovich setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），通过Hopf代数框架将NRDE的log-ODE步重写为状态空间流形上的几何数值积分，匹配驱动代数与主导的微积分：用于欧几里得Itô动力学的Grossman-Larson有根树、流形上带序协变导数的Munthe-Kaas-Wright平面有根树以及经典Stratonovich情形下的洗牌代数。这产生了精确保持流形约束的固有粗步动力学。进一步引入分支签名核目标，使二次变分项在训练中可见，从而实现Itô一致定律匹配。在粗糙Bergomi波动率、sim-to-real SO(3)动力学预测和SPD协方差动力学上，B-NRDEs提供了超越欧几里得-Stratonovich设置下的统一有效方法。
Motivation: 现有神经粗糙微分方程（NRDEs）依赖于洗牌代数和Stratonovich微积分，无法暴露Itô动力学所需的二次变分项，也无法处理流形上的有序协变导数。需要一种能够统一处理欧几里得Itô、流形上的有序协变导数以及经典Stratonovich情形的框架。
Method: 提出分支神经粗糙微分方程（B-NRDEs），基于Hopf代数框架，将NRDE的log-ODE步重构为流形上的几何数值积分，使用不同的根树代数匹配不同的微积分类型。引入分支签名核目标，使二次变分项在训练中可微。
Result: 在粗糙Bergomi波动率、sim-to-real SO(3)动力学预测和SPD协方差动力学任务上，B-NRDEs展示了有效性能，提供了超越欧几里得-Stratonovich设置下的统一方法。
Conclusion: B-NRDEs为随机和流形值动力学提供了一种统一的、有效的方法，特别适用于需要Itô微积分或流形约束的场景。

papers.title: Aggregating LLM-Based Weak Verifiers for Spatial Layout Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present a pipeline for building and aggregating task-specific, LLM-generated weak (imperfect) verifiers into a strong verifier for spatial layout domains. Given a task description, our pipeline asks an LLM to synthesize a collection of verifier programs using a layout verification DSL. Each individual LLM-generated verifier usually provides an imperfect check for a match between the layout and the corresponding task description. We show that by aggregating the responses of many such verifiers we can produce a stronger verifier. Moreover, by applying techniques from weak learning, our pipeline can learn how to aggregate the weak verifiers from a very sparse set of human labeled example layouts (about 10). We find that the strong verifiers produced by our pipeline outperform the status-quo approach of using a set of LLM judges to directly check whether a layout matches a task description, raising F1-scores by up to 7X across a variety of 3D room layout and 2D poster design tasks. We also demonstrate that verifier-guided layout generation using natural language feedback from our strong verifiers improves layout quality of a base layout generator by up to 66.2% according to a human evaluator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用LLM生成弱验证器并聚合为强验证器的流程，用于评估空间布局（如3D房间布局、2D海报设计）是否匹配任务描述。通过弱学习技术，仅需约10个人工标注样例即可学习聚合方式。聚合后的强验证器在F1分数上比直接使用LLM判决器高最多7倍，且用于指导布局生成时，人类评估者认为布局质量提升最高66.2%。
Motivation: 直接使用LLM作为判决器检查布局与描述的匹配不够准确，需要构建更强健的验证器。
Method: 基于布局验证DSL，让LLM合成多个验证器程序；每个验证器单独不完美，但通过弱学习方法从稀疏人工标注中学习如何聚合这些弱验证器的响应，形成强验证器。
Result: 在多种3D房间布局和2D海报设计任务上，聚合强验证器的F1分数比直接使用LLM判决器提升最高7倍；用于指导布局生成时，人类评估显示布局质量提升最高66.2%。
Conclusion: 聚合LLM生成的弱验证器可以有效提升布局验证性能，且所需人工标注极少。

papers.title: Sharp Low-Degree Thresholds for Planted-vs-Planted Testing
papers.abstract_en: We establish the first sharp thresholds for low-degree polynomial tests in planted-vs-planted settings, where the goal is to determine with vanishing error which of two structured planted mechanisms generated the observed data. We prove matching low-degree upper and lower bounds for counting communities in the planted submatrix and planted dense subgraph models. The resulting testing threshold coincides, down to the sharp constant, with the known low-degree recovery threshold. In contrast, the task of weak testing, where the goal is to outperform random guessing, does not have a sharp threshold but rather a smooth transition, which we identify. To prove our results, we develop a framework for planted-vs-planted testing that builds on a latent-variable expansion originating in low-degree recovery and employs new methods to identify and prune non-signal contributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在 planted-vs-planted 设置下建立了低度多项式检验的尖锐阈值，针对 planted submatrix 和 planted dense subgraph 模型，证明了匹配的上界和下界。测试阈值与已知的低度恢复阈值精确一致（直到常数），而弱测试（仅需优于随机猜测）表现出平滑转变而非尖锐阈值。作者开发了基于潜变量展开的框架，结合新方法识别和修剪非信号贡献。
Motivation: 在 planted-vs-planted 检验问题中，缺乏对低度多项式测试能力的精确刻画，特别是阈值是否尖锐以及弱测试与强测试之间的行为差异尚不明确。
Method: 基于低度恢复中的潜变量展开，构建了一个框架，并通过新方法识别和修剪非信号贡献，从而推导出 planted submatrix 和 planted dense subgraph 模型的紧的上下界。
Result: 证明了测试阈值与低度恢复阈值在常数级别匹配；弱测试的误差概率随信噪比平滑下降，而非尖锐转变。
Conclusion: 本文为 planted-vs-planted 检验提供了低度多项式测试的精确阈值，填补了理论空白，并指出弱测试与强测试的不同行为。

papers.title: Data-efficient flood depth prediction through domain-aware coreset selection and tabular foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Near-real-time flood depth prediction demands surrogate models that are accurate, fast, and transferable across watersheds. Supervised surrogates can match physics-based simulators in accuracy but need millions of training rows per watershed and cannot extrapolate beyond their original mesh. We propose a domain-aware coreset construction pipeline that conditions a tabular foundation model at inference time. The pipeline stratifies storms by return period and most-affected watershed, then samples hexagons with a target-aware spatial selector. With 0.7% of the per-watershed training pool, the model attains a mean $R^2$ of 0.663 across nine Houston-area watersheds, within 98.5% of the supervised reference ($R^2$ = 0.673). It transfers to held-out watersheds without task-specific retraining, staying ahead of a coreset-trained supervised baseline. On real storms it exceeds the supervised reference on a far out-of-distribution case and trails it on a mostly in-distribution one. Domain-aware coreset construction lets tabular foundation models deliver data-efficient, watershed-transferable flood predictions without per-watershed training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种领域感知的coreset构建流程，在推理时条件化表格基础模型，用于近实时洪水深度预测。仅使用每个流域0.7%的训练数据，模型在九个休斯顿流域上达到平均R²=0.663，达到监督基准的98.5%，且能迁移到未见流域，无需重新训练。
Motivation: 监督替代模型在洪水预测中精度高，但每个流域需要数百万训练样本且无法外推。需要一种数据高效、跨流域可迁移的方法。
Method: 提出领域感知coreset构建流程：按重现期和受影响最严重的流域对风暴分层，然后使用目标感知的空间选择器采样六边形。在推理时条件化表格基础模型。
Result: 使用0.7%的训练数据，模型在九个流域上平均R²=0.663，接近监督基准的0.673。在未见流域上迁移性能优于基于coreset训练的监督基线；实际风暴测试中，在远分布外案例上超过监督基准，在分布内案例上略低。
Conclusion: 领域感知的coreset构建使表格基础模型能够实现数据高效、跨流域迁移的洪水预测，无需每个流域单独训练。

papers.title: REGEN: Reference-Guided Synthetic Multivariate Time Series Generation for Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Training robust multivariate time series forecasting models requires large, diverse corpora, yet many real-world domains provide only a handful of observed sequences. Existing generators fail to resolve this mismatch: prior-based approaches (e.g., CauKer, TimePFN) produce domain-agnostic samples, while data-driven methods (e.g., TimeGAN) treat references as black-box supervision, forfeiting explicit control over periodic structure, local variability, and cross-variable dynamics. We propose ReGeN, a reference-guided generative pipeline that treats observed sequences not as examples to imitate, but as structural scaffolds for controllable synthesis. ReGeN decomposes each reference into three interpretable components: a phase-aligned periodic backbone capturing dominant domain morphology; per-variable stochastic residuals modeled with a deep-kernel Gaussian process; and lag-aware cross-variable dependencies injected through a structural causal model with fitted coupling coefficients. Sampling these components at controllable temperature broadens distributional coverage while preserving domain-grounded structure. We show that ReGeN-generated data consistently substitutes for real sibling data with minimal forecasting degradation, and in strongly periodic domains such as traffic, can outperform the real source itself. We further show that a foundation model pretrained on ReGeN corpora outperforms those pretrained on prior-based and data-driven synthetic alternatives. This suggests that in low-data regimes, how reference data is structurally exploited can matter as much as how much data is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGeN，一种参考引导的多元时间序列生成方法，它将观测序列分解为相位对齐的周期骨干、随机残差（深度核高斯过程）和滞后感知的跨变量依赖（结构因果模型），通过可控温度采样扩展分布覆盖。实验表明，ReGeN 生成数据可替代真实数据且预测精度损失极小，在强周期领域（如交通）甚至优于真实数据，且基于 ReGeN 预训练的基础模型优于其他合成方法。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列预测模型需要大规模多样化的训练数据，但许多现实领域只有少量观测序列。现有生成方法要么生成领域无关样本，要么将参考视为黑盒监督而失去对周期结构、局部变异和跨变量动力学的显式控制。
Method: ReGeN 将每个参考序列分解为三个可解释组件：相位对齐的周期骨干（捕获领域主导形态）、基于深度核高斯过程的逐变量随机残差、以及通过结构因果模型引入的滞后感知跨变量依赖。通过对这些组件以可控温度采样来生成多样且保留领域结构的新序列。
Result: ReGeN 生成的数据在替代真实兄弟数据时预测性能下降极小；在强周期领域（如交通）甚至能超越真实数据。基于 ReGeN 语料库预训练的基础模型优于基于先验和数据驱动的合成替代方案。

papers.title: Policy-Conditioned Counterfactual Credit for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning of Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning and tool use, yet long-horizon language agents still learn unsupported evidence chains, belief drift, and shortcut actions that satisfy terminal checks. Existing process rewards are mostly correlational: they reward retrieval-, reflection-, or verification-like steps without estimating whether the step contributes to final verified success under a specified intervention. We propose CVT-RL, a constrained policy-gradient algorithm with dense verifiable rewards, intervention-validity gating, and a policy-conditioned counterfactual contribution (PCCC) estimator. Deletion, semantic substitution, evidence substitution, and tool-output perturbation define separate controlled interventions; continuations are sampled from a frozen reference policy, and a selection-adjusted doubly robust estimator augments the advantage. Belief control uses only prefix-observable labels, while an augmented Lagrangian constrains unsupported claims, skipped verification, tool tampering, and unsafe calls. On long-context QA, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and web/tool tasks, CVT-RL improves average task success from 71.8% for compute-matched non-causal RL and 75.4% for an information-matched counterfactual-process baseline to 78.9%, improves evidence F1 from 78.9 to 82.8 over the information-matched baseline, and reduces measured hacking from 7.2% to 3.9%. Independent human audit estimates 4.6% hacking for CVT-RL versus 8.1% for the information-matched baseline, and adaptive detector-evasion attacks raise hacking only to 7.1%. Stratified bootstrap and mixed-effects tests give p<0.01 after Holm correction for all primary metrics. Carefully scoped counterfactual credit, paired with validity gating, diagnostics, and verifiable constraints, provides a reproducible route toward more reliable long-horizon RL for language agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CVT-RL，一种基于策略梯度的强化学习算法，通过可验证奖励、干预有效性门控和策略条件反事实贡献估计，提升长程语言智能体的推理可靠性和可验证性。在长上下文QA、ALFWorld等任务上，CVT-RL将平均任务成功率从非因果RL的71.8%提升至78.9%，证据F1从78.9提升至82.8，并减少了3.9%的作弊行为。
Motivation: 现有强化学习中的过程奖励多为相关性而非因果性，导致长程语言智能体学习到不支持的证据链、信念漂移和仅满足终端检查的捷径行为。
Method: 提出CVT-RL算法，包含策略条件反事实贡献估计器、干预有效性门控和可验证约束；使用删除、语义替换等干预，从冻结参考策略采样续文，并采用选择调整的双重稳健估计器增强优势函数，同时通过增广拉格朗日方法约束未支持的声明等行为。
Result: 在长上下文QA、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和网页/工具任务上，CVT-RL平均任务成功率达78.9%（非因果RL为71.8%，信息匹配基线为75.4%），证据F1提升至82.8（基线78.9），测量作弊率从7.2%降至3.9%；人类审计估计作弊率为4.6%（基线8.1%），自适应检测规避攻击仅使作弊率升至7.1%。
Conclusion: 精心范围设定的反事实信用与有效性门控、诊断和可验证约束相结合，为更可靠的长程语言智能体强化学习提供了可复现的路径。
