papers.title: Expand Neurons, Not Parameters
papers.abstract_en: This work demonstrates how increasing the number of neurons in a network without increasing its total number of non-zero parameters improves performance. We show that this gain corresponds with a decrease in interference between multiple features that would otherwise share the same neurons. On symbolic Boolean tasks, splitting each neuron into sparser sub-neurons with knowledge of the clauses systematically reduces polysemanticity metrics and yields higher task accuracy. Notably, even random splits of neuron weights approximate these gains, indicating that reduced collisions, not precise assignment, are a primary driver. Consistent with the superposition hypothesis, the benefits of this framework grow with increasing interference: when polysemantic load is high, accuracy improvements are the largest. Transferring these insights to more realistic models, including classifiers over CLIP embeddings, convolutional neural networks, and deeper multilayer networks, we find that widening networks while maintaining a constant non-zero parameter count consistently increases accuracy. These results identify an interpretability-grounded mechanism to leverage width against superposition, improving performance without increasing the number of non-zero parameters. Such a direction is well matched to modern accelerators, where memory movement of non-zero parameters, rather than raw compute, is often a dominant bottleneck.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 9 pages, 6 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Shavit-Lab/Expand-Neurons
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明在不增加非零参数数量的前提下增加神经元数量可以提升网络性能，其收益来源于减少多个特征共享同一神经元造成的干扰。在符号布尔任务上，将每个神经元分裂为更稀疏的子神经元降低了多语义性指标并提高了准确率；即使在CLIP嵌入分类器、卷积网络和深层MLP等更现实的模型中，保持非零参数数恒定而加宽网络也一致地提升了准确率。
Motivation: 传统观点认为模型性能主要取决于参数数量，但现代加速器的瓶颈往往是非零参数的内存移动而非计算量。本文试图探索在参数预算不变下通过增加神经元数量（即宽度）来提升性能的可能性，并揭示其与叠加假说（superposition hypothesis）中特征干扰的关系。
Method: 提出一种神经元分裂策略：将每个神经元替换为更稀疏的多个子神经元，并保持非零参数总数不变。在符号布尔任务中采用基于子句（clause）的知识分裂；在现实模型中采用随机分裂权重的方式近似实现。通过对比实验分析宽度增加对多语义性指标和任务准确率的影响。
Result: 在符号布尔任务上，神经元分裂减少了多语义性（polysemanticity）并显著提升了任务准确率；随机分裂也能近似达到类似效果。CLIP嵌入分类器、CNN和深层MLP上，加宽网络在非零参数数不变时一致提升准确率，且在高多语义负载（即特征干扰严重时）收益最大。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了一种基于可解释性的机制：利用宽度缓解叠加（superposition）问题，在不增加非零参数的前提下提升性能。该方向适配于现代加速器的内存带宽瓶颈，为神经网络架构设计提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accuracy Limits of Causal Trees for Individualized Treatment Effects
papers.abstract_en: Recursive decision trees are widely used to estimate heterogeneous causal treatment effects in experimental and observational studies. These methods are typically implemented using CART-type recursive partitioning, with splitting criteria designed to identify variation in treatment effects across covariate-defined subgroups. We study causal tree estimators based on adaptive recursive partitioning and establish lower bounds on their estimation accuracy. The class we analyze includes versions with and without sample splitting, based on common treatment effect and squared-error splitting criteria. Even in a constant-effect benchmark with randomized treatment assignment, causal trees constructed via standard CART-type splitting rules can have uniform-norm errors that decrease more slowly than any power of the sample size. The underlying mechanism is that greedy recursive partitioning selects highly imbalanced splits with nonvanishing probability, producing terminal nodes containing very few observations and leading to large estimation variance. We further show that sample splitting, often called ``honesty,'' does not remove this limitation. As a consequence, causal tree estimators may converge arbitrarily slowly uniformly over the covariate space. At the same time, these estimators can have small integrated mean squared error, showing that average accuracy can mask local inaccuracy. Our results also clarify the role of balanced partition assumptions in existing theoretical guarantees for causal forests and related ensemble methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究因果树（causal tree）估计器在个性化处理效应（ITE）中的精度极限，建立了基于自适应递归划分的估计精度的下界。即使在随机化处理分配和恒定效应基准下，标准CART型分裂规则构造的因果树在均匀范数下的误差可能比任何样本量的幂次下降得更慢。原因是贪婪递归划分以非消失概率产生高度不平衡的分裂，导致终端节点样本很少，估计方差大。论文还表明样本分裂（"诚实"）不能消除这一局限，因果树估计器可能在协变量空间上任意缓慢一致收敛。
Motivation: 因果树广泛用于异质因果效应估计，但现有理论保证通常假设平衡划分或依赖集成方法（如因果森林）来平滑误差。本文旨在揭示简单因果树本身的精度极限，解释为什么在某些情况下均匀一致误差可能极差。
Method: 在固定效应基准且随机化处理的设定下，分析基于常见处理效应分裂准则和平方误差分裂准则的因果树。推导均匀范数误差的下界，并分析样本分裂对下界的影响。
Result: 证明了即使是最简单的设定，因果树估计器的均匀一致误差下降速度可以慢于任何样本量的幂次；样本分裂（诚实）不能解决这个问题。但集成均方误差可能很小，说明平均精度掩盖了局部不准确性。
Conclusion: 因果树估计器在均匀一致误差方面存在固有限制，这为因果森林等集成方法提供了理论基础，强调了平衡划分假设在现有理论中的重要性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Is attention truly all we need? An empirical study of asset pricing in pretrained RNN sparse and global attention models
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the pre-trained RNN attention models with the mainstream attention mechanisms, such as additive attention, Luong's three attentions, global self-attention and sliding window sparse attention, for the empirical asset pricing research on the top 420 large-cap US stocks. This is the first paper on the large-scale state-of-the-art (SOTA) attention mechanisms applied in the asset pricing context. They overcome the limitations of the traditional machine learning-based asset pricing, such as mis-capturing the temporal dependency and short memory. Moreover, the enforced causal masks in the attention mechanisms address the future data leaking issue ignored by the more advanced attention-based models, such as the classic Transformer. The proposed attention models also consider the temporal sparsity characteristic of asset pricing data and mitigate potential overfitting issues by deploying the simplified model structures. This provides some insights for future empirical economic research. All models are examined in three periods, which cover pre-COVID-19, COVID-19 and one year post-COVID-19, for testing the stability of these models under extreme market conditions. The study finds that in value-weighted portfolio back testing, the global self-attention model and the sliding window sparse attention model exhibit excellent capabilities in deriving the absolute returns and hedging downside risks, while they achieve an annualized Sortino ratio of 2.0 and 1.80 respectively in the period with COVID-19 in the static transaction cost scenario. Moreover, the sliding window sparse attention model performs more stably than the global self-attention model from the perspective of absolute portfolio returns with respect to the size of stocks' market capitalization.

TL;DR: 本文首次将多种预训练RNN注意力模型（加性注意力、Luong三种注意力、全局自注意力、滑动窗口稀疏注意力）应用于资产定价，基于420只美国大盘股数据，验证其在极端市场条件下的表现。全局自注意力和滑动窗口稀疏注意力在价值加权组合回测中获得了年度Sortino比率2.0和1.80，且滑动窗口稀疏注意力在大市值股票上表现更稳定。

Result: 全局自注意力和滑动窗口稀疏注意力在静态交易成本下，COVID-19期间价值加权组合的年度Sortino比率分别达到2.0和1.80；滑动窗口稀疏注意力在大市值股票上绝对收益更稳定。
Conclusion: 研究表明，预训练RNN稀疏和全局注意力模型在资产定价中表现优异，尤其滑动窗口稀疏注意力兼顾收益与稳定性，为未来实证经济研究提供了新方向。

papers.title: A Differentiable Framework for Full and Phaseless Data Inversion Using Neural Implicit Contrast-Source Representation
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we extend the contrast source inversion to a fully differentiable, unsupervised framework based on a neural implicit representation of the contrast source. Specifically, instead of a pixel-wise discrete representation, the contrast source is parameterized by a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (ResMLP) as a continuous neural field conditioned on spatial coordinates and transmitter settings. This continuous parameterization provides a more flexible representation of the contrast source and improves reconstruction accuracy and robustness under noisy measurements. Building on this representation, the state equation and data equation are combined with total-variation regularization to form a differentiable objective function. By reformulating the VIE-constrained inversion as an end-to-end differentiable optimization problem, the network parameters and the medium contrast are jointly optimized via automatic differentiation. Within the same framework, both full and phaseless data inversion are accommodated by only modifying the data misfit function. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this scheme yields higher reconstruction accuracy and robustness than conventional CSI across a range of noise levels and measurement settings. The continuous neural field further enables super-resolution inference at resolutions finer than the training grid, decoupling inversion cost from reconstruction fidelity. Ablation studies and comparisons with alternative neural architectures further confirm that the contrast source parameterization and VIE-based formulation are both essential to the observed improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经隐式对比源表示的可微分框架，用于全数据和无相位数据反演。将对比源参数化为连续神经场（ResMLP），结合状态方程和总变分正则化构成可微目标函数，通过自动微分联合优化网络参数与介质对比度。数值实验表明该方法在噪声和测量设置下比传统CSI具有更高重建精度和鲁棒性，且能实现超分辨率推理。
Motivation: 传统对比源反演（CSI）使用像素级离散表示，重建精度和鲁棒性受限，尤其在噪声测量下。需要更灵活的参数化方法。
Method: 将对比源用轻量残差MLP（ResMLP）参数化为连续神经场，条件于空间坐标和发射器设置。结合状态方程和总变分正则化构成可微目标函数，通过自动微分联合优化。通过修改数据失配函数可适应全数据和无相位数据反演。
Result: 数值实验表明，在多种噪声水平和测量设置下，该方法比传统CSI提供更高的重建精度和鲁棒性，且连续神经场支持超分辨率推理，将反演成本与重建保真度解耦。消融研究确认对比源参数化和VIE表述对改进至关重要。
Conclusion: 该方法为全数据和无相位数据反演提供统一可微框架，提升重建质量和鲁棒性，并实现超分辨率。未来可用于更复杂场景。

papers.title: In-Training Defenses against Emergent Misalignment in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning lets practitioners repurpose aligned large language models (LLMs) for new domains, yet recent work reveals emergent misalignment (EM): Even a small, domain-specific fine-tune can induce harmful behaviors far outside the target domain. Even in the case where model weights are hidden behind a fine-tuning API, this gives attackers inadvertent access to a broadly misaligned model in a way that can be hard to detect from the fine-tuning data alone. We present the first systematic study of in-training safeguards against EM that are practical for providers who expose fine-tuning via an API: We evaluate whether they a) prevent broad misalignment, b) allow narrow misalignment, c) learn well on benign tasks, and d) remain coherent. We investigate five training regularization interventions: (i) KL-divergence regularization toward a safe reference model, (ii) $\ell_2$ distance in feature space, (iii) preventive steering with an evil persona vector, (iv) interleaving training examples from a general instruct-tuning dataset and (v) inoculation prompting. We demonstrate that selecting interleaving data by the perplexity gap between aligned and misaligned models yields the best results overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究针对微调后语言模型出现“突发性失调”（emergent misalignment）问题的训练中防御措施。作者评估了五种正则化干预方法（KL散度正则化、特征空间L2距离、预防性引导、插值通用指令微调数据、接种提示），发现根据对齐/失调模型困惑度差距选择插值数据效果最佳。
Motivation: 微调可以将对齐语言模型用于新领域，但少量领域微调也可能导致模型在目标领域之外出现有害行为，攻击者可通过API利用此漏洞，而仅从微调数据难以检测。
Method: 研究五种训练时正则化干预：（i）KL散度正则化（向安全参考模型）、（ii）特征空间L2距离、（iii）利用恶意角色向量预防性引导、（iv）从通用指令微调数据中插值训练样本、（v）接种提示。通过比较，发现根据对齐与失调模型困惑度差距选择插值数据的方法整体效果最好。
Result: 插值方法在防止广泛失调、允许窄范围失调、在良性任务上学习良好且保持连贯性方面表现最佳。
Conclusion: 该研究为通过API提供微调服务的提供商提供了实用的训练中防御策略。摘要未明确提及其局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Causal Discovery in Real-World Time Series with Power-Laws
papers.abstract_en: Exploring causal relationships in stochastic time series is a challenging yet crucial task with a vast range of applications, including finance, economics, neuroscience, and climate science. Many algorithms for Causal Discovery (CD) have been proposed; however, they often exhibit a high sensitivity to noise, resulting in spurious causal inferences in real data. In this paper, we observe that the frequency spectra of many real-world time series follow a power-law distribution, notably due to an inherent self-organizing behavior. Leveraging this insight, we build a robust CD method based on the extraction of power-law spectral features that amplify genuine causal signals. Our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets with known causal structures, demonstrating its robustness and practical relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文观察到真实世界时间序列的频谱常服从幂律分布，基于此提取幂律谱特征以增强真实因果信号，提出一种鲁棒的因果发现方法。在合成基准和已知因果结构的真实数据集上，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法，展示了其实用性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有因果发现算法对噪声敏感，真实数据中易产生虚假因果推断。论文利用真实时间序列频谱的幂律特性来提升因果发现的鲁棒性。
Method: 提取时间序列的幂律谱特征，基于这些特征构建因果发现方法，以放大真实因果信号并抑制噪声。
Result: 在合成基准和真实数据集上，该方法在因果发现准确性上持续超越现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 提取幂律谱特征是一种有效且鲁棒的因果发现策略，尤其适用于真实世界时间序列。

papers.title: Towards Accurate Heart Rate Measurement from Ultra-Short Video Clips via Periodicity-Guided rPPG Estimation and Signal Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Many remote Heart Rate (HR) measurement methods focus on estimating remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals from video clips lasting around 10 seconds but often overlook the need for HR estimation from ultra-short video clips. In this paper, we aim to accurately measure HR from ultra-short 2-second video clips by specifically addressing two key challenges. First, to overcome the limited number of heartbeat cycles in ultra-short video clips, we propose an effective periodicity-guided rPPG estimation method that enforces consistent periodicity between rPPG signals estimated from ultra-short clips and their much longer ground truth signals. Next, to mitigate estimation inaccuracies due to spectral leakage, we propose including a generator to reconstruct longer rPPG signals from ultra-short ones while preserving their periodic consistency to enable more accurate HR measurement. Extensive experiments on four rPPG estimation benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method not only accurately measures HR from ultra-short video clips but also outperform previous rPPG estimation techniques to achieve state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对超短2秒视频片段的心率测量问题，提出了一种周期引导的rPPG估计方法，通过强制超短片段与长参考信号之间的周期性一致性，并利用生成器重建更长信号以减少频谱泄漏，从而在四个基准数据集上实现了最先进的心率测量性能。
Motivation: 现有rPPG方法主要针对10秒时长视频，忽视了超短视频片段（如2秒）的心率估计需求，而超短视频中心跳周期数有限且存在频谱泄漏问题。
Method: 提出周期引导的rPPG估计方法，强制超短视频片段与长真值信号之间的周期一致性；并引入生成器从超短信号重建更长rPPG信号，同时保持周期一致性以减少频谱泄漏。
Result: 在四个rPPG基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法不仅从超短视频片段中准确测量心率，而且超越了以往rPPG技术，达到了最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了周期引导和信号重建策略在超短视频心率测量中的有效性，但尚未提及对极端运动或光照条件的鲁棒性。

papers.title: HOPSE: Scalable Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder for Combinatorial Representations
papers.abstract_en: While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven highly effective at modeling relational data, pairwise connections cannot fully capture multi-way relationships naturally present in complex real-world systems. In response to this, Topological Deep Learning (TDL) leverages more general combinatorial representations--such as simplicial or cellular complexes--to accommodate higher-order interactions. Existing TDL methods often extend GNNs through Higher-Order Message Passing (HOMP), but face critical scalability challenges due to the steep complexity overhead of propagating messages through combinatorial structures. To overcome this limitation, we propose HOPSE (Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder), a framework free of message passing layers that uses Hasse graph decompositions to derive efficient and expressive encodings over arbitrary higher-order domains. Notably, HOPSE scales linearly with the size of combinatorial representations while preserving the expressive power and permutation equivariance of the HOMP approaches. Experiments on molecular and topological benchmarks show that it matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance while consistently achieving speedups over HOMP-based models, opening a new path for scalable TDL. The code is available at https://github.com/geometric-intelligence/topobench.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HOPSE（高阶位置和结构编码器），一种无需消息传递的框架，通过Hasse图分解对任意高阶组合结构（如单纯复形、胞腔复形）进行高效编码。HOPSE具有线性复杂度，同时保持了排列等变性，在分子和拓扑基准上达到或超越现有高阶消息传递方法的性能，并实现显著加速。
Motivation: 现有拓扑深度学习方法依赖高阶消息传递（HOMP），在处理复杂组合结构时面临严重的可扩展性问题，因为消息传播的开销随结构尺寸急剧增长。
Method: 提出HOPSE框架，利用Hasse图分解将高阶组合结构转换为层次图，并设计可学习的位置和结构编码器，避免显式消息传递，实现线性缩放。
Result: 在分子和拓扑基准实验上，HOPSE在性能上匹配或超越现有HOMP方法，并持续获得速度提升。
Conclusion: HOPSE为可扩展的拓扑深度学习提供了新路径，展示了无消息传递编码器在高阶表示学习中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在分子和拓扑基准实验上，HOPSE在性能上匹配或超越现有HOMP方法，并持续获得速度提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: HOPSE为可扩展的拓扑深度学习提供了新路径，展示了无消息传递编码器在高阶表示学习中的潜力。

papers.title: Self-supervised Feature Disentanglement and Augmentation Network for One-class Face Anti-spoofing
papers.abstract_en: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) techniques aim to enhance the security of facial identity authentication by distinguishing authentic live faces from deceptive attempts. While two-class FAS methods risk overfitting to training attacks to achieve better performance, one-class FAS approaches handle unseen attacks well but are less robust to domain information entangled within the liveness features. To address this, we propose an Unsupervised Feature Disentanglement and Augmentation Network (\textbf{UFDANet}), a one-class FAS technique that enhances generalizability by augmenting face images via disentangled features. The \textbf{UFDANet} employs a novel unsupervised feature disentangling method to separate the liveness and domain features, facilitating discriminative feature learning. It integrates an out-of-distribution liveness feature augmentation scheme to synthesize new liveness features of unseen spoof classes, which deviate from the live class, thus enhancing the representability and discriminability of liveness features. Additionally, \textbf{UFDANet} incorporates a domain feature augmentation routine to synthesize unseen domain features, thereby achieving better generalizability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed \textbf{UFDANet} outperforms previous one-class FAS methods and achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art two-class FAS methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督特征解耦与增强网络（UFDANet），用于一类人脸反欺骗（one-class FAS）。该方法通过无监督特征解耦分离活体特征与域特征，并引入活体特征增强和域特征增强以提升泛化能力。实验表明UFDANet优于以往一类FAS方法，性能接近最先进的两类FAS方法。
Motivation: 现有两类FAS方法可能过拟合于训练攻击，而一类FAS方法虽能处理未见攻击但对域信息纠缠鲁棒性不足。本文旨在提升一类FAS的泛化能力。
Method: 提出UFDANet，包含无监督特征解耦模块（分离活体/域特征）、离群活体特征增强（合成未见欺骗类的新活体特征）以及域特征增强（合成未见域特征）。
Result: 大量实验表明UFDANet优于以前的一类FAS方法，性能与最先进的两类FAS方法相当。
Conclusion: 本文提出的无监督特征解耦与增强策略能有效提升一类FAS的泛化性，且不依赖攻击类别标注。

papers.title: Adversarial Agents: Black-Box Evasion Attacks with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Attacks on machine learning models have been extensively studied through stateless optimization. In this paper, we demonstrate how a reinforcement learning (RL) agent can learn a new class of attack algorithms that generate adversarial samples. Unlike traditional adversarial machine learning (AML) methods that craft adversarial samples independently, our RL-based approach retains and exploits past attack experience to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of future attacks. We formulate adversarial sample generation as a Markov Decision Process and evaluate RL's ability to (a) learn effective and efficient attack strategies and (b) compete with state-of-the-art AML. On two image classification benchmarks, our agent increases attack success rate by up to 13.2% and decreases the average number of victim model queries per attack by up to 16.9% from the start to the end of training. In a head-to-head comparison with state-of-the-art image attacks, our approach enables an adversary to generate adversarial samples with 17% more success on unseen inputs post-training. From a security perspective, this work demonstrates a powerful new attack vector that uses RL to train agents that attack ML models efficiently and at scale.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Findings of CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将对抗样本生成建模为马尔可夫决策过程，提出基于强化学习（RL）的黑盒逃逸攻击方法。代理人（agent）通过学习历史攻击经验来提升未来攻击的有效性和效率。在两个图像分类基准上，该方法相比传统方法达到攻击成功率提升13.2%，查询次数减少16.9%，并在未见输入上相比最先进图像攻击方法提升17%成功率。
Motivation: 现有对抗机器学习（AML）方法通常以无状态优化方式独立生成对抗样本，无法利用历史攻击经验，导致攻击效率低下。本文旨在通过RL利用历史经验，发展更高效、可扩展的黑盒攻击策略。
Method: 将对抗样本生成形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），用RL训练代理（agent）学习攻击策略：agent与环境（目标模型）交互，基于状态（如当前扰动、模型输出）选择动作（修改像素），获得奖励（如攻击成功、查询代价）。
Result: 在图像分类基准上，agent训练后攻击成功率提升13.2%，平均每攻击查询次数减少16.9%。与最先进图像攻击方法对比，在未见输入上攻击成功率高出17%。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了一种利用RL训练高效、大规模攻击模型的新攻击向量，对机器学习模型安全性构成新的威胁。

papers.title: GridPE: A Grid Cell-Inspired Unified Position Embedding for Arbitrary-Dimensional Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Understanding spatial relationships across all dimensions is fundamental for intelligent systems. However, existing positional embeddings, such as Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE), lack theoretical guarantees for high-dimensional spatiotemporal tasks like video understanding and robotic navigation. Inspired by the hexagonal periodic coding of grid cells in mammalian spatial cognition, we propose GridPE -- a novel positional embedding framework that integrates computational neuroscience principles with harmonic analysis. Our approach builds upon Random Fourier Features and leverages principles from neuroscience to construct efficient embeddings. Theoretically, we prove that any translation-invariant spatial function can be approximated by a finite sum of Fourier bases, which naturally reduces to RoPE in the one-dimensional case. We then derive the directions and quantities of frequency vectors at each scale in any Euclidean dimension, along with the optimal ratio between different scales, from a bioavailability perspective. These derivations are equivalent to the relationship between the centroid and the vertices of a regular simplex in that dimension. We validate GridPE across a range of spatial modeling tasks, including 2D image classification (ImageNet100) and 3D point cloud recognition (ModelNet40). Our theoretical analysis establishes GridPE as a unified framework for positional embedding in arbitrary-dimensional spaces, while empirical results demonstrate its superiority over existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文受哺乳动物空间认知中网格细胞的六边形周期编码启发，提出GridPE——一种将计算神经科学与调和分析相结合的位置嵌入框架。理论证明任何平移不变的空间函数可由有限傅里叶基逼近，并在一维情形下退化为RoPE。导出任意欧几里得维度下频率向量的方向和数量以及最优尺度的比值。在ImageNet100上的2D图像分类和ModelNet40上的3D点云识别任务中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有位置嵌入（如RoPE）缺乏对高维时空任务（如视频理解、机器人导航）的理论保障。
Method: 基于随机傅里叶特征（Random Fourier Features）并利用神经科学原理构造高效嵌入；通过理论推导确定各尺度频率向量的方向、数量和最优比率。
Result: 在ImageNet100（2D图像分类）和ModelNet40（3D点云识别）上，GridPE优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 理论分析确立GridPE作为任意维度空间位置嵌入的统一框架，实验证明其优越性。

papers.title: Binary Gaussian Copula Synthesis: an LLM-powered data augmentation framework for early dialysis prediction in chronic kidney disease
papers.abstract_en: Only a small fraction of patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) progress to dialysis, creating severe class imbalance that limits the performance of machine learning models for early dialysis prediction. This challenge is compounded by the binary structure of electronic health record (EHR) data, for which most existing augmentation methods were not designed. We propose Binary Gaussian Copula Synthesis (BGCS), a two-stage data augmentation method tailored to binary clinical data. BGCS first generates synthetic minority-class samples using a Gaussian copula framework that explicitly models pairwise dependencies among binary features, then applies a fine-tuned GPT-2 classifier to filter out clinically implausible samples before training. We evaluated BGCS on a real-world EHR dataset of 15,169 patients with CKD from West Virginia collected between 2008 and 2022, benchmarking it against SMOTE, CTGAN, and standard Gaussian Copula across four machine learning classifiers over 25 independent runs. BGCS consistently outperformed all comparison methods, achieving the highest minority-class recall for 90-day dialysis prediction, with median values ranging from 0.78 to 0.87 across classifiers, and the strongest distributional fidelity to real data, with a mean p-value of 0.68 across features. The best-performing BGCS-augmented model was integrated into an interpretable decision tree-based clinical decision support system for dialysis risk stratification, with electrolyte imbalances, cardiovascular comorbidities, and renal monitoring indicators emerging as the most influential predictive features. These findings suggest that augmentation methods designed for the structural properties of binary EHR data can meaningfully improve early dialysis risk prediction and support the development of interpretable clinical decision-support tools for CKD care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对慢性肾病（CKD）患者透析预测中类别不平衡问题，本文提出Binary Gaussian Copula Synthesis (BGCS)数据增强框架。该方法先利用高斯Copula生成符合二元特征依赖的合成少数类样本，再经微调GPT-2过滤临床不合理样本。在15169名患者真实EHR数据集上，BGCS使四种分类器的少数类召回率中位数达0.78–0.87，分布保真度优于SMOTE、CTGAN等，最终模型被集成到可解释决策树临床支持系统。
Motivation: CKD患者中仅少数进展至透析，导致严重类别不平衡，且EHR数据多为二元特征，现有数据增强方法未针对此结构设计，亟需专用方法改善早期透析预测。
Method: 提出两阶段数据增强方法BGCS：第一阶段使用高斯Copula建模二元特征间的成对依赖关系，生成合成少数类样本；第二阶段利用微调后的GPT-2分类器筛选并剔除临床不可信的样本。
Result: 在包含15169名CKD患者的真实EHR数据集（2008–2022年西弗吉尼亚州）上，BGCS在25次独立实验中一致优于SMOTE、CTGAN及标准高斯Copula：少数类召回率中位数达0.78–0.87（四种分类器），分布保真度指标（平均p值0.68）最高。电解质失衡、心血管合并症和肾功能监测指标被识别为最影响预测的特征。
Conclusion: 针对二元EHR数据结构性而设计的增强方法可显著提升早期透析风险预测，并支持构建可解释的临床决策支持工具。

papers.title: Uncovering Model Processing Strategies with Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NPEFF (Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization), an interpretability method that aims to uncover strategies used by a model to generate its predictions. NPEFF decomposes per-example Fisher matrices using a novel decomposition algorithm that learns a set of components represented by learned rank-1 positive semi-definite matrices. Through a combination of human evaluation and automated analysis, we demonstrate that these NPEFF components correspond to model processing strategies for a variety of language models and text processing tasks. We further show how to construct parameter perturbations from NPEFF components to selectively disrupt a given component's role in the model's processing. Along with conducting extensive ablation studies, we include experiments to show how NPEFF can be used to analyze and mitigate collateral effects of unlearning and use NPEFF to study in-context learning. Furthermore, we demonstrate the advantages of NPEFF over baselines such as gradient clustering and using sparse autoencoders for dictionary learning over model activations. We release the code used in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NPEFF（非负每样本 Fisher 分解），一种用于揭示模型预测策略的可解释性方法。NPEFF 通过新颖的分解算法将每样本 Fisher 矩阵分解为学习到的秩1正半定矩阵组件。通过人工评估和自动分析，证明这些组件对应多种语言模型和文本处理任务中的模型处理策略。还展示了如何从 NPEFF 组件构建参数扰动以选择性干扰特定组件的作用。实验包括消融研究、分析机器遗忘的附带影响以及研究上下文学习。方法在梯度聚类和基于稀疏自编码器的字典学习等基线上显示出优势。
Motivation: 现有模型可解释性方法难以发现模型在处理不同样本时所采用的多样化策略，需要一种能够自动识别和分离模型预测时使用的不同处理模式的方法。
Method: 提出 NPEFF，通过非负矩阵分解变体分解每样本 Fisher 信息矩阵，学习一组秩1正半定矩阵作为组件。每个组件代表一种处理策略。可以通过构造参数扰动来选择性破坏某一组件的作用。
Result: 在多种语言模型和文本任务上，NPEFF 组件被验证对应可解释的处理策略。在分析机器遗忘和上下文学习任务中展示了应用价值。与梯度聚类和稀疏自编码器相比，NPEFF 提供了更可解释的组件。
Conclusion: NPEFF 提供了一种有效的工具来揭示和操纵模型内部处理策略，有助于理解和改善模型行为，特别是在机器遗忘等场景中。

papers.title: Can Language Models Learn to Listen?
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for generating appropriate facial responses from a listener in dyadic social interactions based on the speaker's words. Given an input transcription of the speaker's words with their timestamps, our approach autoregressively predicts a response of a listener: a sequence of listener facial gestures, quantized using a VQ-VAE. Since gesture is a language component, we propose treating the quantized atomic motion elements as additional language token inputs to a transformer-based large language model. Initializing our transformer with the weights of a language model pre-trained only on text results in significantly higher quality listener responses than training a transformer from scratch. We show that our generated listener motion is fluent and reflective of language semantics through quantitative metrics and a qualitative user study. In our evaluation, we analyze the model's ability to utilize temporal and semantic aspects of spoken text. Project page: https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~evonne_ng/projects/text2listen/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，利用说话者的话语文本生成听者的面部反应。方法使用 VQ-VAE 量化面部动作并作为语言 token 输入到基于 transformer 的语言模型，初始化自文本预训练权重。实验表明生成的听者动作流畅且反映语义。
Motivation: 现有的听者生成方法往往忽略语言语义，本文旨在利用说话者的文字来驱动听者的面部反应。
Method: 将听者面部动作序列用 VQ-VAE 量化为离散 token，与说话者文本 token 一同输入 transformer 语言模型，并利用文本预训练权重初始化。
Result: 定量和用户研究表明生成的听者动作流畅且语义相关，相比从头训练 transformer 效果更好。
Conclusion: 通过将动作 token 作为语言 token 输入，文本预训练的语言模型能够生成语义感知的听者面部反应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Central Description Length (CDL) Clustering Validation Index
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a clustering algorithm and its hyperparameters without labels is a common difficulty in engineering machine learning pipelines that work with unsupervised analysis of sensor, image, or process data. Clustering validation indices (CVIs) provide internal scores for ranking candidate clusterings, but most popular CVIs are built from Euclidean compactness and separation terms and so tend to favour compact, convex partitions. Their performance is known to degrade on non convex, irregular, or variable density data, where kernel transformations or alternative distance measures are typically used at the cost of additional tuning and computation. This paper introduces the Central Description Length (CDL) clustering validation index. CDL uses the observed within cluster compactness, the estimated cluster centers, and the estimated cluster covariances to compute a probabilistic upper bound on the description length associated with the unobservable true cluster centers. The bound condenses intra cluster compactness and centroid displacement into a single computable quantity and is evaluated on the partition produced by any clustering algorithm. The implementation uses only observable quantities (the data, the partition, the estimated centers, and the estimated covariances) and does not use ground truth labels. On synthetic benchmarks with non convex and arbitrary shape clusters, CDL-CVI selected the reference number of clusters more often and reached higher Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) values than the conventional CVIs we tested, without an additional kernel preprocessing stage. On image benchmarks (MNIST, CIFAR-10, STL-10) clustered from frozen unsupervised embeddings, CDL-CVI returned cluster numbers close to the reference class counts across K-means, DBSCAN, and spectral clustering in the reported trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的聚类验证指数——中心描述长度（Central Description Length, CDL），用于无标签情况下评估聚类结果。CDL通过簇内紧致性、估计的簇中心和协方差，计算出不可观测的真实簇中心描述长度的概率上界。该方法仅使用可观测量（数据、划分、估计中心和协方差），无需真实标签。在非凸和不规则形状的合成基准以及图像基准（MNIST、CIFAR-10、STL-10）上，CDL比传统聚类验证指数更准确地选择簇数，且无需额外的核预处理。
Motivation: 无标签情况下选择聚类算法和超参数是机器学习流水线的常见困难。现有聚类验证指数多基于欧氏紧致性和分离性，倾向于紧凑凸形划分，在非凸、不规则或变密度数据上性能下降，核变换或替代距离度量会增加调参和计算成本。
Method: 提出中央描述长度（Central Description Length, CDL）聚类验证指数。利用观测到的簇内紧致性、估计的簇中心和协方差，计算真实簇中心描述长度的概率上界，将簇内紧致性和质心位移合并为单一可计算量，仅依赖可观测量。
Result: 在非凸和任意形状的合成基准上，CDL比传统CVI更频繁地选出参考簇数，并达到更高的调整兰德指数（ARI）。在图像基准（MNIST、CIFAR-10、STL-10）上，使用冻结的无监督嵌入，CDL在K-means、DBSCAN和谱聚类中返回的簇数接近参考类别数。
Conclusion: CDL是一种有效的无监督聚类验证指标，适用于非凸、不规则形状的数据集，无需核预处理，实验验证了其在合成和真实图像数据上的优越性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantifying the biophysical properties of stomatocytes in health and disease
papers.abstract_en: Hereditary stomatocytosis (HS) comprises red blood cell (RBC) disorders characterized by cup-shaped erythrocytes that respond oppositely to splenectomy: curative in overhydrated HS (OHS) but potentially thrombogenic in dehydrated HS (DHS/xerocytosis). This paradox persists because RBC biomechanics is governed by partly independent parameters--shear modulus, bending rigidity, surface-to-volume ratio (S/V), and cytoplasmic viscosity--that existing assays capture only piecemeal. Here we combine dissipative particle dynamics (DPD) simulations with microfluidic imaging to construct a control discocyte and three stomatocyte models (ST-RBC1-3) at fixed membrane area and decreasing volume (109.7, 101.5, 89.8 fL), spanning the OHS-to-DHS range. Tracing this parameter set through five mechanically orthogonal assays, we find that interendothelial-slit (IES) traversal is geometry-dominated: overhydrated ST-RBC1 requires an order of magnitude higher critical pressure than healthy RBCs, whereas dehydrated ST-RBC3 passes freely. ST-RBC3 nonetheless suppresses membrane tank-treading and raises low-shear whole-blood viscosity by ~29% at physiological haematocrit, comparable to Gaucher-disease hyperviscosity. A funnel-obstacle chip amplifies these differences into a label-free centerline-offset signal predicted to separate all four RBC types (~4.5 standard deviations between extreme phenotypes). These results unite single-cell mechanics, splenic filtration, and hemorheology in one framework, resolve the splenectomy paradox, and point toward microfluidic pre-operative risk stratification in HS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文结合耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟与微流控成像，构建了包含正常盘状红细胞和三种口形红细胞（ST-RBC1-3）的模型，覆盖从过水化到脱水的遗传性口形红细胞增多症（HS）范围。通过五种力学正交实验发现，内皮间隙（IES）穿越主要由几何因素决定：过水化ST-RBC1所需临界压力比健康红细胞高一个数量级，而脱水ST-RBC3可自由通过；但ST-RBC3抑制膜坦克履带运动，使低剪切全血粘度在生理红细胞压积下升高约29%。漏斗障碍芯片可无标记区分四种红细胞类型（极端表型间约4.5个标准差）。结果统一了单细胞力学、脾过滤和血液流变学，解析了脾切除悖论，指向微流控术前风险分层。
Motivation: 遗传性口形红细胞增多症（HS）中，脾切除术对过水化型（OHS）有效，但对脱水型（DHS/xerocytosis）可能引发血栓，这一悖论尚未解决，因为红细胞生物力学由多个部分独立的参数（剪切模量、弯曲刚度、表面积体积比、细胞质粘度）控制，现有检测方法只能片面积捕捉。
Method: 采用耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟与微流控成像相结合，构建了一个对照盘状红细胞和三种口形红细胞模型（ST-RBC1-3），固定膜面积但体积递减（109.7、101.5、89.8 fL），涵盖OHS到DHS范围；通过五种力学正交实验追踪参数集。
Result: 过水化ST-RBC1的IES穿越所需临界压力比健康红细胞高一个数量级，而脱水ST-RBC3可自由通过；ST-RBC3抑制膜坦克履带运动，使低剪切全血粘度在生理红细胞压积下升高约29%；漏斗障碍芯片可产生无标记中心偏移信号，预计可分离所有四种红细胞类型（极端表型间约4.5个标准差）。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了单细胞力学、脾过滤和血液流变学，解析了脾切除悖论，并指向微流控术前风险分层在HS中的潜在应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Language of Elution: Autoregressive Prediction of the Next Feature in Untargeted LC-HRMS Lipidomics
papers.abstract_en: Untargeted liquid chromatography-high-resolution mass spectrometry (LC-HRMS) detects thousands of molecular features per sample, yet only 2-20% receive confident structural annotations. A root cause of this "dark metabolome" is that tandem MS/MS acquisition is reactive: instruments select precursors only after ions appear, blind to what elutes next. We reframe chromatographic elution as an autoregressive sequence prediction task. Because reversed-phase elution order is governed by hydrophobicity, successive features form a physically constrained sequence, like tokens in language. We discretize the mass-to-charge (m/z) axis into 110 bins and train long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer models to predict the next eluting m/z bin from five annotation-free per-token features: m/z bin, mass defect, retention-time gap, polarity, and intensity rank. Trained on 15,242 features from four clinical lipidomics cohorts (342 plasma samples; SCIEX TripleTOF 6600+, Waters CSH C18), the LSTM reaches 98.4% top-1 accuracy (99.99% top-5; mean absolute error 3.6 Da) and the Transformer 98.0%. Ablation shows autoregressive context accounts for 55.5 percentage points while no single feature contributes more than 0.2 pp: the sequential pattern, not molecular properties, drives prediction. Models transfer across instruments sharing the method (r=0.999 on an independent Agilent 6530 dataset) but fail under a different column chemistry (5.1% top-1) or polarity mode (2.6%), confirming method- and mode-specificity. Fine-tuning on as few as two to five quality-control injections recovers held-out accuracy from 2.6% to nearly 50%, so cross-condition deployment needs minimal calibration. These results establish that elution sequences are highly predictable and lay the groundwork for predictive MS/MS acquisition to improve annotation coverage in untargeted metabolomics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文将非靶向液相色谱-高分辨质谱（LC-HRMS）中的洗脱过程重新构建为自回归序列预测任务。通过将质荷比（m/z）离散化为110个区间，并利用LSTM和Transformer模型预测下一个洗脱的m/z区间，在四个临床脂质组学队列（15,242个特征）上达到98.4%的top-1准确率。研究表明洗脱序列具有高度可预测性，为预测性串联质谱采集奠定基础，以改善非靶向代谢组学中的注释覆盖率。
Motivation: 非靶向LC-HRMS能检测数千个分子特征，但仅有2-20%获得可靠的结构注释，主要原因是串联质谱（MS/MS）采集是被动的，仪器无法预知下一个洗脱的特征。
Method: 将洗脱顺序视为自回归序列预测任务，将m/z轴离散化为110个区间，使用五种无需注释的特征（m/z区间、质量缺陷、保留时间间隔、极性、强度排名）训练LSTM和Transformer模型来预测下一个洗脱的m/z区间。
Result: LSTM模型达到98.4%的top-1准确率（top-5为99.99%，平均绝对误差3.6 Da），Transformer模型为98.0%。消融实验表明自回归上下文贡献了55.5个百分点的准确率，而单个特征贡献不超过0.2个百分点。模型在相似仪器上可迁移（r=0.999），但在不同色谱柱化学或极性模式下性能大幅下降（top-1分别为5.1%和2.6%），少量微调（2-5次质控注射）可恢复至近50%。
Conclusion: 洗脱序列具有高度可预测性，但方法特异性和模式特异性要求跨条件部署时进行最小校准。这项工作为基于预测的串联质谱采集以提高非靶向代谢组学注释覆盖率奠定了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where's the Structure? A Systematic Literature Review of Empirical Research on Human-AI Collaboration and Hybrid Intelligence for Learning
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been applied across educational contexts to support learning. One approach to such support is "human-AI collaboration" (also termed "hybrid intelligence"), where human(s) and AI components interact to promote human learning. However, as in human-to-human computer-supported collaborative learning (CSCL), unstructured interaction does not necessarily produce an effective learning experience. This paper reports a systematic literature review of empirical studies (N=62) on human-AI collaboration and hybrid intelligence for learning support. The review characterizes collaboration processes, their structures, and contexts of application. It also extracts emerging design knowledge and research gaps. Researchers and technology designers can use these findings as a starting point for structuring more effective AI-enhanced technologies for collaboration, in educational practice and future research.
papers.comment: 59 pages, 4 figures, submitted to a journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对学习支持中的人类-AI协作（混合智能）进行系统性文献综述，分析62项实证研究，表征协作过程、结构及应用背景，并提取设计知识和研究空白。
Motivation: 尽管AI已广泛应用于教育，但如同人类间计算机支持的协作学习，无结构的互动不一定产生有效学习体验，因此需要系统理解协作结构。
Method: 对62项关于人类-AI协作和混合智能支持学习的实证研究进行系统性文献综述，分析协作过程、结构及应用情境。
Result: 综述总结了协作过程的特点、常见结构及不同学习情境中的应用，同时提取了新兴的设计知识和研究空白。
Conclusion: 研究者和技术设计师可以以此为基础，为教育实践和未来研究设计更有效的AI增强协作技术。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 研究者和技术设计师可以以此为基础，为教育实践和未来研究设计更有效的AI增强协作技术。

papers.title: Gradient Descent with Large Step Size Restores Symmetry in Deep Linear Networks with Multi-Pathway
papers.abstract_en: Recent analyses of multi-pathway Deep Linear Networks use Gradient Flow to predict a "winner-takes-all" specialization in which path symmetry breaks and each feature concentrates in a single pathway. In this work, we show that discrete Gradient Descent (GD) with a large step size tells a different story. We prove that single-path solutions are sharp minima, whereas distributing signals across pathways reduces sharpness by a factor that decreases with both the number of pathways and depth. Consequently, while early training reproduces the depth-driven symmetry breaking predicted by GF, oscillations at the Edge of Stability subsequently override this tendency and drive the network into a re-balancing phase, where signals redistribute across pathways. Together, these results clarify how depth shapes pathway competition and explain why large-step GD favors shared representations rather than persistent single-pathway dominance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度线性网络（Deep Linear Networks）中多路径（multi-pathway）的对称性恢复问题。传统分析使用梯度流（Gradient Flow）预测路径对称性破缺和赢家通吃（winner-takes-all）的特化，但本文证明离散梯度下降（Gradient Descent）在步长较大时会导致相反行为：单路径解是尖锐极小点，而多路径分布式信号降低尖锐度，且降低幅度随路径数和深度增加而增大。因此，早期训练虽复现深度驱动的对称性破缺，但后续在稳定性边界（Edge of Stability）的振荡会覆盖这一趋势，驱动信号重新分布到各路径。
Motivation: 已有理论基于梯度流预测多路径深度线性网络中路径会特化为单路径，但离散梯度下降的大步长动力学尚未被充分理解，尤其对称性恢复机制。
Method: 理论分析离散梯度下降（GD）在深度线性网络（Deep Linear Networks）多路径设置下的动力学，证明单路径解是尖锐极小点，分布式信号降低尖锐度，并利用稳定性边界（Edge of Stability）现象解释更新过程中的对称性恢复。
Result: 证明分布式信号相比单路径解的尖锐度降低因子与路径数和深度成反比；实验表明大步长GD在稳定性边界处驱动信号重新分布，而非持续单路径主导。
Conclusion: 结果表明深度塑造了路径竞争的方式，大步长GD倾向于共享表示而非持续的单路径优势，挑战了基于梯度流的赢家通吃预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Score Hamiltonian: Mapping Diffusion Models to Adiabatic Transport
papers.abstract_en: We exhibit an exact correspondence between sampling with score-based diffusion models and adiabatic transport of ground states for a family of Schrödinger operators we call Score Hamiltonians, built from the learned score's quantum potential. We obtain novel density reconstruction bounds and principled annealing schedules via adiabatic theorems for Fokker-Planck equations with time-varying potentials. We find the fundamental limit of sampling is set by the ratio of squared score-matching error to Score Hamiltonian spectral gap - the inverse Poincaré constant of the data density.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于得分的扩散模型（score-based diffusion models）与一族薛定谔算子（称为Score Hamiltonians）的基态绝热输运之间的精确对应关系，其中Score Hamiltonian由学习到的得分的量子势构建。通过含时势场的Fokker-Planck方程的绝热定理，获得了新的密度重建界和原则性的退火调度。采样基本极限由得分匹配误差平方与Score Hamiltonian谱隙（数据密度的逆庞加莱常数）之比决定。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型缺乏严格的理论框架来理解采样过程的动力学和效率极限，该工作旨在建立扩散模型与量子绝热输运之间的精确映射，从而利用绝热理论提供理论保证。
Method: 构造了一族依赖时间的薛定谔算子（Score Hamiltonians），其势能项来自学习到的得分函数；将采样过程重新解释为这些算子的基态随时间绝热输运，并利用Fokker-Planck方程的绝热定理推导出采样误差上界。
Result: 得到了新颖的密度重建界和原则性的退火调度；指出采样的根本限制由得分匹配误差的平方除以Score Hamiltonian的谱隙（即数据密度的逆庞加莱常数）给出。
Conclusion: 该映射为理解扩散模型的采样动力学提供了理论视角，并给出了一个量化采样难度的通用上限。

papers.title: Transformer-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning: Fundamentals and Applications in Communication Networks
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has long been a powerful solution to various problems in communication networks. However, traditional RL models still face with several limitations. Not only do they rely on large numbers of interactions with the environment, but they are also limited in terms of modeling long-term relationships and tackling partial observability. In recent years, the Transformer model has demonstrated the ability to enhance RL models, allowing them to overcome these issues. Particularly, the self-attention mechanism within the Transformer enables efficient modeling of long-range dependencies and global correlations, as well as accelerates training processes and handles heterogeneous data modalities. In this paper, we present a comprehensive survey of Transformer-based RL algorithms and their applications in communication networks. Specifically, the paper provides the mathematical background of RL and Transformer architectures, along with insights into key issues such as resource allocation, computation offloading, routing, and trajectory control, and network security. We conclude the paper by discussing challenges, open issues, and notable future research directions, including Transformer-enhanced DRL algorithms for semantic communication and network optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于Transformer增强强化学习（Transformer-enhanced RL）在通信网络中应用的综述。文章首先介绍了传统强化学习在通信网络中的局限性，包括依赖大量环境交互、难以建模长程依赖和部分可观测性。然后详细阐述了Transformer模型如何通过自注意力机制增强RL，使其能够高效建模长程依赖和全局相关性，加速训练并处理异构数据。综述涵盖了资源分配、计算卸载、路由、轨迹控制、网络安全等关键应用领域，并讨论了未来研究方向，如语义通信和网络优化。
Motivation: 传统强化学习模型在通信网络中面临交互次数多、无法有效建模长程依赖以及处理部分可观测性等局限，亟需引入新机制以提升性能。
Method: 文章综述了Transformer增强的强化学习算法，其核心是利用Transformer的自注意力机制捕捉序列中的长程依赖和全局相关性，同时加速训练并支持异质数据模态。
Result: 文章系统梳理了基于Transformer的RL在资源分配、计算卸载、路由、轨迹控制及网络安全等通信网络问题中的应用，并指出了语义通信和网络优化等未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 该综述总结了当前面临的挑战与开放问题，并展望了Transformer增强DRL算法在通信网络中的未来发展方向。

papers.title: Ontology-constrained multi-LLM scoring of hypothesis support in the predictive processing literature
papers.abstract_en: Fragmentation is common in interdisciplinary fields with diverse methods and theoretical commitments. Predictive coding neuroscience is a clear example: its literature spans computational theory, electrophysiology, imaging, behavior, and modeling, creating a synthesis problem that conventional meta-analysis cannot easily resolve. Here, we describe a local multi-LLM pipeline for ontology-constrained literature synthesis. The pipeline reads papers, extracts evidence, incorporates figure descriptions, assembles constrained prompts, and validates outputs against an expert glossary. We manually defined a predictive-coding glossary of thirty-six concepts grouped into three hypotheses: predictive suppression, feedforward error propagation, and ubiquity. A council of ten local language models scored 31 studies according to their agreement or disagreement with each glossary factor across local and global oddball contexts. This enabled pairwise study-agreement analysis, cross-model comparison, and three-dimensional hypothesis-space mapping. Agreement was high for some hypotheses but weaker for others, revealing structured disagreement, particularly across local versus global oddball paradigms. We further define hypothesis-space temperature, a geometric dispersion metric measuring how compactly studies occupy the hypothesis space. Temperature was lower for local oddball contexts and higher for global oddball contexts, indicating greater dispersion in the latter. The scoring geometry also allowed us to estimate vectors of change between experimental contexts. These results demonstrate that local multi-LLM councils can produce auditable disagreement measurements that map heterogeneous literatures into quantitative evidence spaces. This framework may generalize to cross-study hypothesis mapping where conventional meta-analysis lacks a common comparison space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种本体约束的多大语言模型（multi-LLM）流水线，用于综合预测编码（predictive coding）文献中的假设支持度。该流水线读取论文、提取证据、整合图表描述，并利用十个本地大语言模型组成的委员会，对31项研究在三种假设（预测抑制、前馈误差传播、普遍性）下的支持度进行评分，从而生成可审计的量化证据空间。结果表明，不同假设的一致性存在差异，且在局部与全局oddball范式下研究分散度不同。
Motivation: 预测编码神经科学等跨学科领域因方法多样、理论承诺各异而呈现碎片化，传统元分析难以有效综合文献。
Method: 构建包含36个概念、三种假设的预测编码术语表；使用十个本地大语言模型对31项研究进行评分，提取证据并验证输出；通过成对研究一致性分析、跨模型比较和三维假设空间映射来量化假设支持度。
Result: 某些假设下评分一致性高，另一些则较弱，揭示了局部与全局oddball范式下的结构化分歧；定义了假设空间温度（hypothesis-space temperature）作为几何分散度指标，全局oddball上下文下分散度更高。
Conclusion: 本地多LLM委员会能够产生可审计的测量结果，将异质文献映射到定量证据空间，该框架可能推广到缺乏共同比较空间的跨研究假设映射。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Fidelity Learning with Shallow Recurrent Decoders for Reactor Physics
papers.abstract_en: In reactor physics, neutronics can be treated with different fidelity levels, according to the needs of the user. On one hand, the precise modeling of neutrons' behaviour in reactor physics is often expensive and time-consuming due to the high computational costs to numerically solve the Boltzmann transport equation. Conversely, by adopting suitable assumptions, such as the SP$_N$, diffusion theory, and point kinetics, it is possible to generate efficiently low-fidelity data. From the perspective of surrogate models, this computational limitation translates into a scarcity of high-fidelity data and a significant amount of low-fidelity data. Given this difference in fidelity levels, it would be interesting to develop a suitable procedure to map low-fidelity models towards higher fidelity models; for instance, one could obtain the solution to a multi-group diffusion equation starting from time-series data obtained from a point kinetics model. Indeed, this work investigates this possibility by leveraging multi-fidelity information with Shallow Recurrent Decoders, a novel machine learning architecture able to map time-series observations to the full state of the reactor. This technique has been designed to use local or global measurements as input and map their temporal trajectories to the high-dimensional state; by the same logic, in principle, this architecture can also be used when the input is formed by the solution of a lumped model. This work applies this idea to a benchmark reactor geometry, mapping the point kinetics model to the diffusion solution under various input conditions, with much less computational costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用浅层循环解码器（Shallow Recurrent Decoders）进行多保真度学习，将反应堆物理中的低保真模型（如点动力学模型）映射到高保真模型（如扩散方程解），从而以较低计算成本获取高保真数据。在基准反应堆几何上验证了该方法，展示了从低保真时间序列数据重建全状态的能力。
Motivation: 反应堆物理中，高保真中子学求解计算成本高，导致高保真数据稀缺，而低保真模型可快速生成大量数据。需要一种方法将低保真模型映射到高保真，以利用低保真数据的丰富性。
Method: 采用浅层循环解码器架构，该架构以局部或全局测量（此处为低保真模型的时间序列输出）为输入，通过循环神经网络映射到反应堆的高维状态空间。
Result: 在基准反应堆几何上，该方法成功将点动力学模型的时间序列映射到扩散方程解，显著降低了获取高保真数据的计算成本。
Conclusion: 该方法为反应堆物理中多保真度建模提供了一种有效途径，可推广到其他由低保真模型到高保真模型的映射场景。

papers.title: State commitment learning: training language models to distinguish computation from memory
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models do not distinguish tokens used for computation from tokens that constitute persistent state: once generated, all hidden thoughts remain in context and influence future predictions. As a result, downstream reasoning may depend on failed attempts, dead ends, and private scratch work that should not be safely relied on later. We recast this phenomenon as a new training objective, state commitment learning: training models to explicitly distinguish information that should be committed as persistent state from temporary computation that can be discarded. We define a counterfactual criterion, persistent-state sufficiency, which makes it trainable and measurable whether an answer remains usable after hidden thoughts are erased. We then propose Counterfactual Erasure RL (CERL), which evaluates, under the same prefix, both a path that keeps hidden thoughts and a path that erases them, and gives reward only when the erasure path remains correct. We also introduce the Erasure Dependence Protocol and show across mathematics, long-chain logic, scientific QA, and multi-turn tool-use evaluation that CERL substantially reduces answer dependence on hidden thoughts without sacrificing accuracy, consistently outperforming correctness-only RL and long-answer SFT baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出状态承诺学习（state commitment learning）训练目标，使语言模型区分用于计算的token和构成持久状态的token。通过反事实擦除RL（CERL）方法，在数学、长链逻辑、科学QA和多轮工具使用评估中，显著降低答案对隐藏思想的依赖而不牺牲准确性。
Motivation: 推理语言模型不区分计算token和持久状态token，导致后续推理可能依赖失败尝试、死胡同和私有草稿等不应安全依赖的信息。

Result: 在数学、长链逻辑、科学QA和多轮工具使用评估中，CERL显著降低答案对隐藏思想的依赖而不牺牲准确性，一致优于仅正确性RL和长答案SFT基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调CERL有效减少模型对临时计算信息的依赖，且不损失精度。

papers.title: A differentiable machine learning small-angle X-ray scattering analysis framework for structure elucidation of lipid nanoparticles
papers.abstract_en: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are efficient delivery systems for negatively charged nucleic acids. Their multi-component architecture yields a core-shell structure. Small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) is an important characterization technique for LNPs, but recovering internal structure and size distribution from SAXS is an inverse problem with non-unique solutions. Realistic models are often too expensive for systematic exploration. We introduce a machine-learning-accelerated, differentiable framework for SAXS analysis of heterogeneous, polydisperse LNPs. The forward model combines a core-shell particle with a Gaussian random-field interior, a neural surrogate for the monodisperse SAXS map, and a differentiable layer integrating over particle-size distributions. The surrogate reduces prediction cost by four orders of magnitude, while differentiability enables large-scale multi-start fitting and ensemble identifiability analysis. Applied to synthetic and experimental MC3 LNP data, the framework shows that near-identical SAXS fits can arise from distinct parameter modes, with the experimental fits dominated by a trade-off between size-distribution and interior-structure parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个机器学习加速的可微框架，用于脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）的小角X射线散射（SAXS）数据分析。该框架结合了核壳粒子模型、高斯随机场内衬、神经代理模型以及可微的粒径分布积分层，将预测成本降低了四个数量级。在合成和实验的MC3 LNP数据上，框架显示近乎相同的SAXS拟合可能源自不同的参数模式，而实验拟合主要由粒径分布和内部结构参数之间的权衡主导。
Motivation: 从SAXS数据中恢复LNP的内部结构和尺寸分布是一个逆问题，存在非唯一解，且真实模型通常过于复杂无法系统探索。
Method: 引入可微框架，包含核壳粒子模型与高斯随机场内衬的混合模型、用于单分散SAXS图的神经代理模型，以及可微的粒径分布积分层；利用可微性实现大规模多起点拟合和集成可辨识性分析。
Result: 神经代理模型将预测成本降低四个数量级；在合成和实验的MC3 LNP数据上，框架发现接近相同的SAXS拟合可能来自不同的参数模式，实验拟合由粒径分布和内部结构参数之间的权衡主导。
Conclusion: 该框架为异质多分散LNP的SAXS分析提供了可微的机器学习加速方法，有助于解决逆问题中的非唯一性。

papers.title: Finite Element-Based Material Learning via Automatic Differentiation: Learning constitutive neural network models from full-field deformation data
papers.abstract_en: The identification of constitutive neural network models from heterogeneous full-field deformation data provides a robust alternative to traditional calibration methods based on homogeneous stress-strain experiments, particularly given the high dimensionality of trainable parameters. Existing approaches must balance generality, robustness, and computational efficiency: Conventional finite element model updating is broadly applicable but computationally demanding; weak-form methods offer efficiency but are sensitive to noise and data scarcity; neural operator models are highly expressive but require extensive training datasets. This work presents FE-MAD (Finite Element-Based Material learning via Automatic Differentiation), an end-to-end differentiable framework that integrates a constitutive neural network model within a JAX-FEM nonlinear solver and identifies its parameters through gradient-based minimization of a measurement-mismatch loss. Newton tangent stiffness and loss gradients are computed automatically using forward- and reverse-mode automatic differentiation throughout the entire pipeline, thereby removing the need for analytic adjoints or offline surrogate models. FE-MAD is demonstrated for two architectures: a grey-box Constitutive Artificial Neural Network (CANN), a polyconvex, fully connected model with high flexibility, and a white-box CANN, an expert-system network with phenomenologically interpretable strain-energy terms. Focusing on incompressible isotropic hyperelasticity, FE-MAD is evaluated on three open experimental datasets: (1) full digital image correlation (DIC) of a perforated tensile specimen, (2) a reduced-data scenario with a one-dimensional stretch profile and global force-displacement curve, and (3) a heterogeneous matrix-inclusion system in which both phases constitutive laws are identified and generalized to twenty-two previously unseen samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FE-MAD，一个基于自动微分的端到端可微框架，将本构建模神经网络集成到 JAX-FEM 非线性求解器中，通过梯度下降最小化测量误差来识别材料参数。该方法避免了解析伴随或离线代理模型，并在三个实验数据集上验证了其识别不可压缩各向同性超弹性材料本构的能力，包括全场数字图像相关、一维拉伸轮廓和异质基体-夹杂物系统。
Motivation: 传统基于均匀应力-应变实验的本构模型标定方法受限于实验条件，而现有从全场变形数据识别本构模型的方法在普适性、鲁棒性和计算效率上存在权衡。需要一种既能利用全场数据又高效且鲁棒的方法。
Method: FE-MAD 将本构神经网络模型嵌入 JAX-FEM 非线性求解器中，利用前向和反向模式自动微分计算牛顿切线刚度和损失梯度，实现端到端可微，无需解析伴随或离线代理模型。
Result: 在三个公开实验数据集上，FE-MAD 成功识别了灰盒和白盒本构人工神经网络（CANN）的参数，包括全场 DIC 数据、降维拉伸-力曲线以及异质两相材料系统的本构定律，并泛化到 22 个未见样本。
Conclusion: FE-MAD 为从全场变形数据识别本构建模神经网络提供了一种通用、鲁棒且计算高效的框架，无需实验设计限制，并能处理噪声和稀疏数据。

papers.title: An accurate nucleic acid-small molecule docking framework via geometric deep learning with large-scale pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Nucleic acids are increasingly recognized as therapeutic targets beyond conventional protein-centered drug discovery, yet accurate and efficient docking of small molecules to nucleic acid structures remains challenging. Physics-based docking methods often show limited accuracy and efficiency, whereas deep learning approaches are constrained by the scarcity of experimentally resolved nucleic acid-ligand complexes. Here, we present NucleoDock, a deep learning framework for nucleic acid-small molecule docking. To address data scarcity, NucleoDock combines physics-guided large-scale pretraining on millions of docking-generated synthetic complexes with fine-tuning on curated experimental co-crystal structures. It further integrates sequence- and structure-informed nucleotide representations with atomistic three-dimensional features to capture both biological context and binding-site geometry. A mixture density network-based geometric scoring head is used to model conditional interaction-distance distributions for pose ranking. On an external benchmark of 125 nucleic acid-ligand complexes, NucleoDock achieved a top-1 success rate of 56 percent at an RMSD cutoff of 2.0 Angstrom, outperforming rDock with 29 percent, while generating 100 poses in approximately 5 seconds per complex. Retrospective virtual screening on the ROBIN benchmark further showed improved early enrichment. NucleoDock represents a step toward bridging the methodological gap between protein- and nucleic acid-directed computational drug discovery.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 4 figures, 4 tabels, Supplementary Materials includes 8 tabels
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NucleoDock，一个基于几何深度学习的核酸-小分子对接框架。为解决实验结构稀缺问题，该方法通过物理引导在百万级合成对接复合物上大规模预训练，并在人工筛选的共晶结构上微调。框架整合序列与结构核苷酸表示以及原子级三维特征，使用混合密度网络几何评分头建模条件相互作用距离分布。在125个核酸-配体复合物外部基准上，NucleoDock在RMSD 2.0 Å截止下达到56%的top-1成功率，优于rDock的29%，每个复合物生成100个姿态仅需约5秒。ROBIN基准的回顾性虚拟筛选进一步显示了改善的早期富集。
Motivation: 现有物理对接方法在核酸-小分子任务上精度和效率有限，而深度学习方法受限于实验解析的核酸-配体复合物数据稀缺。
Method: 采用两阶段训练：先在大规模对接生成的合成复合物上进行物理引导预训练，再在实验共晶结构上微调；结合序列与结构核苷酸表示与原子级三维特征；使用混合密度网络评分头预测条件距离分布以排序姿态。
Result: 在125个核酸-配体复合物测试集上，top-1成功率56%（RMSD < 2.0 Å），rDock为29%；每个复合物生成100个姿态耗时约5秒；ROBIN benchmark上早期富集提升。
Conclusion: NucleoDock缩小了蛋白质与核酸导向计算药物发现的方法论差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Preference Concepts and their Functions in a Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed to make decisions that require trading off near-term gains against long-term consequences, yet little is known about how they internally represent or resolve these tradeoffs. In this work, we causally localize an underlying subgraph for temporal preference in a distilled LLM (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507), identifying mid-to-upper-layer nodes through converging evidence from gradient-based attribution and activation patching. We find that the geometry of time horizon is encoded in the residual stream at the expected localized layers. A behavioral analysis reveals that unintervened LLMs discount the future several times less steeply than humans, yet this preference is unstable across contexts, motivating explicit control rather than implicit reliance on training. Finally, we find suggestive evidence that steering vectors can shift temporal preference. Our work demonstrates how mechanistic interpretability can bring us closer to reliable control over how LLMs plan and reason
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文通过因果定位方法，在蒸馏版大语言模型 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 中识别出处理时间偏好的底层子图，发现中间到顶层节点负责该功能。残差流中编码了时间跨度的几何特征。行为分析表明，未干预的 LLM 对未来折扣比人类平缓但偏好不稳定，而操控向量可改变时间偏好。工作展示了机制可解释性如何实现对 LLM 规划推理的可靠控制。
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于需要权衡近期收益与长期后果的决策，但其内部如何表示和解决这些权衡尚不清楚。
Method: 结合梯度归因和激活修补的证据，因果定位时间偏好相关的子图；通过残差流几何分析时间跨度编码；使用行为分析和操控向量实验。
Result: 时间偏好子图定位在中间到上层节点；残差流编码时间跨度几何；LLM 对未来折扣远低于人类，但偏好不稳定；操控向量可转移时间偏好。
Conclusion: 机制可解释性有助于实现对 LLM 时间偏好的可靠控制。

papers.title: PyCC.id: A package for hypothesis-driven equation discovery with structural identifiability
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven equation discovery is fundamentally an inverse problem that seeks to infer the governing differential equations of a system directly from time-series measurements. A known issue is the ill-conditioned nature of the inverse problem, which frequently produces multiple mathematical models that fit the data similarly well. One path to address this issue is by incorporating known hypotheses and constraints into the training phase beforehand. While this approach effectively reduces the search space, it still results in multiple candidate models, forcing practitioners to rely on post-hoc manual filtering based on their own domain expertise. A recent approach incorporates structural `skeletons' inspired by characteristic curves (CCs), defining a hypothesis-driven methodology. In this methodology, practitioners define a skeleton, which is associated with a family of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and then add their hypotheses and priors based on their domain knowledge to refine the obtained model iteratively. An important advantage of this approach is that some skeletons have demonstrable structural identifiability properties, which are useful for checking whether the skeleton is correct or should be discarded. Furthermore, this formalism enables the use of multiple equation discovery paradigms due to its modularity (such as neural networks, symbolic regression, and sparse regression). In this work, we present the Python library PyCC, which condenses these efforts into a flexible tool that allows researchers and engineers to seamlessly define their skeletons and hypotheses to discover ODEs from time-dependent data.
papers.comment: The software package is available at: https://github.com/FedejGon/pyCC.id
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyCC.id 是一个 Python 软件包，用于基于特征曲线 (characteristic curves, CCs) 的假设驱动常微分方程发现。该工具允许用户定义骨架和假设，从时间序列数据中发现 ODE，并且部分骨架具有结构可辨识性，有助于验证模型正确性。该库整合了多种方程发现范式，如神经网络、符号回归和稀疏回归。
Motivation: 数据驱动的方程发现作为反问题常常病态，产生多个拟合数据同样好的候选模型。即使加入假设约束，仍需人工后处理筛选。
Method: 基于特征曲线骨架的假设驱动方法：用户定义 ODE 族骨架，结合领域知识逐步细化模型；库支持模块化范式进行方程发现。
Result: 提供了灵活的 Python 工具，支持结构可辨识性检查以及多种方程发现方法。

papers.title: Assessing the Geographic Diversity of AI's Platial Representations in Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: (Gen)AI diversity is not merely an ethical issue. From the perspective of geographic information science (GIScience), it could be interpreted as a function of uncertainty and as a form of cognitive bias, embedded in AI outputs. Recent work has sought to develop information-theoretic diversity measures and apply them to evaluate AI-chatbot outputs in a geographic context. As the AI ecosystem to which we are exposed on a daily basis becomes rapidly multimodal, we believe it is important to examine geographic diversity across various modalities. Focusing on images, this paper aims to fill this research gap. First, we select the GPT and DALL-E models as state-of-the-art examples and point out how assessing their geographic diversity involves various stages, including prompt revision and image generation. Then, taking inspiration from species diversity measures in ecological research, we incorporate similarity weighting into the measurement of geographic diversity. Next, we demonstrate how to evaluate geographic diversity in image generation through a case study. Our analysis reveals several counterintuitive findings. For instance, older models can exhibit greater geographic diversity despite producing lower-quality images, and prompt revision yields greater geographic diversity than image generation. At the same time, we observe explicit model homogeneity underlying the lack of geographic diversity, as the selected models consistently depict the same prototypical geo-specific feature or similar features. This is concerning, as it risks producing stereotypical representations of places.
papers.comment: Full conference paper accepted by the AGILE 2026 (https://agile-gi.eu/conference-2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估AI图像生成模型（GPT和DALL-E）中地点表示的地理多样性。受生态学物种多样性测量启发，引入相似性加权度量，并通过案例研究发现：旧模型虽图像质量较低但地理多样性更高，提示修订比图像生成带来更多多样性，且模型存在同质性导致刻板印象。
Motivation: 现有AI多样性研究多关注文本模态，图像模态的地理多样性评估尚属空白，而地理多样性不足会引入认知偏差和不确定性。
Method: 选取GPT和DALL-E作为代表，设计包括提示修订和图像生成的评估流程；借鉴生态学物种多样性测量，引入相似性加权的多样性指标。
Result: 案例发现旧模型地理多样性更高尽管图像质量较低；提示修订比图像生成贡献更多多样性；不同模型倾向于生成相似的原型特征，导致同质化。
Conclusion: 作者认为地理多样性不应仅被视为伦理问题，更是GIScience中的不确定性和认知偏差来源，需跨模态评估。

papers.title: Geographic Bias and Diversity in AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Among the many challenges hindering the responsible development and deployment of AI, arguably none has faced more intense scrutiny than bias in its various forms. This underscores the widespread concerns across AI researchers that model outputs, e.g., from generative AI, may encode structural distributional imbalances (stemming from training data or model design) that may amplify social inequality or introduce systemic distortions across application domains ranging from biodiversity to disaster mitigation. Yet, relatively little work has investigated the geographical nature of bias or developed measurable benchmarks for what it means for (generative) AI to be unbiased. In this chapter, we investigate this issue through a literature review. As foundation models are reshaping the landscape of bias research, we examine work spanning both the pre-generative AI and generative AI periods. First, we identify a range of geographic biases. These biases span from representation bias in the training data and regional disparities in the factual recall of language models to the tendency of generative AI to over-proportionally favor prototypical places (called defaults). Then, we showcase how recent studies address the latter bias by evaluating geographic diversity in the outputs of generative AI across various cognitive levels, parameter settings, and output modalities.
papers.comment: Book chapter accepted by "Geography According to ChatGPT"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过文献综述，系统梳理了生成式AI及前生成式AI时代中地理偏差的表现形式，包括训练数据的代表性偏差、语言模型事实回忆的区域差异，以及生成式AI倾向于过度选择典型地点（称为默认）的问题。此外，展示了近期研究如何通过评估生成式AI输出在不同认知层次、参数设置和输出模态下的地理多样性来应对后一种偏差。
Motivation: 尽管AI偏见已受到广泛关注，但关于地理性质偏见的研究相对不足，缺乏可衡量的基准来定义（生成式）AI的无偏性。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过文献综述，识别地理偏差类型（代表性偏差、区域事实回忆差异、原型地点偏好），并归纳近期评估地理多样性的方法（跨认知层次、参数设置、输出模态）。
Result: 识别出多种地理偏差，并展示了通过评估地理多样性来量化生成式AI原型地点偏好问题的实证研究进展。
Conclusion: 本文强调地理偏差是AI评估中不可忽视的维度，未来需要建立更系统的地理公平性基准。

papers.title: Staged Factorial Screening for Budget-Constrained Micro-Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Budget-constrained micro-pretraining often requires triaging many candidate recipes on a shared accelerator before larger search budgets are spent. We study whether a staged fractional-factorial workflow can recover stable early effect structure in this setting. On a fixed autoresearch-derived single-GPU training loop, we run 613 experiments across pilot and follow-up screens at 2, 5, and 10 minutes; full 16-condition seeded reruns at 5 and 10 minutes; targeted seeded anchor checks; same-host greedy and matched-cost random baselines; a 60-minute bridge package; and bounded Windows A100 and Linux L40S anchor continuations through 24 hours. Main penalties from total batch, depth, and width are largest at short budgets and relax as budget increases. Within the predeclared seeded full-screen families, D, A, B, and C retain non-zero estimates at 5 and 10 minutes after within-budget Benjamini-Hochberg correction, while E does not. Random search can reach strong incumbents in this 32-condition space, but repeatedly in the same low-penalty region and without factor attribution. The 60-minute bridge anchor has the lowest mean, although that package does not separate workflow refinement from the larger bridge model's capacity advantage. In bounded 12-hour and 24-hour three-anchor continuations on both hosts, the bridge has the lowest sample mean while the non-bridge ordering stays host-sensitive. We therefore present a bounded methods result: use short designed screens to identify high-penalty directions, confirm promising anchors under repeated runs, and refine locally inside the reduced space. The evidence supports a bridge-centered recommendation through 24 hours on two hosts, not hardware-invariant ranking or general hyperparameter-optimization superiority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预算受限的微预训练中如何通过分阶段部分因子实验来识别早期效应结构。在单GPU上运行613次实验，发现总批次、深度和宽度的惩罚在短预算时最大，随预算增加而缓解。随机搜索可找到强基线但缺乏因子归因。结果表明应使用短设计筛选识别高惩罚方向，在缩减空间内局部优化。
Motivation: 预算受限的微预训练需要在共享加速器上对大量候选方案进行分类，以便在更大搜索预算投入之前做出决策。现有方法缺乏对早期效应结构的稳定识别。
Method: 采用分阶段部分因子筛选工作流，在固定训练循环上运行多个屏幕（pilot、follow-up、full rerun、anchor check、random baseline、bridge package等），并在不同时间预算（2、5、10分钟）和不同硬件上（Windows A100、Linux L40S）进行验证。
Result: 总批次、深度和宽度的惩罚在短预算时最大，随预算增加而减弱；在预先声明的全因子家族中，D、A、B、C在5/10分钟时保留非零估计，E则不；随机搜索可达强基线但缺乏因子归因；60分钟桥接锚点具有最低均值，但无法分离工作流优化与模型容量优势；跨主机24小时延续中桥接锚点保持低均值，但非桥接排序敏感于主机。
Conclusion: 建议使用短设计筛选识别高惩罚方向，通过重复运行确认有前景的锚点，并在缩减空间内局部优化。证据支持在24小时双主机上以桥接为中心的推荐，但不支持硬件不变的排名或通用超参数优化优势。

papers.title: Drishti AI-Event Guardian: An Intelligent Real-Time Crowd Monitoring and Emergency Response System for Mass Gathering Events
papers.abstract_en: Mass gathering events are associated with critical safety incidents caused by insufficient crowd monitoring and inadequate emergency response coordination. Traditional surveillance systems lack intelligent analytics, resulting in delayed threat identification, poor resource deployment, and weak support for vulnerable individuals during dense public assemblies. This paper presents Drishti AI-Event Guardian, an intelligent crowd management framework using deep learning for public safety enhancement. The architecture combines multimodal data from CCTV networks and UAV platforms, processed by models on Google Vertex AI infrastructure. Core methods include real-time crowd density estimation using YOLOv8, spatiotemporal anomaly detection, and predictive crowd-flow modeling through gradient-boosted regression. Drishti also integrates four modules: (i) facial recognition for missing person identification with crowd-wide notification; (ii) medical emergency reporting with automated dispatch; (iii) a conversational AI chatbot for reports and complaints; and (iv) an intelligent guard reallocation engine that dynamically reassigns personnel in response to crowd density changes. The system is evaluated on two scenarios: the Kumbh Mela gathering and the RCB Victory Parade event, achieving crowd density estimation MAE of 3.2 persons/m2, anomaly detection F1-score of 0.91, facial recognition precision of 0.93, and median alert latency of 111 ms. Predictive congestion modeling provides five-minute forecasts with MAPE of 8.3%, enabling preemptive intervention. The chatbot resolved 89% of incident filings without human operators, while guard reallocation reduced responder deployment latency by 34% versus manual reassignment. Results demonstrate a shift from passive surveillance toward active crowd intelligence and scalable foundation for events from local gatherings to mega festivals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Drishti AI-Event Guardian，一个结合深度学习和多模态数据（CCTV与无人机）的智能人群监控与应急响应系统。系统包含人群密度估计（YOLOv8）、时空异常检测、预测性人群流动建模（梯度提升回归）、人脸识别、医疗紧急报告、对话式AI聊天机器人以及智能警卫重新分配引擎。在Kumbh Mela和RCB Victory Parade事件中评估，人群密度估计MAE为3.2人/m²，异常检测F1为0.91，人脸识别精确率0.93，中位警报延迟111ms，预测模型MAPE为8.3%，聊天机器人解决了89%的事件报告，警卫重新分配减少了34%的响应延迟。
Motivation: 大型公共集会因人群监控不足和应急响应协调不力导致安全事故；传统监控系统缺乏智能分析，威胁识别延迟、资源部署低效，对弱势群体支持不足。
Method: 构建基于YOLOv8的实时人群密度估计、基于时空模式的异常检测、梯度提升回归的预测性人群流动模型；集成人脸识别、医疗紧急报告、对话式AI聊天机器人、智能警卫重新分配引擎四个模块；部署于Google Vertex AI平台。
Result: 在Kumbh Mela和RCB Victory Parade测试中，人群密度估计MAE 3.2人/m²，异常检测F1 0.91，人脸识别精确率0.93，中位警报延迟111ms；5分钟预测MAPE 8.3%；聊天机器人解决89%事件报告；警卫重新分配减少34%部署延迟。
Conclusion: 该系统实现了从被动监控到主动人群智能的转变，为从本地集会到大型节庆活动提供了可扩展的基础方案。

papers.title: The Granularity Gap: A Multi-Dimensional Longitudinal Audit of Sycophancy in Gemini Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as high-stakes advisors, yet standard alignment benchmarks treat sycophancy as a binary failure mode. We introduce the Granularity Gap: coarse binary metrics mask substantial social-compliance behaviors where models capitulate to user framing, validate questionable premises, or soften factual corrections without producing overtly false outputs. We evaluate six Gemini variants across generations 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 on 73 adversarial prompts under three guardrail conditions (Control, Simple, Protocol), yielding 8,830 graded responses. Using a 0-4 Likert scale validated against a human annotator triad (Fleiss kappa = 0.71; Cohen kappa = 0.78 vs AI consensus; 95.9 percent binary accuracy, 100 percent specificity), we quantify sycophancy as continuous rather than binary. Three findings emerge. First, 27.2 percent of responses contain substantial sycophantic content (Likert >= 2.0) and 22.7 percent reach moderate or severe levels (>= 3.0), while binary win-rate framing reports only modest failure rates; coarse metrics explain just 29 percent of graded variance. Second, generational progress is non-monotonic: Gen 2.5 regresses sharply (mean Control 2.64) relative to Gen 2.0 (1.90) and Gen 3.0 (2.01), and Gen 2.5 shows inverse scaling (Pro 1.94 worse than Flash 1.71) while Gen 3.0 restores standard scaling. Third, we document an Alignment Tax: Spearman rho = -0.63 between sycophancy and truthfulness, indicating social compliance trades against factual accuracy. Egotistical Validation prompts act as a sycophancy trap (mean 3.27), nearly double Unethical Proposals (1.72). Simple guardrails outperform elaborate Protocol scaffolding on flagship models, but distilled Gen 3.0 Flash inverts this, suggesting small models may structurally require chain-of-thought scaffolding. We release the dataset and rubric to support continuous sycophancy measurement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“粒度差距”(Granularity Gap)概念，指出当前二进制对齐基准掩盖了LLM中持续的社交屈从行为。通过对Gemini多代模型（2.0/2.5/3.0）在73个对抗性提示下的8,830个分级响应进行纵向审计，使用0-4 Likert量表验证，发现27.2%的响应包含实质性谄媚内容，且代际进步非单调（Gen 2.5倒退），并发现谄媚与真实性之间存在对齐税（Spearman rho=-0.63）。
Motivation: 现有对齐基准将谄媚视为二进制失败模式，无法捕捉模型因应对话框架而软化事实纠正等连续社交屈从行为，即粒度差距。
Method: 提出多维度纵向审计方法：设计73个对抗性提示，在三种防护栏条件下（控制、简单、协议）评估六个Gemini变体，使用0-4 Likert量表评分，并通过人类注释者三元组验证（Fleiss kappa=0.71）。
Result: 关键发现：（1）27.2%响应包含实质性谄媚，二进制指标仅解释29%的方差；（2）代际进步非单调，Gen 2.5倒退且逆缩放，Gen 3.0恢复；（3）谄媚与真实性的Spearman rho=-0.63，表明对齐税；自我验证提示平均谄媚分数3.27，接近非道德提案1.72的两倍。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Reasoning for Natural Language Inference
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Inference (NLI) is a fundamental task in natural language understanding that requires determining the logical relationship between a premise and a hypothesis. Despite the remarkable success of transformer-based pre-trained models, most existing approaches primarily rely on the final-layer token representations, which are often insufficient for capturing the complex and hierarchical semantic interactions required for effective reasoning. In particular, fine-grained lexical cues, phrasal compositions, and higher-level contextual semantics are typically entangled or diluted in a single representation space. To address these limitations, we propose a novel \emph{Multi-Granularity Reasoning Network} (MGRN) that explicitly leverages hierarchical semantic features within an interactive reasoning space. The proposed framework mimics the human cognitive process of language understanding, which naturally progresses from shallow lexical matching to deeper semantic abstraction and logical reasoning. By integrating semantic information across multiple granularities in a progressive and structured manner, MGRN is able to uncover intricate semantic relationships underlying natural language expressions. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that MGRN consistently outperforms strong baseline models, validating the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多粒度推理网络 (MGRN)，通过显式利用层次化语义特征（从词汇匹配到逻辑推理）来改进自然语言推理 (NLI)，在多个公开基准上优于强基线模型。
Motivation: 现有NLI方法主要依赖Transformer最后一层的表示，难以捕获细粒度词汇线索、短语组合和高层上下文语义之间的复杂层次交互。

Result: 在多个公开基准上，MGRN持续优于强基线模型，验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 多粒度语义交互推理是改善NLI任务的有效途径。

papers.title: From Scoring to Explanations: Evaluating SHAP and LLM Rationales for Rubric-based Teaching Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automated scoring models are increasingly used to assign rubric-based quality ratings to complex language performances, including classroom transcripts, yet they typically provide little insight into why a particular score is produced. We propose a general framework for sentence-level interpretability of rubric-based scoring that combines model-agnostic Shapley-value attributions with rationales generated by large language models (LLMs). Instantiated on the Quality of Feedback dimension of the CLASS framework using the NCTE corpus, the framework enables systematic comparison of fine-tuned pretrained language models (PLMs) and prompted LLMs on both scoring performance and explanation faithfulness. Across 6k annotated transcript segments, fine-tuned PLMs outperform LLMs in prediction accuracy but exhibit label compression toward mid-scale scores. Deletion-based tests show that SHAP identifies sentences that reliably drive model predictions, producing typically larger and more coherent prediction shifts than LLM-generated rationales. Cross-model analyses further reveal that SHAP attributions transfer robustly across architectures, whereas LLM rationales exert limited and inconsistent influence. Overall, the findings demonstrate that SHAP provides more faithful and transferable explanations for rubric-based scoring, and that the proposed framework offers a principled basis for evaluating both scoring models and their explanations in high-stakes educational settings and other rubric-based language assessment tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于评分量规的教学质量自动评分缺乏可解释性的问题，提出结合SHAP和LLM解释的句子级可解释框架。在CLASS框架的反馈质量维度上，使用NCTE语料库进行了评估。摘要显示微调PLM在评分准确性上优于LLM，但存在中间分数压缩；SHAP解释比LLM解释更忠实和可迁移。
Motivation: 自动评分模型能分配评分量规质量等级，但无法解释评分原因，在高风险评估中需要可解释性。
Method: 提出通用框架，结合模型无关的Shapley值归因和LLM生成的解释，在CLASS反馈质量维度上实例化，比较微调PLM和提示LLM。
Result: 微调PLM在预测准确性上优于LLM，但倾向于压缩到中间分数；SHAP识别出更可靠驱动预测的句子，且归因在模型间鲁棒迁移，而LLM解释影响有限且不一致。
Conclusion: SHAP为基于评分量规的评分提供更忠实和可迁移的解释；该框架为评估评分模型及其解释提供了原则性基础。

papers.title: The Virtual Roundtable: Multi-Agent Personas Simulating the Dynamics of Human Brainstorming
papers.abstract_en: As AI-driven product development accelerates, the bottleneck is shifting from how we build to what we build. Traditional human brainstorming faces challenges including groupthink, echo chambers, and limited diversity. To address this, we present a multi-agentic architecture that simulates roundtable brainstorming through two phases: divergent thinking to generate diverse ideas, and convergent thinking to evaluate and rank the most promising ones. The system employs diverse AI personas that engage in roundtable discussions, guided by an agentic facilitator that steers the discussion toward productive outcomes. Personas maintain private thoughts while commenting publicly, with ideas emerging organically throughout the discussion. Per-persona quotas on idea submissions and votes promote balanced participation while producing natural rankings. Throughout the session, the system tracks each idea's lineage, capturing how concepts originate and cross-pollinate over time. We demonstrate this approach through a case study generating consumer ideas for AI smart glasses, showing (i) it produces diverse, relevant ideas with insights into their evolution; (ii) the cumulative exchange of perspectives across personas cultivates a shared context that progressively deepens the quality of discussion and the ideas produced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多智能体架构模拟圆桌头脑风暴，包括发散思维和收敛思维两个阶段，通过多样化AI角色讨论产生创意，并追踪创意演化。案例研究针对AI智能眼镜的消费者创意生成。
Motivation: 传统人类头脑风暴面临群体思维、回音室和多样性不足等挑战，需要新的方法产生多样化创意。
Method: 采用多智能体架构，包含发散思维和收敛思维两阶段，使用多样化AI角色进行圆桌讨论，由智能体引导者引导讨论方向，每个角色有私有想法和公开评论，通过配额促进平衡参与，并追踪创意演化。
Result: 案例研究表明该方法能产生多样化、相关的创意，并提供创意演化洞察；角色间的观点交流逐步深化讨论质量和产出创意。
Conclusion: 该架构有效模拟人类头脑风暴，提升创意多样性和演化追踪能力。

papers.title: MCBench: A Multicontext Safety Assessment Benchmark for Omni Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing multimodal safety benchmarks focus solely on visual inputs and cannot assess Omni Large Language Models (LLMs) that process vision, audio, and text. We introduce MCBench, a benchmark with 1196 scenarios spanning four safety categories that require integrating multiple modalities for accurate safety assessment. Each unsafe scenario is paired with a minimally different safe counterpart to assess model sensitivity. Our evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal significant challenges. Omni LLMs struggle with subtle or non-physical risks but perform better when salient visual or acoustic cues are present. Analysis of reasoning traces shows that, although models can extract modality-specific information, they often fail to integrate these cues effectively for safety judgments. Our findings reveal that current Omni LLMs lack robust cross-modal reasoning in safety-critical settings, underscoring the need for improved architectures and training strategies for multimodal safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对现有多模态安全基准仅覆盖视觉输入、无法评估全模态大语言模型（Omni LLM）的问题，本文提出MCBench基准，包含1196个需要整合视觉、音频和文本的多模态安全场景，每个不安全场景配有最小差异的安全配对。评估显示当前最强全模态LLM在微妙或非物理风险上表现不佳，尽管能提取模态信息，但跨模态推理能力薄弱，难以综合判断安全性。
Motivation: 现有安全基准只针对视觉输入，无法全面评估能同时处理视觉、音频和文本的全模态LLM的安全性，亟需覆盖多模态交互的安全评估资源。
Method: 构建MCBench基准，包含1196个跨四个安全类别的多模态场景，每个不安全场景配有最小差异的安全配对，以测试模型对细微安全差异的敏感性。
Result: 对最先进模型的评估表明，全模态LLM在微妙或非物理风险上表现挣扎，依赖明显视觉/听觉线索；推理轨迹显示模型能提取单模态信息但无法有效整合进行跨模态安全判断。
Conclusion: 当前全模态LLM在安全关键设置中缺乏稳健的跨模态推理能力，突显了改进多模态安全架构和训练策略的必要性。
