papers.title: PEFT of SLM for Telecommunications Customer Support: A Comparative Study of LoRA Configurations with Energy Consumption Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) show strong performance in natural language understanding and generation, their evaluation and adaptation to domain-specific constraints in telecommunications customer support remain limited. In addition, data sovereignty, regulatory constraints, and the handling of sensitive customer and network information complicate the use of externally hosted foundation models in this domain. We present a systematic study of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) applied to Qwen2.5-3B to build a domain-specific conversational assistant. We introduce a combinatorial synthetic data generation approach based on a glossary of 52 industry-specific terms, producing approximately 30,000 training examples across 1,560 distinct problem scenarios via a generative pipeline powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash. We evaluate 16 LoRA configurations by varying hyperparameters and target modules. Our evaluation extends beyond standard metrics by incorporating energy consumption analysis and qualitative assessment using an LLM-as-a-judge framework with GPT-5.2 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet. Results show a clear divergence between quantitative and qualitative performance: models achieving the lowest validation loss do not necessarily obtain the best human-aligned rankings. The best validation loss (0.5024) ranks only 6th-7th in qualitative evaluation, while the worst loss (0.6807) ranks first according to both judges. This work contributes (1) a combinatorial method for synthetic dataset construction, (2) insights into the impact of target module selection for LoRA injection, (3) evidence that validation loss alone is insufficient for selecting fine-tuning configurations in conversational AI, and (4) an energy-performance trade-off analysis for sustainable LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了参数高效微调（PEFT）中LoRA配置对电信客服领域小语言模型Qwen2.5-3B的影响，通过组合式合成数据生成方法构建约3万个训练样本，评估16种LoRA配置，并纳入能耗分析和LLM-as-a-judge定性评估。结果显示定量与定性性能存在明显分歧：最低验证损失（0.5024）在定性评估中仅排第6-7位，而最高验证损失（0.6807）被两judge评为第一。
Motivation: 大语言模型在电信客服领域面临数据主权、法规约束和敏感信息处理的挑战，现有研究缺乏领域适配的评估和能耗分析。
Method: 提出基于52个行业术语的组合式合成数据生成方法，利用Gemini 2.0 Flash生成约3万个训练样本；对Qwen2.5-3B应用16种不同的LoRA配置（变化超参数和目标模块），并采用GPT-5.2和Claude 4.5 Sonnet作为LLM评判框架进行定性评估。
Result: 最佳验证损失0.5024的模型在定性评估中仅排第6-7位，而最差验证损失0.6807的模型获得两评判器最高排名；揭示了验证损失不足以作为对话AI微调配置的选用标准。
Conclusion: 本研究贡献了组合式合成数据集构建方法、目标模块选择对LoRA影响的见解、验证损失在对话AI中不足的证据，以及可持续LLM部署的能耗-性能权衡分析。

papers.title: Improving Heart-Focused Medical Question Answering in LLMs via Variance-Aware Rubric Rewards with GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong promise in healthcare applications. Yet deploying general-purpose models in real-world settings remains difficult due to data privacy constraints, inference costs, and limited suitability for edge or on-device use. These challenges motivate the development of smaller, more efficient models that require robust post-training strategies to ensure reliable medical reasoning. In this work, we investigate Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for post-training LLMs on heart-focused medical question answering with rubric-based supervision derived from RaR-Medicine. We propose a Variance-Aware Reward Framework that extends the Explicit Aggregation and Implicit Aggregation strategies of Rubrics as Rewards by replacing weighted binary criterion aggregation and single overall Likert-style scoring with continuous analytical reward functions derived from criterion-level rubric outcomes. This formulation provides richer optimization signals for feedback that is sparse, multi-criteria, and difficult to verify automatically, and enables more stable on-policy reinforcement learning. On a held-out heart-related subset of HealthBench, our best GRPO variant improves accuracy from 0.362 to 0.502 and F1 from 0.532 to 0.668 relative to the Qwen3-14B base model, while remaining competitive with GPT-OSS-120B (0.508 accuracy, 0.674 F1). Our findings show that carefully designed rubric-based rewards provide a practical strategy for improving heart-focused medical question answering in LLMs, with potential to extend to other rubric-based tasks.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Masked language modelling (MLM) has been the dominant pre-training objective for text encoders since BERT, yet it encourages representations that are strongly anchored to surface-form token identity rather than deeper semantic structure. Inspired by the success of Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) (LeCun, 2022) in vision and audio, we propose a hybrid pre-training objective that combines a JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with a standard MLM objective over a single shared encoder. A learnable scalar parameter continuously balances the two objectives during training. We pre-train both a hybrid model and a pure-MLM baseline on English Wikipedia using identical architectures and compute budgets (NVIDIA H100). Extensive representation analysis across five GLUE benchmarks (SST-2, MRPC, MNLI, CoLA, STS-B) using four pooling strategies reveals that the hybrid encoder produces significantly more uniform embeddings (uniformity less than -0.16 vs -0.05 for MLM), exhibits richer spectral geometry under max pooling, encodes less surface-level lexical information, and achieves a better semantic-to-lexical balance. Despite similar linear-probe downstream accuracy, the geometric differences are consistent and significant, suggesting that the JEPA predictive objective reshapes the latent space in ways that standard accuracy metrics alone cannot capture.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables. Preprint. Code available at : https://github.com/aymen-000/predict-reconstruct-language-models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合JEPA风格潜在空间预测损失和标准MLM目标的混合预训练目标，用于自监督语言表示学习。在英文维基百科上使用相同架构和计算预算进行预训练，通过GLUE基准上的表示分析发现，混合编码器产生更均匀的嵌入，具有更丰富的谱几何，编码更少的表层词汇信息，达到更好的语义-词汇平衡。
Motivation: MLM鼓励表示锚定于表层词形而非深层语义结构，需要一种能学习更抽象语义表示的预训练目标。
Method: 提出混合预训练目标，结合JEPA式的潜在空间预测损失和MLM损失，通过可学习的标量参数在训练中平衡两者。
Result: 在GLUE五个基准上，混合编码器的嵌入均匀性显著更高（均匀度< -0.16 vs -0.05），谱几何更丰富，表层词汇信息更少，语义-词汇平衡更好；下游线性探测精度相似。
Conclusion: JEPA预测目标能重塑潜在空间，产生标准精度指标无法捕捉的几何差异，但下游任务性能未提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is This Edit Correct? A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Reasoning-Aware Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based image editing has achieved strong visual fidelity under natural language instructions, yet most existing systems still operate at the level of surface instruction following, without reasoning about the implicit contextual constraints embedded in real user requests. This often leads to visually plausible but logically inconsistent edits. In this work, we introduce RE-Edit, a benchmark for REasoning-aware image Editing that evaluates image editing systems across five complementary reasoning dimensions: physical, environmental, cultural, causal, and referential. RE-Edit comprises 1,000 carefully curated samples, each designed such that visual plausibility alone is insufficient and correct editing requires satisfying implicit logical constraints. To support fine-grained analysis, we establish dimension-aligned evaluation criteria and conduct a comprehensive study of ten open-source and two commercial image editing models. Our results show that even advanced systems frequently struggle with implicit multi-dimensional reasoning despite producing high-quality visuals. We further present a lightweight reasoning-guided post-edit baseline as an initial exploration, illustrating how inserting explicit reasoning can help mitigate such failures in a model-agnostic manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RE-Edit 基准，用于评估图像编辑系统在物理、环境、文化、因果和指称五个推理维度上的表现。该基准包含 1000 个精心设计的样本，要求编辑不仅视觉合理，还需满足隐含逻辑约束。对 10 个开源和 2 个商业模型的测试表明，现有系统虽能生成高质量视觉结果，但常在多维隐含推理上失败。
Motivation: 现有扩散图像编辑主要遵循表面指令，缺乏对用户隐含上下文约束的推理，导致编辑视觉合理但逻辑不一致。
Method: 构建 RE-Edit 基准，覆盖五个推理维度，每个样本设计为仅凭视觉合理性无法通过；同时建立维度对齐的评估标准。
Result: 对 12 个图像编辑模型的评估显示，大多数模型在隐含多维推理上表现不佳，尽管生成结果视觉质量高。
Conclusion: 提出轻量级推理引导的后编辑基线，初步表明插入显式推理可模型无关地缓解逻辑不一致问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ERRORQUAKE: Heavy-Tailed Error Severity Distributions in Open-Weight Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: At matched accuracy, open-weight LLMs differ substantially in the shape of their error severity distribution -- a difference invisible to the scalar error rate. Hallucination benchmarks report a single error count and treat all errors as equivalent, yet a wrong date and a fabricated court ruling differ by orders of magnitude. We introduce Errorquake-10k, a 10,000-query benchmark scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 severity scale across 8 domains and 5 difficulty tiers, and we fit per-model severity distributions for 21 open-weight models. For each model we estimate a severity distribution index (b, the Gutenberg-Richter upper-tail slope) with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Headline: across the 210 model pairs, 85 have disjoint 95% b confidence intervals at matched accuracy (|Delta epsilon| < 0.05) on human-consensus scoring, e.g. deepseek-v3.2 vs. ministral-14b at epsilon = 0.586 and Delta b = 0.47. A 519-item three-rater human validation study confirms measurement reliability (ICC(2,k=3) = 0.85), validates the LLM-judge ranking (rho = 0.89), and confirms the dense-model scaling correlation on human data (rho_s = -0.86). We prove a Non-Reducibility Theorem showing that severity profile and error rate are informationally non-redundant (I(b; model | epsilon) = 1.56 bits; 64.5% of cross-model b variance is unexplained by epsilon). A severity mechanism taxonomy (kappa = 0.83) reveals that error type shifts categorically with severity: low-severity errors are retrievals (71%); high-severity errors are fabrications (39%) -- and this composition differs by model size (p < 0.0001). Severity distribution should be reported alongside accuracy; it carries discriminative information that the error rate cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Errorquake-10k 基准，对开放权重 LLM 的响应进行连续 0-4 级严重性评分，发现即使准确率匹配，不同模型的错误严重性分布也存在显著差异。通过拟合 Gutenberg-Richter 尾部斜率 b，证明严重性分布与错误率信息非冗余，且严重性分布应作为准确率的补充指标。
Motivation: 现有准确率指标将所有错误视为等价，忽略了如错误日期与捏造判决之间的巨大严重性差异，无法反映模型实际质量。
Method: 构建包含 10k 查询的 Errorquake-10k 数据集，覆盖 8 个领域和 5 个难度层级，由 LLM 评判员对每个响应进行 0-4 连续严重性评分；对 21 个开放权重模型拟合严重性分布，计算 Gutenberg-Richter 尾部斜率 b 及其 95% 置信区间；通过 519 项三人人工验证测量可靠性 (ICC=0.85) 并验证 LLM 评判排序 (rho=0.89)。
Result: 在 210 个模型对中，85 个对在匹配准确率 (|Δε|<0.05) 下具有不重叠的 b 置信区间；非冗余定理显示跨模型 b 方差的 64.5% 不能被错误率解释；严重性机制分类揭示低严重性错误多为检索 (71%)，高严重性错误多为捏造 (39%)，且组合因模型大小而异 (p<0.0001)。
Conclusion: 严重性分布携带错误率无法捕捉的判别信息，应作为准确率的常规补充指标。

papers.title: The Evaluation Blind Spot: A Stereological Theory of Benchmark Coverage for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We give a stereological theory of LLM benchmark coverage. For any suite with effective dimensionality d_eff, the visible Hausdorff distance between two convex capability profiles consistent with the same scores is bounded by epsilon + C R m^(-1/(d_eff-1)), with matching Lipschitz lower bound. Empirically, three independent leaderboards (Open LLM v2, an extended 12-benchmark suite, LiveBench) all have d_eff in [2.86, 4.80] on their competitive frontier; the structural blind spot exceeds the observed runner-up score gap by two orders of magnitude and dominates statistical noise by 52-127x. Under a chi-squared projection model, the isotropic prior is the optimistic case; across six hidden-capability priors and four ambient dimensions the simulated half-split swap rate of the top two models stays in [0.38, 0.49], and a 500-trial random visible/held-out split shows that 92% of trials swap the top-1 ranking with on average 2.83 of 5 top-5 models changing. A submodular greedy algorithm with the Nemhauser (1 - 1/e) guarantee finds a stable core of 4 benchmarks; 7 of 12 suffice for 90% coverage, and the trained subset transfers across temporal quarters with 93-97% retention. A counterfactual validation across 12 internal benchmarks and 27 Chatbot Arena categories confirms that the eigenstructure predicts which evaluations are irreplaceable (rho = -0.69, p = 0.013 for removal disruption) and which external evaluations bring new information (rho = +0.38). As a second, independent theoretical contribution, we resolve Gardner's Problem 1.5 (1995) for C^2 support functions, establishing the minimax rate Theta(R/(kappa m^(2/(D-1)))) in general dimension via optimal recovery theory on S^(D-1).
papers.comment: 55 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, extensive appendix with proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM基准覆盖的立体学理论，通过有效维度估计发现排行榜存在巨大结构盲点，并提出子模贪婪算法选择稳定核心基准集，同时解决了Gardner问题1.5。
Motivation: 现有LLM基准套件可能无法充分覆盖模型能力，存在结构盲点，导致排名不稳定和评估不可靠。
Method: 采用立体学理论分析基准覆盖，通过有效维度d_eff和豪斯多夫距离刻画可见差异；使用卡方投影模型模拟排名交换率；应用子模贪婪算法选择核心基准子集。
Result: 三个排行榜的d_eff在2.86-4.80之间，结构盲点比亚军得分差距大两个数量级，统计噪声比为52-127倍；92%的试验中前1名排名交换；用7个基准即达到90%覆盖率且跨季度保留93-97%。
Conclusion: 基准覆盖的结构盲点严重影响排名稳定性，子模贪婪算法可选出稳定的核心基准，且特征结构可用于预测评估的不可替代性和信息含量。此外，独立解决了Gardner问题1.5。

papers.title: Epidemiology of Model Collapse: Modeling Synthetic Data Contamination via Bilayer SIR Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Training on synthetic data causes model collapse, but existing analyses treat this as single-chain degradation. In reality, the AI ecosystem involves cross-contamination: models ingest synthetic data from other models, produce new synthetic text, and contaminate shared corpora. We propose a bilayer coupled SIR/SIRS framework -- a phenomenological mean-field model treating data corpora and AI models as two interacting populations, each with susceptible, infected, and recovered compartments linked by cross-layer transmission. The SIRS variant (our primary recommendation) incorporates immunity waning, reflecting that filtered corpora and retrained models remain susceptible to re-contamination. We derive the basic reproduction number $R_0 = \sqrt{β_D β_M / [(γ_D+μ_D)(γ_M+μ_M)]}$ via the Next Generation Matrix and apply standard epidemic threshold results to the bilayer system. Illustrative scenario-based calibration from public AI text prevalence data yields supercritical dynamics ($R_0 > 1$) across three scenarios; Sobol sensitivity analysis identifies synthetic-text detection as the highest-leverage parameter. A bipartite-network agent-based model confirms mean-field consistency ($R^2 > 0.96$) for dense networks but degrades under heterogeneity. GPT-2 contamination chain experiments (192 runs across WikiText and Shakespeare) show dose-response degradation and diversity loss qualitatively consistent with the threshold picture. Matched-budget source-diversity experiments (1,088 runs) provide suggestive evidence that multi-source mixing modestly attenuates collapse, but the effect vanishes at lower contamination fractions. Intervention analysis identifies detection-based filtering and herd immunity as the highest-leverage strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双层SIR/SIRS流行病学框架，模拟AI生态系统中模型之间合成数据交叉污染导致的模型坍缩（model collapse）。通过计算基本再生数R0并使用公共数据校准，发现当前场景均处于超临界状态。实验表明合成文本检测和群体免疫是最有效的干预策略。
Motivation: 现有模型坍缩分析通常假设单链退化，忽略了AI系统中模型相互污染的真实复杂性。需要一种能够刻画数据语料库与AI模型之间交叉污染动态的理论框架。
Method: 提出双层耦合SIR/SIRS模型，将数据语料库和AI模型视为两个种群，各有易感、感染、恢复室，并引入免疫衰减（SIRS变体）。通过下一代矩阵推导R0，并结合公共AI文本流行率数据进行场景校准和Sobol敏感性分析，辅以二分网络Agent-Based模型验证。
Result: 三个校准场景均显示R0>1（超临界）；敏感性分析表明合成文本检测是最重要参数。GPT-2实验显示剂量-反应退化和多样性损失，多源混合在低污染率下效果消失。
Conclusion: 检测过滤和群体免疫是最高杠杆的干预策略，验证了流行病学框架对模型坍缩的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAINO: Anchoring Agents in Reality, A Systematic Review and Conceptual Framework for Realism in Agent-Based Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Realism is a central yet seemingly under-theorized concept in Agent-Based Modelling. This paper presents a Systematic Literature Review, aiming to identify how realism is currently operationalized and demonstrated. The results show that realism is often poorly defined and lacks a consistent conceptual framework. A wide variety of methods are used to achieve and demonstrate realism, but explanations of whether and why these methods are appropriate for their intended purposes are generally limited. Building on this review, we introduce the Reality Anchor, Input, Output (RAINO) framework. RAINO identifies the key structures used to argue for realism in Agent-Based Models, consisting of Reality Anchors (e.g., empirical data, formal theory, expert knowledge, common-sense expectations) and their application as model Input or Output. RAINO broadens existing perspectives on how realism is framed. It explains why different assessors may evaluate the realism of a model in different ways, and it shows how this broader framing can lead to significantly different approaches to model development.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted in the Social Simulation Conference 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基于智能体建模（ABM）中的现实主义概念进行了系统文献综述，发现当前定义模糊且缺乏一致框架。作者提出RAINO框架，区分了现实锚点（如经验数据、形式理论、专家知识、常识期望）及其作为模型输入或输出的应用，解释了不同评估者为何对同一模型现实主义程度的判断可能不同，并展示了该框架如何导致不同的建模策略。
Motivation: 现实主义是ABM的核心概念，但现有文献中缺乏对其操作化和证明的系统性理解。
Method: 通过系统文献综述，识别当前ABM中实现和证明现实主义的方法，并在此基础上提出RAINO框架，将现实锚点分为输入和输出两类。
Result: 综述发现现实主义定义不充分、方法多样但缺乏合理性解释；RAINO框架提供了更广泛的现实主义视角，能解释不同评估者的分歧并指导建模实践。
Conclusion: RAINO框架有助于澄清ABM中现实主义的含义，并揭示更广泛的建模可能性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ask-to-Clarify: Resolving Instruction Ambiguity through Multi-turn Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: The ultimate goal of embodied agents is to create collaborators that can interact with humans, not mere executors that passively follow instructions. This requires agents to communicate, coordinate, and adapt their actions based on human feedback. Recently, advances in VLAs have offered a path toward this goal. However, most current VLA-based embodied agents operate in a one-way mode: they receive an instruction and execute it without feedback. This approach fails in real-world scenarios where instructions are often ambiguous. In this paper, we address this problem with the Ask-to-Clarify framework. Our framework first resolves ambiguous instructions by asking questions in a multi-turn dialogue. Then it generates low-level actions end-to-end. Specifically, the Ask-to-Clarify framework consists of two components, one VLM for collaboration and one diffusion for action. We also introduce a connection module that generates conditions for the diffusion based on the output of the VLM. This module adjusts the observation by instructions to create reliable conditions. We train our framework with a two-stage knowledge-insulation strategy. First, we fine-tune the collaboration component using ambiguity-solving dialogue data to handle ambiguity. Then, we integrate the action component while freezing the collaboration one. This preserves the interaction abilities while fine-tuning the diffusion to generate actions. The training strategy guarantees our framework can first ask questions, then generate actions. During inference, a signal detector functions as a router that helps our framework switch between asking questions and taking actions. We evaluate the Ask-to-Clarify framework in 8 real-world tasks, where it outperforms existing state-of-the-art VLAs. The results suggest that our proposed framework, along with the training strategy, provides a path toward collaborative embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，使具身智能体通过多轮对话澄清模糊指令，然后端到端生成底层动作。框架包含一个VLM用于协作和一个扩散模型用于动作生成，通过两阶段知识绝缘训练策略保持交互能力并生成动作。在8个真实世界任务中，该框架超越了现有最先进的VLA方法。
Motivation: 当前大多数基于VLA的具身智能体只能单向接收指令并执行，无法处理指令模糊性，限制了它们在真实场景中的应用。
Method: 提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，包含协作VLM和动作扩散模型，通过连接模块将VLM输出转换为扩散条件。采用两阶段知识绝缘训练：先微调VLM处理歧义对话数据，然后冻结VLM微调扩散模型。推理时使用信号检测器作为路由器在提问和行动间切换。
Result: 在8个真实世界任务上，该框架优于现有最先进的VLA方法，具体性能提升未在摘要中量化。
Conclusion: 该框架和训练策略为实现具有协作能力的具身智能体提供了路径，但摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 5
